abstract: Considering many constraints in practical application of container ship, a hybrid genetic algorithm for the optimized cargo stowage problem with a variety of goods in a single container was presented. Firstly this paper presents a mathematical model for the cargo stowage problem, then, describes the solving method of hybrid a genetic algorithm in detail. It could avoid the Genetic Algorithm's precocity to a certain degree, and enhance the ability of local search.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation Index System for Supply Chain Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new index system for measuring the supply chain risk in the basis of previous research. The system framework is presented by: self risk, cooperation risk and system risk. By using this new index system, supply chain enterprise can evaluate its supply chain risk, and take corresponding measures to avoid uncertain risk.

articleTitle: Multi-Tactics to Enable Better Internal Control by Information System Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On account of new challenges to internal control of companies in IT intensive environment, it is necessary to enable internal control through information system integration. According to literatures ISI fosters an enabling approach to management control in terms of each of the four design characteristics which are repair, internal transparency, global transparency, and flexibility. Effective internal control system is not only a technical issue, but also a managerial issue. This literature demonstrated how to set and optimize a technique-managerial embedded internal control system. ISI through ERP is an enabling approach to control allowing for a more sound solution of both technical and managerial aspect. The integrated information architecture underlying ISI will foster the four design characteristics underlying an enabling approach to control therefore optimize internal control system through system integration, good information and communication, business process reengineering and IT techniques itself.

articleTitle: Autonomous Segmentation of Liver MR Image
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is a matter of difficulty for a segmentation of liver Magnetic Resonance image because of the infiltrations among the internal organs and their individual differences. Based on the previous research, an Iterative Quadtree Decomposition (IQD) algorithm is put forward to obtain a autonomous segmentation result through quadtree decomposition, regional morphology operation and ordering of ROI. The segmentation difficulties of the convex or concave part of the liver image and its boundary are overcome by IDQ. The segmentation result demonstrates the feasibility of the approach and lays foundation for future extraction of tumour.

articleTitle: The Construction and Promotion of a Vocational Training Platform of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article analyzed the present demands on e-commerce talent in our country, and the present situation of talent training. This paper summarizes the significance of the establishment, function and realized methods of the platform, and it points that this platform will integrate the needs of the talent and the needs of students' vocational training, which will achieve the win-win purpose. Finally, this paper expounds the promotion strategy of the platform.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Zero Time Sales Logistics in Pingyu Coal Company
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper first analyses the problems of Pingyu Coal Company in the sales logistics system and process, such as low informatization and laggard customer management notion. Then zero time theory is introduced to develop the new concept of zero time sales logistics (ZTSL) and three strategies are proposed to support the ZTSL objective, including instant management, instant response and instant value alignment strategy. The contribution of this paper is the development of concept ZTSL and the implement strategies for Coal Company in the perspective of customer oriented.

articleTitle: Research on Product-Based Method of Process Planning Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To enhance the productivity, effectiveness and consistency of process plans in small and medium enterprise, the classification of process planning knowledge is studied and a product-based method of process planning knowledge management is proposed. Process planning knowledge can be viewed through three perspectives: hierarchical view of information vs. knowledge, tacit vs. explicit, and individual vs. collective. The explicit knowledge, which can be converted to structured process planning information, includes process plan cases, process resource, process decision-making knowledge, established standards and processing handbook. The tacit knowledge existing in individual, about specific production environment and decision making, can be converted to semi-structured or unstructured information. A framework of a process planning knowledge management system is constructed. A BOM-based representation of process planning case knowledge is proposed to integrate process plan information and related process design experience of process planners.

articleTitle: Application of Component-Based Permission Control in MIS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RBAC is the model of "strategies neutral". It has not given a specific definition on permission. The essence of permission is open and it can be defined according to different applications and security strategies. By analyzing the features of management information system based on B/S, the permission in web applications has been tessellated and the concept of "component" has been put forward in this paper. Furthermore, a novel Component-Based Permission Control Scheme is given and it can realize the permission control of the RBAC model in management information system based on web. So, the advantages of RBAC model can be took better.

articleTitle: The Impact of Order Smoothing on the Performance of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper considers a single-echelon supply chain where a retailer holds an inventory to satisfy a customer demand and faces an external supplier who has a fixed supply capacity. It proposes an inventory replenishment policy that uses "order smoothing" to reduce order-size variability and reduce the total costs, including order cost and inventory cost. It studies two smoothing replenishment policies, generalized order-up-to policy and two-period moving average policy. It analyzes the impact of smoothing parameters, fixed supply capacity, and initial inventory on the performance of supply chain. Our analysis shows that order smoothing policies can reduce the total costs.

articleTitle: Decay Estimates of Global Solutions for Some Model Equation Long Wave in Nonlinear Dispersion
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The initial-boundary value problem for a class of inhomogeneous BBM equations with nonlinear term |u|<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">¿-2</sup>u is studied. For some range of parameter ¿ value, The decay estimates of the global solutions for this problem are proved by means of Sobolev inequality.

articleTitle: A Multi-Volume Visualization Framework for Spatial Aligned Volumes after 3D/3D Image Registration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method for the visualization of spatial aligned volumes after 3D/3D image registration is presented in this paper. This work aims at displaying the full information of the multi-volume in the same scene. First, we form a vectorial volume from the spatial aligned multi-volume. Then, a statistical vectorial volume classification method based on neighborhood weighted Gaussian mixture model is applied to analyze the vectorial volume and get material distribution information. Finally, several rendering techniques are adapted to visualize the parameters. We imply an application case: the visualization of preoperative kidney planning system to express our visualization method, but this method is not limited to the specific application case. According to the levels where the data intermixing occurs, our method mix the data at the earliest level so that it is called the acquisition level intermixing method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Cross-Diamond Search Algorithm for Fast Block Motion Estimation in H.264
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Motion estimation plays a key role in the H.264. It is the most computationally intensive module. In this paper, we proposed a novel adaptive cross-diamond search (ACDS) algorithm for fast block motion estimation in H.264. The proposed algorithm adaptively chooses different search pattern according to the seven types of macro block division in H.264 and the motion vector distribution characteristics of video sequence. Experimental results show that the proposed ACDS algorithm is much faster than the UMHexagonS algorithm, whereas similar prediction quality is still maintained.

articleTitle: Application of GIS in Water Pollutant Capacity Total Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The capacity total control, in the field of water pollution prevent, is more effective than the traditional mandatory total control. In this article, GIS was applied into the capacity total control of water pollutant. Using the ArcSDE technology, a spatial geodatabase that included many kinds of spatial information and attribute data was built. Based on it, a spatial model system of the water pollutant capacity total control (WPCTC) under GIS was developed by the redevelopment in Delphi, VBA and ArcGIS environment. By applying many types of GIS functions, such as buffer analyzing, linear referencing and spatial distance measuring etc, this model system could greatly increase the efficiency and precision of the total control, and had the characteristic of visibility.

articleTitle: The Research on Multi-Strategy Course Scheduling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The timetabling problem is a NP-complete problem which has been committed to finding a solution by the field of operations research and computer but has not got a good solution. The timetabling is the most important problem in the course scheduling. With the development of disciplines, the change of the size and direction of enrollment, increasing the difficulty of the Course Scheduling. This paper raised a Multi-strategy Course Scheduling Algorithm which based on Greedy Algorithm, Genetic Algorithm and Taboo Search, in order to effectively alleviate the shortage of classroom resources, time conflicts and other issues. The experimental results show that this method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A Trustworthy Network Fault Diagnosis Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Trustworthy network fault diagnosis approach is one critical management item to enhance network trustworthiness. Aiming at gaining highly trustworthy of fault diagnosis in Internet, we present a trustworthy fault diagnosis approach based on integration of Artificial Neural Network and Rule-based Reasoning. Supported by the topology of hierarchical and distributed in multi-domains, reasoning rule matrix and its operation are studied to acquire parallel reasoning capability. Moreover, the quantitative trustworthy degree is defined and information entropy is applied to define threshold function marked on arcs and nodes in the Artificial Neural Network. Our approach possesses higher parallel capability guaranteeing by matrix operation and trustworthiness by trustworthy degree definition and calculation using Artificial Neural Network. Further, it is general so that it can be transplanted into various application fields.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of City's Undertake Capability of Offshore Software Outsourcing in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Offshore software outsourcing is a hot topic in the services outsourcing field. Based on the study of existing literature, and take city's undertake capability of offshore software outsourcing as its research object, this paper sets up a comprehensive evaluation system, 30 quantitative and qualitative indexes were selected from three aspects of a undertake city, including industrial competitiveness, competitiveness of human resources and basic environment. This paper evaluates the undertake capability of offshore software outsourcing of Nanking, Wuxi, Suzhou and Changzhou by weighted principal component TOPSIS value function model. And on the basis of evaluation results, some important suggestions and strategies are presented on upgrading cities undertake capability of offshore software outsourcing.

articleTitle: Optimal Model of Assets and Liabilities Management Considering Interest Risk and Time Structure Risk
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the duration gap and immunity conditions are used to control the interest rate risk and protect the equity rights. By using the time structure matching of assets-liabilities to control the time structure risk, the optimal model of assets and liabilities portfolio is established. The contributions of this paper lie on two aspects: firstly, it controls the liquidity risk through the time matching of asset and liability, so as to solve the problem of bank run resulting from shortage of liquidity; secondly, it introduces the interest rate structure symmetry into the optimization of bank assets portfolio.

articleTitle: The Financing Problems of Chinese SMEs under the Global Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Small and Medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) play a very important role in Chinese economy. The global financial crisis has brought both positive and negative impact on SMEs. It forced SMEs to rethink their growth models and future plans. However, the biggest problems Chinese SMEs are confronting now are financing difficulties. In order to solve the issue, it needs the support from the banking system as well as the capital market. Moreover, if Chinese SMEs want to turn the financial crisis into an opportunity, they should also restructure their businesses and build greater brand recognition and customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Identifying Model of Industry Clusters Life Cycle Based on RS-ANN
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of integration of rough sets (RS) and RBF Artificial neural network (ANN), a model is constructed to identify the industry clusters life cycle. Firstly, the continuous attribute values are discretized using fuzzy clustering algorithm based on maximum discernibility value (MDV) search method and information entropy. And then the major attributes are reduced by rough sets. At last, taking 138 industry clusters as samples, the RBF neural network is trained with training samples and life cycle stages of testing samples are identified. The empirical results show that the fuzzy clustering algorithm based on MDV and information entropy can improve the discretization performance effectively, and the integration model of rough sets and neural network, the predicting precision of which is high, is an efficient and practical tool to identify industry clusters life cycle.

articleTitle: Creation of Spatial Information Service Semantic Topology Description Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on analyzing the service semantic description model, the paper concludes it dynamic that the relationship between services constructed presently. So when executing a static service combination, it needs a dynamic matching process; and with a dynamic service combination, it will form a complicated performing mode of dynamic service re-matching. In connection with/Aiming at this defect, a new spatial information service semantic description model is proposed in this paper, and the static topology can be established on this model, with purpose of improving the speed and performing efficiency of the service combination and matching.

articleTitle: The Relationships between Perceived Residential Environment Quality and Perceived Restoration in Urban Residents
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The aim of this paper is to explore the relationships between perceived residential environment quality and perceived restoration and analyze which components of residential environments has restorative value for Ningbo city, China. Data were mainly drawn from a questionnaire survey to the residents of Ningbo focusing on their residential environment and perceived restoration. The author analyzed the validation of factorial structures through Confirmatory Factor Analysis technique and which components of residential environments have restorative value through structure equation model analysis. The conclusions of study present that architectural and urban planning spaces and Recreational services were important indicators to promote residents' perceived residential environment quality in urban areas. Moreover, strengthening a spatial and functional planning can raise people's emotional bonding to residential environment and furthermore, perceived their restorations. The results of this research can give direction to the development and improvement of residential environment for Chinese city planning, and furthermore can contribute to other city in China.

articleTitle: An Design of the 16-Order FIR Digital Filter Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At first, this paper analyzes the basic structure and hardware characteristics of the FIR digital filter, and then a design method of the FIR filter is discussed on the basis of the FIR filter structure. It is a method that is based on FPGA, draws the coefficient by Matlab and adopts the pipeline to implete the FIR digital filter. The article focuses on the introduction of the overall framework of the FIR digital filter adopting the finite-state machine as well as the principle of each module of the design. The design is impleted by use of the Verilog hardware description language and each module is verified and simulated by Quartus 8.0 and Modelsim-Altera.

articleTitle: Extracting Domain-Specific Concepts to Enhance Search Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many users often perform searches in unfamiliar domains and these search experiences are often unsatisfactory since the users are lack of domain-specific knowledge. In this paper, we present a concept based retrieval method to deal with domain-specific searches. Three groups of domain-specific concepts are extracted from the online resource. The following experiments on three domain-specific test collections show that this approach is effective in improving domain-specific search accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Programmable Power Signal Source Based on DDS Technique
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the petroleum logging signal, the direct digital synthesis technique was applied to produce the logging exciting signal, to realize accuracy control of output signal frequency and phase. The integrated power amplification technique was used to produce the signals of high power, and power tracing technique was also used to lower the dissipation of power devices, and to improve the circuit working efficiency. With USB bus technologies the signal can be real-time controlled, the signal parameters can be real-time monitored. The results show that the output frequency of signal source is 0.01Hz ~250 kHz, frequency resolution 0.004Hz, phase resolution 0.002rad, frequency stability Â±5x10^-6 per hour, output voltage scale Â±75V, output current â‰¤6A, output power 400W. And the signal source was successfully applied in the study of the cased hole resistivity logging technique and the three-component induction logging technique.

articleTitle: The Research and Design of a Model on Pipe Network Offline Editing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Offline Editing is an effective way to manage multi-user operations in long transaction at present. The realization of offline editing is divided to there parts, which are data modules, work flow and related technologies, based on its principle and modes, and they are discussed in this paper. The author introduces an "Optimistic Concurrency" mode of offline editing, and mainly talk about the management of pipe network data, that is a data set with topological relation including entities in several types like point and line. Work flow is the whole process of a long transaction, and in this process an offline editing operation is completed with the steps of checking out, designing, submitting, checking, and checking in. The key steps and related technologies in the work flow are detailed in the article, and the description comes down to the crucial arithmetic and technologies of cutting down the data, maintaining the topological relation as checking in or checking out updates, solving the conflicts caused by concurrent operations and transferring the task files. There is an example to show the application of this model in the scene of updating mobile data with technologies such as offline editing and formats transform of files for storing at last.

articleTitle: Vibration Signals De-Noising Based on a New Wavelet Packet Threshold Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article analyses the wavelet packet threshold de-noising method on vibration signals. Several thresholds and threshold functions are introduced. This paper puts forward a new threshold function, which overcomes the shortcomings of the hard-threshold method with discontinuous function. At the same time, this new function overcomes the shortcoming there is an invariable dispersion. It proves that this method can de-noise the vibration signals more effectively both theoretically and practically.

articleTitle: Research and Exploration of Mechanism for Reconfigurable Multi-Cluster System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-cluster system has been a popular platform for HPC (high performance computing) environments. But it is lack of flexibility and usability, especially for the vehicle-bone and mobile parallel computation. To solve the problem, we propose a reconfigurable mechanism for the management of multi-cluster system in this paper. The concept of reconfiguration is that the structure of the multi-cluster system could change dynamically, including addition and quit of clusters. According to this, we analyze the key issues and design the reconfigurable mechanism by two aspects, including the architecture and the cases of the mechanism. Then some policies are proposed to achieve it, which are accomplished by aggregation algorithm and optimized Bully algorithm. This mechanism increases the flexibility of HPC environments.

articleTitle: A Semantic Architecture for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a conceptual architecture with Semantic Web technologies and Web Service is introduced for the e-commerce applications. Semantic web technologies are used to provide more machine understandable data and effective services finding and dynamic composing. With this architecture, e-commerce applications with semantic-services will be more effective and useable for future.

articleTitle: Voiceprint Verification Based on Two-Level Decision HMM-UBM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Voiceprint recognition is a new technology of biology authentication, and the most important task of it is to reduce both the false rejection rate (FRR) and false acceptation rate (FAR). To build a highly reliable voiceprint recognition system, this paper proposes three novel methods: two-level decision based on HMM-UBM, Model Distance and Dynamic Threshold. The evaluation results demonstrated that our methods had good performance.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation on Intelligence Frequency Tracking Model of Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Studying on the series resonance, we would establish a frequency Tracking model of first-order phase-locked loop and describe the realization of the model by the theory of phase-locked loop. With this model in the resonant transformation of resonant converter, we have succeeded in intelligence frequency Tracking and let the loop absolutely work in the inductive load with minimum loss, minimum heat, the highest conversion efficiency etc.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Thermal Economic Analysis for Turbine's Sliding Pressure Operation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Research of a Wide Tuning Range CMOS VCO
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper provides a structure of a wide tuning center frequency range VCO (Voltage Controlled Oscillator). The VCO is completed on the base of oscillation theory and negative resistance structure. This circuit has a high stability of output voltage amplitude and can oscillate in a great range of frequencies.

articleTitle: The High-Frequency Electromagnetic Field Scattering Analysis by Calling ANSYS Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method is introduced to realize the calling of simulation analysis programs designed by ANSYS's parametric design language APDL in MATLAB. The procedures are illustrated by a practical example in which MATLAB calls ANSYS to create the high-frequency electromagnetic field finite element simulation model, applies the loads and the boundary conditions, and achieved the simulation of a medium column scattering effect analysis under a plane wave incident. The obtained data and images show the transmission characteristic of electromagnetic wave. The results can be conveniently calling and processing by MATLAB. A good platform is built by this method for data transmission and interactive use between MATLAB and ANSYS. Some key commands and steps are explained in the paper.

articleTitle: An Approach Based on Reverse Hidden Markov Model for Audio Classification
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, with more and more multimedia data being captured and stored, the searching and indexing techniques for multimedia data are getting more attention in the area of multimedia databases. As many research works were done on the content-based retrieval of image and video data, less attention was received to the content-based retrieval of audio data. As one of important parts in audio retrieval, audio classification is discussed in this paper. The reverse Hidden Markov Model is introduced and an approach based on reverse Hidden Markov Model for audio classification is presented. Experiments show that this method is effective.

articleTitle: The Study of The Denoising and the Trend Extraction Method of Signal
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the capability of orthogonal wavelet transform in de-noise and trend extract function of EMD, a new noise filter and trend extraction model is built up. Then, simulated data is used to test the method. The following conclusions are drawn from these tests: (1) Orthogonal wavelet transform and EMD method can better mitigate the random errors which hide in periodic signal; (2) For signal with linear trend, Orthogonal wavelet transform filtering method is superior to EMD. (3) For signal with nonlinear trend, theoretic analysis and simulation results show that the new noise filter and trend extraction model is superior to EMD and to union simply wavelet and EMD method. This method greatly improves accuracy of the extracted deformation.

articleTitle: Application of Independent Component Analysis in Denoising the Instantaneous Signals
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a new approach of blind source separation (BSS), independent component analysis (ICA) is a recently developed method in which the processed objects are mixed signals from linear combination of the original data, and the goal is to separate the source from the mixtures and the components separated are statistically independent, or as independent as possible. The ICA method are used in communication, sound and image processing, biology medicine, earthquake signals processing, even the finance date analysis etc. At present, the application domain of ICA is taken on end on end the enlarged trend. In the paper, the basic theory and algorithm of ICA are briefly introduced, and then the simulation instantaneous signals are denoised. The five signals such as two sines sweep signals and one-sine signals and one sawtooth wave signals and one stochastic noise are mixed together, and then the mixed signals are separated with ICA. The results show that the five signals can be exactly separated with ICA, and the ICA method has high ability to separate the instantaneous signals from their mixtures, consequently providing an effective technology for the pretreatment of signals to fault diagnosis of mechanical equipment.

articleTitle: Study on Marine On-Line Analysis WebGIS System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Geographic Information System (GIS)has a wide range of applications in many areas. The project "the Bohai Sea ecological environment real-time monitoring demonstration system" uses the ships which carries the fast observation system, the ecology buoyage, the submarine automatic inspection station, and other monitoring measures to carries on the monitoring to the Bohai Sea ecological environmental conditions. This paper discusses the application of marine environmental protection on-line analysis webgis system, the paper explains how to take WebGIS and other information technology as the technical support, established the internet website of marine information system based on the ArcIMS platform. It can intellectualized gain monitors of the environment information, and can draw the information products such as the plane distribution map, time series form and curve, form, data file, stick plot or cake chart of the marine monitoring data on net, to satisfies each kind of users.

articleTitle: Linking GIS and Computable General Equilibrium Model for Studying Resource Supply
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The strength of model link lies in analyzing spatial data and generating useful information. The linked model have a quantitative specification essentially like empirically based models: statistical models provide high degrees of precision and specified levels of sensitivity and reliability. It also hoped to solve some problems encountered by empirically based approaches through behavioral parameter ascertain process, then send back to GIS, therefore, can reveal important new information that leads to better decision-making.

articleTitle: A Model for Representing Topological Relations between Regions with Holes
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a unified model-D9-intersection model to represent topological relations between regions with holes. D9-intersection model can describe simple regional relations as accurately as 9-intersection model. When holes are allowed, D9-intersection model can distinguish relations that 9-intersection could not and then be more expressive than 9-intersection model. In addition, we present the reasoning method based on D9-intersection model restricting to regions with at most one hole.

articleTitle: Improve Precision of Time-of-Flight: Principle and Structures
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The accuracy of ranging is dominated by the precision of time-of-flight in the pulsed laser ranging. And the higher accuracy cannot be reached by boosting the clock frequency, because of electron bottleneck. A method is proposed in this paper, which can improve the precision by means of counting phase-shifted clocks. Its principle and structures are described primarily.

articleTitle: A Simplification Algorithm of Regular Grammar Production
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Production quality of regular grammar influences the efficiency of lexical analysis. The paper puts up a new algorithm, in which can get more simple production equal to grammar for given right (left) liner grammar. Firstly, translate grammar production's simplification into the renovation of finite automata. Then, make the string length of each arc is small than 2 by algorithm about automata. At last, verify the transition process with an instance.

articleTitle: Corner Detector Algorithm for Colour Image with Highlights and Shadows
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traditional curvature scale space(CSS) corner detection algorithms did not differentiate various physical causes of image differential structure, therefore these algorithms could not detect corners correctly in color image with shadows and highlights. According to the problem above mentioned, dichromatic reflection model was applied to differentiate image differential structure and multi scale localization and multi scale detection algorithm was improved. Finally new dichromatic reflection model based CSS algorithm was proposed. Experimental results showed that the new algorithm could detect the corner of the objects in image with highlights and shadows correctly, while traditional algorithm obtained many false corners. The new algorithm is better than the traditional algorithms in performance.

articleTitle: A Role and Task-Based Workflow Dynamic Authorization Modeling and Enforcement Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Current workflow products can support more complex modeling of business processes, workflow engine mechanism is well researched, but the link between organizational elements and process activities is less well understood. In access control, most products can only support fixed role-based task assignment, not enough in considering more complex security policies, such as DSOD, task binding of duties, and temporal constraints, that important in dynamic workflow system. This paper examines workflow access control requirement in practice, analyzes WFMC workflow meta-model, and adopts the R&TBAC approach to separate role-based organization and task-based authorization-step modeling, and especially designs an agent-based dynamic policy enforcement mechanism to bridge the gap. The intelligent task assigning agent to be defined as a virtual participant in workflow process definition, and creating within workflow engine controlled available task instance, acts as to evaluate task dynamic authorization policy to provide eligible task participant role-set based on its information model. This paper gives a formal specification of the workflow authorization model, and designs the agent information model, assigning policy model, and function model in detail. The modeling approach can widely adapt to various existing workflow systems and can automatically change policy as enterprise organization or business process definition need changing.

articleTitle: A Service Path Finding and Recovery Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new way to study reliability-based service composition. First, an interference model is proposed to quantitatively characterize and measure the interference. Then, based the model, we present a minimum interference service composition and recovery algorithms (MISCR) by exploiting the local path recovery and reliable service paths. The experimental results show that our model and algorithms can achieve much better performance than the traditional methods in finding service paths, with respect to decreasing the interference to end users.

articleTitle: Research and System Development on the Model of Construction Safety Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper discusses the situation and characteristics of construction safety, and further researches advanced model of construction safety management from the perspective of informatization. The structure of management information system of construction is presented, which is based on analyzing and studying to a large number of documentation, including the experience of construction management and the model of risk control management. Then the computer program of management information system is developed, which realizes the functions of hazard management, management and evaluation of risk, accident prevention, safety precaution. It is of practical value for application.

articleTitle: Application Research on Method for Data Format Transformation on Road Informationization of Jilin City Based on SuperMap
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Approach to transfer data format from CAD to GIS is researched. The method based on SuperMap, which is considered better by being analyzed the data format transformation method based ArcGIS, FME, GEOWAY and SuperMap, can maintain the geometric element integrality, support adding the attribute data of GIS, and support the data format of China GIS software. The method for data format transformation from CAD to GIS based on SuperMap is studied, while the study object is the CAD data of transport infrastructure provided from Jilin City. The application result shows that the method for data format transformation from CAD to GIS based on SuperMap can realize the data format transformation work better, such as the transformation of geometric elements, coordinate system conversion, layer alignment, layer topology processing and layer label.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm Base on How to Use the Least Vectors to Another Vector
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel algorithm, which can be used to resolve the problem that how to use the least vectors in vector space, expresses the known vector, was proposed in this paper. Compared with MP (matching pursuit) algorithm, the new algorithm has less errors and more exactly than MP algorithm of the lower dimension. By this novel algorithm, the vectors was cut off first, so it can be expressed by simple vector, and then extended these vectors. The novel algorithm is better than MP algorithm, for MP algorithm just closed infinitely, and cannot be exactly to express the known vector.

articleTitle: Risk Calculation Based on Source and Destination of Attack Events
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Network risk assessment has become a hot topic in the area of network security research in recent years. Risk Calculation in the risk assessment is a very important part. Some methods have been presented to resolve this problem. These methods have strengths and drawbacks. In order to achieve more actual risk assessment result of network system, this paper proposed a new network risk calculation method based on Source and Destination of attack events, the two risks to determine whether the event is a alert from two different aspects in order to reflect the security of the entire network. At the end, through the experimental results with DARPA Data sets 2000 from Lincoln laboratory, it demonstrates the potential of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improve Wireless Application System Authentication Security by Using ICA and Factorial Face Code
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we use the independent component analysis (ICA) and Factorial Face Code as an additional user identity checking method to strengthen the solidity of the wireless application system authentication security. The basic theory of ICA and factorial face code are presented firstly and then the main works of this method are detailed. After that an experiment based on this method is given. We use the face database down-loaded from the website of http://www.uk.research.att.com/ to buildup the basis images, get the user's factorial face code to encode the user's face and then check the user's identity to test the affectivity of this method by computing the user's factorial face code with different expressions. According to this experiment, we know that this method can confirm user's identity and can be an additional method to check wireless application system user identity. In order to improve the affectivity of this method, we should increase the amount of image data in the face database, getting more ICs and enlarging the size of the basic images set. All this will increase the length of the factorial face code, and subsequently will differentiate one person from another more easily.

articleTitle: Software Diffusion Analysis Based on Multi-Agent Simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: New product diffusion is a form of technological diffusion. Nowadays, Software, as a virtual product, has its own characteristics and behaviors. Once, software has the same channels along with other real goods, but with the internet's development, software's diffusion channels have be changed, each person can download and buy them on internet. In this paper, we used a simulation way to study software diffusion, and according to the epidemics' idea, a multi-agent simulation model has been established to do the simulation experiments with AnyLogic, with the simulation result and sensitivity analysis, it is drawn that, it is sensitive in software diffusion process for many rates, especially the word of mouth's impact; positive word of mouth can make more potential users change into users, and negative word of mouth affected the software's diffusion significantly, so software enterprises should control word of mouth's spread, especially the nonusers' negative word of mouth's spread.

articleTitle: The Research of Mobile Communication and Internet Interface Technology Based on WAP
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mobile communication and Internet are the backbone of present information industry. With the implementation of 3G, both integrated has become the direction in the future. This paper aims at the technology between Mobile Communication Network and Internet interface technology, focuses on the analyze and design of the interface based on WAP, as well as gives an example to justify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Parameter Configuration Method For IEEE 802.11e Fairness and Channel Utilization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to different AIFS and CWmin, IEEE 802.11e can provide different priority to different levels of service operations to ensure high-priority QoS. In order to get a balance of fairness and optimization, a new parameter configuration method for IEEE 802.11e is proposed in this paper, meanwhile a validate analysis is done by NS2, and simulation shows the feasibility adequately. Therefore, the research is of necessity to some extent.

articleTitle: Based on Modified Metropolis Dynamics Concrete CT Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, the architecture quality problem has been getting more and more attention. Concrete is a sort of savageness disfigurement material and is abroad in architecture industry. But concrete meso-structure has not been more analyzed. In this paper, we present a pseudo-stochastic variation of the Metropolis dynamics for combinatorial optimization in concrete CT image classification using Markov Random Fields. Experimental results are compared to those obtained by the Metropolis algorithm, the Gibbs sampler and ICM (Iterated Conditional Mode). Classify result indicate that using MMD can reflect the interior spatial distribution of the concrete materials on deformation, and afford an effective method on concrete meso-structure CT image study.

articleTitle: The Study of the Relationship between Organizational Justice and Job Satisfaction on Y-Generation in Chinese IT Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Research on job satisfaction of employees has always been a hot spot in Human Resource Management. This study examined the relationship between three forms of organizational justice and job satisfaction on Post-'80 generation employees in Chinese IT industry. Survey data were collected from 198 IT personnel employed coming from ten IT enterprises in two cities of China via a combination of mail survey and paper questionnaire. Bivariate analysis revealed that there were significantly relationship between three forms of organizational justice and job satisfaction. The further hierarchical regression results supported a main effects model of the distributive justice and procedural justice to job satisfaction. Implications of the research findings are discussed.

articleTitle: A New Method of Software Security Checking Based on Similar Feature Tree
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to optimize the fault feature database(FFD) and to improve the checking efficiency of software fault, in this paper, a novel method of software security checking based on similar feature tree(SFT) is proposed. All of fault feature patterns in FFD are considered as nodes of SFT. SFT is a special binary tree in which the left child of each node is a super-pattern of the node and the right child is a brother-pattern of the node. An improved K-modes clustering algorithm and association rules are used to construct SFT. According to the characteristics of association rules, if a fault feature which is obtained by program slicing from software procedure can't successfully matches to root of SFT, then it matches to the right child of the root. Otherwise the fault feature matches to the left child of the root. This process is iterated according to "even left not right" rule until leaf node in right sub-tree or no node can be successfully matched in left sub-tree. Finally, the checking result is given by SFT. Experimental results show that our method has higher efficiency of software fault checking.

articleTitle: A High Performance Quotes System for Bulk Commodities Exchange Market
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: One of the important design goals of electronic quotation system is to carry out high-speed data transmission while controlling the consumption of server-side computation resources and network bandwidth resources. Different from other exchange markets (e.g. stock market), bulk-commodity exchange market is characterized by fewer varieties of future contracts and more focus on single future contract. As inadequate attention has been paid to the market characteristics during the design stage for most existing bulk quotation systems, these systems are faced with such problems as huge uneconomic resource consumption and significant data transmission delay, and the design goals are difficult to realize. As novel quotation system architecture, HSQuotes employs separated channel, broadcast long-connection model and compressed HTTP short-connection model as well as other technologies to perform classified data storage and high-speed transmission. HSQuotes has been successfully applied to dozens of bulk-commodity exchange markets including steel, chemical industry, port trade and stock index futures, etc., and exhibits the characteristics of reliability, stability and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Method of Weapon Equipment Based on LS-SVM with Parameters Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In efficiency analysis of weapon system, in order to achieve and represent the preferences of decision maker and make the most optimum selection, an efficiency evaluation method of weapon equipment based on LS-SVM with parameters optimization is proposed. Firstly, the principle of efficiency evaluation method based on LS-SVM is discussed. Secondly, to learn samples from the MADM problem extractly, an approach to estimate the utility functions for attributes is presented. An optimal selection approach of LS-SVM parameters (¿, ¿) was put forward based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. Finally, the implementation algorithm of efficiency evaluation method based on LS-SVM with parameters optimization is presented. The proposed method is simple and reliable with less number of parameters, comparing with SVM. In the end, an example is quoted to demonstrate that the method is feasible and available.

articleTitle: A Phylogenetic Tree Constructing Method Based on Ant Colony Partitioning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method for constructing phylogenetic trees from a given set of objects (proteins, species, etc.) is presented. The method bisects the set of gene sequences so that the sequences within one subset have most similarity, and the gene sequences between different subsets have most difference. Recursively repeating such bisecting until procedure until all the subsets contains only one gene sequence. With these subsets, a phylogenetic tree is progressively constructed where the leaves are the gene sequences. Each level of bisecting is based on an extension of ant colony optimization for traveling salesman problem. Experimental results show that our algorithm is easier to implement and more efficient. It can convergence faster and obtain higher quality results than other methods.

articleTitle: Analysis on Starting Probability of Pseudo-Random Binary-Phase-Coded Fuze under Noise AM Jamming
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The impact of noise AM jamming on starting probability of pseudo-random binary-phase-coded fuze (PRBPCF) is researched in this paper. Analysis model of the starting probability is set up, and the starting probability of the PRBPCF is deduced under noise AM jamming. Factors influencing the starting probability are discussed. The simulation results show that the starting probability is affected not only by jamming to signal ratio (JSR) of reaching receiver and interference bandwidth, but by pseudo-random code period, code-element width, receiver bandwidth, Doppler frequency, and comparator threshold. The starting probability of fuze is an important anti-interference performance indicator, anti-interference performance of fuze can be assessed by studying it.

articleTitle: Echo and Background Music Canceler by Using Smart Acoustic Room System for Car Hand-Free Telephone
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new structure of echo and background music canceler by using Smart Acoustic Room (SAR) system for car hand-free telephone is presented. In this system, echo and background music canceler are combined together just using one microphone. That is, the sound signal from loudspeakers of car will be diminished at the microphone position of the hand-free telephone. This is realized by robust estimation algorithm for well control of the acoustic impulse responses in car. Therefore, unwanted background music and echo signals are canceled while the hand-free telephone receiving the speaker's voice. In other words, people at far-end will not hear the background sound and echo signal from the near-end room. The computer simulation results support the theoretical findings and verify the robustness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: WebGIS and Models Integration in an Evaluation System for Heavy Metals in Farmland Soils
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the spatial-temporal database of soil heavy metals, integrating open source WebGIS, spatial interpolation models and soil heavy metal pollution evaluation models, a WebGIS-based evaluation system for heavy metals in farmland soils (FSHMEGIS) is developed with ASP.NET, JavaScript and HTML. The construction of FSHMEGIS is divided into two parts: heavy metals database and models system. The database consists of sample measured data, spatial data and metadata. The Model system covers single index evaluation models, comprehensive evaluation models, and spatial interpolation models. The FSHMEGIS includes four primary modules named as sample data acquisition, sample data evaluation, regional simulation, and metadata browsing, respectively. Combining sample monitoring data with GIS data, spatial analysis and relevant modeling process are conducted. FSHMEGIS can be used for the on-line sharing, evaluation and consultant service of soil heavy metal information.

articleTitle: Research on Issues of Critical Mass in IT Competition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Information Technology (IT) has a typical characteristic of network externalities. This characteristic makes the IT competition not only depend on its own function of technology, but also on whether the consumer volume can meet the critical mass or not, which will trigger off the mechanism of positive feedback. This paper extends the Ronald Shone's diffusion model, gives the computing formula of critical mass, and unveils the role of technology's function, network externalities, and compatibility in IT competition.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: The Key Technology Research of the Interoperability in the Digitizing Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To setup the multi-discipline digital design in the uniform platform, this paper proposed to build the interoperability architecture between CAD platform and the other digital platforms for designers. Because of the difference of the discipline and the digital platform belong to the same discipline, the hierarchy of shared ontology and local ontology is designed. The shared ontology describes the interoperability set of special discipline. The local ontology describes the interoperability of the special platform in a certain discipline. The function ontology was encapsulated by the OWL-S (Ontology web language-Service) and the data ontology was encapsulated by the XSD and XML. The XSLT technology was used to implement the transformation between the shared ontology and local ontology. This method to implement the interoperability can be used to on the interoperability between the other digital platforms.

articleTitle: Image segmentation algorithm for cord fabric defects inspection based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In an online defects inspection system for cord fabric based on machine vision, Image segmentation for cord fabric defects has been the hot and difficult problem. An adaptive segmentation algorithm using threshold surface is presented in this paper. And this method which is a fast adaptive threshold surface constructing method based on column statistic is proposed. This method inspects defects through detecting the change of image gray levels caused by the difference in optic character between cord fabric and defects. And it is set up around the analysis of for cord image and the requirements of online inspection system such as reliability, real-time, and veracity. The experiment results indicate that the proposed method has low computation cost, fast speed and good segmentation performance. It is in accord with the requirements of online inspection system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The First Step Study of Sustainable Development for the City and Countryside Orchestrate to Experiment the Area Based on SIS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: New Method of Extracting Human SEP
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Object To use an auto-reference, auto-correlative and adaptive interference cancellation theories and techniques (AAA-ICT) to extract the human somatosensory evoked potential(SEP). Methods: The electrical stimulation signals were used to stimulate the body surface of human wrist median nerve. The stimulus signals are single-pulse square wave signals. We use the surface electrode on scalp to extract the SEP. The extracted signals are processed by the AAA-ICT. Results: The single trial SEPs and their averaging SEPs were obtained. Conclusions: The SEP extracted by AAA-ICT avoids the defect of the traditional averaging theories, could be able to get the variance feature, so can be provide new signs for diagnosing and differentially diagnosing certain neurological or psychological disorders.

articleTitle: Vibration Simulation of Commercial Vehicle Suspension System and Its Active Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering one type of commercial vehicle suspension system, a full multi-body model with twenty Degree of Freedom is established with MSC.ADAMS. After evaluating such parameters as stiffness and damping of the simulation model, the effects of outside exciting on the suspension system are analyzed based on the simulation results. The harmonic response of the mass center of the seat at model coordinate space provides reference for the general performance of the suspension system. Finally, the robust control method was introduced to track the position successfully. The simulation results verified the system modeling and control design.

articleTitle: Dense Stereo Matching Based on PCNN
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A key problem in stereo matching lies in selecting an appropriate window size. This paper presents a new method based on using small window for first-step matching and Pulse Coupled Neural Network for perfecting disparity maps. Our algorithm not only reflects the predominance that small window achieves sharper counter, but also gains accurate depth of the region with weak texture and reduces patches effectively. The experimental results indicate that this method could build dense disparity maps with high accuracy compared with common ways.

articleTitle: Low Power Nodes Revocation Scheme in Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to constrained energy in wireless sensor networks, how to reduce energy consumption of nodes revocation becomes the important target of security technology researches. A low-power distributed node revocation (LDNR) scheme was proposed in this paper. This scheme first generated vote keys and defined local vote members and non-local vote members. Secondly, this scheme checked a detected misbehaving node by having local vote members broadcasting local votes and made non-local vote members asleep for decreasing energy consumption. Thirdly, this paper analyzed transition states of vote members and relations between unit time duration of a revocation process and maximum time taken for a local-neighborhood broadcast. At last the performances of the LDNR scheme such as energy consumption and node life were simulated. The results show that LDNR scheme reduces energy consumption and prolongs the network life, while this scheme is flexible for various models of communication.

articleTitle: Blending Luminance Uniformity Matrix: A New Robust Photometric Calibration in Multi-Projector Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Large-scale displays as multi-projector systems are used in scientific visualization, virtual reality and other visually intensive applications. It always needs complicated photometric calibration in multi-projector systems. The most popular methods of photometric calibration can be generalized into two types: edge blending and LAM (luminance attenuation maps). Unfortunately, both these two methods have their drawbacks. In this paper, we provide a new method which combines the blending with luminance attenuation by slightly reducing the area of luminance attenuation in overlapped region, which efficiently solves the problem of "luminance inconsistency in the edge of overlapped region" in LAM and the problem of "un-global luminance uniformity" in blending. In addition, instead of finding the minimum common luminance value in the photometric calibration, we just find a more suitable common luminance value which can well solve the dim problem in camera-based photometric uniformity of prior approaches. Moreover, the process of photometric calibration on multi-projecting system will be no more complicated than before. The method is robust and accurate, and can be implemented with commercial off-the-shelf components.

articleTitle: Classification of Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Oral Cavity Using Wavelet Analysis and BP-Chaos Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: 66 samples from the human oral mucosa tissue were measured by confocal Raman microspectroscopy. A preprocessed algorithm based on wavelet analysis was used to reduce noise and eliminate background of Raman spectra firstly. Then the integrated areas of four normalised wavenumber regions 1004, 1156, 1360 1587 and 1660 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> were carried out for discrimination of the normal and malignant oral mucosa tissue samples. Lastly, by means of combining the improved BP algorithm and chaos optimization algorithm, an embedded BP-Chaos algorithm was proposed and successfully used as a classification method to identify whether the tissue is normal or not. This could result in a new diagnostic method, which would assist the early diagnosis of squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity.

articleTitle: Widely Linear Linearly Constrained CMA of Momentum and Dither Sign Error for CDMA Blind Multiuser Detection
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Motivated by the performance of linear minimum mean squared error (MMSE) multiuser receivers may be improved by widely linear (WL) processing, the algorithm convergence can be fastened by adding momentum, and the overall computational complexity of algorithm can be reduced by using the dither sign-error (DSE) formation, a WL DSE momentum linearly constrained constant modulus algorithm (WL-DSE-M-LCCMA) for the multi-access interferences (MAI) suppression in direct sequence code division multiple access (DS-CDMA) systems is proposed and analyzed in this paper. Simulations have confirmed that the proposed algorithm performs better in a DS-CDMA system by employing a BPSK modulation than other algorithms such as CMA, LCCMA, WL-LCCMA.

articleTitle: An Effective Method to Recognize BPSK Signal Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: BPSK communication has been widely applied into the military communication area because of its strong anti-jamming capability. Many researchers have studied the methods to recognize the BPSK signal. Based on the study of the modulation and recognition of the BPSK signal and the analysis of the wavelet transform, an suitable wavelet is selected, and an effective method to recognize BPSK signal based on the wavelet was present. The results of simulation tests show its good performance.

articleTitle: Graph Theory-Based Multi-Layer State Space Modeling Method of Complex System and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the characteristics of complex system, such as decomposability, complex internal connection, the paper researches multi-layer state space model, and further discusses a same level system mode with graph theory. Finally, it puts forward a multi-layer state space modeling way of complex system based on graph theory, and uses the way to complete a renewable energy statistical analysis model. The practice indicates the method can show commendably the complex system interior longitudinal level relations, and should have advantages to research the relations between the same granularity subsystems in complex system, and it can provide certain reference for further research complex system modeling.

articleTitle: A Study on Optimization of Management Mode of Ying-Rui Highway Construction Project of Jiangxi Province in China into Partnering
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through the analysis on status quo and problems of the Ying-rui Highway construction project management, this paper firstly discusses the necessity and possibility of the optimization of the project management mode into Partnering. Based on this, the paper offers suggestions for the optimization of the project management mode into Partnering, and these suggestions include clarifying obligation-authority-responsibility of each party, improving trust and cooperation, strengthening communication and coordination, optimizing motivation mode, and establishing risk management mechanism; further, the paper constructs the model of the optimization of Ying-rui Highway construction project management mode into Partnering.

articleTitle: An Incremental Sensor Deployment Strategy for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: One of fundamental issues in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) is sensor deployment, which affects the performance and effectiveness of WSNs. Sensor node redeployment is an efficient way to extend the lifetime of the network by deploying additional sensor nodes in the sensing region. In this paper, we formulate the event occurrence probability distribution of the redeployment problem in WSNs as Binomial Distribution rather than Uniform Distribution and use Bayesian Estimation to estimate the probability of each node's sensing area. In addition, we proposed a novel algorithm called MFCSB-static to solve the problem under static routing schemes. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm greatly outperforms the algorithm using Uniform Distribution (MFCSU-static) in the percentage of successfully predicting the earliest energy drain out node.

articleTitle: A New Approach for Image Registration in 3D Modeling
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Image registration is widely used in 3D modeling. In this paper, an approach for multiview image registration based on augmented Kalman filter is proposed. The position and orientation of viewpoint are considered as augmented system state vector. A simplified system state and two system models are constructed. The system state is augmented and updated recursively. The position and orientation of each viewpoint is estimated. The proposed multiview image registration method can handle the uncertainty efficiently and the registration result is globally consistent. Some experimental results are provided to validate the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Impact of Personality Traits on Perception of Relational Benefits: An Empirical Study in Service Context
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper explores the antecedent influencing factors of relationship benefits form the perspective of personality traits. Empirical study in service context shows that social affiliation has directly and positively impact on perception of confidence benefits and social benefits. Need for variety negatively influences the perception of confidence benefits and marginal negatively influences perception of special treatment benefits. The study also reveals that social benefits are positively related to special treatment benefits.

articleTitle: Research on Capacity Planning Model of Supply Chain Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because of current strong globalization trend, manufacturers and planners are more willing to cooperate in many aspects such as purchasing, production, planning and so on. Accordingly, capacity planning of supply chain should also be done in order to maximize the overall interests of supply chain. Firstly, the difference between capacity planning of supply chain and traditional capacity planning is studied. Then a whole framework for capacity planning system is proposed. Meantime, a knowledge-based agent is also put forward. Finally, the operation model of capacity planning based on multi-agent is given.

articleTitle: Research on the Decision Support System of the Management for Equipment Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Equipment maintenance management is an important part of enterprise management, which plays a very important role in enhancing work efficiency and market competition power. With rapid development of equipment, its scale and degree of automation is also increasing continuously and maintenance cost of production equipment accounts for higher proportion in the cost of production. Subsequently the problem that the confliction between the lack of the repair capacity and advanced equipment is puzzling increasingly enterprises has been appearing. It is essential to establish more advanced equipment maintenance management information system. Decision support system of the management for equipment maintenance is introduced in the paper. According to the basic theories and designing ideas of decision support system, the paper analyzes the contents of decision-making in this system and presents its designed case.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control for Modified Rejective Synchronization of Non-Identical 4-D Chaotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents chaos synchronization between a new four-dimensional chaotic system (Qi systems) and Lorenz-Stenflo (LS) by using active control technique. The designed controller ensures that the state variables of the controlled slave Qi and LS systems globally synchronize with the state variables of the master systems respectively. The results are validated using numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Method in Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Current many information retrieval methods are based on purely keywords for representing the user needs. One of the main problems with this method is that it does not formally capture the explicit meaning of a keywords query, and ignores the documents that may be different in content but related with them. To improve the precision of the information retrieval, this paper proposes a hybrid method for information retrieval in digital libraries, and gives a corresponding framework and the algorithm of the approach. The proposed method combining the ontology technique and vector space model can improve effectively the drawback existed in present retrieval system.

articleTitle: A Key Update Based on Logistic Model in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When the crypto-period is expired or the key is compromised, trusted third party (TTP) broadcasts the materials of key update. The method cannot guarantee that all the nodes access to key materials in time if nodes work on different spectrums in cognitive radio networks. This paper presents a new algorithm based on the logistic model (KULCR) which reduces the demand for network synchronization and distributes key materials through the direct broadcasts of TTP nodes and the relay among cognitive radio nodes, the latency of key update is decreased from O(n) to O(âˆšn) by this way, n is the number of spectrum. We also introduce a ring signature based on threshold in order to secrete the trusted third party. The efficiency of this protocol is proved and trusted third party is able to resist malicious attacks by simulation experiment.

articleTitle: A Front-End Solution to VAD, SNR, and AGC for Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper VAD, SNR and AGC, as main complications of a front-end signal processor in automatic speech recognition are discussed with their structure and realization, including experimental evaluation on the module global-SNR is given. The front-end has five advantages: i) propose a novel scheme to long-term power estimation based on accumulate average; ii) elegant policy for VAD based on pitch detection; iii) relative highly accurate SNR estimation; iv) AGC based on soundcard when silence between utterances; v) robust performance even in very noisy acoustical circumstance.

articleTitle: Model Simulation of Groundwater Level under the Effects of Land Use in an Oasis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Interaction between land use and water resources is an interactive process, and it is advantageous for the exploitation of water and land resources to quantitatively simulate the interaction process of these two. In this paper, the effects of land use on the change of regional groundwater level in the oasis in the Sangong River Basin, Xinjiang, China are quantitatively analyzed and simulated using GIS and FEFLOW model. GIS means are used to process the various spatial data, such as the data of land use, source-sink terms and boundary conditions, and FEFLOW is used to develop the groundwater model so as to predict and simulate the change of groundwater level. Based on the information of land use in 1987 and 1998 and the measured data of groundwater level during the period from 1987 to 2003, the parameters used in the model are debugged, and the model is revised. The results show that the simulated results are ideal, a gradual drawdown of groundwater level occurs in the urban residential areas in the upstream area of the oasis, and the extent of drawdown of groundwater level is obvious; groundwater level in the downstream area of the oasis is in a slow rise trend. Land use change, especially the expansion of cultivated lands and the long-term land development, was obvious in the central area of the oasis during the period from 1987 to 1998, and there is a certain difference between the actuality of land use change and the predicted result. Expansion of cultivated land results certainly in that the volume of sink terms of groundwater (such as the pumped groundwater and evapotranspiration) is much higher than that of source terms (such as the permeation of irrigation water, precipitation and condensed water), so cultivated land is the uppermost land use pattern affecting groundwater resources.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of data prefetching for pointer-chasing applications
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data prefetching is a well know approach to reduce memory latency and to improve performance, and has been explored in different applications. Chip Multiprocessor (CMP) now presents new opportunities to data prefetching. However, for pointer-chasing applications with irregular memory access patterns, the prefetching tends to achieve little overall performance gains. In this paper, we compare and analyze the performance of conventional prefetching thread and prefetch instruction by an example and six selected benchmarks from Olden benchmark suite. The experimental results show that prefetch instruction achieves better performance in most cases. In addition, it is observed that the prefetching thread can eliminate more L2 read misses than prefetch instruction on general.

articleTitle: Research on the Management Framework of Personal Desktop Document DataSpace
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
