It is necessary that Chinese XBRL network system should be reinforced. It should be applied in accounting activities and various internal and externals financial reporting to improve information quality and reduce cost of info exchange.

articleTitle: Keyword Search on Streaming XML Fragments
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the growing popularity of XML and emergence of streaming data model, processing streaming XML has become an important topic. This paper proposes keyword search solution over XML fragment streams based on hole-filler model. Two efficient indexes, dual list and sketch are developed to further improve the performance: dual list indexes the candidate XML fragments to keep track of the relationship among fragments that include keywords and sketch summarizes the candidate XML elements to compute SLCA. SLCA computing algorithm, which is triggered by certain keywords, avoids redundant operations on computing the SLCA of elements that not contribute to the final result. The algorithm produces partial answers continuously without having to wait for the end of the stream. We illustrate the effectiveness of the algorithms developed with experiments.

articleTitle: Driver Design Based on Notification Mechanism in Synthesis Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because of the complexity of the object under test, the synthesis Virtual Instrument gains more and more attention, but the driver technique concerning this kind of VI has not been deeply studied. This paper introduces the driver interface layer based on command queue and data queue which are based on queue technique. The driver interface layer abstracts and encapsulates the instruments' driver programs, and is to solve the mutex and competition and data synchronization problems among multi-modules. The driver interface layer improves the driver technique from query and waiting mechanism to queue and notification mechanism. Experimental results are given, showing that the driver technique based on queue and notification mechanism solves the competition for the bus and the device resource, and it also increases the driver efficiency when compared to the query and wait mechanism.

articleTitle: Well-Defined Semantic Templates for Pornographic Images Identification
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Skin-color is proved to be powerful to pornographic images identification. However, skin-color is not determinant but heuristic. If we find documents with the same topic and some same keywords, we usually regard them as the same class. Based on this motivation, we proposed a well-defined semantic template, including topic template and bag-of-visual-words, to incorporate global semantics and local semantics for pornographic images identification. Topic template is designed to capture the patterns of whole images, such as areas of skin-color and some objects or scenes related to pornographic content. Visual words are intended to find some patterns of pornographic parts or poses which can be determinant to pornographic images identification. Our semantic templates can be applied for concept understanding and content analysis.

articleTitle: The Design of Computer Hardware Curriculum Experimental Project Based on SOPC
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of integrated circuit, the traditional experimental model of computer hardware curriculum can't meet the demand of the present development. This paper discussed experimental systems model based on SOPC under the foundation of the introducing the basic features of the SOPC systems. This project was expected to achieve two main objectives: the first one is to build the basic components of computer so as to make the students fully understand the principles of the computer organization and the computer application systems; the second one is to make the students master the EDA technology and the design methods of the modern digital system so as to design the specialized embedded digital systems. This paper provides the designed examples of soft core CPU and some functional parts.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization of Working Group Configuration in a Power Dispatching System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dispatching speeds of certain substations exert a great impact on the power supply of both residents and industries and the security of power grid. Choosing substations in Guangdong Power Grid as the research object, this paper researches on the operating process of dispatching instructions with Monte Carlo method. By comparing the statistical indicators, such as the probability of waiting, the average time of instruction dispatch, the utilization of working group, etc, of single-working-group and double-working-group systems, this paper proposes valid decision making methods for optimal configuration of operators in substations.

articleTitle: The Corrosion Control of Posttentioned System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The durability problems highlight the importance of controlling corrosion in posttentioned concrete. The four key factors of corrosion protection of normal posttentioned tendon are presented before grouting, grouting and after grouted. The duct, the voids in grout, the pitting corrosion in coated strand and the anchorage system must be got more attention, and corrosion mechanism, research field and the measurement method of them are also discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Sparse Coding for Natural Images Based on Pearson-Type VII Density Functions
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Sparse coding is a method for finding a representation of natural images, in which each of the coefficients of the representation is only rarely significantly active. For extracting sparse structures in natural images adaptively, the prior probabilities over the coefficients are modeled with Pearson-type VII density functions, which can describe a wide class of super-Gaussian or sparse distributions, and can be adaptive to the input images by adjusting the scale and the steepness parameters flexibly in the density functions. Moreover, the derivatives of the sparseness cost function are continuous at each point of its domain, which is convenient for gradient techniques based learning algorithms. The performance of the flexible prior is demonstrated on a set of natural images.

articleTitle: A Modified FBLMS Algorithm Research and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As there is a conflict about block step size between the requirements of the convergence velocity and parameters' maladjustment within FBLMS algorithm, a modified FBLMS algorithm is well presented in this paper which uses a variable block step size to solve the contradiction between convergence rate and precision. The modified FBLMS algorithm is simulated in the MATLAB platform. The simulation results prove that this algorithm not only has a faster convergence speed, a faster tracking speed and a smaller stationary error, but also has a better anti-jamming capability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision Support System of Tunnel Surrounding Rock Classification Based on the .NET framework
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of tunnel excavation, it is important to classify the tunnel surrounding rock. In view of the insufficiency of artificial forecast as well as the tradition expert system about the classification of tunnel surrounding rock, this article proposes a intelligent decision support system (IDSS) with 3-layer B/S architecture based on. NET framework. This article analyses the overall structure of Web-based IDSS, the implementation of its core components, as well as the method of using fuzzy artificial neural network to diagnose tunnel surrounding rock. Moreover, a development environment and method was discussed. Experimental results have indicated that the accuracy of our system was 90%. Therefore, the system is applicable for practical implementation.

articleTitle: Weighted Intuitionistic Fuzzy Reasoning Based on Probabilistic Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new method of bidirectional intuitionistic fuzzy reasoning by employing a weighted similarity measure between the fact and the antecedent portion of intuitionistic fuzzy production rule. Our proposed method is very simple and flexible, since it not only can deal with multidimensional intuitionistic fuzzy reasoning scheme, but also consider the different importance degree of linguistic variables in production rule and that of elements in each universe. One numerical example is given to illustrate the usefulness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Remote Vision System Based on 3G Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional monitoring mode can't meet existing security requirements, so an effective monitoring method is needed to ensure that important equipments and peripheral situation in distribution network are visualization and control ability. This paper introduced a new system based on embedded system, video compression and 3G network, which can transport video image to remote monitoring center and PDA mobile phone users anytime to complete video capture and browsing in real-time. The prestored and real-time video can be transmitted mobile terminal to mobile terminal and mobile terminal to Internet.

articleTitle: Influence of Meteorological Anomaly Indices on Grain Yield of Four Provinces in East China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to study the influences of meteorological factors on Shanghai city, Jiangsu province, Zhejiang province and Anhui province's grain yield, this article calculated and compiled the daily four hour point data of meteorological factors such as temperature, wind speed, relative humidity and atmospheric pressure in 2001 to 2005, created the meteorological anomaly values and abnormal indices, collected data of crops such as yield, labor, area, fertilizer inputs in the same period, using the Cobb-Douglas-Climate production functions, comparative analyzed the influence of these abnormal meteorological indices on the grain yield.

articleTitle: Study on Accuracy Information Management Countermeasures of Road Hazardous Materials Transportation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to ensure security and strengthen management of road hazardous materials transportation, the causes of hazardous materials transportation accident have been comprehensive and systematic analyzed, and meanwhile the accuracy information management countermeasures of road hazardous materials transportation of our country have been proposed, which point out that science and technology are very important for real-time tracking and monitoring the road hazardous materials transportation. In order to promote the accuracy information management, the paper also analyzed and studied the monitoring and early-warning technologies about hazardous materials, transportation vehicles and drivers, and proposed to establish the hazardous materials transportation monitoring platform that integrated the advanced technology of RFID, GIS, GPS, GPRS, fingerprint identification, video monitoring, voice monitoring, wireless communications, databases and so on. Therefore, it would be easy for us to achieve the modern management of hazardous materials transportation and turn the management method of road hazardous materials transportation from passive to active.

articleTitle: Robust Color Appearance-Guided Particle Filter for Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presented a color image tracking method. In order to implement an effective and robust tracking task, a novel approach of weighted color distribution appearance model based on color histogram is discussed, which takes into account the target's shape and position of pixels as necessary factors in target model. Experiment result shows, in contrast with Mean Shift and conventional particle filter, the proposed method can locate object more accurately and have lower complication of calculation. Especially for some complex tracking conditions such as occultation illumination changes, cluttered backgrounds and the proposed method have a better robust.

articleTitle: Study on XML Traffic Information Basic Data Effectiveness Validation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Validation of XML documents confirms the XML documents whether conforms to the XML documents form of the professional stipulation. Based on basic data element of transportation information standard, we not only use XML Schema to regulate basic data element of transportation information XML documents, but also use JAVA validation tools to examine the basic data element of transportation information.

articleTitle: Symbolic Analysis of Authentication Protocol Based on GSPM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Formal methods are proved to be effective in analyzing security protocols. GSPM is a general model for formal analysis of security protocols by using process algebra and knowledge inference. In order to implement the automatic tool for verification, in this paper we introduce symbolic techniques into GSPM framework. Symbolic techniques can eliminate infinite branches caused by input actions. The analysis of NSPK is given as an example to illustrate such idea.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Urban Management System of Gulou District of Nanjing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Digital urban management is a significant breakthrough in the application domain of digital city technique in China. The technique of digital urban management lays the foundation for highly efficient urban management, but realization of high efficiency depends on the establishment of urban management system that adapts to digital urban management. On the basis of analyzing digital urban management in China, this paper takes Gulou district of Nanjing City as an example, and elaborates the basic condition of digital urban management system. Making innovations in digital management technique plays a fundamental decisive role for system creation, and making innovations in management system is the decisive strength for promoting technical creation.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machines Based on Spread Directions of Manifold
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper aims at settling the shortcomings in SVM such as it is sensitive to the distribution of samples near separating margin. Inspired by spread directions of manifold, we propose a new SVM learning method. This method, constructs scalar field and corresponding gradient field in observation space according to the classification decision function, and then, from viewpoints of field and principal spread directions, establishes an evaluation approach of classification performance under nonlinear mapping from observation space to intrinsic embedding space, which maximizes the classification margin of training samples in observation space and maintains intrinsic regularity of manifold distributed in embedded space. Numerical experiments on artificial dataset and practical dataset show that proposed algorithm, which have higher classification accuracy rate and stabilization than C-SVM, is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: A New Public-Key Encryption Scheme Secure against Adaptive Chosen Ciphertext Attack
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new public key encryption scheme is proposed and analyzed, which is based on a vector space over some finite field with respect to a class of matrix semigroup action. The scheme is proved secure against adaptive chosen ciphertext attack under EDDH assumption. Since EDDH assumption is weaker than DDH assumption for generic bilinear groups, the new encryption scheme is a good replacement for Cramer-Shoup encryption scheme when bilinear group is adopted as construction platform.

articleTitle: Detecting Corner Using Fuzzy Similarity Matrix
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In real-time video stream application, a feature point detector is very necessary. Stable feature points are useful in machine vision application. Feature point detectors such as SIFT, Harris and SUSAN are good methods which extracted high quality features, but neither the Harris detector nor the detection stage of SIFT can operate at real-time frame rate. In this paper, we present a new corner detection algorithm which uses fuzzy similarity matrix to calculate average similarity of contiguous pixels. It can be used in real-time applications of any complexity. In our experiments to evaluate our corner detector, difference image transformations are computed and the repeatability of feature points between a reference image and each of the transformed images are computed. Experiment results show our corner detector could give good results.

articleTitle: The Characterization of a kind of Orthogonal Vector-Valued Wavelet Packets with Compact Support
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this article, the notion of vector-valued multiresolution analysis is introduced and the definition of orthogonal vector-valued wavelet packets is proposed. The characteristics of the vector-valued wavelet packets has been investigated and three orthogonality formulas regarding the wavelet packets are derived. In particular, it is shown how to obtain a new orthogonal basis of the vector-valued function space from these wavelet packets.

articleTitle: Research on Node's Trust Computation Based on Grey Relational Analysis theory in MANETs
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The trust relationship between nodes is changed incessantly due to the dynamic and temporarily of Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (MANETs). With lack of a prior trust relationship, the reputation-system offers the reasonable effective solution to resolve the uncooperative behavior which launched by the malicious and selfish nodes in the inner MANETs. Because obtaining trust experience between nodes is still in poor way, the sample quality and quantity can't satisfy trust evaluation requirements. This paper gives a reputation computation method based on the grey relational analysis theory in MANETs which aims to resolve the problem. The scheme, which try to provide a new way to study the node's trust relationship in MANETs, includes extracting the node's key features as the input multi-attribute of the model, using the theory of grey relational grade and set up an trust computation model for mixed type multi-attribute evaluation problem with time series. The analysis and computation shows this scheme is an efficient nodes trust assessment method in Mobile Ad-hoc Networks.

articleTitle: Resource Performance Management Based on Globus in Grid System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The ability to have applications draw computing power from a global resource pool to achieve high performance has become a new challenge for grid computing and Internet technologies. This challenge not only involves solving technical difficulties in the construction of Grid environments, it also involves resource sharing and advances grid system performance. This paper presents a RPMS (resource performance management service) based on Globus, which provides the functions of monitoring resources and managing Job, the aim to manage the resource performance efficiently. Finally, it shows how RPMS can apply to the Grid's system in the lab, and illustrate by simulation experiments carried out on the parallel 3D reconstruction.

articleTitle: A Subtractive Based Subspace Clustering Algorithm on High Dimensional Data
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The sparsity and the problem of the curse of dimensionality of high-dimensional data, which make the most of the traditional clustering algorithm, lose action in high-dimensional space. Therefore, clustering of data in high-dimensional space is becoming the hot research areas. By utilizing the subtractive clustering as initialized method, and combine with the revised clustering validation indices, this paper offers a subspace clustering algorithm for automatically determining the optimal number of clusters on high dimensional data. The experiment results show that the proposed clustering algorithm can get better cluster validation performance than that of conventional indices.

articleTitle: Prediction of Summer Precipitation Anomalies over China by CAM-RegCM Nested Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The newly global atmosphere general circulation model CAM is nested with the regional climate model RegCM in order to predict the summer precipitation anomaly over China. The ensemble hindcast experiments from 1984 to 2000 are performed, and their results indicate that CAM-RegCM has some forecasting skills on the summer precipitation anomaly, that is the prediction score is above 80, the anomaly correlation coefficient can reach 0.29, and the forecasting effect is better in the north of East China than in the south. The real time forecast experiments from 2003 to 2007 show that it is correlated better in 2003, 2004, 2006 and 2007. Furthermore, correction is one important step in the short-term climate prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis of China's Logistics Parks Based on Germany's Experience
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Germany, as one of the most developed country in logistics field in the world, has developed its logistics parks earlier. This paper takes Germany's logistics park as the subject in research. By analyzing Germany's experiences of developing logistics parks, this paper tempts to find out problems in China's logistics parks and put forward suggestions for further development and construction.

articleTitle: An Interactive-ROI Image Transmission Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Region of interest (ROI) image coding is an important method of image compress coding, in the traditional ROI image coding method, the ROI is confirmed by image transmitter, but it is difficult to choose the ROI. This work provides an Interactive-ROI image coding method base on the improved NLS, who's ROI was confirmed by the image receiver. Experiments show that this method can make a sufficient ROI image in low bit rate image transmission.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of IC Card I/O Interface
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the Sumsung ARM S3C44B0X embedded development platform, a design scheme of data communication between IC card and general purpose I/O ports is presented, including the instruction of hardware interface design and software design in detail, especially many problems should be noticed in hardware implementation are put forward. And the scheduling of data communication between general purpose I/O ports and IC card is implemented by using the common advanced language C. By defining different data transmission formats with proper software adjustment, the specific of IC card can be easily implemented.

articleTitle: LiterMiner: A Literature Visual Analytic System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The data set of scientific literature contains abundant knowledge. Currently, most bibliography search engines provide only keyword search or similarity search functions for retrieving information directly stored in the database but neglect mining hidden information. In this article, we design a visual analytic tool called LiterMiner to extract entities such as article, author, affiliation, and keyword from these literature records, establish the relationships among them and display them to help analyst understand them effectively. Especially, LiterMiner uses community detection algorithm to explore academic teams. Our tool has three principle features. First, a sophisticated data clean process is designed for integration of many different formatted literature records. Second, LiterMiner can find academic teams and analyze the resume of an academic team. Third, an interactive and cooperate visualization solution is used to display the analysis result, which help user understand the result better.

articleTitle: Garment Human Modeling Approach Using Prototype
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper discusses a techniques method based on prototypes for generating controllable human body models. Users are assisted in modifying an existing one by controlling the parameters provided. The prototypes from the Poser and 3D Max is preprocessed as templates. The modeling method learns from these prototypes the correlation between the parameters and the body geometry. After this learning process the synthesizer is devoted to the generation of appropriate shape and proportion of the body geometry through transaction. Finally, we demonstrate our modifier synthesizer for more subtle manipulations of prototype models. On any synthesized model, the underlying bone and skin structure is properly adjusted. By allowing automatic modification from a set of parameters, our approach may eventually lead to the automatic generation of a variety of population models.

articleTitle: Study on the Professional Accreditation Criteria of Engineering Programs in the USA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper explores the development course and contents of the system of Professional Accreditation Criteria for Engineering Programs in the USA, and summarizes the main characteristics of the Engineering Criteria 2000,then discusses its' enlightenment on the establishing and improving the system of professional accreditation criteria of engineering programs in China.

articleTitle: Finding Success Factors in IS Outsourcing Projects: A Customer Lifecycle Management Based Way
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper carries out a research into success factors in information system outsourcing projects, based on customer life cycle management theory derived from customer relationship management. In this paper, the author firstly categorizes success factors into four periods in customer life cycle; then uses content analysis to select 52 cases from academic database, build up an analytical framework and code these cases; and finally does Chi-Square testing along with descriptive statistics to reach the conclusion as follows: (1) Find out customers' needs and provide customized service. Out of 52 cases involved in this research, 37 (71.2%) cases mention this factor. The reason why customers' needs and customized service are so important can be well explained by customer life cycle management theory. In the perspective of customers, through cross-buying and increased-buying, customers gradually gain experience in this outsourcing industry and begin to compare between current supplier and other potential suppliers, which means customers are no longer satisfied with current service level and want added value. (2) Be communicative. 35 (67.3%) cases of the 52 sample cases describes great outcomes from well communication situations between customers and suppliers during information systems outsourcing projects. Being communicative not only allows suppliers to know what customers want quickly but also lower operation cost and avoid all kinds of possible lost resulted from communication failures.

articleTitle: The Study of Household Electric Appliance Product Innovation in Shunde, China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a global manufacturing base for household electrical appliances, Shunde has its own inner background. In this paper, it studies deeply on internal factors of success of household electrical appliance product innovation, summarizes the basic situation of house-hold electrical appliances, and reviews the history of the development of household electrical appliances. Based on it, this paper studies on basis of Shunde household electrical appliances and practice characteristics, sums up product innovation modes and experiences of product innovation. It discusses the existing problems of household electrical appliances product innovation, and brings forward the problems which will be solved in future. This study pays importance to how to promote product innovation to develop the local economy for developing countries and regions.

articleTitle: Tambour: A Scalable and Robust DHT Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Distributed Hash Tables (DHTs) organize the peer-to-peer network in a structured manner and provide a simple lookup interface which is similar to a hash table. In this paper, we present a new DHT protocol, Tambour, which bounds its communication overhead automatically and controls the lookup latency with high probability across a wide range of operating scenarios. Unlike many popular DHTs which employ a fixed routing table size, Tambour maintains a flexible routing table and tunes its size dynamically to improve lookup performance. It does not periodically probes its neighbours, but selects multiple nodes with high probability of availability and low latency to forward lookup messages in a parallel manner. In simulation evaluations, Tambour shows good lookup performance and robustness against high level of churn.

articleTitle: The Study of Independent Innovation of IT Industry in Dongguan of China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dongguan of China is a global manufacturing base for IT products. In the changing environment of domestic and international economy, Dongguan is facing a great pressure to innovate. Based on the background of emphasizing and supporting independent innovation by the local government, firstly, the paper analyzes the formation of the IT industry in Dongguan deeply, and then studies the problems, characteristics, advantages and content of IT industry independent innovation in Dongguan of China, discusses the related policies and independent innovation model of IT industry over the past 30 years. Lastly, the paper gives a prospect of independent innovation model in the future. Study in the paper has a positive significance for Dongguan to improve the local innovation capability.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of the Influence of Transnational Corporations' R&D Investment in China on the Regional Innovation System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper makes an empirical analysis through the methods of principal component analysis and regression analysis. Firstly, the paper achieves the dimensional reduction of indicators of regional innovation system by the principal component analysis, to calculate comprehensive scores of the four factors. And then it divides the analysis into two stages using the method of regression analysis: the first phase shows that transnational corporations' R & D investment will have a positive impact on regional innovation system in China. But the degree of influence is different, and the effect on technological innovation is more significant and direct than other factors.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Financial Risk Evaluation of Real Estate Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Subjective and objective weights of indexes are determined respectively by G1 and entropy methods in the paper, furthermore, optimal weight is determined based on the Combination Weighting Method by minimizing the summary of the square of deviation. Finally, construct the financial risk evaluation model applied to the real estate and rank the order of related companies according to the comprehensive risk value. Contributions of this paper lie in three aspects: Firstly, the established financial risk evaluation index system overcomes the shortcomings of the existing one in indexes' calculating. Secondly, the growth rate and cash inflows indexes are included in the appraisal system. Thirdly, Combination Weighting Method is used to guarantee the minimization of the overall deviation.

articleTitle: The Study on Expert Selection in Peer-Review Based on Knowledge Management - The New Application of Scientometrics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article describes a method that can solve the selection problem of peer review experts-scientometrics. From the external part of the scientific community, we can deal with the expert selection of peer review that is the internal part of the scientific community in essence. Only the scientific selection of peer review experts can guarantee the scientific evaluation of the objectiveness, impartiality and fairness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Relations between Regional Logistics and Regional Economy Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This essay establishes the dynamics model about the regional logistics and regional economy from the point of view of system dynamics, according to the characteristics of the regional logistics and regional economy. Then simulate on the Vensim Software and obtain the simulation result. Through analysis of the results of simulation, the relations of the regional logistics and the regional economy are explored further.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement with Noise Suppression Ability Using Histogram Manipulations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A simple contrast enhancement method based on histogram manipulation is presented. The method is based on histogram equalization and histogram stretching. The proposed method successfully enhances the microscopic image without over amplifying the noise level.

articleTitle: Annual and Seasonal Precipitation Variations Trend Analysis in Jinan City from the Year of 1956 to 2007
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on monthly and annual precipitation data in Jinan City from1956 to 2007, using Mann-Kendall method to analyze the change trend of precipitation in Jinan City. The results show that from 1956 to 2007, Jinan City, the annual precipitation was a significant concussion downward trend. In 1961, there was an inflexion showed rising trend. However, in 1965, there was another inflexion showed a significant reduction in rainfall. In 2003, there was an inflexion showed rising trend again. At the same time, the spring precipitation, autumn precipitation, Summer precipitation and Winter precipitation anomaly from 1956 to 2007 indicated an obvious downward trends, especially in spring, summer and autumn.

articleTitle: DNA Algorithm Based on Incomplete Molecule Commixed Encoding for the Shortest Path Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: DNA algorithms have solved some NP-complete problems such as Hamilton path and Chinese postman problem; however there are only some suggestions for the shortest path problem. Weight encoding is a very important and challenge aspect in DNA computing. In this paper a computing method which based on incomplete Molecule Commixed Encoding (IMCE) is proposed. In this method, the vertex of the graph is encoded as single-strand, weight is encoded as double-strands and the edge is incomplete encoded. This method is used to solve the shortest path problem.

articleTitle: Research of Intelligent Authorization Model Based on Spatial Information Workflow
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Access control of spatial information workflow is mainly achieved by access authorization that only permit user to do operation just when they satisfy all constrain conditions. RBAC model also can't be applied flexibly. It can't express complicated workflow access constrain, especially can't express constrain between roles. It also can't deal with the correlativity between spatial information resources. Furthermore, it can't combine security strategy of spatial information into workflow. How to depict and manage relation between spatial information resource and role uniformly is the most important and universal demand of spatial information workflow system. Therefore, this paper tries to introduce ontology into authorization management in spatial information workflow system, and puts forward an ontology-based authorization management model to depict and manage authorization-related information uniformly so as to build a security system flexibly and conveniently. It also designs a user resource authentication algorithm based on this model which has been applied successfully in the new generation GIS platform-MapGIS 7.0.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Clipping in OFDM Predistortion
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The predistortion is described firstly, then a summary of clipping technology is followed, the analysis of clipping's influence on predistortion is provided lastly in this paper. Through analysis and simulation, following ideas are pointed out: As for TWTA power amplifier model, clipping cannot improve the predistortion performance, while too large clipping will influence predistortion effect. In view of memory polynomial model, clipping could not improve predistortion performance at large, but proper clipping can get little improvement of predistortion performance.

articleTitle: Managerial Policy and Knowledge Sharing Performance: A Dialectic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge is the fundamental source to the competitive advantage of a firm, and knowledge sharing is a primary approach to make configurations of the knowledge resource. Much of the current researches on knowledge sharing had a common assumption or argument that the managerial policy has positive roles to knowledge sharing performance, while many other researches did not support. This confused circumstance made trouble to the present research on knowledge sharing. Based on the previous literatures, we made a deep analysis on the positive roles and negative roles respectively, and argued that managerial policy has positive roles to knowledge sharing performance when its intension is weak, and vice the versa.

articleTitle: Study on the Interfaces and Determinants of Organizational Systems Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Interfaces, as the reactive medium of integrate units, transfer information, exchange materials, conduct energy and shape order. Man, machine and organization, 3 factors of organizational systems integration, their composition varied with different systems. Thus, man-man, man-machine, man-organization, machine-organization, organization-organization, 5 interfaces appeared. Since differences between nature, characteristic and objective of integrated units and systems, the mechanism how interfaces come into being diversify. The paper, by analyzing those interfaces features and functions, discusses determinants that influenced the formation of interfaces.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: C Language Theory and Practice Teaching Effect Research and Exploration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Improving Connectivity Based on Prediction and Reservation in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a slots reservation scheme based on the nodes' position prediction in wireless sensor networks with IEEE 802.15.4 standard. To forecast the mobile nodes' location, a two-order forward filter model is used. Then, a guaranteed time slots reservation and allocation algorithm as well as the design method are introduced to reserve resources according to the estimated position. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm could improve the connectivity and system reliability.

articleTitle: A Non-Sensing Reservation MAC Protocol for Dynamic Spectrum Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose a non-sensing reservation medium access control (MAC) protocol in dynamic spectrum access networks namely distributed coordinated dynamic spectrum reservation (DCDSR) protocol which is not based on the cognitive radio technology. All primary users (PUs) and secondary users (SUs) have two transceivers operating in common control channel and licensed data channels to access control and data packets in the corresponding control and data frames, respectively. PUs will inform SUs which channels will be used in next data frame and then SUs reserve unused channels by contending with each other during contention interval (CI) in control frame. The available channels which can be reserved by SUs will depend on the channel usage of PUs and further affect the throughput of SUs. Whenever SU successfully reserve channel in CI, they will start access reserved channel in next data frame after the end of CI. This will cause the wasted idle time for those SUs which have successfully reserved channel whenever the CI doesn't finish. SU which couldn't successfully reserve channel in current control frame should try to reserve again in next control frame. Thus, the duration of CI will affect the delay and wasted idle time of SUs. We analyze and simulate the performance of throughput, delay and wasted idle time in DCDSR. The analytical and simulation results show that the proposed DCDSR performs very well.

articleTitle: Research on Moral Hazard of the Governmental Investment Construction Projects Based on the Residual Claiming Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper studies the residual claiming model for stimulating participants of the governmental investment construction projects. Introducing the residual claiming model based will effectively avoid the "Moral Hazard" in construction projects, therefore we establish residual claiming model and analysis it.

articleTitle: Cell Recognition and Calculation Based on Color Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Color characteristics in cell images are quantized by analysis of cell color first. Then the color in cells is recognized by using multi-threshold segmentation technique, meanwhile the number of different kind of cells is calculated easily. The experimental results show that the average time of recognition is 18 seconds, the accuracy rate of recognition is 96.3%, and the accuracy rate of calculation is 83.7%.

articleTitle: A Study on Life Cycle-Oriented Analysis Method of Project Cost
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper described the concept of life-cycle management theory. Learning from internationally recognized life-cycle project cost management theory, we uses fuzzy math and the system theory, and does some research on the life-cycle project cost management methods and steps and gives the algorithm.

articleTitle: The Implementation of LCD High Resolution Application Based on ARM9
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the embedded field the resolution of LCD is no more than 600×480 pixels by the resource limitation. The article mainly discusses the implementation methods of high resolution of LCD based on ARM-Linux. These methods optimize the system performance and the application with these implementations can support high resolution of LCD, such as 1024×768×16bit@60Hz.

articleTitle: Developed of Fully Automatic Digital Itinerary Controller
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is introduced that a design of digital itinerary controller for mine hoist automatic operation which is composed of embedded microcontroller LPC2138 based on ARM core and relevant interface circuit. The ideas, system functions, hardware circuit design, software module of hoist's travel control are analyzed. This device can be applied to arbitrary hoisting system, its travel control idea of S-shaped curve, perfect functions of protection, monitoring and control not only make people more comfortable and the system more secure, moreover shorten the hoisting cycle. It provides reliable guarantee for safe and efficient operation of hoist.

articleTitle: Data Organization for National CINRAD DataBase Construction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Network of China Next Generation Weather Radar (CINRAD) has operated for many years. The establishment of a national disaster radar case database is very important for conducting strong convection and heavy rain research. Radar case library system is supported by three basic database which are radar case metadata, radar basis database, radar characteristics database. On the basis of the formulating the relevant standards of case selection, establishing meta-information cataloging system, collecting described meta-information content of case, providing basis information for the construction of meta-databases of the radar database; Through the establishment of radar Characteristics extraction system, complete the acquisition and extraction of the basic data, product data, feature parameters data, provides the data support for the basic database of case databases and radar characteristics data.

articleTitle: Urban Spatial Expansion Based on "Smart Growth"
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: "Smart growth", a new urban development mode, was put forward by USA for dealing with urban sprawl. Urban sprawl in varying degrees also occurs in urban spatial expansion in China. In this paper, the problems in the spatial expansion of Lanzhou City are discussed based on analyzing the actuality of population growth and industrial and spatial expansion in Lanzhou City, and the concept of "smart growth" is use as a source of reference for formulating the scientific and rational strategy of urban spatial development in Lanzhou City.

articleTitle: An On-Demand Virtual Backbone Broadcast Protocol for VANET
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Broadcast mechanisms are widely used in wireless ad-hoc networks, in this paper we proposed a novel on-demand virtual backbone broadcast protocol (OVB-CAST) for VANET. Our OVB-CAST supports safety applications based on WAVE architecture and it provides better adaptability and reliability than some other protocols by its fitness calculator and the on-demand multiple backbones. And we give a comparison between OVB-CAST and other broadcast protocols to show the advantages.

articleTitle: The Reducing of the Bluetooth Interference in IEEE802.11b
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are many interference canceller methods widely used in the coexisting Bluetooth and WLAN systems recent years. Among these methods, an adaptive filter followed by Rake receiver system is simple and efficiency. And there are also many algorithms used in adaptive filter being researched. Combining with these different algorithms, the system can improve its efficiency further. We proposed a modified LMS algorithm based on the conventional LMS algorithm. This algorithm makes the step size adjustable and solves the contradiction between the high speed and accuracy of the convergence. This system can effectively cancel Bluetooth interference in an IEEE802.11b with this algorithm.

articleTitle: Data Dependent Control Statements Conversion on SIMD Image Co-Processor
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many data-parallel applications, including emerging media applications, have regular structures that can easily be expressed as a series of data parallel function operating on data streams. Data-parallel architectures are designed to exploit this regularity by performing the same operation on many data elements concurrently. However, applications containing data-dependent control constructs perform poorly on these architectures. Data-dependent control statement conversion converts these constructs into data-dependent data movement. This allows data-parallel architectures to efficiently execute applications with data-dependent control flow. This kind of conversion extends the applications which can run on the data parallel architecture.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research and Implementation of Distance Learning Based on 3G Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Public Cultural Products Service Model Based on Web Publishing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The popularity of the Internet provides a platform for creating, sharing and communicating of content information. Increasing development of network technology caused a revolution of the meaning, form and creation process of content. According to the consumption patterns and reading habits, the paper analyzed the characteristic of web publishing under the environment of cross-media, including the product, consumption, industry and business rules. The intention of doing this is to construct different business model of digital publishing. It will be important both for publishing industry changing from traditional to digital and for sustainable development of publishing industry.

articleTitle: An Study for the Relationship between the Innovation of IT and Risk Investment of Pearl River Delta(PRD) in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Global IT industry is transferring to the main-land of China in a large scale. The Pearl River Delta has become the world's important manufacturing base for electronic information products. Based on this background, this paper carried out the empirical research between the IT industry and venture capital. It studied the risk investment, IT industry and the technological innovation in the Pearl River Delta region. What's more, the paper proposed the related suggestions on how to establish the risk investment mechanism of IT industry, improve the regional innovation capability and further speed up the development IT industry in the Pearl River Delta.

articleTitle: Prediction on Development Trend of Forestry Biological Energy Resource of Heilongjiang State-Owned Forestry Area
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Forestry biological energy resource is an important renewable resource. The development of forestry biological energy in China has obvious advantages and has great potential. In this paper, taken the state-owned forest area of Heilongjiang as the research object, the volume of biological energy resources is mastered through empirical research, and the development trend of the amount of biological energy resources in the next two years is forecasted by making use of grey system theory and methods. At the same time, the countermeasures of promoting the sustainable development of the resource of forest wood by the use of scientific development view and combination of strengthening of planning guidance and active investment by the government are put forward with a view to provide the theoretical basis for the development of biological energy in the state-owned forestry area.

articleTitle: A Study on Application of Virtual Variables Model in the Forecasting of Material Demand in Oil Field Oil Drilling
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Oil drilling materials are an essential material used in the process of oil exploration and development, it is important to predict the consumption quantity of oil drilling materials scientific. Firstly this paper proposes a guiding significance to the demand Forecasting, reviews the research on methods of demand forecasting. Secondly the basic principle of a forecasting model of the virtual variables is introduced. Thirdly the process of selecting the model variables is illustrated. Finally, the process of construction of virtual variable model is analyzed in detail. Its accuracy and a significant are tested. The results show that the predictability of the model is good. It is conducive to the oil drilling material management and control of oil companies.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of the Interaction between Tropical Pacific and Indian Ocean in Different Periods
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The CCM3 simulation results show that the interaction of El Nino upon Indian Ocean Dipole mode was very weak during the phase between 1930 and 1961. But from 1962 to 2001, Indian Ocean Dipole mode provided favorable conditions for Pacific warm events warm, the Walker circulation over the tropical Pacific and the vertical Zonal monsoon circulation over the tropical Indian Ocean coupled well at the Oceanic Continent. and also warm events in the Pacific provided favorable condition for Indian Ocean Dipole mode from 1962 to 2001.

articleTitle: Photo-Realistic 3D Visualization of Urban Building with Vector Map, Lidar Point and Close-Range Image
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes general framework photo-realistic 3D visualization of urban building with digital map, Lidar point and close-range image in photogrammetry community. First, Vanish Point (VP) geometry deduced from classic photogrammetry co-linear equation is used to obtain camera Interior Of Parameter (IOP) using groups of mutually orthogonal space lines appeared in buildings; Next, "line photogrammetry" is introduced to precisely reconstruct building geometrical model. To this end, coarse building geometry model is generated from digital map and Lidar point, and further refined with constrains from abundant image line features; After that, texture for each building facet is well reconstructed by applying photogrammetry differential rectification to eliminate texture distortion due to inherent perspective projection and detecting texture elements to remove occlusion as well; Finally, experiment is presented by integrating digital map with low-altitude aerial video image strips for photo-realistic 3D visualization of building. Contributions are also concluded.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Clustering Hierarchy Model for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The main goal of research for wireless sensor network is to minimize the energy consumption of each node, and maximize the network lifetime. We divide the network into many unequal clusters. According to different distance to the Sink, the clusters head are in charge of different geographical scope, which could reduce the internal energy consumption of the cluster headers near the sink relatively, thus energy consumption of WSN is relatively evenly distributed, in result, improve energy utilization and prolong the life of the entire Wireless Sensor Networks effectively.

articleTitle: Text Mining & Visualization on Doctor Dissertation Text of International Management Science
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Text mining is the extraction of useful information from large volumes of literature. This paper addresses text mining in the context of the international management doctor dissertation literature from ProQuest Digital Dissertation. Based on the principle and method of co-word analysis, visualization technology, and social network analysis method, 1880 PhD dissertations text are analyzed. The results show that the 92 high frequency words are cluster 11 word groups; Two word groups exists close connection and belongs to management's central research subject; one word group is mainly manages research methods; there are 22 words become the most central subject words.

articleTitle: An Optimized Design of Bit Plane Prediction Based Image Compression Algorithm on DSP
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of DSP platform, this paper presents an optimized design of wavelet image compression algorithm based on bit plane prediction. The optimization is made focus on adaptive quantization module and predictive and entropy coding module respectively. As for the adaptive quantization module, the optimization is made through the ways of luminance value calculation by look-up table, improving calculation formula of standard deviation, eliminating storage space of luminance values under the condition that no time complexity is increased, sampling calculation of standard deviation and converting heavy division calculation to multiplication calculation. As for the predictive and entropy coding module, we improve the storage method of the wavelet coefficients, implement predictive classification by look-up table, and optimize the scanning encoding method by zero block coding. The tested results through hardware platform on DSP show that the operation speed of the optimized algorithm has increased by about 30 times and reaches more than 70 Mbps.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis on the Asymmetric Regional Effects of Chinese Monetary Policy: Based on the VAR Models of Jiangsu and Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the unified monetary policy, the unbalance of regional economic and financial development has to be considered. To improve the effect of monetary policy, it is necessary for us to know the different regional effects from the unified monetary policy. After the unbalance of the regional economic and financial development of Jiangsu province and Henan province is analyzed, the different regional effects of the unified monetary policy are proved by empirical approaches VAR and IRF in the paper. The moderate different monetary policy can selectively be applied according to the regional reality.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis on Wind-Induced Vibration of Long Span Power Transmission Towers
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method for analyzing wind-induced vibrations of 1000kv Hanjiang ultrahigh voltage long span power transmission towers coupled with power lines is discussed in this paper. This paper also discusses the influence on response characteristics of differences in transmission support systems and differences between peak factors, computed from a time-series and from power spectrum density. Through the analysis of the data of dynamic characteristic and wind-induced response of the tower-transmission line system, the results of analysis show that differences in the way power transmission towers supported power lines have an influence on response characteristics, and peak factors computed from a time-series response are greater than those computed from power spectrum density.

articleTitle: Database Management and Data Processes of Environmental Observations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It has become increasingly pressing to build a database managing environmental observations for common media, e.g., water, soil and waste streams. Such management enables samples collected in a single domain and characterized in a succinct and straightforward means. An MS-Access based database is described in this paper to demonstrate a robust manner informatively managing environmental observations. The database includes typical functions that a database processes, e.g., data entering, browsing, and filtering, and spans a range of analytes which are regulated in common environmental regulations. The database forms a platform featuring the storage, retrieval, input & output of environmental observations. Besides the data management, processes of observation data are presented as well, including the data characteristics, distributions, challenges and methods. Many illustrations are presented to depict the database uses and data processes. The contents help build a prospective tool kit favoring regulatory authorities, env-statisticians, characterization and remediation professionals in environmental communities. Use of the tool kit would eventually improve the regulatory compliance procedure and environmental impact assessment of any environmental medium, and thus play a role in decision-making about the medium's destination.

articleTitle: Building a Resource Overlay for Distributed Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To address the problems of resource sharing and utilization in the distributed environment, the paper aims to establish a resource overlay for the distributed system monitoring. The resource overlay can construct a logical space, and the type of the nodes in the space can be classified as host node and resource node. The host node and resource node are mapped into the logical space of network by the consistent hash function and the location preserving hash function respectively. An improved DHT algorithm is used to establishing the resource overlay, and supporting the range query for the resource information. Experiments have proved the validation of the method, and the results show that it is an effective method for finding the available resource in less routing hops.

abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Inverse Eigenvalue Problem for Tridiagonal Matrices With Linear Relation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper researches the inverse eigenvalue problem for tridiagonal matrices with linear relation. And presents the problem that using the tridiagonal matrix and the matrix which is got rid of the last row and the last column to make the original matrix. The expression of the solution of the problem is given, and some numerical example is provided.

articleTitle: Business Process Reengineering in E-commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The replacement of industrial age by information age made the traditional vertical division of labor unable to meet the rapidly changing market requirements, therefore, the horizontal integration model has been in place based on a variety of management processes within organization. In this paper, we analyzed four levels of organizational structure reform and the value distribution system basing on process reengineering and the corresponding division of responsibilities in department in the changing process from hierarchical organization to process-oriented organization, providing some ideas for the organizational management reform.

articleTitle: Optimize Shallow Simplification of Mesh Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article traces the development of mesh model simplification methods, and presents a refinement using edge collapse. The idea is sacrificing depth of simplification to ease the burden of error metrics, edge selection and vertex placement. To prevent model contraction, the method adjust clustered vertex; it also restricts triangle flipping and vertex degree to improve output quality. Experiment shows, for a shallower simplification, the output quality can match popular methods, but time consumption is greatly reduced, and even more significantly if input is denser or flatter.

articleTitle: Research on Different Emergency Evolution Models
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Emergencies have been bringing huge damage, even worse when emergency event chain reaction is formed. Different emergency evolution models have been studied in the systematic perspective to find out common characters and correlation among four various emergency events. We propose an academic framework with four hierarchies including single event, event chain, event network, and event supernetwork and discuss how to response to the emergency in different hierarchies. We also prove its efficiency by discussing a real case. This paper can provide useful guidelines to prevent broadcasting of disaster and macro precaution.

articleTitle: CF Improvement Based on Probabilistic Analysis of Discrete Explicit Rating Vector
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Collaborative Filter (CF) is one of the important algorithms of Recommendation System, the sparsity problem is a significant impediment for real use of CF technique. In this paper, based on probabilistic analysis to users' discrete explicit rating vector, an All-Average improved algorithm are proposed to solve the problem of CF sparsity and other practical problems. Experimental result show this method improved the precision and quality of CF prediction.

articleTitle: Application of Harmonic Clustering and Classification Method in Electric Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Clustering and classification are two important research areas of data mining, and classification needs prior-knowledge, while clustering is often based on a similar measure to find its own inherent characteristics from the data. In practice, the results of classification and clustering are often inconsistent. For this problem, the definition of harmonic matrix is given in this paper, and based on this conception a harmonic clustering-classification algorithm is proposed, which makes the results of classification and clustering keep high consistency. At the same time, this method has been used in power system load forecasting, and the experiment shows that the classification results obtained by our method are more reliable.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technology Based on Abstract Method in Archaeology - A Case Study of First-Period Culture of Jiangzhai Site
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper firstly expatiates the basic definition of conception hierarchy, ascertains the abstraction algorithm oriented to attributions based on rules, make use of the attribution data and graphics data of first period culture of Jiangzhai site to do data mining on multi-levels, finally, processes the archaeological analysis and explanation on the results of data mining.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a WEBGIS-Based Quality Evaluation System for Bridge Construction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Bridge construction quality inspection and evaluation systems previously developed have been no more than just conventional management information systems, in which no mapping or sophisticated visual analysis capabilities are supported or even considered, not to mention network connectivity, especially Internet access. To address the problem, it is herein presented a WEBGIS-based quality inspection and evaluation system for bridge construction, applicable to not only simply-supported, old-fashioned bridges like arches, girders, etc., but also complex bridges like suspension, cable stayed, and other bridges with unique characteristics. Great efforts have been made to incorporate into the system the features like: real-time visualization, online spatial queries, comprehensive analysis, damage pattern recognition, decision making, and so on. The objective of this study is to demonstrate various new possibilities that Internet and GIS technology could bring to bridge construction quality inspection and evaluation, through the design and implementation of the Shenyang WEBGIS-based quality inspection and evaluation system for bridge construction.

articleTitle: The Development of Global Software Outsourcing and Its Project Issues in a Leading UK Financial Company
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Global Software Outsourcing (GSO) is a very topical and emotive subject which lacks project level research. Although most of the UK's large scale companies are employing GSO presently, its performance does not entirely satisfy the industry's expectations. This paper explores the development of GSO and its growth in the UK. A case study has been carried out to explore the project issues in a leading UK financial company. Industry observation and interviews have been introduced to collect the industrial data. Based on the data analysis, some representative project issues and their implications are outlined - resource, communications, project sponsors, requirements, and the project process critically influence the success of GSO projects in the company. The last part of this paper describes some possible resolutions to the problems identified.

articleTitle: Assessment and Management of Water Resources-Ecological-Social System of Baiyangdian Wetland
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Baiyangdian is the largest wetland in north China, and plays an important role in many aspects such as climate regulation, biodiversity protection, flood control, and local fishery production etc. the research of this paper include the following four aspects: 1) The composition, current situation, and changing tendency of sub-systems that constructed the whole system. 2) Building up the system model of water resources-ecological-social system of Baiyangdian Wetland, explaining the relationship of different sub-systems and their layer structure, discussing the system features. 3) The criterion for the system health status identification, AHP method has been used to the system assessment, at the high frequency water level of 7.9 m, the system is at the status of sub-health, the result shows except water quantity sub-system, the other sub-system also face many problems. 4) Based on the system management objectives, a series of system management countermeasures have been put forward to improve the health status of water resources-ecological-social system of Baiyangdian Wetland.

articleTitle: Analyse Changing Risk of Organizational Factors in Agile Project Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fuzzy cognitive maps are used as project management risk factors decision aids to better assess how change in one part of an IT agile project management organization affects other parts of it. FCM modeling is used to analyze the impact of the changes. It suggested that the initial decision would not yield the expected results so intervention measures were undertaken to reengineer existing relationships between specific areas of the IT project risk management factors. It presents a general overview of FCM and proposes a set of possible organizational concepts and relations. It also provides something about agile project management principle, and something about revelatory for an complexity agile project.

articleTitle: Innovation of Financial Management to Firm: Based on Market Orientation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In a market economy, Market Orientation is the only correct choice for economic development strategy, so it is also significant for financial management innovation. While most studies in the past decade focused on the consequences of fund in financial management, few have investigated antecedents to market orientation concept. This study focuses on the financial management innovation based on the Market Orientation. We develop a Mechanistic model of the role of Market Orientation for financial management innovation to explore the impact of Market Orientation on the financial management innovation in enterprise. We take a first step on researching the impact of culture of Market Orientation on financial management. The next Market Orientation's three core activities (market information generation, dissemination and responsiveness). Finally, we research financial management innovation across four different aspects of the financial management, and thereby show the consequences of financial management innovation more than previous studies.

articleTitle: Arnold Transformation Algorithm and Anti-Arnold Transformation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Arnold transformation is applied widely in digital image scramble because of its periodicity. But we will waste lots of time when we used its periodicity to get the anti-Arnold transformation algorithm, especially when it used in the picture with big degree. So, in this paper, we use a new anti-Arnold transformation algorithm which got by solving equation groups. By this way, we needn't to figure out the degree, which will save lots of time.

articleTitle: Adaptive Management of Virtualized Resources in Cloud Computing Using Feedback Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cloud computing as newly emergent computing environment offers dynamic flexible infrastructures and QoS guaranteed services in pay-as-you-go manner to the public. System virtualization technology which renders flexible and scalable system services is the base of the cloud computing. How to provide a self-managing and autonomic infrastructure for cloud computing through virtualization becomes an important challenge. In this paper, using feedback control theory, we present VM-based architecture for adaptive management of virtualized resources in cloud computing and model an adaptive controller that dynamically adjusts multiple virtualized resources utilization to achieve application Service Level Objective (SLO) in cloud computing. Compared with Xen, KVM is chosen as a virtual machine monitor (VMM) to implement the architecture. Evaluation of the proposed controller model showed that the model could allocate resources reasonably in response to the dynamically changing resource requirements of different applications which execute on different VMs in the virtual resource pool to achieve applications SLOs.

articleTitle: An Energy Detection Algorithm Based on Double-Threshold in Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on conventional single-threshold energy detection algorithm, we put forward a double-threshold version in cognitive radio system, and then, we analyze the detection probability, false alarm probability, miss probability and their relationships. For further research, we define two parameters for performance evaluation: the probability of collision between the cognitive user and the primary user, and the probability of spectrum unavailable to the cognitive user. Comparing to the single-threshold energy detection algorithm, both analysis and simulation results show that the proposed double-threshold energy detection algorithm can make a lower collision probability between the cognitive user and the primary user, despite a little increasing of the spectrum unavailable probability.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Multi-Channel MAC Protocol with Dynamic Interval Division in Vehicular Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: High throughput performance of the Wireless Access in Vehicular Environment (WAVE) system can provide more capacity for future high density traffic, which is little considered in the ongoing IEEE 802.11p/P1609.4 defined WAVE Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol. To achieve this goal, we propose a novel multi-channel MAC protocol that can use a dynamic time boundary instead of fixed boundary to separate Control Channel (CCH) Interval and Service Channel (SCH) Interval. In our scheme, CCH Interval is further split into Service Announcement Phrase (SAP), Beacon Phrase (BP) and Peer-to-peer Reservation Phrase (PRP), meanwhile a distributed algorithm based on several dynamic parameters is employed to calculate the duration of low-priority PRP according to the real-time traffic load in every Synchronization Interval. The simulation results show that our protocol out-performs the WAVE MAC protocol in different traffic load.
