Simulation results show that the proposed method, THP-BF, has better BER performance than traditional THP and some linear precoding methods such as block diagonalization (BD) and zero forcing (ZF). The sum rate of ZF-THP at asymptotically high SNR is computed, and the computation results are consistent with simulation results. Simulation results reveal that ZF-THP has higher sum rate than linear precoding methods (such as ZF and BD) due to its more degrees of freedom of MIMO channels, and that THP-BF also has higher sum rate than traditional THP at low and moderate SNR.

articleTitle: Adaptive Resource Allocation for OFDMA System Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the problem of adaptive resource allocation in OFDMA system. An ant colony algorithm based adaptive resource allocation is proposed in this paper. The problem is modeled as finding a minimum cost path in a graph. The ants' solution construction is guided by pheromone trail and heuristic information. Due to the unique heuristic searching mechanism of the ant colony algorithm, the proposed algorithm is guaranteed to converge quickly to an approximately optimal solution. Simulation results showed that the performance of the proposed algorithm is close to the optimal solution, and gains 1-2 dB in comparison with the fixed allocation scheme.

articleTitle: Automatic Calibration Method Based on Traditional Camera Calibration Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Camera calibration is one of the key procedures for computer vision and the accuracy of camera calibration is of vital importance in terms of ensuring the systematic measurement accuracy. An automatic calibration method based on traditional camera calibration is proposed in this paper. First of all, calibrated image series can be gained by using improved calibrating template with regional calibration points. Then scanning areas for these spots will be confirmed though edge detection technique. Finally, parameters of camera will be calculated after linear calibration and nonlinear correction according to camera perspective projection model. Experiments show that the improved calibration method has several advantages such as higher scanning speed, better stability and more satisfying robustness which makes the process of traditional camera calibration an automatic process.

articleTitle: An Improved Camshift Algorithm Based on Dynamic Background
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an improved Camshift algorithm based on dynamic background is presented, detecting motion objects with Twice-Frame-Difference Method (TFDM) and tracking objects with Multi-Features-Fusion Method (MFFM). By the comparing experiments, the presented improved algorithm can acquire the better detecting effects and improve the robustness and accuracy of tracking.

articleTitle: A Fast Thinning Algorithm for Fingerprint Image
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Thinning algorithms can be classified into two general types: serial and parallel algorithms. Several algorithms have been proposed, but they have limitations. A new thinning algorithm based on the centroid of the block is presented. The new algorithm checks the 9*9 local neighborhoods around the pixel to find out the centroid pixel of the block, and other pixels are removed. The process is performed iteratively until less than ten pixels are deleted in one loop. To ensure the ridge is one pixel wide, a post-processing loop is designed and the pixels are deleted from the image if they satisfy some conditions. Experimental results are used to compare this new algorithm to other algorithms and their relative performances are assessed. The new algorithm is fast than other algorithms and the ridges are one pixel wide after thinned.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Protocol for Event-Driven Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a cross-layer Event-Driven Sensor MAC protocol (ED-SMAC) for event-driven WSNs. ED-SMAC defines two network statuses: regular status and event status. On regular status, sensor nodes only send little normal detection information to sink, so the basic techniques in SMAC protocol are adopted to reduce the energy waste and guarantee the data transmissions. On event status, a new cross-layer event-based cluster formation algorithm is proposed. Several sensor nodes which have been detected a specific event in the network form a cluster and elect a cluster head. The event information is collected, aggregated and transferred to sink by their elected head. Simulations results show that the proposed protocol improves event detection reliability, shortens the average packets latency, and saves node energy.

articleTitle: A Secure and Efficient Key-Policy Attribute Based Key Encryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Attribute based encryption has captured the attention of crypto-researchers in recent years, which can be regarded as a special type of identity based encryption integrated with flexible access control policy. In this paper, we propose a new construction of key-policy attribute based encryption, which is proved to be secure in the Selective-Set model of security under the decisional BDH assumption in the random oracle model. The proposed scheme not only provide public parameters whose size is independent of the number of attributes in each identity (used as public key), but also it has useful structures which result in more efficient key extraction and encryption than the Goyal et al.'s key-policy attribute based encryption scheme, which is proved to be secure in the Selective-Set model of security under the decisional BDH assumption in the standard model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors on the Management Performance of Expressway Construction Project Based on DEMATEL Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Expressway is an important infrastructure which influences the development of national economic, while the management performance of expressway construction project is the key to succeed in expressway construction. This paper put forward an index system of influencing factors on the management performance of expressway construction project from the perspective of project management theory. To identify the key influencing factors on the management performance of expressway construction project, the paper employed the DEMATEL method to analyze and optimize the index system, which will provide a basis for optimizing the project management of expressway construction.

articleTitle: Improve Peer Cooperation Using Social Peer-to-Peer Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In unstructured peer-to-peer (P2P) networks, there exist numerous malicious nodes, whose false behaviors decrease the efficiency and reliability of the search. This paper is devoted to decrease the negative effects of those nodes in resource searching process by regarding P2P networks as social-like networks. Forwarding trust, routing trust and transaction trust are proposed to assess the quality of a friend node and are evaluated according to its previous behaviors in its transactions history with other nodes. When a peer node selects friends to forward the query message, the friends with high trust and correlation will be given priority. The simulation results show that our algorithm effectively screens out the malicious nodes. Meanwhile, the cooperation of the honest peers is reinforced and the query efficiency for honest peers is improved remarkably as well.

articleTitle: Half-Against-Half Multi-Class Text Classification Using Progressive Transductive Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Progressive Transductive Support Vector Machine extends Transductive Support Vector Machine in different class distribution. It is the solution to the problem that it has to estimate the ratio of positive negative examples from the sets which are not an easy task to deal with. The paper introduces a Half-Against-Half Multi-Class Text Classification algorithm Using Progressive Transductive Support Vector Machine. It shows both in theoretical estimation and experimental results on Reuters-21578 data set that HAH has significant advantages over the methods of OAA, OAO and DDAG in the testing speed, the training speed and the size of the classifier model, and the accuracy of classification is close to OAA, OAO and DDAG. It is a promising approach to solving the issues of large-scale multi-class text classification.

articleTitle: Using Ant Colony Algorithm for Solving Minimum MPR Set and OPNET Simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Finding the minimum MPR set is a NP-complete problem in OLSR protocol, and intelligent computing methods can be used to solve it. Based on analyzing the defects of the strategy of the greedy heuristic algorithm, ant colony algorithm is imported to solve the minimum set of MPR problem. Firstly, defining the out-degree and the in-degree of a node, and in accordance with the out-degree and in-degree constraints, ant colony algorithm based on the graphic is given to find the minimum sets of MPR in this paper. Then, three kinds of ant colony algorithm model such as Ant-Cycle, Ant-Quantity and Ant-Density are improved, and the analysis of the convergence curves about the three kinds of model is described by Matlab. As the result shows that Ant-Cycle model has a faster rate of convergence, the ant colony algorithm of solving a minimum MPR sets based Ant-Cycle Model is determined. After using the OPNET to simulate the algorithm, the statistics show that the connectivity and data consistency of nodes, which also prove the rationality of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Program Design Methodology Based on Multithreading NP
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to reduce the speed gap between today's processor and memory, many processors adopt multithreading technology, Intel IXP series Network Processor (NP) is such a typical kind. This paper takes IXP series Network Processor for example, first analyzes multithreading mechanism; then targeting on how to realize multi-thread synchronization, presents three design methods and a specific example which could illustrate the difference between these methods; at last does some experiments according to different design methods, from experiment results draws some conclusions which would be useful in designing applications based on multithreading NP, including producing as less constrains and context swaps as possible, making the program executing time be longer than the memory access latency at every stage and so on.

articleTitle: Influence of Modes of Multimedia Presentation on the Effects of Primary School Students' Chinese Characters Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With grade 2 students in primary school as subjects, this study conducted an experiment to explore the influence of 2 modes of presentation on students' recognition and recall of Chinese characters. The research results indicated that: (1) Modes of presentation had significant effect on students' Chinese characters learning, and dynamic presentation was superior to static presentation. (2) The advantage of dynamic presentation had notable effect on simple task of character recognition, whereas it had no significant effect on complex task of character recall. (3) Sex difference had no significant effect.

articleTitle: A Distributed Proving and Negotiation Algorithm for Trust Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The credential collection method plays a vital role in automated trust negotiation (ATN) systems. Most existing work used the traditional trust negotiation method, which brings a much heavy burden to the credential server and causes blind credential fetching problem. This paper presents a distributed proving and negotiation (DPN) algorithm for trust management. DPN can intelligently carry out a remote proving or a local inference for a credential request. Moreover, it can give out all the related proof rules for a request. Both the soundness and the completeness of the algorithm are analyzed, and the experiment results demonstrate that DPN has a better performance than a traditional trust negotiation method.

articleTitle: What Makes Information Moving? Introducing a Theory of Information Physics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Basic ideas that providing explanation to the movement of information in information systems were proposed in the light of regarding information as a kind of matter. It was suggested that information had both "momentum" and "energy". The momentum of information provided explanation for the dynamic behaviors, and the energy of information provided explanation for the static attributes. A Theory of Information Physics was also proposed to provide more integrated explanation to general information movements. Some common information-movement examples were discussed to provide support for the proposing theory.

articleTitle: Project and Quality Management at Politecnico di Torino
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The profitable collaboration between Building Service and DISET -Building Engineering and Territorial Systems Department- applied to last works concerning some redevelopment areas of the Politecnico di Torino had brought to test the latest technologies in order to improve the quality of the whole design process, from the conceptual phase to the facility management one. In this regard, two case studies drawn up using Building Information Modeling technology are analyzed: they constitute the basis for further experiments in terms of software interoperability, that means the ability to exchange information automatically, without loss of data between different applications (structure, cost evaluation, building physics) that develop specific domains.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the C Language Programming Teaching Reform Based on CDIO
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In response to the demand for innovative and engineering talents under economic globalization on industrial development, aiming at specific issues existing in C language programming teaching, the paper fully discusses the teaching reform of C language programming based on CDIO idea, and puts forward some countermeasures, namely from the case to the project, from the papers to the industry experience, to establish new teaching system and new evaluation system of C language programming under CDIO mode.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling for the Pollutant Dispersion of the Middle and Lower Reaches of the Yellow River
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The unpredictable water pollution incident of the Yellow River Basin is an important part of the emergency work. Based on the Saint-venant equation set, a 1-D pollutant dispersion model is built for the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River. It calibrates key parameters with the valley characteristics, rapidly and effectively achieves the forecasting of pollutant dispersion using implicit finite difference scheme in this paper. The model can maximize the information obtained from the available data and adapt to the fast evolution of the river bed as well as other external changes. The experimental results show that the model provides a strong support for relevant decision makers with high usability and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Ajax and Silverlight Technology in WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The integration of Web and GIS Technology brings quick development of WebGIS. WebGIS changed the old way of spatial data acquisition, transmission, sharing and development, became to be an important development direction in GIS area. To solve the problem of low responding rate and poor performance, a new development model integrated Ajax and Silverlight is proposed. Ajax Silverlight WebGIS platform is constructed by using the latest development model, which can be used to shorten responding time between client and server-side, to reduce the volume of data transmission of networks, and to increase rich multi-media effect, thus the ability of WebGIS is greatly expanded.

articleTitle: Information Retrieval for Engineering Projects: Using Images to Search for Images
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The difficulty in retrieval of visual information in engineering technical drawings needed for decision-making is an area of major concern. Current methods of retrieval do not satisfy the demand for rapid and precise location of information contained in large sets of drawings. This paper presents a conceptual model, a classification scheme and a prototype of an information retrieval system (IRS) for engineering technical drawings which addresses this problem using techniques of analysis and processing of images. The system integrates concepts of information science, computer science and engineering to improve retrieval of technical drawings which can impact positively on services and decision making in areas such as infrastructure (sanitation, energy and roads), security, health and education.

articleTitle: EMP: The Framework of a Parallel Delivery Scheme for Large Scale Virtual Worlds
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Now all kinds of 3D virtual worlds have been popular on Internet, but due to gigantic data of virtual scenes and limit network bandwidth, traditional Client/Server based downloading scheme has been bottleneck for a user to construct local virtual worlds swiftly. This paper proposes a parallel delivery scheme for large scale virtual scenes in a two-layer hybrid based P2P(Peer-to-Peer) overlay, in which server notification scheme is used to discover neighbors firstly, then an EMTFOI(Extended Multi-Tier Field of Interest) based culling algorithm is employed to cull needed virtual scenes. To compare with C/S based downloading scheme, this scheme realizes progressive delivery of virtual scenes in parallel with viewpoint movement in a multi-user environment and used bandwidth between nodes soundly.

articleTitle: Authorized Model of Digital Product Based on License
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Attacking at illegal authorized usage which easy to be caused by the characteristics of digital products, this paper designed an authorized model based on license. Which includes two different licenses: commodity license and the usage license, control the user only can act in the permission by making full use of usage license and plug-ins, has achieved a common permission check mechanism for digital content, and completed a lasting access control of digital content through this way.

articleTitle: Robust Speech Recognition Based on AMS Spectrum Subtraction and Confidence Interval Test
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Amplitude Modulation spectrogram (AMS) can reflect the orthogonality between the "periodotopical" organization and the tonotopical organization in neurons. So we can use it as a reliable discrimination between speech and noise. This paper presents a novel approach of robust speech recognition by using AMS and Spectrum Subtraction with Confidence Interval Test. By dynamic using Confidence Interval Test, the error of estimated SNR was decreased. Experiment results show the proposed method yield good performance for attenuating the influence of noises and can improve the robustness of ASR.

articleTitle: The Design of Input Method for CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, three new input methods for CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B are introduced. As the characters in extension B are always appearing in ancient books, the pronunciations of most of them are unfamiliar for readers, so an input method based on the character structure is easier to input. Within computer, CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B are stored by four-bytes. Considering the character structure, this paper designs three input methods: Stroke Input Method based on the writing sequence; Simplified Strokes Input Method which takes the common features of the characters in this part into account and simplifies the input process; and Radicals Plus Character Structure Input Method. Experiment results show that the three input methods are convenient and very easy for users to input the Chinese characters in B extension part.

articleTitle: Module-Based Analyse and Design of T-MPLS Node
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Increases in network traffic due to the expansion of IP broadcast services in recent years have stimulated the requirement of performance and capability in transport network. As an attractive candidate to support the packet switching functionality envisioned in converged next generation transport systems, T-MPLS is gained more attentions to find out its characteristics. This paper describes a T-MPLS test-bed which is composed of Management Plane (MP), Control Plane (CP) and Transport Plane (TP), and then also proposes a means of module design on T-MPLS nodes, by which the entire functions the T-MPLS needs can be achieved. For each node, the three planes of T-MPLS will be mapped with Management Unit (MU), Control Unit (CU) and Packet Switching & Forwarding Unit (P&FU), which are independent in logic but relied on each other in function. Those three modules communicate with each other via NMI-C and CI.

articleTitle: Research and Exploration upon Informationization of Biology Teacher Education Program - Taking Information-Based Construction of Biology Teaching Methodology Program as an Example
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Informationization of teacher education program is the need of society, and also the objective requirement of school and subject construction. Application of information technology in teaching promotes information-based development of teacher education program. This paper takes integration of information technology and ecology teaching methodology program as an example, and probes into the channels and developmental trend of information-based construction of ecology teacher education program from such aspects as basic theory course of ecology teaching methodology, teaching skill training and network platform construction.

articleTitle: 3D Forestation Simulation Based on Direct 3D-Interaction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A couple of pivotal techniques on 3D forestation simulation based on direct 3D-Interaction are introduced in the paper. To simulate 3D forestation a specific data model is developed and adopted based on object-oriented methods. And a virtual environment is built through modeling and realistic rendering. The paper realized natural and efficient planning and design for forestation by direct 3D-interaction in VR. Finally the paper presents realization of the 3D forestation to test its effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Perceptual Content-Aware Image Reducing Based on Visual Perception
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a perceptual content-aware image reducing method based on visual perception. First the Regions Of Interest (ROI) are extracted by visual perception. Then we construct the self-adaptive energy function to denote the importance of pixels. At last, the pixel seams which have lowest energy are deleted to protect image content and provide excellent visual effect. Selecting seams may deduce to an optimal problem, in our algorithm, which is transferred to a Shortest-Path problem and solved by dynamic programming. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can preserve the important areas and produce excellent vision effects. The reducing results are more desirable compared to all the state-of-the-art algorithms since we pay especially attentions to the biological structure of human beings.

articleTitle: Analysis on Market Segmentation and Marketing Strategy of Vegetables Consumption - A Case Study in Changsha
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper has studied the beneficial segmentation status of vegetable consumption market with the statistical methods of factor analysis and cluster analysis. Its purpose is to promote the development of vegetable industry and its marketing strategy in Hunan province by deeply exploring the purchasing behavior and demography characteristics of vegetables purchasers in different segment market. The results indicate that the impact affecting on the purchasing behavior of vegetable consumers in Changsha city acts mainly in six categories, namely "producing area", "security", "taste", "facilitate", "Variety", "appearance". Cluster analysis further revealed that the vegetable consumption market in Changsha City could be broken down into the consumer market for taste-type, security- type consumer market, convenience- type, visual- type and diverse consumer market- type consumer market.

articleTitle: Discussion on Multi-Media Teaching Quality Appraisal System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This thesis analyzes the current situation and common existing problems in multi-media teaching through discussing characteristics of multi-media teaching, puts forward an easy, simple, objective and quantified multi-media teaching quality appraisal system model, and it's tested by practices that it could be effectively applied in the supervision and management of multi-media teaching quality.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Compressive Sensing Approach with Column Sparse Prior
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compressive sensing is an international popular issue recently. In classical compressive sensing framework, the global sparse prior is employed to recovery image from the incomplete random projection, hence it is time consuming. In this paper we present a new image compressive sensing approach for image sparse recovery with column sparse prior. As opposed to compressive sensing, our model and algorithm based on 2D image matrices rather than 1D vectors so the image matrix does not need to be transformed into a vector prior to measurement and the size of sensing matrix can be greatly reduced. A new practical variant of GPSR algorithm is developed for the relevant optimization problems. To test our model and evaluate its performance, a series of experiments were performed in the paper. The experimental results indicated that our method can decrease the memory space cost and computational time on encoding and recovery.

articleTitle: Optimal Sensor Placement Using Improved Sensitivity Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method of optimal sensor placement which is called sensitivity analysis method (SAM) is presented in this paper. It uses structural curvature mode shape changes due to stiffness changes (damages are simulated as stiffness reduction) to analyze the sensitivity. Then, another two traditional methods of optimal sensor placement - the effective independence method (EIM) based on maximizing the data information and the kinetic energy method (KEM) based on maximizing the kinetic energy are discussed briefly, and we compare our new method (SAM) with the two traditional methods under two modal criteria, mean square error (MSE) and modal assurance critical (MAC). The numerical simulation results show that the SAM is the best one of the three.

articleTitle: Research on Psychological Evaluation System of Safety Personnel in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The requirement of the mining safety production for safety psychological qualities of the coal mine safety personnel was analyzed in the study, and then, the psychological forecast indexes correlating with safety at work were chosen and psychological measurement was carried. The psychological pretest indexes chosen having a forecasting effect on the safety work performance of the coal mine safety personnel were determined by means of analyzing and evaluating psychological criterion validity. It was confirmed that the application of psychological measurement technology could provide valuable basis for selecting and assigning mining personnel.

articleTitle: The Application of Dimensionless Analysis to Evaluation of Factors Affecting Water-Inrush from Coal Floor
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dimensionless analysis was applied to correctly evaluate the order of the factors affecting water -inrush from coal floor. In the evaluation of water -inrush from coal floor, many factors need to be considered. Thus, to correctly evaluate the order of the factors affecting water -inrush from coal floor is very important, which is the key to reasonable evaluation of water -inrush from coal floor. Based on systematic collection of the hydrogeological data of Yanzhou Coal Mining Area, we analyzed the factors affecting water -inrush from coal floor and evaluated water-inrush risk of lower group of coal seams mining. We used dimensionless analysis for the standardized process of hydrogeological data. There also came a comparison of each factor affecting water -inrush from coal floor under information fusion. Then we obtained the order of factors affecting water-inrush from coal floor. The results shows that dimensionless analysis is good for evaluating many factors affecting water -inrush from coal floor. It provides the powerful foundation for evaluation of water -inrush risk from coal floor in lower group of coal seams mining.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Stock Information System Architecture Based on Business Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In general, all business intelligence takes the enterprise or organization's business data as the data source. This article takes stock information system as the carrier, uses the Web data as data sources, proposed the improved three-story intelligent frame for business intelligence, and realizes the stock information system based on the architecture of business intelligence solutions which includes constructing ETL package and OLAP database designing report, and putting forward to a new deployment solution of the stock information system. The stock prediction sample shows the validity for the proposed architecture.

articleTitle: Agent Based Supply Chain Research
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using MAS theory to set up modeling systems for four lever no-liner orders needs of supply chain. At the same time study the structure of Agent System, Agent interaction and decision-making. On this basis, research sharing information in the value of simulation for MAS-based supply chain. In the simulation example. Analysis of information-sharing effects throughout the supply chain system as well as members costs of the supply chain. And discuss the information-sharing influence on the bullwhip effect.

articleTitle: Temperature Characteristics of Threshold Voltage in Single Material Double Workfunction Gate(SMDWG) MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The effects of temperature on threshold voltage are studied in Single Material Double Workfunction Gate (SMDWG) MOSFET, and an analytical temperature model of threshold voltage is presented. Comparisons are carried out between the model calculated results and the MEDICI simulation results at wide temperature range from 200K to 500 K. The good agreements validate the new model.

articleTitle: The Research on Flame Image Segmentation Based on Fuzzy Clustering and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, linking with the basic principle of FCM algorithm, on the basis of theory research, a method of the cluster analysis that FCM and the genetic algorithm are combined together is proposed. Firstly, the approximate optimal solution obtained by the genetic algorithm is taken as the original value of the FCM algorithm, then carrying on the local search to obtain the global optimal solution, the final segmentation result is achieved at last. The experiment results prove that in the view of the flame image segmentation, this method shows the good performance, and has the widespread serviceability, so it is the practical method in image segmentation.

articleTitle: Carrier Frequency Offset Estimator with Low Complexity and High Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In coherent orthogonal frequency division multiplexing systems, the pilot symbols are often inserted into time-frequency grid to tracking the real time variation of the channel response. In this paper the frequency synchronization algorithm using these pilot symbols and decision data is further analyzed and a carrier frequency offset estimator with high accuracy and low complexity is proposed. Simulation results demonstrate that the presented frequency offset correction scheme provides the accuracy required in practical applications for OFDM wireless systems.

articleTitle: The Pulse Waveform Characteristic Points Detection Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The pulse waveform characteristic points detection is very important for detecting cardiovascular parameters. A real-time algorithm based on wavelet transform (WT) is developed for detecting the characteristic points exactly. The algorithm combines the zero-crossing of a wavelet with one vanishing moment and the local extrema of a wavelet with two vanishing moment to improve the detection rate of characteristic points. The detection results show that automatic identification of characteristics points has high accuracy, which is convenient for evaluating the global behavior of arterial parameters.

articleTitle: SoC Architecture with a Switch Bridge for Wireless ECG Data Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: NoC architecture with a switch bridge is designed for mixed signal SoC of the ETB (ECG T on body) applied in home healthcare wireless network. The SoC including multi CPU systems can be divided into different parts with data process function. Therefore each part of the system can work independently without influence each other. With the discussion of the performances of ETB, the switch bridge is a suitable NoC (network on chip) technology for reducing the dies size and power consumption. The switch bridge designed in this paper connects two CPU systems and two others digital circuitry components together. To the CPU systems, common digital circuitry is a part of the CPU system with the bridge. The architecture and logic function of the switch bridge is analyzed in detail and simulated. The simulation results demonstrate that the connection bridge cannot only supply the connection of two CPU and two common modules, include display module and RAM, but also increased the running speed and system performance.

articleTitle: Team Development Measurement by Dynamic Fuzzy Social Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: How to obtain a high performing team quickly and effectively is very important in a project management. Communication is most essential part in a project team. In this paper, a method of measuring team performance by dynamic social network analysis is put forward. With dynamic fuzzy social network analysis, we can find the organizational structure of a team, the pattern of communication in a team. Then, the performance of a team can be analyzed by the organizational structure and communication pattern of a team.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Importance of Service Quality Factors in PMR Based on Grey Relational Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the grey relation theory, the paper presented a grey relational assessment model to evaluate the importance of various quality factors in property management of residence (PMR). First, this study found out twenty main service quality factors that influence overall service quality of property management of residence (SQPMR) based on SERVQUAL instrument and interview with experts and literature review, then, introduced the method and process of computing the grey relation degree between overall SQPMR and twenty service quality factors. Finally, the application analysis of a general residence was presented. The empirical results from the general residence show that the selected twenty quality factors all are important for overall SQPMR, but their degrees of influence are different.

articleTitle: An Upgraded Load-Aware Routing Protocol for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Minimum-hop strategy of normal routing protocols for ad hoc wireless networks doesn't consider the load of the network, which may lead to network congestion and degrade performance of the network thereafter. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a simple and effective modified version of AODV-Load-Aware AODV (LA-AODV), in which, each node decides whether or not to accept routing requests from other nodes according to its local link layer load. Simulation results show that the upgraded LA-AODV performs better than AODV, which bring the overall improvement on the network performance.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on Impact of Real Estate Credit Scale on House Price
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a brief summary of real estate credit policies in recent years is reviewed, and then an empirical analysis, which is based on the data of years from 1997 to 2007, on the relationship between the average house price and the national real estate credit scale is made. The results indicate that there is a relevancy between them, while the loans for real estate development make a different influence on the fluctuation of real estate price compared with that influence made by individual housing loans. In the end, the paper gives some suggestions for the healthy development of house market.

articleTitle: The Visualization Study on Expert Selection in Peer-Review Based on Knowledge Mapping
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The article describes a method that can solve the selection problem of peer review experts - Scientometrics. From the external part of the scientific community, we can deal with the expert selection of peer review that is the internal part of the scientific community in essence. And using knowledge mapping as visualization tool, we can make all kinds of information maps about peer-review experts in order to scientific selection. Only the scientific selection of peer review experts can guarantee the scientific evaluation of the objectiveness, impartiality and fairness.

articleTitle: Improvement of an Encryption Algorithm Based on Hyper-Chaos
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problems of Gao algorithm, an improvement of Gao algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the shuffling procedure is combined with pixel diffusion to solve the problem that permutation isn't relative to the pixel values in Gao algorithm. Secondly, to solve the problem that the keystream isn't sensitive to plaintext in Gao algorithm, the feedback mechanism is introduced in the pixel encryption procedure, which makes the generation of keystream relative with plaintext. Finally, it is from analysis and experiments that the improved algorithm is secure and valid.

articleTitle: Economic Model Based on Micro-Payment in P2P Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present the problem of free-riding is serious in P2P network. Free-riding behaviors not only reduce the network scale but only severely restrict the advantage of P2P system. In this paper, an economic model of currency exchange which based on the micro-payment platform with an incentive mechanism is proposed. In the platform, the resources and the services provided by nodes are priced as virtual currency; the excess cost are stored into the node account and paid services can be achieved. The implement of the model is described. This model can effectively solve the problem of free-riding.

articleTitle: Aircraft Type Recognition Based on Shortwave Speech Communication with Auditory Perception
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies aircraft type recognition based on shortwave speech communication. Frequency bands are selected based on wavelet packet decomposition (WPD), considering Bark scale with auditory masking properties, which combines with physical properties of the target acoustic signal simultaneously. Support vector machine (SVM) is used as classifier. The simulation results of aircraft type recognition have shown that WPD based on Bark scale combining with physical properties (BWPD) can extract the robust feature of aircraft cabin background sound and identify the five kinds of aircrafts with high recognition rate. BWPD-SVM has achieved more excellent performance and higher recognition rate than MFCC-SVM and WPD-HOC-SVM.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of Low Frequency Wavelet Coefficients Based on Non-Parameter Local Transformation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Low frequency wavelet coefficients are very useful to image recognition and understanding. While the applications of the low frequency wavelet coefficients are limited in nowadays. In this paper, the authors present a new method of the image retrieval by extracting BFV (Binary Feature Vector, BFV) and TFV (Ternary Feature Vector, TFV) of low frequency wavelet coefficients based on non-parameter local transformation, which develops the application of the low frequency wavelet coefficients. On the other hand, TFV features extraction method overcomes the disadvantages of the typical census transformation by using the adaptive threshold and the adjustive coefficient f. In our experiments, our method is compared with the GLCM, Markov and Fractal algorithms, and the results prove that our method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Evaluation Model of Service Quality: Study on A 3PL Company in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Logistics services have developed greatly in the last decade in China, and had a continuously increasing demand for speed, reliability, reduced costs and value added services. To minimize the potential negative effects, Logistics service quality is paid more and more attention. This paper is to develop a fuzzy evaluation model for assessing service quality of a 3PL company. The model includes two levels consisting of three criteria and their attributes. The result calculated by the model is for decision-makers.

articleTitle: Non-Blocking Passive Replication Consistent Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Replication plays an important role in fault tolerant field which can improve the availability of distributed systems. After analyzing two shortcomings of the passive replication approach, which are update backup state frequently and slow recovery after the primary fault, this paper proposes a non-blocking consistent model, NBPRC. NBPRC satisfies the correctness criteria of passive replication that are termination, total order and response completeness.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Influence of Process Management Capability on IT Application Level
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Selecting enterprise IT application level is a process influenced by multi-factor. This research is conducted by constructing the measurement model and using questionnaires that were collected by enterprise interview. Based on empirical model and parameters estimation, this paper has a thorough discussion on influence mechanism which is about how process management capability improves enterprise IT application level. The findings show that process management capability influencing enterprise IT application level is a dynamic process and different process management capabilities lead to different speed of improving enterprise IT application level. And the analysis indicates that enterprise's choice on IT application level must match its own process management capability by paying attention to the cultivation of process management capacity.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of XML-Based Communication Protocol for CECSS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Concerning the features of multi-objects and massive data transmission, a XML-based method to design and implement communication protocol for CECSS is presented. With the aid of UML, the typical requesting and responding protocols of CECSS are analyzed through object-oriented concept. Based on object-oriented analysis of the protocol, the mechanism of designing communication protocol following W3C's XML Schema specification is illustrated. Finally, the main flow of embedding the protocol into CECSS is given by packing and parsing protocol in a CECSS application prototype.

articleTitle: Fast Square-Wave Transform for High Frame Rate Imaging with Limited Diffraction Beams
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: High frame rate(HFR) medical imaging system was developed by Lu Jian-yu in 1997. One of the important steps of this system is weighting with exact limited-diffraction array beams. Recently, Lu Jian-yu developed a new imaging method with square-wave aperture weightings instead of sine and cosine aperture weightings. Experimental results show that almost the same quality of images can be obtained with the square-wave aperture weighting method and with the exact limited-diffraction array beam weightings. But the method with square-wave aperture weighting is more simple, and this method costs less time than the method with exact limited-diffraction array beam weightings. In this paper, a fast square-wave transform is introduced to the HFR imaging method. This fast square-wave transform can be used to deal with the data when the number of data samples is prime. This method can reduce about half of the computation by rearranging the data sequence. And the characters of this method make it have a potential to be actualized easily with digital circuits.

articleTitle: Primary Research on Financing Innovation for China Coal CDM Projects Development
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper gives an update introduction about China coal CDM projects, financing problems in China coal CDM development was analysized and some innovation suggestions for China CDM projects was given. Finally some successful experience in India CDM financing structure was introduced to China.

articleTitle: Automatic Outline Generation of Jiaguwen Based on Curve Fitting of Uniform B-Spline with Shape Parameter
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method of curve fitting based on uniform quadratic B-spline with shape parameter is discussed in this paper. We apply this method in generating Jiaguwen outlines and change the fitting curves by adjusting the shape parameters. During the process of generating fitting curves, the least square method is used to improve the accuracy of curves fitting. The results of experiment demonstrate the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationships between Enterprise Knowledge Structure, Knowledge Creation and Knowledge Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the enterprise knowledge structure, which brings constant evolution and creation of new knowledge under the influence of knowledge field. And knowledge innovation is realized through the application of knowledge. Based on this theoretical frame work, the writer constructs the conceptual model of the relationships between knowledge structure, knowledge creation and knowledge innovation, and concludes that we should study the knowledge innovation practice from the perspective of the relationship between enterprise knowledge structure and knowledge innovation, these can provide a theory basis for further empirical studies on the concrete ways and means of enterprise knowledge management.

articleTitle: Acceptance and Use of an E-Publishing Platform: An Empirical Study on Chinese SciencePaper Online
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For deeply understanding the acceptance and use of Chinese SciencePaper Online (CSO), this study developed a research framework to identify factors that would influence the acceptance and use of CSO using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB). A model with 6 constructs and 7 paths are constructed considering both theoretical and practical backgrounds. Then a survey involving more than 504 users of CSO was conducted to examine this proposed model using structural equation modeling (SEM) technique. Analysis on relationships among those factors in the proposed model that influence the scholars' acceptance and use of this E-publishing platform are also made. Moreover, approaches to enhance the acceptance and use of it are discussed. It is found that (1) Perceived Usefulness has the greatest total effect on Behavioral Intention; (2) both Perceived Behavioral Control and Perceived Ease of Use directly play significant roles in influencing Behavioral Intention; (3) Subjective Norms have significant indirect effects on Behavioral Intention through Perceived Usefulness.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Relationship between Knowledge Spillover and Enterprises Learning in Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Enterprise learning is an important way to maintain the advantages in a cluster. It is a serious issue for the clusters of enterprises, institutions, policy makers at all levels to enhance the competitive ability of the clusters through industrial collective learning. This paper established the relationship model to analyze the systemic relation among the variables based on the hypothesis. And through the method of statistic description and correlation, factor analysis, reliability test and the multiple regressions this paper supported some of the hypothesis and denied three of them. From the model we may get some of the conclusions and some suggestions.

articleTitle: ArcGIS-Based One Dimension Predictive Model of River Water Quality and It's Application
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Surface water pollution is one of the greatest environmental problems faced by large cities in China. Therefore, it is an important mission for these cities to enhance water environmental management, as well as preventing and remedying water pollution. With the worsening of water quality, there is a stricter requirement for water environmental management in cities and the relative areas. Consequently, the method of digital management is very requirement and development trend of regional environmental management. For systemically, speedy and effectively to improving the surface water quality and urban environmental quality, within the article, urban water quality information management system, based on Visual Basic 6.0, is explored and constructed on Arc GIS platform by the secondary exploitation of Arc Engine geographic information system. This article briefs the objective and constitution of these subsystems, and introduces the function of data management subsystem, outfall management subsystem as well as water quality prediction subsystem, which based on brief introduction about the aim and constitution of this subsystem. As a subsystem of urban synthetically information system, an urban water environmental information management system based on GIS and is also a complicated system relating to many social aspects. Moreover, the construction and the process of the system have quite reference-valued for the implementation of digital environmental management and reforming the water environmental quality in many cities.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Elastic Consistency of Distributed Virtual Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Elastic Consistency of Distributed Virtual Environment,"
by Wei Dai and Peng Hu
1st International Conference on Information Science and Engineering (ICISE), 2009. Dec. 2009, pp.3310-3314

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper is a duplication of the original text from the paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"Elastic Consistency in Decentralized Distributed Virtual Environments,"
by Hermann Schloss, Jean Botev, Markus Esch, Alex Hohfeld, Ingo Scholtes, Peter Sturm
in the Proceedings of the International Conference on Automated Solutions for Cross Media Content and Multi-channel Distribution, 2008. AXMEDIS '08. Nov. 2008, pp.249-252


Distributed Virtual Environments like online games or 3D virtual worlds have become very popular in the last few years and a more substantial surge in popularity and use is expected. Because of the huge number of users, such environments will undergo a change of infrastructure from a centralized to a decentralized one, making higher demands on consistency issues. This paper addresses consistency problems which may occur in distributed virtual environments and introduces the elastic consistency model to tackle these problems. According to elastic consistency, different consistency levels setting up a trade-off between consistency and responsiveness of the environment should be introduced in order to provide an efficient way of interaction on a global scale.

articleTitle: A New Spatial Downsampling Algorithm for DCT-Domain Video Transcoder
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Spatial resolution reduction of compressed video is highly desirable in video transcoding. Many studies have addressed this problem, but they either cause drift error or have high computation complexity. A new spatial downsampling algorithm for DCT-Domain video transcoder is proposed in this paper, in which L×M sub-blocks of N×N are combined into a L×N rows and M×N columns blocks in DCT-Domain firstly, by extracting the left-top N×N low-frequency coefficients from this block, the new N×N downsampled block is the obtained. Experimental results confirm that the proposed algorithm performs better than other algorithms in terms of PNSR of reconstructed video sequences, furthermore, the computation complexity reduced greatly. sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: The PSTN Based Remote PLD for Distant Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On purpose to develop network-based engineering education, we produce a new ISP (In System Programming) tool that is capable of remotely designing, debugging or upgrading digital systems and products made of PLD by PSTN. The students can do all digital design and research work at home or anywhere as long as they have a telephone at hand. This tool can be used by schools or universities, where the courses of Digital Logic Circuits or Digital System Design are learned.

articleTitle: The M/G/1 Vacation Queue with General Retrial Times and Repairable Server
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper considers an M/G/1 retrial queue system with single vacation and server breakdowns. The necessary and sufficient condition for the system stability is obtained. The queue indices of server are also derived with the supplementary variable method. Besides, we give numerical examples to illustrate the effect of the parameters on several performance characteristics.

articleTitle: An Improved Adaptive Time-Threshold Based Scheme for Cellular Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper points out the disadvantage of ATTS scheme in performance of the handoff voice call dropping probabilities and then proposes a novel Improved Adaptive Time-Threshold based bandwidth allocation Scheme (IATTS) for voice calls in cellular wireless networks. In order to decrease the prioritized handoff dropping probability, proposed scheme makes prioritized handoff calls have preemptive priority over non-prioritized handoff calls on basis of reserving adaptive algorithm of ATTS. Simulation results show that IATTS further improves QoS of handoff calls while keeping good performances of the new call blocking probability and the bandwidth utilization compared with ATTS. Hence, the proposed scheme provides good QoS guarantees for both mobile voice users and the service provider.

articleTitle: An Area-Efficient Digital Interpolation Filter Applied in Stereo Audio Sigma-Delta DAC
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An area-efficient interpolation filter used in stereo audio Sigma-Delta DACs (Digital-to-Analog Converters) is presented in this paper. The 128× interpolation filter consist of three stage. The first half-band filter adopts the improved poly-phase structure, which eliminates the delay cells of even branch through sharing the delay cells with odd branch. The second 1/4 band filter gives the images caused by the first interpolation another attenuation and leaves a large design margin to the SC filter. Dual-channel multiplexing structure is applied to save the chip area through sharing the digital circuit by the left channel and right channel. The simulation and measurement results show that the designed interpolation filter meets the demand of audio applications. The design is fabricated on TSMC 0.18¿m 1.8V/3.3V 1P5M CMOS process and the digital part only takes a chip area of 0.43 mm2.

articleTitle: Development of a GIS-Based Marine Oil Spill Response Information System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Marine Oil Spill Response Information System, which serves as a decision support system designed to effectively response to the marine oil spill accidents, has been developed through the integration of a series of numerical models with the Geographic Information System (GIS). In the system, the three dimensional hydrodynamic model, oil spill trajectory and fate models are embedded in GIS. The oil spill response and environmental databases are also established to provide decision support to the emergency teams. Finally the function of the system is illustrated through a case study of an oil spill accident which happened at the Pearl River Estuary of Guangdong Province of China in December 2004. The simulation gave a reasonable estimation of spilled oil trajectory with limited environmental input data. The accurate prediction of the behavior of the spilled oil is crucial to the successful recovery operation and protection of marine environment.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Ability of High-Tech Enterprise Strategic Alliances
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper from the overall high-tech enterprises, individual enterprises and technical capacity to build high-tech enterprise strategic alliances' evaluating indicator system, carries on the dynamic evaluation using the BP neural network method to it.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Bessel Beam and Its Application in Tissue Harmonic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Bessel beam has a large depth of field and has been applied in high frame rate (HFR) ultrasonic imaging. In order to improve the spatial resolution in HFR imaging, a theoretical and numerical study for the second harmonic component of J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> Bessel beam is presented, based on the nonlinear KZK equation. B-mode fundamental and second harmonic images of scatters in typical tissue-like medium are constructed using a computation imaging model. The result shows that the second harmonic of Bessel beam is limited diffracting and has a narrower mainlobe beyond the near-field. Harmonic imaging with Bessel beam can provide better spatial resolution than fundamental imaging. Thus an imaging method with high time and spatial resolution is feasible.

articleTitle: Inter-Organizational Trust Game Analysis in Industry- University-Institute Alliance
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Trust is the key factor for inter-organizational cooperation in an industry-university-institute alliance. This paper constructs a basic model of trust game in Industry-University-Institute Alliance, and respectively analyzes the game equilibrium results of single game without constrained condition, single and repeated game with constrained conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Tropospheric Zenith Delay Solved by GPS Data
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The tropospheric zenith delay of Great Wall station in Antarctic grouped with surrounding IGS stations is solved by GAMIT/GLOBK software using GPS observational data. In the process of solving, IGS final ephemeris and precision forecast ephemeris are used to solve the zenith delay in the software. The solutions are analyzed to draw some conclusions. The results show that the zenith delay of different stations solved by the two kinds of ephemeris data at the same time is almost same. The differential minimum is 0 mm and the differential maximum is 0.5 mm. Therefore, the precipitable water vapor content over the GPS stations may be directly acquired by precision forecast ephemeris in this software. It is a useful significance for detecting water vapor content on real time and real-time weather forecast.

articleTitle: A Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on Hyper-Chaotic Sequences
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on classical PSO (abbreviated for particle swarm optimization) algorithm and quantum theory, this paper proposes an improved quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm - zbQPSO (abbreviated for zhao Bezier quantum-behaved PSO) algorithm. Identical particle system is introduced to update the position of particle, hyper-chaotic thought introduced to chaotic search for every particle and average search length thought of search algorithm was introduced to improve the full and local searching ability, convergence rate and calculating precision for elementary particle swarm. The calculation results for classical function show that capability of improved algorithm is superior to classical PSO algorithm and quantum PSO algorithm.

articleTitle: Applying Extended Chebyshev Polynomials to Construct a Trap-Door One-Way Function in Real Field
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the characteristics of Chebyshev Polynomials are analysed and the key point is the feature of semi-group, which might be applied in the cryptography. Next, we extend Chebyshev polynomials from real field to finite field, and propose a trap-door one-way function. According to the proposed function, a secure and practical encryption scheme is given and the feasibility and security of the scheme is discussed. In the end, we conclude that the cryptography algorithm is rational and practical.

articleTitle: Fusion Scheme at Feature Level Based on Air-Borne Electronic and Imaging Information
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the fusion scheme at feature level is brought forward by using both air-borne imaging and electronic reconnaissance information, the author not only gives the structure of whole scheme but expound realization of several pivotal steps in detail. Moreover, the author analyzes the rationality of construction for fusion scheme and advantage of fusion results by making best use of mutual complementary information between two kinds of sensors. The results of simulation experiment illustrate that analysis is correct and fusion scheme is effective.

articleTitle: Unsupervised and Semi-Supervised Bounded C-Support Vector Machines with Polyhedral Perturbations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Support Vector Machines (SVMs) have been dominant learning techniques for more than ten years, and mostly applied to supervised learning problems. These years two-class unsupervised and semi-supervised classification algorithms based on Bounded C-SVMs, Bounded n-SVMs and Lagrangian SVMs (LSVMs) respectively, which are relaxed to Semi-definite Programming (SDP), get good classification results. These support vector methods implicitly assume that training data in the optimization problems to be known exactly. But in practice, the training data are usually subjected to measurement noise. Zhao et al proposed robust version to Bounded C. SVMs, Bounded n-SVMs and Lagrangian SVMs (LSVMs) respectively with perturbations in convex polyhedrons and ellipsoids. The region of perturbation in the methods mentioned above is not general, and there are many perturbations in non-convex regions in practice. Therefore we proposed unsupervised and semi-supervised classification problems based on Bounded C. Support Vector Machines with general polyhedral perturbations. But the problem has difficulty to compute, we will find its semidefinite relaxation that can approximate it well. Numerical results confirm the robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Performance of Human Resources in Research and Development Institutes in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Focusing on the performance of R&D (research and development) efforts, this paper analyzes the different effects of three essential R&D institutes' various R&D inputs on the regional technological innovation with empirical evidence of 30 provinces in China during 2001-2007, and comparatively analyzes the human resources' performance between developed provinces and less developed provinces. The results show that human resources in each R&D institutes have a significant positive effect on the regional innovation, but the R&D expenditure inputs in public R&D sectors have a negative effect; and that the human resources have a greater effect on developed provinces than less developed provinces.

articleTitle: Study on Synthetical Evaluation Model for Urban Flood Control Engineering Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urban flood control layout, based on which urban flood control engineering projects are constructed, will be synthetically evaluated taking into consideration the social, political, economic, environmental and technical factors involved in different levels. Furthermore, a hierarchical structure model for urban flood control layout is presented in this paper. Then a grey-AHP model is proposed based on the analytic hierarchical process (AHP) and the Grey system theory, by which the layout of multiple-objective programming problem can be simplified into a single-objective problem system. Results from an example demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method, which can be widely used in engineering practice of water resources systems.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluating of Operational Effectiveness of On-Orbit Service System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the structure, function, and technology index system of on-orbit servicing system are presented. The effectiveness index system of on-orbit servicing is established. We analyze the effect which single technology index has on the whole on-orbit servicing system efficiency, by using the idea of sensitivity analysis. Finally, we establish a reasonable and integrated index system of effectiveness evaluation. The new method of effectiveness evaluation presented in this paper could be applied for on-orbit servicing system in the future.

articleTitle: Research of Depth Perception Used in Geometry CAI Based on Dynamic Anaglyph
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Depth perception is a visual discrimination in detecting the relative space position. A review of research on depth perception and spatial ability reveals that recognition on anaglyphs allows student to construct and store an image when it is needed in geographic thinking. This paper describes a CAI model of depth perception that was designed to improve spatially based concepts to students. In order to realize the model, we researched on how to generate dynamic anaglyph, which is the key technology to develop the depth perception CAI system and we built a mathematical model of dual-viewpoints projection. The concept and the realization are discussed and a first prototype is presented, which effectively solve the problems existed in teaching practice of 3D Spatial Course.

articleTitle: Biorthogonal Multiresolution Analysis of Shearlets
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we will give the framework of biorthogonal multiresolution analysis of shearlets in two dimensions, and study associated mathematical properties. Then, we will generalize the classical cascade algorithm.

articleTitle: The Study of Object-Oriented Classification Method of Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The object-oriented classification method of remote sensing image takes the characteristics of the imaging spectrum and differences in geometric characteristics into account, which can extract more accurate image information. Regard Cangzhou City in Hebei Province as the study area, and ASTER remote sensing image as the data source, first of all, the study area has been multi-scale segmented. It can determine the best optimal partition scale and parameters according to different types of ground respectively, and then makes use of the nearest method to object-oriented classification research. Finally evaluate classification accuracy of the classification results via confusion matrix; what's more make the method compared with the traditional pixel-based maximum likelihood classification results. The results have showed that the results of object-oriented classification effectively avoid the "salt and pepper phenomenon", and the accuracy of overall classification is 91.5486%, Kappa coefficient is 0.8990, both are higher than the overall accuracy of the maximum likelihood method which the accuracy of overall classification is 61.5134%, and Kappa coefficient is 0.4986. So it has very good application prospects in classification application of ASTER data.

articleTitle: Study of Modified Dynamic Binary Search Algorithm in RFID System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Collision is a familiar problem in application of RFID techniques when there are multiple cards in the effective range of antenna. The total quantity of anti-collision instructions is usually large even if most of the card serial numbers are consecutive, and the reading speed of the reader will slow down. A modified dynamic binary search algorithm discussed in this paper could improve the reading operation of readers. The anti-collision instruction will not be sent from readers while the collision happens at the first bit, and the serial numbers of both cards in collision will be obtained directly. By this algorithm, the speed of reading operation will be increased greatly.

articleTitle: The Relationships among Performance of ISD Projects and Influence Factors
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Researchers have done many studies on the low performance of information system development (ISD), requirement uncertainty, user interaction, personal conflict as well as IS performance has become focus. Previous literature has mentioned the importance of the above four, but empirical studies are handful. This paper attempts to summarize the relationships among them through empirical research, providing a reference to IS management.

articleTitle: Integrating a Legacy 2D GIS with 3D Geographic Simulators through View and Query Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We developed a generic application framework for integrating a legacy 2D geographic information system (GIS) with 3D visual geographic simulation systems. Our framework provides a set of 3D visual components required for the development of a new interactive 3D visual geographic simulation integrated with GIS functions. Our integration framework provides two fundamental integration mechanisms, i.e., view integration and query integration mechanisms. The view integration maps the 2D rendering of a legacy 2D GIS on the surface of the 3D geography used in a 3D visual Geographic simulator and dispatches every event on the geography surface to the original 2D GIS. The query integration automatically converts each 3D simulation result that is shown as a set of highlighted regions on the surface of the geography to the corresponding regional query to the 2D GIS. Our framework integrates 3D Geographic simulation systems with legacy 2D GIS using interactive and visual environments.

articleTitle: A Scheme of CA Digital Signature Based on Intrusion Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The security of critical infrastructures like water, gas or power grid control systems has been discussed more thoroughly in recent years due to recent events that have questioned their security. One has to understand that, despite some systems being considered secure, attackers will continue to discover new vulnerabilities, to try new attacks and some of those attempts will succeed. One approach to address this problem that is gaining momentum recently is intrusion tolerance. Based on this paradigm, there already are intrusion-tolerant network architectures that enhance the protection of critical infrastructures. This paper justifies how we combine the concept of intrusion-tolerant with public key infrastructure(PKI) and presents some in-sights on how to do it. With the kernel of PKI, which is certificate authority, this paper brings the concept of intrusion tolerance to CA, and gives a feasible scheme of CA based on intrusion tolerance. The most important part is that it discusses the system architect, a digital signature of CA based on intrusion tolerance, and the working process of the whole system. Aiming at some shortcomings, it indicates the further work which needs to be improved in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Principle and Strategies of Building High-Performance Project Team Based on Synergetic
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Project teams are becoming more and more crucial to the innovations of technology and products. Studies should be delved to make the team members both work effectively and achieve the expected goal when getting them together. In this paper, by using Synergetic, the author analyses the order parameters and relationship between them, which affect the performance of a team.
