It is concluded that any organization should provide essential material flow, energy flow and information flow to his project teams which are regarded as open systems on the basis of the Slaving Principle, then all order parameters will play definitive roles during the evolutionary process of the systems, which evolving gradually into an orderly structure that is called self-organization, as a result the teams performance will be improved.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Visualization Method for Science Fund Management Based on GIS Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data visualization plays a very important role for science fund management. However, current information management system of National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) fails to portray the region distribution characters of science fund data. In this paper, we propose a novel data visualization method which introduces Geographic Information Systems (GIS) techniques to NSFC management system. In particular, spatial statistics and expression mechanism is applied to achieve the optimal layout of science fund data. Our empirical study shows that the proposed method is more effective and convenient for science fund management than the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Power Distribution Reliability Management by Objective Based on GIS Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve meticulous management in reliability of power supply, the system of MBO (management by objective) is studied based on power distribution network GIS platform. First, a new coding method which used GUID (Global Unique Identifier) technology is integrated in spatial database design. The codes can describe completely the topological structure of distribution network which is necessary for MBO. Then a new algorithm used in objective decomposition for power supply reliability is designed. By this algorithm the total power supply reliability rate of the whole distribution network can be properly decomposed and assigned into each power line. The factors which can influence the results of objective decomposition are discussed and determined. The algorithm is integrated in power distribution network GIS platform, and the practical example shows that the decomposition algorithm can obviously improve the reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Some Thoughts Based on the Evaluation of Classroom Teaching and Its Data-Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Up to a certain extent, keeping a firm grasp on the improvement of the critical aspect of the classroom teaching evaluation, can promote and facilitate the teaching reform and its quality. This paper describes the method of using SAS for the classroom teaching evaluation and the data regression analysis. The final result will help to improve the quality of teaching and put forward more concrete measures of improvement, and by changing the scope of data samples, we can easily achieve the comprehensive evaluation result of the same class of different teachers, the same course of different teachers, a faculty, an university, a region as well as the result across the country level. Through the practical experiment, the results of case studies received students' high recognition and have very good reference value.

articleTitle: Comment on the Software Requirements Process and the Application of Standard
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In software engineering project, requirement process is the beginning and basis process of a project. It affects whether a software engineering project could be success. With the development of software engineering, it has been taken more and more seriously to standardize project process. So the article analyses the software requirements process and how to apply China national standard in project requirement process from the angle of standardizing a project.

articleTitle: Image Regressing Technique Research of Astronomical Blurring Images: Astronomical Image Regressing Based on Wiener Filtering
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In astronomical telescope systems, the image quality is strongly influenced by the focus scattering effect and Gaussian white noise. We apply Wiener filtering method to regressing the blurred images in terms of the point spread function of the lens system. The result shows that this method can effectively restore the original image. It provides a powerful technique for treating the similar problems on image processing in astronomical telescope systems.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Airflow Field in Grinding
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With a view to find better ways for coolant delivery, the boundary layer of peripheral air of grinding wheel is simulated using finite volume method. By means of introducing Sparlart-Allmaras (SA) model into the mathematical model, the airflow field is calculated and pressure distributions and velocity distributions are obtained by simulations. An experiment is run to testify solutions of numerical simulation accordingly. The simulation solutions are in consistent with the experiment results on the whole. Therefore, this simulation method holds true for predicting the performances of airflow field around grinding wheel when grinding wheel rotates at high speeds. Based on the numerical solution results obtained in this paper, the causes to disadvantage of coolant delivery into the grinding zone are studied from the point of view of the pressure and velocity. In the end, one optimizing way of coolant delivery is specified and a few useful conclusions are drawn for applications of coolant delivery in the course of high speed grinding. Methods and conclusions of this research are available for perfection of grinding theory and applications of cooling in the future.

articleTitle: On Capacity of Multi-Code MIMO-CDMA in Ricean Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We investigate the capacity of MIMO-CDMA system based on LS spread sequence with suboptimum multicode detector in Ricean fading channel. We compare the capacity of optimum ML multicode detector and suboptimum ZF (zero-forcing) multicode detector under two different Ricean models. It shows multicode detector's behavior is very different with different Ricean models. When Ricean channel is beneficial, performance of ZF multicode detector can approach that of ML multicode detector rapidly as K-factor increases. Otherwise, the loss of capacity incurred by ZF multicode detector is significance when K-factor increases. This result gives guideline in the development of practical wideband MIMO-CDMA system based on LS code.

articleTitle: The Research on Intangible Assets Composition and Characteristics of Enterprises, Universities and Governments
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the coming of knowledge-based economy, the intangible assets shows the value which tangible assets cannot show. Because universities, enterprises and governments do not have a clear understanding to their own intangible assets, so this kind of assets is lack of effective management and cannot play their due role. This paper defines the connotation and composition of intangible assets of universities, enterprises and governments, analyzes the uniqueness to help universities, enterprises and governments evaluate and manage their own intangible assets, utilizes market discipline to rise their value, promotes the development of the higher education, improves the enterprise competitiveness, increases public revenues.

articleTitle: SESANMS: A Scalable and Extensible Architecture for Web Based NMS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Web based and distributed NMS is the trend of new generation NMS solution to manage large-scale network system. This paper presents a scalable and extensible architecture for web based telecommunication network management system. The architecture is based on the J2EE and EJB technologies that allow all the parts of the network management system to be located on separate computers located in different location. A practical telecommunication network management system has been implemented according to the SESANMS architecture. The experiments show that the SESANMS architecture can be used to construct web based NMS to manage the geographically distributed and large-scale network consisting of thousands devices in the distributed, reliable and perfect performance environments.

articleTitle: An Effective Genetic Algorithm for QoS-Based Routing Optimization Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Routing of packets in networks requires that a path will be selected either dynamically while the packets are being forwarded, or statically (in advance) as in source routing from a source node to a destination. The genetic algorithms which has been applied to routing optimization problem is difficult because network is not a widely connectivity network. If we use traditional GA, it may generate some illegal routes during initialization, crossover and mutation. In order to remove these illegal solutions, some methods are used, for example establishing legitimate solution space and determining nodes connectivity before decoder. These methods increase algorithm complexity and computation time to some extent. In the paper an improved GA is brought out with a new encoding and decoding method. We describe how possible routes can be produced from prior knowledge, and then be selected based on fitness with respect to QoS. The decoding procedure is similar with Maze algorithm. Based on our experimental results, this approach adapts to network routing optimization problem, and it has obtained better convergence and stability.

articleTitle: A Study of Orthogonality Quality of a Class of Matrix-Valued Uni-Wavelet Packets with Compact Support
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wavelet analysis has become a popular subject in scientific research for over twenty years. In this paper, the matrix-valued uni-wavelet packets are defined. A procedure for constructing the matrix-valued uni-wavelet packets is presented. The properties of matrix-valued wavelet packets are discussed by using integral transformation and operator theory. Finally, new orthogonal bases of L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(R,C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s×s</sup>) is constructed from the orthogonal matrix-valued wavelet packets.

articleTitle: Wireless Channel Allocation Based on Double Auction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a model of wireless channel allocation scheme based on double auction, this scheme has the following properties: The available and the demand of the wireless channel is balance in the auction; The wireless users' dominant strategy is to provide their true value; The wireless service providers' dominant strategy is to provide their true value.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research about the Bridge Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Subspace-Based Blind Separation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An orthogonal subspace-based method is proposed for the blind separation of convolutive mixtures of nonstationary colored signals. The proposed method relies on eigenvalue decomposition (EVD) of a specially constructed matrix, which contains inform from two orthogonal subspaces. A multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) blind deconvolution problem can be converted to multiple single-input multiple-output (SIMO) blind deconvolution problems by using the EVD. Numerical simulation demonstrates that the method can successfully separate audio and speech signals from their convolutive mixtures.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Collaborative Learning Issue of Network Curriculum Based on Knowledge Management: Case Study on the Course of eCommerce in Tourism
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on High-Tech Industrialization Based on Secondary Business Incubation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The concept of secondary business incubation improves business incubation from the stage of enterprise incubation to the stage of industry incubation. The core function of secondary business incubator is high-tech industrialization. Finally some policy suggestions on high-tech industrialization based on secondary business incubation are given.

articleTitle: Distributed Data Recovery Based on Grid Service
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data recovery on Erasure code could effectively improve the reliability of data storage; however, the algorithm also increased time of data recovery. On the basis of that, this paper presents distributed data recovery based on grid service (DDR-GS), which combines with grid services to improve the efficiency of data recovery. Through extensive experiments on random datasets, it is shown that with the increasing of the number of nodes, DDR-GS improves the speed of matrix calculation. And the time of data recovery is greatly reduced about 77.74%.

articleTitle: A Center Selection Algorithm with Delay Constrained and Delay-Variation Minimized
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Center-based trees are one kind of group-shared trees. Packets are distributed over center-based trees from all sources to all multicast destinations. Because of its simplicity, the idea of center-based trees is used in multicast protocols such as CBT (Core-Based Tree) and PIM (Protocol Independent Multicast). There are two main problems in center-based trees. One is the core selection problem. The other is the routing problem. Since many applications require that the delay and delay-variation are constrained, the delay and delay-variation constrained center-based tree problem is proposed. It is proved that this problem is a NP-complete problem. And a new center selection algorithm DVCT (Delay Variation based Centered Tree) which try to minimized the delay variation with constrained delay. The simulation results show that this algorithm is a delay constrained algorithm with low delay variation and time complexity.

articleTitle: A Strategy Research on Resource Discovery Based on Education Grid Community
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper puts forward a kind of strategy that makes use of small world model to discover to educate resources, mainly according to founded the model of educational resources based on grid community, the characteristics of the grid communities and educational resources distributes in the grid,. The paper analyzed the characteristics of small world model and the small world features that the education grid community has, built up the small world model based on education resources grid community and put forward resource dynamic discover algorithm Based on community, and carried on analysis and imitate to the algorithm.

articleTitle: The Characteristics of the Lightning Locating System and Its Application in Lightning Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we primarily discuss how the lightning locating system (LLS) working. We present the method of lightning risk assessment and the process of the data received from the LLS sensors. Also discussed will be the practical applications in lightning risk assessment.

articleTitle: Applicability Analysis of the Models on Prepayment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Prepayment risk of the residential mortgage has gradually become important to commercial banks. It affects banks' income, disturbs cash flow management, triggers reinvesting risk and blocks the process of securitization. This paper states four main methods of constructing empirical models, focuses on analyzing their applicability in China and finally comes to a conclusion that an econometric model is a suitable choice.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Memory Management Mechanism for Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of the first-fit arithmetic and dynamic equidimension memory allocation arithmetic, this paper proposes a new solution of dynamic memory management applied in embedded system. With the appending of dynamic equidimension memory table in the first-fit arithmetic, time spent in releasing the memory blocks is no longer dependent on the length of the allocated linked table. Meanwhile a statistical mechanism for memory demand is added to further enhance the realization efficiency of the arithmetic.

articleTitle: RFID Information Acquisition: An Analysis and Comparison between ONS and LDAP
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RFID is regarded as a link between the virtual world and the real world, and it's a key problem to acquire RFID-related information effectively. EPCglobal proposed a service called ONS to solve this problem, but ONS has weakness in the granularity of resolving, data manageability, application flexibility and security. This paper gives detailed analysis of these weaknesses and introduced a new RFID information acquisition mechanism based on LDAP. Advantages of this new mechanism are also explored in this paper.

articleTitle: Semi-Supervised Covariance Estimation Using Clustering for Small Sample Size Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Small sample size (SSS) problem is still a puzzle in classification. For the generally used Maximum Likelihood Classifier (MLC), the small size of training sample with respect to the high-dimensional data deteriorates the performance of parameter estimation. In the extreme case, MLC could be disabled by the singularity of the covariance matrices. Generally speaking, predecessors experimented in two aspects to solve the matter. One aspect is dimensionality reduction for higher dimensional data; the other is covariance estimation. Classical methods to estimate covariance matrix calculate the common covariance matrix of various forms to replace or modify the sample covariance. However, most methods work in the supervised pattern and consider little about the useful information contained in the vast number of unlabeled samples. In view of this, we propose a semi-supervised scheme for covariance estimation. The method mainly involves clustering of all samples to obtain C clusters and the corresponding covariance matrices(C is the class number), and combination of the matrices generated by clustering and original sample covariance to modify the latter. Four experiments are carried out to assess the performance of proposed method and the results show the method performs well.

articleTitle: A Water Marking Algorithm of Digital Image Based on DWT-SVD
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presented a water marking algorithm based on discrete wavelet transform (DWT) of image and singular value decomposition (SVD). After decomposing the original image into four bands, the SVD is applied to the blocks of the low sub-band. To improve the security the watermark is scrambled by Arnold transform, and then is embedded into the largest singular value of every block. The watermark can be extracted without the original image, among which a person who does not know the secret key cannot correctly retrieve the watermark.

articleTitle: Analyzing Traffic Characteristics of Application Using Chi-Square Statistic
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The knowledge of traffic behavior characteristics of every application has vital effect on the accuracy and granularity of application identification. Based on analyzing the Chi-Square Statistics, a novel method named ABSA is proposed to analyze the traffic behavior characteristics of applications. The ABSA method does not focus on any certain applications; in contrast, it aims at providing a quantitative measurement for describing the behavior differences among applications. So that the traffic behavior characteristics and their significances of any applications can be determined. The theoretical analysis and experiments results also indicate that, the ABSA method can keep the sequence of behavior characteristic significance unchanged in packet sampling environment, which is often used by NetFlow and many other flow information collecting systems, to simplify the process of characteristic re-selection when sampling rate changes.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of National Meteorological Computing Resource Management System Based on Grid
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to track and manage the computing resource usage and allocate resources scientifically, meteorological computing resource management system is developed based on meteorological computing Grid. We explore to establish an abstract meteorological model and a computing resources management database for describing the meteorological computing resources on an unified form. National meteorological computing resource management system involves 3 layers: remote meteorological grid nodes, obtaining of resource status information and WEB representation. UNICORE is employed to construct meteorological grid nodes. Postgresql database has been adopted on resource accounting and resource analysis. Making use of PERL programming language, we develop the resources statistics process. With the wide deployment of meteorological computing resource management system, the major high performance computer systems have been under integrated monitor. The key issues are resolved including heterogeneity system shield, fine accounting, user security, statistics and analysis, and so on. As a result, the utilization of meteorological high-performance computing resources is improved and local meteorological forecast operations or researches are conducted widely.

articleTitle: Chemical Image Recognition Based on BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method to identify the catalyst activity based on BP neural network is proposed in this paper in order to enrich the recognition methods of chemistry catalyst activity. In this method some important image features from the process of using chemistry catalyst can be extracted depending on the gray level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) by image filtering and image segmentation. Furthermore, a BP neural network is trained by the image features and used to identify the catalyst activity. The result of experiment shows that recognition rate of chemistry catalyst is increased and the production cost is saved accordingly for the reduction of chemistry catalyst.

articleTitle: A Study of the Critical Factors That Impact Users Satisfaction in ERP Implementations in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) is an enterprise-wide information system that integrates and controls all the business processes in the entire organization. The issues of ERP implementation have been given much attention due to its high failure rate. The ERP literature has reported that many ERPs' users were not satisfied with system and "users' resistance" was identified as a main factor for ERP failure. This research investigates the Critical factors that impact user satisfaction in ERP implementations. A conceptual model that determines the critical factors which influence users' satisfaction will be developed. It can be expected to provide valuable guidelines to support management for organisations while taking decisions regarding the implementation of ERP.

articleTitle: The Nature of News, Insider Ownership, Stock Price and Stock Returns
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper attempts to address the connections among the nature of news, insider ownership, stock price, and stock returns. The empirical studies show that stock price could mislead investors' behavior and enhance the impact of the nature of news on stock returns. Besides, the higher stock price is, the less impact analyst forecast revision would create. This research assumes that investors tend to be over-confident and overestimate their ability to invest when stock price is buoyant, thus ignoring analyst forecast revision. Instead, when stock price declines, the impact of analyst forecast revision would become more significant.

articleTitle: DIJKSTRA Optimization and CAD Based on VC Lowest Cost Process
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Optimal design with the production cost of the manufacturing technology is carried out by the Dijkstra algorithm, the best processing lines and the relevant technological methods with condition of the lowest production cost are obtained. Practical instance with CAD procedure is given.

articleTitle: Parallel Computing Based Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper describe a detailed study into the object-oriented design and implementation of distributed and parallel computing environment for Finite element analysis of parallel manipulator on desktop computers cluster using message passing while communication are needed among related computing nodes. The solution routines were blind to whether the objects were local or remote. Numerical tests were carried out and reasonable speed-up was achieved, particularly for direction solution methods. It is concluded that message passing provides a viable mechanism for computing nodes coordination while implementing distributed parallel computing environment based on personal computer (PC) cluster.

articleTitle: The Application of the Association Rules Mining Based on the Fuzzy Systemic Clustering in the Hydrocracking Refining Device
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Hydrocracking technology is Medium Pressure Cracking technology applied to change the quality of the catalyst cracking diesel oil. It can resolve catalyst cracking diesel oil sulfur, nitrogen, the aromatic hydrocarbon content high, 16- alkanes low etc problem, taking the very important meaning for the environmental protection. Data mining taking data as analysis object is an application technology. Mature technology, accumulated data and practical needs provides a perfect opportunity for the combination of chemical technology and data mining. The paper takes the sulfur content in crude oil and process data of hydrocracking refinery device as mining object, and makes mining algorithm of association rules by the fuzzy systemic clustering as research methods for study. The results show that the association rules mining by the fuzzy systemic clustering in the hydrocracking refining device obtains a good application.

articleTitle: A New Global Calibration Method Using Combined 3D Target
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A global calibration method based on combined 3D target is proposed to solve the calibration problem of two sensors vision system without common view field. The combined 3D target is consisted of two planar targets, which are placed freely according to the sensors' positions. By translating the 3D target properly, the closed-form solution of the transformation from one local camera coordinate frame to another local camera coordinate frame can be computed using the equality of each planar target's translating vector. Simulation results demonstrate high accuracy of proposed calibration method. The proposed method simplifies the global calibration process, and only needs to combine several planar targets to carry out the global calibration.

articleTitle: Automatic Sentiment Analysis for Web User Reviews
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The web contains a wealth of user reviews about a topic concerning positive, negative or mixed mood, but it is a daunting task to discriminate them manually. This paper presents an approach for automatic sentiment analysis by 1) generating positive and negative sentiment words from Tongyici Cilin with paradigm words, 2) determining the sentiment orientation of ambiguous words according to their contexts, 3) setting up proper weight factors to different part-of-speeches, and 4) expanding the initial sentiment words by an iterative process. The performance of our approach is verified on web user reviews and achieves an average precision of 83.52%.

articleTitle: A Reconstruction Method for Circular Interlaced-Source-Detector-Array CT
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a helical interlaced-source-detector-array (HISDA) CT approach for superior temporal resolution. A Feldkamp-type algorithm is first proposed for HISDA CT reconstruction. Then, schemes for recovering missing projection data are studied. The performance of HISDA CT is evaluated in the numerical simulation, which is better than the previously proposed circular interlaced-source-detector-array (CISDA) CT in terms of accuracy and uniformity.

articleTitle: A Protocol Design of Electronic Payment Based on CNAPS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper puts forward a design of electronic payment standard based on CNAPS (China National Advanced Payment System). From the perspective of standardizing the electronic payment remittance and improving the security, this standard solves the problem that online payment of B2B e-commerce has low realization rate in China. This paper describes the design of electronic payment mechanisms with CNAPS as a platform; introduces the Universal Payment Identification Code UPIC in this mechanism; focus on a unified standard CNFN STP 820 for electronic payment remittance and analyzes its advantage.

articleTitle: A Competency Model for Civil Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Key competencies and employability skills are central to vocational education. In order to educate better qualified students, a competency model for construction major student was proposed. The post cluster of students will engage in after their graduation was first investigated. Then the professional knowledge and capability which current construction profession request are analyzed. Following that, four kinds of competencies, namely, reading, construction, calculation and management are summarized. Finally, the validity and reliability of the model are discussed. The competency under this model is combination of multi-aspect, multi-level and multi-field complex. It is a tree-like structure in term of construction, taking specific skills as its foundation, taking comprehensive capacity to deal with the real project as the key ability, and accomplishment that student will be qualified in their work after graduation as its aim. It is a netted structure in term of combination and each constitute ability is co-related.

articleTitle: The Simulation of Engineering Drawing Practice Teaching Platform Based on Assembly Modeling
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Economic pressures on universities and the emergence of new technologies have spurred the creation of new systems for delivering engineering practice teaching platform in education, in particular simulation system of practice teaching. By using the 3D CAD technology, an integrated practice teaching system for curriculum of mechanical parts measuring is presented. The system consists of three modules: 3D animation of mechanisms, assembly modeling of mechanisms and modeling of each part. Using 3D animation, the operating principle of mechanisms is shown clearly and visually. Moreover it can inspire enthusiasm of students for mechanical engineering. The graphics fundamental knowledge and practicing of 2D drawing and 3D virtual modeling are combined in practice teaching, so it can train the engineering consciousness and creative ability of students.

articleTitle: Design of Power Plant Energy Information Monitoring System Based on Wireless Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with the national promotion of energy-saving and pollution-reducing, energy information management level of power plant needs to be improved, and a kind of solution scheme based on the integration of management and control including automation technology, computer technology and network technology is urgently needed by power plant. In order to avoid the complexity of wiring in traditional wired network, ZigBee wireless technology which has obvious advantages is adopted. A kind of energy information monitoring system for power plant based on ZigBee wireless network which uses the JN5121 ZigBee module of Jennic Company is designed. The overall design of the system is described and the overall structural diagram is given. The hardware design of ZigBee modules, the establishing flow of ZigBee wireless network, the establishing flow of ZigBee network topology structure and the communication flow of ZigBee devices are introduced in details. Furthermore, the corresponding flow charts are also given. Results of the whole system test show the unique application superiority of the ZigBee technology in terms of self-association, dynamic network topology and large network capacity in power plant energy information monitoring.

articleTitle: The Combinating Optimizing Algorithm for Grounding Grid Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Grounding grid is commonly installed in the substation. When it's damaged, not only restoring and improving work affects the production, but also it is difficult to carry this work out. In this paper, a new nonlinear constraint optimization model is established in order to find out the corrosion and abruption of the grounding grid. Due to the characteristics of grounding grid fault diagnosis, a combined optimizing algorithm is proposed, in which evolutionary strategy in groups and two kinds of adaptive functions are used. In order to reduce the infeasibility of the particle, in each step, after using PSO, linear programming is used to make partial updating around every particle, so the rate and efficiency is improved. When some particle is near enough to the optimal particle, we renew it by the way the initial particle is generated so as to increase the diversity and prevent precocity of the swarm. The algorithm proposed here could solve the multi-solution problem when touchable nodes are not enough, so we can find out corrosions of the grounding grid.

articleTitle: Service-Oriented Business Rule Processing Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to satisfy various requirements of multi-tenants of Software as a Service (SaaS), the paper proposes a service-oriented business rule processing model (BRPM) by applying business rules in SaaS environment. Rule customization, rule storage and rule execution are three components of this model. Ontology is introduced and two feasible ways for two roles in SaaS are presented for dynamic rule customization, two rule storage modes are analyzed with a suggested scheme given, and then rule execution strategies are discussed and a proposal is summarized. By putting this model into practice, the experimental SaaS application indicates that the model can well support business rule processing in SaaS environment.

articleTitle: Survey on Web Image Content-Based Filtering Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To prevent the spread of pornographic image and video on internet, this paper conducts a survey on web image content-based filtering technology. The color model, filtering technology and existing problems are mainly discussed in this paper. Filtering techniques are classified into three categories which are discussed for their characteristic. The results of this paper contribute to further theoretical study and extensive application to prevent the spread of pornography.

articleTitle: An Effective Iris Recognition System Based on Biomimetic Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new method for effective iris recognition using Biomimetic Pattern Recognition (BPR), which is a new theory proposed by academician ShoujueWang. A model for iris recognition that is based on BPR was introduced and thoroughly discussed here. Experimental results on the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Institute of Automation (CASIA) iris image database clearly demonstrates that the use of Biomimetic Pattern Recognition makes it possible to achieve highly accurate and efficient recognition results with the proposed iris recognition model.

articleTitle: Architecture of Airport Operation Database System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the architecture of an airport operation database system (AODBS), which is the most important part of airport information integration system (AIIS) developed by the author. This airport operation database system is a distributed computing system with a multi-layer structure and connected to the rest of the AIIS through web service and message queue interface. The application modules of AODBS are written in C#, web modules written in Java and client modules written in Delphi, the modules communicate with others through web service. In the system, an object-oriented (OO) model of airport operation is developed and object relational mapping (ORM) technique is used to connect the OO model and database. The airport operation database system consists of a database server, three application servers, a web server and about 100 clients. The Architecture of AODBS described in this paper is proved to be reasonable and efficient by actual operation in the airport.

articleTitle: High Efficient Compression Strategy for Scanned Receipts and Handwritten Documents
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Image compression is one of the traditional topics in image processing and has been widely discussed and applied. Some standards, such as, JPEG and JPEG 2000, have also been published for the applications dealing with gray or color photos and medical images. However, for some specific applications, such as, electronic financial management systems (eFMS), much higher efficient algorithms have to be designed for the compression of receipts or handwritten documents. A new strategy is discussed for the compression based on the separation of foreground and background according to the assumption that less degradation of foreground is allowed because of the most important information represented, while more degradation of background is acceptable because it only provides the sense of reality of the document. The image is firstly transformed to YCbCr color space to separate intensities from tones. Then, foreground and background are extracted from the intensity subimage with median filter. Both foreground and background are down-sampled and respectively clustered based on the gray histograms. The chromatic aberration subimages are also down-sampled and transformed to palette-index model by the clustering based on the 2D histogram. All clustered subimages are encoded with JPEG introduced RLE algorithm and synthesized finally. The results demonstrated much higher compression rates of presented strategy than that of JPEG standard.

articleTitle: Data Aggregation in Wireless Sensor Networks for Structure Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Structural monitoring is the collection and analysis of structural response to ambient or forced excitation. One key issue in such monitoring is data aggregation. The sensors are typically sampled at high frequencies, producing large amounts of data; limited network resources make acquiring and processing this data quite challenging. In this paper, we propose an novel data aggregation scheme in WSNs for Structure Monitoring. In scheme, the interesting nodes can autonomously discover each other in a distributed fashion and form an ad hoc aggregation structure that can be used to compute cumulants and moments, or other statistical summaries. Simulation results show that the data size is reduced by a factor of 30 depending on the scheme in the aggregation.

articleTitle: Synthetically Improved Genetic Algorithm in Public Traffic Dispatch System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of the bus scheduling problems, using stochastic optimization theory and nonlinear programming theory and so on, the bus scheduling and the situation of bus arrangement of Shijiazhuang Hebei province were analyzed. Study on the difference of this process and the improvement between the actual situation and the optimum scheme in theory. Because there are many of random factors among the bus scheduling in the practical environment, on the base of nonlinear programming theory, the random analysis theory was used. A stochastic nonlinear programming model and solutions to them were proposed, objectively the defects of poor objectivity of nonlinear programming theory was made up. At the same time the paper introduces a synthetically improved genetic algorithm which utilizes the advantage of other meliorated genetic algorithm and synthesizes them. Therefore the synthetically improved genetic algorithm's capability is enhanced and the result of model which is solved using it is excellent in the solution space. So the abuse of traditional model was avoided. It considered the dual interests among passenger and the bus company. And it researches a balance point among them.

articleTitle: A Security Authentication System Based on Trusted Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An authentication system based on trusted platform is presented in distributed network, network nodes are distributed in each domain, the domain authentication server based-TPM granted a certificate to each trusted member of domain and authorize trust token to access network source in different domain, in this paper, many security technologies are applied, member with trust token can span domain boundaries, transmit security message and access resource, authentication can prevent message from tampering and counterfeiting based on Dolve-Yao attack, and shorten the response time of authentication.

articleTitle: SNN - A Neural Network Based Combination of Software Reliability Growth Models
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Applying SRGMs (Software Reliability Growth Models) to real projects is a major concern in software reliability. Sometimes, it is hard to decide the best model for a specific project. Researchers have made a first step on solving this problem by combination, but the effect was limited in accuracy and adaptability. Aiming to improve the usability of the SRGMs, we propose a neural network based combination method to build accurate and adaptive SNN (Selective Neural Network) model. It avoids relying on a single model, thus reduces the risk to produce inaccurate predictions and improves the average performance in accuracy. Neural network and multi-criteria model selection strategy enable the SNN model to be adapted to various projects, producing accurate predictions. Experiment results show that the SNN model makes a notable improvement in accuracy compared with its component models and other combinational models do.

articleTitle: A Parallel Algorithm for Nonlinear Dynamic Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A parallel algorithm for nonlinear transient dynamic analysis of large structures is presented in this paper. An unconditionally stable Newmark-ß method (average acceleration technique) is employed for time integration. The proposed parallel algorithm is devised using overlapped domains, unlike most of the existing parallel algorithms which are basically derived using nonoverlapped domains. A predictor-corrector scheme is formulated for iteratively improving the solution in each step. The algorithm is implemented on a cluster of workstation. Numerical results indicate that the proposed algorithm is superior in performance to the conventional domain decomposition algorithms.

articleTitle: The Application of Information Fusion Technology in the Monitoring System of Mine Pump
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the monitoring system of mine pump, one of important parameters is the water level of sump. When monitoring the water level, usually two different types of liquid-level sensor are used to obtain the value of the liquid level and then the method of sensor threshold is adopted to judge whether the water level beyond the limitation. The method just simply combines the value of the two sensors, and carries out binary decision according to the alarm threshold value which causes a lot of information lost.In order to overcome the above problems, this paper applied the multi-sensor information fusion technology based on the fuzzy theory into the system. This method reduced the misinformation and error caused by the information limitations of single sensor, decreased the uncertainty and made full use of multi-source information redundancy and complementarity, which effectively increased the accuracy of monitoring and improved the performance of the whole monitoring system.

articleTitle: Meteorological Prediction Using Support Vector Regression with Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The theory of support vector regression (SVR) is introduced in this paper. And genetic algorithms (GAs) are adopted to optimize free parameters of support vector regression. Then we develop an optimal meteorological prediction model based on support vector Regression with genetic algorithms (SVRG). In this study, SVRG is applied to predict meteorology. The experimental results indicate that SVRG model proposed in this paper overcomes some shortcomings of the traditional SVR, and can achieve better forecasting accuracy and performance than traditional SVR and BP neural network (BPNN) prediction models. Consequently, the meteorological prediction model based on SVRG is an effective method.

articleTitle: Centralized Identity Authentication Research Based on Management Application Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the analysis of management application platform, this article proposes a centralized identity authentication solution which can be run on web environment and deeply analyses and researches a cookie-based authentication and a implementation mechanism of single sign-on. This solution provides an effective scheme for the integration of enterprise application systems.

articleTitle: Multithreading Technology in the Application of Transportation Planning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Transportation Planning is the planning to stipulate transportation companies working line, automobile types, shifts and schedule, which is the core and key of production plan of transportation companies. The current paper proposes that starting from improving passengers shifts, under the restriction of various conditions such as the satisfaction of transportation market requirement, automobile utilization efficiency and transportation distance, current each passengers transportation routes, automobile types and passengers transportation shifts should be optimized and arranged in order to realize the maximization of transportation and production business profits based on the satisfaction of passengers requirement. The paper dwells on the realization methods applied in highway passengers planning optimization and arrangement.

articleTitle: A New Method to Choose the Threshold in the POT Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The selection of an appropriate threshold is one of the main concerns about the POT (Peaks Over Threshold ) model, which is widely used in many fields, such as in insurance and environmental analysis. In this article, a new method which is based on the MSE criterion and two-sample K-S tests is proposed to determine the optimal threshold in the GPD model. Different from the traditional subjective methods, the proposed method can determine the threshold by quantification, and is easy to be implemented by a computer program. An empirical study using the daily returns of S&P 500 index is also presented. It's shown that the proposed method can well capture the optimal threshold.

articleTitle: A Mechanism for Collecting and Feedbacking the Real-Time Quality of Web Service
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Quality of Service (QoS) is an important factor during service composition and replacement. Since static QoS data cannot reflect the real-time performance of Web Service (WS), a mechanism is needed to collect the dynamic QoS data. Also, QoS query result is determined by the QoS data stored by service registry. Consequently, it is also necessary to enable a mechanism to feedback those dynamic QoS data to the service registry from both consumer-side and provider-side.In this paper, we propose three methods to collect the real-time QoS data, namely AOP-based, Proxy-based, and Port-based. The application of the three methods will be discussed by comparing their advantages and disadvantages. Since the feedback conforms to the OWL-Q language, which is a rich and extensible modular ontology language, programs can understand the semantic feedback automatically by parsing the feedback messages.

articleTitle: Discussion on Some Issues in Large-Scale Project Management and Organization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In China due to the scale of large projects too large and complex, which many deep-seated problems have also exposed in the implementation process. This paper analyzes the problems of the management model for the government and owners, management level, centralization and decentralization, public bidding and the management after bidding, the overall coordination of supervision, construction general contracting management and labor management etc., and put forward a decentralized self-organizing management model and some enlightening recommendations with the author's practical construction experiences of large projects in the Guangzhou University Town, the University Park in Zhuhai and so on.

articleTitle: Visual Simulation of Crime Scene Based on OpenGL Performer
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The scene simulation is an important part of virtual reality system. The creation and development of scene simulation provides powerful methods support to the research of forensic science. In this paper, the visual simulation and forensic science was closely integrated; the composition structure and function of OpenGL performer which is advanced development tools on the field of visual simulation is analyzed; the flow of virtual reality simulation was studied; the nodes of motion simulation and interactive was designed; the interaction rules between scene objects, the event triggering and feedback method of the simulation procedure was discussed. Finally, this paper takes fire scene as an example and finds a solution for the problem of scene investigation and reconstruction.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Real-Time Response Parallel Visualization Using Multi-Core Hardware
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through analyzing the reasons which lead to the low efficiency in multiple 3D visualization strategies when rendering the large-scale scene, the paper proposes the serial visualization flow should be divided into three main parallel flow, including I/O response, scene data loading and scene rendering, and the certain numbers of the parallel threads should depend on the parallel ability of the hardware, especially the multi-core hardware. Finally, through comparing the performance between multiple rendering projects, testifying the validity of the real-time response parallel visualization technique.

articleTitle: Virtual Machine Based Hot-Spare Fault-Tolerant System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Safety-critical systems have to work correctly and meet time constraints even in the presence of faults. Hardware fault-tolerant technology can provide a high level of reliability, but custom-designed hardware and operating system are too costly to be accepted by most common applications. At present, some research works about hot-spare fault-tolerant systems based on virtualization technology have been carried out, this method can provide a highly available system based entirely on commodity hardware and open-source operating systems. But how to control the overhead of main-backup synchronization, including space usage and time consumption is the most important thing need to consider. In this paper we present the framework of hot-spare fault-tolerant systems based on virtualization technology and analyse the procedure of main-back synchronization. We also discussed how to chose a proper strategy and opportunity of synchronization to ensure the recovery is exactly. We did several experiments to evaluate the performance of this system and the result proved our view point.

articleTitle: Distributed Data Processing Framework for Oral Health Care Information Management Based on CSCWD Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The computer information processing, databases, graphics technology, can be widely applied to the dental clinic information management system. This paper presents a distributed data processing framework for the oral health care information management based on the CSCWD technology. The framework is based on a multi-layers distributed architecture, and is comprised by a collaborative toolkit of the videoconference tools, the cooperative oral health care information imaging diagnosis tools and the electronic patient records. The system can be applied to setup a cooperative oral health care diagnosis environment that allow doctors located in different hospitals to achieve a cooperative diagnosis through the dental images tools, telemedicine, dental electronic patient records (DEPR) and video-conference.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Main Memory Database Based on an Improved P2P Routing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Distributed Main Memory Database is the combination of Distributed Database and Main Memory Database. It realizes effective database operation, and meanwhile it solves the problems of Central Database such as high spending on communication, easy to become the bottleneck of the system and so on. The article studies routing algorithm of structured p2p overlay and proposes an improved routing algorithm which assures the average lookup times are not more than 2 when the overlay is steady. The improved routing algorithm and FastDB that is an open source Main Memory Database are applied to construct a Distributed Main Memory Database. The method has been improved to be effective in the end and basically it realizes load equalization.

articleTitle: Research of CLV Forecasting Model Based on E-Commerce Website
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To predict the customers' transaction behavior is essential to the basic work of client management in BtoC website. The Pareto/NBD model was generally accepted in this field. The BG/NBD model is an improved model of the Pareto/NBD. The paper makes use of actual transaction data at a site in Liaoning province to verify the applicability of the BG/NBD in this field and redefines some variables more suitable for their practical application. By comparison with the actual data through diagram, the results show as follows. The prediction outcome of the BG/NBD model is very close to the actual data in the high trading frequency, despite a certain deviation compared with the actual in low frequency; The BG/NBD model can capture the hidden information in the sales data and be effectively used in China's online marketing to forecast customer buying behavior; in addition, this article summarizes the method to set warning point for customer loss rate.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of an ETL Model Based on Task
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The focus of this paper is to develop an ETL model for financial data integration. This model of metadata-driven utilizing the method of the combination of coding and commercial tools implements a task model which is the core of the ETL model. The task model adopts a flexible mode to divide the entire assignment and constitute some basic tasks which do not have interaction with each other. As a result, each basic task can be completed particularly. So the ETL model is able to adapt to the complicated and harsh data environment of the financial system (especially bank system). Meanwhile, exception handling module and system log module guarantee the robustness of the system. Practical application shows that this ETL model meet demands well.

articleTitle: Speech Information Hiding Using Fractional Cosine Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new idea for speech information hiding using fractional cosine transform (FRCT) is proposed. We find in our analysis that the 3rd parameter of FRCT presents property of high frequency, then we put forward two methods for embedding secret information into speech signal in FRCT domain. One is low bit embedding method and the other is over zero rate detection method. Results of simulation indicate that both ways have certain ability for anti-jamming. The discoveries in our study provide a new thought for application of FRCT in speech information hiding.

articleTitle: An Improvement Text Clustering Algorithm Based on Ant Colony
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ant colony clustering was first proposed by Deneubourg in 1990, it is a bionic clustering method and has been widely used in cluster analysis. In this paper, an ant colony clustering algorithm based on appropriate retention of the elites is presented. Based on the general ant colony clustering algorithm, the mechanism to retain the elites is introduced, in each of the iterative algorithm always retain a certain number excellent solution into the next cycle, with a view to improving the performance of algorithm. In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, a text data set judged by two external evaluation indicators is selected, the experimental results show that the new algorithm can effectively improve the performance.

articleTitle: 3D Curves Matching Based on Directional Angles of Junctions
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Contour curves matching technique was researched for mosaicing 3D broken objects. Method of 3D curves matching based on direction angles of junctions was presented. Contour curves were filtered and re-sampled. The feature vectors of contour curves were represented by direction angles of junctions on contour curves. Similarity between two contour curves was determined by comparing feature vectors of two contour curves. Contour curves matching and fragments mosaicing were realized. Experimental results show that this approach has robust, fault tolerant, accurately and effectiveness in curves matching and broken objects mosaicing.

articleTitle: A Combined Reputation Model for Distributed System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As more and more people enter into the virtual world based on the internet, reputation has become the key to punish the bad behaviors of people and encourage the good behaviors of them. How to evaluate effectively the reputation of the participators is the urgent problem which should be solved. The paper provides a combined reputation model TRUST for distributed environment. This model, according to the characteristics of internet, is based on the direct and indirect experience of service consumer to the service provider. It combines the merits of centralized evaluation and distributed evaluation through binding the centralized reputation and distributed reputation mechanism. Centralized reputation mechanism is used in communities; distributed reputation mechanism is used among communities. Simulating experiments prove this model can give service consumer more profit, thus adapting to the distributed system circumstance better.

articleTitle: Face Detection Based on QFT Phase-Only Correlation Template Match
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Face detection is the basis of the human face image pattern recognition processing. It has a very important role. This paper focused on the problem of face detection in the color image with complex background. A new face detection method based on Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) average template-pair phase correlation matching was presented. The face image expressing in the CIE Lab color space and the method to buildup the eyes and faces average template-pair were analyzed. The quantum state vector encoding of the corresponding phase-only image was discussed. The QFT was used to compute the phase correlation between the phase-only images, realizing the face detection in the color image with complex background. The experiment showed that this method had a good detection ability for the different image resolution, single or several face with variety image background.

articleTitle: HLA-Based Design of Space Coordinated Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A simulation system based on HLA is developed in order to study simulation system architecture. This paper briefly introduces the importance of research, analyses requirements of system based on function and element, gives the design principle of cooperation and establishes assessment index, then brings the key technologies - FDMS and Multi-Resolution Modeling, designs a layered system configuration, presents the view of system configuration by the examples of Manager Federate and Satellite Federate. In the last part, a CSS prototype based on the key technology mentioned above is discussed. The development of prototype system plays an important role in the future CSS research and application.

articleTitle: PSO Parameters Optimization Based Support Vector Machines for Hyperspectral Classification
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study investigates a new approach in hyperspectral image classification. The new method of hyperspectral classification in this paper is a new SVM algorithm based particle swarm optimization (PSO-SVM). First, three classification methods are used to classified a benchmark hyperspectral images: SVM, ML (maximum-likelihood) and K-nn (K-nearest neighbor), the performances of SVMs are compared with two other traditional classifiers (maximum-likelihood classifier and the K-nearest neighbor classifier). The study indicates that the classification accuracy of SVM algorithm is better than ML and K-nn algorithms. The over accuracy of the SVM using RBF kernel is above 90% and the over accuracy of the traditional methods is below 81%. The kernel parameters setting for SVM in a training process impacts on the classification accuracy, to select accurate parameters of the RBF kernel function, we present a SVM algorithm based particle swarm optimization (PSO-SVM) to improve the classification accuracy compared original SVM classification, the experiment indicates our proposed PSO-SVM approach can improve the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Civil Engineering Professional Courses Collaborative Recommendation System Based on Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Network environment provides a uniform learning platform for the students in the major of civil engineering and for their teachers. Collaborative recommendation system structure of civil engineering professional courses has been put forward and two core algorithms - knowledge matching and adaptability - are designed on the base of students' personal learning needs and a strong systematicness for civil engineering specialty courses. Finally, an example was used to simulate the implementation process of collaborative recommendation, which verified the feasibility.

articleTitle: The Application of RS code in CCK Modulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RS code is a kind of linear block code. Due to its characteristics such as high capability in error correction, easy realization and so on, RS code has been widely applied in wireless communication systems. In this paper, the algorithms of RS encoding and decoding are introduced firstly, then they are applied to CCK(Complementary Code Keying) modulation system which based on 802.11b standard. The simulation results demonstrate that the applications of RS code can effectively reduce the error probability of CCK system over Gaussian white noise channel.

articleTitle: Research and Application of the Floating License Management Strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software license is the most well-used technology in copyright protection of commercial software and shareware, as well as the development and management of free software and open source software. There are several different license types that allow controlled access of services. The two most popular types are the fixed license, which gives access rights for an identified workstation, and the floating license, which restricts the number of simultaneous users to a certain bound. In this paper, we propose a floating license system, called MFFLS, which efficiently implements the management and protection of software.

articleTitle: Forest Site Evaluation Based on GIS and Kriging
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Forest site evaluation is required by forestry production and is also the basis on which forest cultivation, management and planning, and forest yield prediction can be made. Thus, it is very important to develop new methods for quickly and accurately evaluate forest sites and estimate forest site indices with small samples of field data. Based on the existing forest inventory data, this paper demonstrated a forest site evaluation method by integrating geographic information system (GIS) and a spatial interpolation method-kriging in geostatistics. This method was based on spatial autocorrelation of forest height. As an example, this method was applied to evaluation of Chinese fir sites in Fengshushan tree farm, Jiangxi Province of China. The obtained results show that the spatial autocorrelation of Chinese fir site index can be quantified using spherical model and the ratio of nugget variance to sill variance is 66.15%, which indicates a moderate degree of spatial autocorrelation. Moreover, based on the sample data, Kriging can accurately reproduce the spatial distribution and variability of Chinese fir site index and result in site index map. By cross-validation, the obtained average error between the observed and predicted values and mean standard error of predictions for Chinese fir site index are close to zero. The root mean square error (RMSE) and average standard error are also relatively small and the standardized RMSE is close to one unit. In addition, this method provides a useful tool for forest management, predicting Chinese fir site index, and identifying the appropriate area for Chinese fir reforestation.

articleTitle: Based on MLE of Pairwise Broadcast Clock Synchronization for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Pairwise Broadcast is a novel low-power wireless sensor network clock synchronization method. A subset of sensor nodes are synchronized by overhearing the timing message exchanges of a pair of sensor nodes. Therefore, a group of sensor nodes can be synchronized without sending any extra messages. This paper mainly account for the problem that the original Pairwise Broadcast Synchronization in absence of the clock skew between the pairwise broadcast node, proposed that use MLE(Maximum Likelihood Estimation) for accurate estimation of the clock offset and clock skew of nodes under Gaussian delay model. The simulation results indicate this method to ensure high accuracy simultaneously effectively reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: The New Application of "Two-Factor" Model in Consumer Brand Selection Study
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Herzberg's "Two-Factor" Theory develops a concept that satisfaction and dissatisfaction are not on a continuum with one increasing as the other diminishes, but are independent phenomena. Factors that increase satisfaction are different with those decrease dissatisfaction. Consumer's brand selection behavior is also influenced by their satisfaction or dissatisfaction towards brand. So the authors studied the relationship between brand awareness and brand purchase, discovered that the "Two-Factor" model can also be applied in consumer brand selection study, to help classify and interpret the different influences of various factors that matter with consumers' brand selecting decision. Limited marketing resources can therefore be utilized more effectively by acting on those key factors.

articleTitle: The Theory and Realization of Signal Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to sampling theorem, if the sampling frequency is more than twice of maximum frequency of signal, the original signal can be regained. And it is often half past twice or so of maximum frequency of signal. But under this sampling frequency, the waveform of sampled signal is deformed seriously. But if the signal is sampled with too large frequency, it would need too much memory. It is a contradiction between perfect waveform and memory. This paper discusses the principle of reconstructing the original signal from the sampled signal. And the kernel codes of the program are shown, too. This method can achieve the performance of using the minimum memory to get maximum information of signal. Through emulation in MATLAB, this method is proved to be highly effective.

articleTitle: Improved Algorithm Based on Dempster-Shafer Theory: Using in the Integrated Navigation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The algorithm of multi-sensors' information fusion is studied here based on Dempster-Shafer theory. An improved approach for Dempster-Shafer theory can be put forward. We should use this theory in the integrated navigation. The whole reliability is imported in the whole system and we can analyse it during the calculating process. Because of that we can estimate whether the GPS's signals are interfered and analyse these data. So we should choose the better navigation's mode at the right time and advance the precision of the whole system.

articleTitle: Research on Routing Algorithms in Space-Based Integrated Information Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Space-based Integrated Information Network (SIIN) is a newly proposed conception in recent years which means information are processed, interlinked and transmitted in multi-spacecraft. LEO satellite network is a basic and important part in SIIN, so several routing algorithms of connection oriented routing strategy and connectionless routing strategy in LEO satellite networks are introduced respectively in this paper, the advantages and disadvantages of the algorithms are discussed too. The current tendency is aiming at pushing the IP technology to satellite networks, so in this paper three IP-based routing algorithms are discussed in particular. At last, the features of each routing protocol mentioned in the paper are summarized, and the problems need to be resolved in the following research are proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of China Meteorological Disasters Loss in Recent Years Based on Synthesis Index
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the integrated method is used to calculate the synthesis index of economic losses caused by meteorological disasters and the clustering is adopted to grade the meteorological disasters' losses and also analyze the trend in recent 20 years, based on the data of national natural disasters and damages from 1989 to 2008. The results show that economic losses derived from meteorological disasters is higher in first decade while is distinct lower in the second. The mortality of meteorological disasters decreases significantly in recent 20 years, in which the year 1991, 1994, 1996 and 1998 is a higher mortality.

articleTitle: A Measurement Model of Reusability for Evaluating Component
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Several current measurement methods for evaluating reusability of reusable component are analyzed, then a relationship of component reusability and its complexity is presented according to the two usual measurement methods of component complexity. Furthermore, a quantity method that appraises the reusability of reusable component is given.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Empirical Study on the Capacity of Regional Technical Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an aspect of the regional innovation system, the capacity of regional technical innovation is determining factor of region economy growth. The capacity of regional technical innovation is the interactive outcome of various regional innovational factors. This paper sets up evaluation indexes for four aspects with twenty-two variables selected from six provinces in Central China. The principal of factor analysis with SPSS is introduces. The method of factor analysis is applied to evaluation of regional technical innovation capacity. The process and result with the method of cluster analysis are illustrated in detail based on factor analysis. It can help us to compare different areas innovation activities and provide the scientific reference for adopting suitable regional technical innovation strategy.

articleTitle: Aircraft Departure Sequencing Method Based on Integer Quadratic Scheduling Programming Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the increase of the fight flow at airport, the runway capacity can't satisfy aircraft transportation so as that the airplanes on the taxiways will queue to wait for taking off. The paper proposed an innovative model, the integer quadratic programming algorithm (IQPA) to solve taxiway departure scheduling on the airport. The method can realize sequence optimization considering the flight interval of fore-and-aft aircraft type. As compared with traditional measures, the total departure time and the algorithm optimization time is decreased, which is simulated in the paper. In the end, simulation results demonstrate the availability and practicability with two scenarios.

articleTitle: A Raw Material Purchasing Decision-Making Model of Order Allocation with Multiple Suppliers and Its Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Purchasing decision-making is an important part of logistic management for process plants.
