The paper considers a purchasing activity process of multiple suppliers and multiple species based on activity cost analysis. A purchasing optimization model with composition constraints is set up with minimum order quantity. The paper proposes an improved genetic algorithm to decide the optimal order quantities of each supplier based on methods of Gauss Mapping, improved adaptive penalty function and chaotic migration. A computation example is given to show the feasibility and effectiveness of the decision-making model and optimization strategy for raw material purchasing problem.

articleTitle: Multifractal Analysis of Daily Streamflow Series in the Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We have performed a detailed multifractal analysis on the daily streamflow series of the Yangtze River from 1940 to 1992. The partition function ¿<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(¿), exponent function ¿<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>, generalized fractal dimensions Dq, singularity ¿ and multifractal spectrum f(¿) are calculated. It is found that the partition function ¿<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(¿) scales as a power law with respect to the box size ¿ and the whole series and every annual series obey multifractal scaling, rather than being a simple monofractal. Furthermore, the range of singularity ¿ of the annual series reach minimum value in 1988 and maximum value in 1974, which indicated that the series of 1988 variation is smallest and the series of 1974 variation is largest.

articleTitle: A Novel Security Risk Assessment Method of Enterprise Information System Based on the Correlation of Equipments
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many risk assessment approaches evaluate the security by considering the status of equipments in the system separately, while the infrastructure of the system, which also has impact on assessing the system risk, is not taken into consideration properly. In this paper we propose a novel risk assessment method which considers the correlation of the equipments in the evaluated system. Where the risk of every equipment is divided into the individual one and the impact of other equipments. By setting vulnerability-threat conjunction matrix of the equipments, we give an approach which is facilitate to calculate the impact of other equipments. In the end of the paper, we propose an example to explain the correctness and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A System Level Simulation Platform for the Study of QoS Provisioning in UMTS/WLAN Interworking
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: IEEE 802.11 Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) provides data-intensive access to complement the existing Universal Mobile Telecommunication System (UMTS). However, few literatures focus on the simulation platform integrating UMTS and WLAN. This paper uses OPNET¿ to implement a system level simulation platform to allow researchers to study the quality of service (QoS) provisioning issues in UMTS/WLAN interworking. The platform handles different classes of service defined for UMTS, also allows for the study of user mobility, as well as radio resource management (RRM) schemes such as handoffs and call admission control (CAC). This paper mainly presents the architecture of the simulation platform and the realization of UW_AP and UWE node models, and then proposes a CAC scheme based on velocity and service type. The performance of the proposed scheme is proven better than WLAN-First scheme through simulation in the platform.

articleTitle: PDCA Circulation in University Education Applied Research
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The teaching quality is enhanced by the way of improvement in which the PDCA circulation is used continually. This is because the quality of teaching and the teaching process is interaction, also and PDCA of four stages in teaching process. Therefore, this may say that the plan is the premise which the quality of teaching enhances, the implementation and the inspection method is chose is the guarantee, action is the indispensable, which The teaching quality is enhanced.

articleTitle: Real-Time Elastic Network Scheduling of Networked Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Limited network bandwidth and dynamic changes in workload have serious impact on the performances of networked control systems. For a multiple loops networked control system in a dynamic environment, this paper proposes a real-time network scheduling method based on the idea of feedback scheduling. System packet loss rate can be reduced by dynamically adjusting the sampling period of tasks, thus achieving higher utilization of network resources. The implementation mechanisms for the model structure and the algorithm are analyzed in detail, and the algorithm is verified by simulated experiment. Results show that this algorithm can improve resource utilization and guarantee good stability at the same time.

articleTitle: A New Method for Disaster-Affected Area Grade Zoning with Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to focus on the serious area affected by earthquakes and other hazards, and to meet the demands of post-disaster reconstruction, the disaster-affected area must be evaluated scientifically. In general, select indicator set firstly, then construct comprehensive disaster index, finally divide the disaster-affected area into different grade zones according to a certain threshold determined by a total consideration. This kind of method is simple and easy to operate, but prone to be interfered by subjective factors. In response to this problem, a new evaluation method based on cloud model, one kind of uncertain artificial intelligence models, is proposed. The new method can obtain a "soft" grade zoning by directly learning from objective data set, the evaluation results are more scientific. In this paper, the authors take Wenchuan seismic disaster- affected grade zoning as an example to testify the feasibility and reliability of this new method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Portable MANET Terminal
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper develops a portable MANET terminal. It provides a self-healing, robust, mobile network that supports voice, video communication, and other data applications. The terminal includes a system board based on PXA270 and a video compression board based on BF537, using 802.11b/g external network card as wireless transmission equipment. This paper proposes a route protocol special for small scale MANET and deploys it on the terminal, and develops h.264 video transmit module and voice transmit module based RTP. A security communication protocol is also proposed which grounded on off-line digital certificate. In the end, this paper summarizes the capabilities of the terminal. It operates over multiple wireless hops at data rates of at least 256Kbps.

articleTitle: Design of Telegraph Training Device with USB Interface
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The telegraph training device connect to PC with USB interface helps the telegraph operators to exercise. The core of hardware is STC89C52; After being shaped by pretreatment circuit, the key signal is identified to morse code by adaptive algorithm, and then sent back to the computer. Additional noise superimposed with keying sound is to adjust the training difficulty.

articleTitle: An Incremental Clustering Algorithm Based on Subcluster Feature
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For very large databases, such as spatial database and multimedia database, the traditional clustering algorithms are of limitations in validity and scalability. According to the notion of clustering feature of BIRCH, an incremental clustering algorithm is designed and implemented, which solves the problems of effectiveness, space and time complexities of clustering algorithms for very large spatial databases. Theoretic analysis and experimental results demonstrate that the incremental clustering algorithm cannot only handle very large spatial databases, but also has good performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Packet Queuing and Scheduling Algorithm and Its Link Sharing Performance for the Home Internet Gateway
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A home Internet gateway is the node that resides between a public network and a home network for computers to share Internet connections. To insert customized queuing and scheduling codes into the embedded Linux kernel is a way to make the Linux-based home Internet gateways support Quality of Service(QoS). It is desirable that the small Linux kernel adopts an efficient queuing and scheduling algorithm to support link sharing, priority and traffic shaping. The algorithm presented in this paper is based on the concept of hierarchical link-sharing and each class in the hierarchy is bound with a token bucket, which can shape the traffic of this class. The analysis and simulation results presented in the paper show that through the novel way of weighted fair token sharing, this proposed algorithm guarantees basic bandwidth service for each class and enables weighted fair sharing of excess bandwidth, with which home computers connected to the network share the Internet service evenly.

articleTitle: A Strategy of Resource Scheduling for Grid Computing Based on QoS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the computational grid we need effective schedulers to minimize the makespan that are spent for the execution of the jobs. Conventional scheduling algorithms do not concern over quality of service. In this work, a job scheduling heuristic based on quality of service is proposed and a simulation application is developed by using GridSim toolkit to investigate the performance of the heuristic. The experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the improved Min-Min heuristic in terms of jobs' special requirements. Our experimental results indicate that the novel strategy can reduce the completion time of jobs with constraints and improve user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on Reverse Supply Chain Information Management System of Steel & Iron Enterprises Based Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the problem that the high cost of reverse logistics in steel & iron industry lowers the rate of recovery of scrap steel and reutilization.etc, on the basis of analyzing the business processes flow of reverse logistics in iron & steel industry, the reverse supply chain management information systems for the steel & iron enterprises is introduced in the paper. To determine location selection of interim storage station, recycling network of scrap steel are build by mathematical programming, and the programming problem are solved by the improvement of simulated annealing algorithm in this paper. The optimized result is proved effectively by instance.

articleTitle: The Research and Design of Middleware in Hybrid Network Test System Based on LXI Bus
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the various devices, bus structure and platform in network test system, implementation method is analyzed for different type of LXI is connected to hybrid network test system in the paper. The hardware and software architecture of hybrid network test system based on LXI is designed. Message middleware based on LXI scheme is put forward after researching on implementation scheme intermediate layer, and the flow of message publication and subscription, and the format of message are mainly discussed in detail. All kinds of application can be extended different operating system and network environment with the middleware, which make basic test unit cooperative working in network test system. The middleware has got the perfect effect in weapon proving ground, which provides a kind of public communicated way.

articleTitle: Web-Based Integrative Presentation of Distributed Spatial Data
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: WebGIS typically consists of many clients and unique server. Such a framework is suitable for simple application. But for many real cases, the client possibly needs a map which contains a lot of theme layers referring to spatial data owned by different departments. Therefore how to technically integrate the spatial data, physically distributed over different data/map server, together into one client's view is worthy of attention. One solution for this purpose is to pull multi-source spatial data to a unique web map server. Another solution is to implement 'pulling spatial map from different web map service' at client. Both solutions have some advantages and shortcomings to meet the increasing complex requirements. This paper gives a brief introduction to Open Source Web Map client: OpenLayers and to Open Source Web Map Server: MapGuide OS, and then proposes a new solution. With the solution MapGuide OS is used to organize the distributed spatial data/services, meanwhile, OpenLayers is used as a container for accepting multi-source map image together from different types of web map service including MapGuide OS. One real WebGIS application based on proposed solution is introduced, which obviously possesses advantages of two traditional solutions and has much better extensibility.

articleTitle: Study and Application on the Integration Technology of GIS and MIS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly studies the feasibility and methods of the integration technology of Geographical Information System (GIS) and Management Information System (MIS). The discussion is focused on the application of Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE), Object Linking Embedding (OLE), ActiveX and the integrated solution of spatial data and attribute data. Then in view of the application of the "Coal Resources Management System", we brings forward the resolving scheme based on the integration technology of GIS and MIS, the results demonstrate that our scheme is reliable and acceptable, which realized the unified operation of picture, text and table of coal resources information.

articleTitle: Research on the Readiness Evaluation Index System of Green Supply Chain Management Based on RBV
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Green readiness means the resources and factors optimization level that an enterprise or organization successfully takes measures to carry out the green strategy or plan. A large contingent of enterprises are positively exploring the approach of green supply chain management, however, more and more enterprises have realized that green readiness of supply chain is the dominant item that needs to be worked out while carrying out green supply chain strategy. This paper analyzes the key competitive resources of green supply chain upon the resource-based view (RBV), and establishes the readiness evaluation index system of green supply chain management for the manufacturing enterprises by recognizing the crucial factors of green readiness. Furthermore, it analyzes the promotion and cultivation strategy of green supply chain readiness. This paper will provide theoretical and practical evidence for reference by building green supply chain readiness aiming at constituting firm green supply chain strategy for sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on FFT-Based Large Integers Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The most common use for fast Fourier transform is in high speed signal processing, encryption algorithms and other fields, which use the properties of primitive complex nth root of unity in complex number field. In order to implement the FFT-based large integers multiplication arithmetic whose time complexity is O(nlogn), this paper discusses how to select the primitive nth root of unity for FFT-based large integers multiplication under modulo-p arithmetic, where p is a prime or a composite number, further more, some related proofs which the primitive nth root of unit satisfies the condition of discrete Fourier transform (DFT) and its inverse are given too.

articleTitle: Application of GIS in Prediction of Ordovician Limestone Water Inrush from Seam Floor in Nanding Coal Mine(China)
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For exploiting safely in deep area of Nanding coal mine in Shangdong province of China, this paper have used multi-originated information complex to predict fatalness of water inrushing from seam floor during mining. This paper analyzed main factors which affect water inrush from seam floor with the function of multi-originated of GIS in Surfer software to modify the method of water inrush coefficient and built model of water inrush index adapt to the coal mine. The coal mine was divided into three areas, dangerous areas and relative dangerous areas and safe areas with the model when the tenth coal seam was mined. The results show that water inrush from floor are result by various factors working together, geologic structure play a control action, hydraulic pressure and mining pressure are the dynamic condition, aquifuge takes the restriction effect. The result of prediction will guide Nanding coal mine exploit safely in deep area.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Detention Basin Ecosystem Services in Dahuangpuwa
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dahuangpuwa detention basin is an important flood control project in Haihe River Basin. It provides complex ecological functions and services. Examples of the ecosystem's services are flood control, water purification, biodiversity, production output and recreation. Based on field surveys and research of the study area, the economic values of the main ecosystem services in Dahuangpuwa are computed. The results show that the direct use values including provision of ecosystem products, and recreation and tourism are 44825×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> RMB, mainly the value of fish production. The indirect values in terms of flood regulating, plant and wildlife habitat provision, water purification and air regulation are 27200 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> RMB, in which 21574×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> RMB of flood storage. From above estimated values, it can be concluded that the detention basin ecosystem services have great ecological and economic values.

articleTitle: Hybrid Maintenance Routing for Client Network of Wireless Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new routing algorithm applicable for client network of Wireless Mesh Network (WMN), called hybrid maintenance routing (HMR), is presented. WMN share common features with ad hoc networks, the routing protocols developed for ad hoc networks can be applied to WMN. Based on DSR (dynamic source routing), HMR applies multi-path routing to improve the routing fault tolerance of client networks of WMN. Route maintenance has been the main area of protocol in ad hoc network. There are two kinds of approach for route maintenance, the proactive routing maintenance and the on-demand reactive routing maintenance. A hybrid maintenance approach which combines the proactive routing maintenance and the reactive routing maintenance will improve the validity of multi-path without increasing too much overhead.

articleTitle: A General Coding Method for Lightweight Data Integrity Check in Distributed Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is desired to check the data integrity in a lightweight manner in terms of low communication and storage overhead in distributed data storage systems. Naive cryptographic hash function can check the data integrity but it has to involve source data that may induce a large volume of communication overhead. Coding method that generates transformed data information has been found a promising techniques to balance between efficiency and integrity assurance. To cope with this problem, we present a general coding method consisting of Intra-codes and Inter-codes. Inter-codes are distributively stored and Intra-codes are generated on demand for checking. A simple checking scheme for distributed data storage is presented for illustrating the application of such coding method. The lightweight of this method is justified via extensive analysis.

articleTitle: Adaptive Vector Quantization of SAR Raw Data
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper deals with the compression algorithms of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) raw data based on vector quantization (VQ) techniques. The block adaptive tree-structured vector quantization (BATSVQ) algorithm and the block adaptive lattice vector quantization (BALVQ) algorithm are presented. Compared with the block adaptive vector quantization (BAVQ) algorithm, both of the proposed methods using constrained vector quantizer take the full advantage of SAR raw data properties of a Gaussian stationary process after a blockwise normalization. Live SAR data implementations and quantitative analysis of resultant images show that, a better trade-off between performance and complexity can be achieved by using the BATSVQ and BALVQ algorithms.

articleTitle: Event-Driven RFID System Development for Retailer Supermarket
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RFID system's event processing ability immediate influence to entire RFID system's operating efficiency. This article designs the model and frame of event-driven RFID system, and defines the RFID event. Based on this, designs the filtering mechanism and complex event matching processing strategy based on the Hash table, can realize real-time analysis and processing of the RFID data, and provided the basis for the high-level application. By developing the simulative retailer supermarket management system, the rationality of design and the accuracy of algorithm are proved.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of a Wireless Real-Time Video Transmission System over WLAN
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless real-time video transmission system is widely adopted in many fields. In this paper, an embedded Linux system platform is built. The platform is based upon i.mx27 with inner ASIC video codec. We transplant embedded Linux kernel and transmission protocol stack to support application interfaces. In order to ensure the real-time property, we use hardware video encoder, optimize MPEG-4 codec configuration, and adopt effective transmission control protocol. Also a WLAN protocol, 802.11g with relatively larger bandwidth is applied. Finally, we examine the end-to-end performance of this system. The results show that this system can support real-time video transmission service well.

articleTitle: Research on Fractional Option Pricing Model Under Real Brownian Motion Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The self-similarity and long-range dependence properties make the fractional Brownian motion a suitable tool in mathematical finance. This paper uses the hypotheses that assert price follows geometric fractional Brownian motion to construct the Ito¿ fractional Black-Scholes market. By the quasi-martingale method based on the fractional risk neutral measure, the fractional Black-Scholes model is given, which makes the original Black-Scholes equation being a special example. Then the fact that the long memory parameter is an important factor in option pricing is testified by a numerical case. Finally, two polular semiparametric methods are used to calculate the H value of Chinese stock markets.

articleTitle: Impact of ENSO on Summer Monsoon in Southern Parts of Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The impact of ENSO (El-Nino/Southern Oscillation) on summer monsoon rain fall in southern parts of Pakistan is studied for deeply understanding the characteristics of summer rainfall variation and factors causing severe water shortages in already drought prone regions. The 16 stations data of summer rainfall, sea surface temperature and ENSO during 1951-2000 has been analyzed. The results comparing the rainfall and SST anomaly during the period leads to the idea that the all ENSO events are not essentially correlated with the poor monsoon in southern parts of Pakistan. The research results show that the relationship among ENSO, summer monsoon and drought is uncertainty. Further research is needed to pay attention to find the key factor of impact on summer monsoon rain fall in southern parts of Pakistan for attribution and development of better forecasting techniques for planning and development in the region.

articleTitle: Building Dynamic Management System of Pipe Network Based on MapGIS Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: From the aspects of overall structure of the system, principle of System Design, completeness, standardization, advancement and adaptability etc, a dynamic underground pipe network information system is proposed in the paper, which is supported by MapGIS as working platform. The dynamic management system of network is also discussed in detail from the aspects of terrain management module, editing module, comprehensive use module, network maintenance module, network planning module and web module. Taking a campus as example, the dynamic management system is built and comparatively satisfactory effect is obtained. The research provides a reliable basis for Building pipe network dynamic management System.

articleTitle: From Wuxi to Sihanoukville - Discussion on the ODI of Hongdou Group in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years the overseas direct investment (ODI) from China's textiles industry to the lease developed countries has increased obviously. Under the global economic crisis environment the Chinese textile & garment industry has confronted a very big challenge never met before, and China's government encourages the ODI of the textiles industry further. On the basis of the ODI cases from Jiangsu textiles industry, this paper mainly discussed the effect of the Jiangsu Hongdou Group's ODI in Sihanoukville on the structure adjustment of Jiangsu textiles industry.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing Methods for DTMB Based Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cognitive Radio (CR) systems are well considered to be used in television bands as IEEE 802.22 WRAN suggested. And as Digital Television Terrestrial Multimedia Broadcast (DTMB) is the standard for China digital television which has been implemented since Aug. 1st 2007, two simple and efficient spectrum sensing methods for DTMB based CR systems are proposed in this paper. The proposed methods are based on the PN sequences of DTMB frame header. Both methods have a property of little time-delay. The performances of the methods are studied by simulations. Simulation results show that both methods have good performances when SNR is not too low.

articleTitle: Theoretical Foundations of Mobile Learning Mediated by Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In china, over 60% of the general population and 80% of young adults own mobile phones. These offer the opportunity for people not only to make phone calls, but to gain the advantages of mobile services such as text and multimedia messaging, mobile learning, etc. Mobile learning is rapidly growing from a set of research projects into worldwide deployment of services for classrooms, workplace training and informal learning. The objective of this paper is to offer some theoretical foundations of mobile learning such as informal learning, situated cognition and learning, contextual learning, action learning, experiential learning, etc. The aim is to analyze learning process in the mobile age and provide theory foundations for the designer and developer of mobile learning.

articleTitle: On Capacity Bounds of Multi-Cell MIMO Broadcast Channel
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A model of MIMO broadcast channel for multicell is proposed. We proposed a new method to evaluate the sum rate capacity of the MIMO BC of multicell system. We transformed it into a standard convex optimization problem to get an upper bound of sum rate. By suboptimal modified greedy power allocation algorithm we get a lower bound with the constraint of power. Simulation shows that these two bounds are comparative compact at high SNR.

articleTitle: An Improved K-Anonymity Algorithm Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Privacy disclosure is a common problem in data publishing, formerly, K-anonymity methods of Privacy Protection have great influence on the data precision. This paper analyzes the reasons of the influence, and proposes an improved algorithm. The algorithm defines a Weight-related of attribute in order to select attributes for generalization. This approach effectively prevents sensitive data loss in the generalization. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm of K-anonymity model increases the data precision effectively.

articleTitle: Multi-Attribute Decision-Making Method Based on Rough Set and Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The information is often uncertain, incomplete, and ignorant and the weights of attributes are not equal to each other in multi-attribute decision-making (MADM). The evidence theory is a method for MADM under uncertainties, but focal element increases rapidly. A feature reduction algorithm based on rough set is used when classification result is almost invariable, on the one hand, adopts a little of attributes to evaluation decision-making problem, reduces the dependence between the evidences and prevents from focal element increasing rapidly; on the other hand, draws the weight of each attribute from the decision table objectively and prevents subjectivity points of the experts. Then an example is given to make out that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: Application of FY-2C Data in Rainstorm Nowcasting
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The stationary meteorology satellite data are useful for rainstorm forecasting, the cloud top temperature of FY-2C IR1 channel are used in this research. Based on the deviation analysis and projection correction, it is found that selected 5 × 5 pixels are enough for the accuracy of rainstorm forecasting. The exactly matches between the changes of time series of TBB and the evolution of convective clouds are available. When the unstable energy is gathered, the cloud system obviously turns to the pattern. The phase-space structure method extracts the transition information for the rainstorm forecasting. The research results show that this method is effective for forecasting of strong convection, it is not only to improve the use of satellite data efficiently, but could improve the capability of accurate forecasting of mid-latitude rainstorms in China.

articleTitle: Calculate the Common Normal Line's Distance of Single Arc Gear Based on Secant Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The measurement of single arc gear common normal line length, was a basic detection project, which aimed to control the tooth thickness. The method was to compute the common normal line length of two regular changes between the surface, the process is complex. With the single arc gear transmission development drive to high-speed, heavy-duty, high-power, the measurement face a higher demand, we not only needed to improve the existing measurement methods, calculation and measurement technology, but also strengthened the research of new test method. Just as it was, we provided a way used Secant method and put forward the calculating principle of the common normal line, the flow chart, the alternating equation. This method was based on the calculating principle and formula of the double arc gear's driving and measuring common normal Line's distance and made 67 arc gear as an example. It creased labor power firmly and the precision was also increased.

articleTitle: Financial Crisis as a Turning Point in the Development of China's E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The financial crisis triggered a global economic recession, many business failures, a greater number of enterprises, or get laid off. E-commerce companies can reduce costs, improve efficiency and expand business opportunities, become a new path of development. China can also be used to develop e-commerce to reduce the financial crisis has a negative impact on efforts to resolve a number of constraints exist in the development of China's e-commerce factors, including imperfect credit system, on-line transaction security cannot be effective protection, logistics and distribution system constraints, such as legal policy lag; against the constraints and the corresponding countermeasures and suggestions, including e-commerce to speed up the construction of credit system, establish a scientific system of e-commerce security, improve logistics and distribution system and establish a sound legal system related to e-commerce has become customary and innovative network of trade in transition to achieve timely, innovative e-commerce services to develop emerging markets region, networks of innovation to achieve precision marketing services. Information through the network of small and medium-sized means of changing the mode of operation of its ongoing commitment to provide value-added products, the completion of the transformation and upgrading of enterprises, so that the resistance of e-commerce to become the biggest bright spot in financial crisis, so that the financial crisis as a turning point in the development of electronic commerce.

articleTitle: Research on a Distributed Network Intrusion Detection System Based on Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Putting forward a system model based on association rule mining and improving the FP-Growth algorithm based on associative analysis. The experimental result shows that the network intrusion detection developed by this paper can work stably, find out intrusion activities accurately and promptly, improve the speed of data mining effectively, enhance the detective ability of intrusion detection greatly, and provide a solid protection for network security.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Assessment of Environmental Impact of Large-Scale Water Conservancy Project: A Case Study of Yintao Irrigation Project on Tao River in Gansu, China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Yintao Irrigation Project (YIP), aiming to handle the drought and water problem in the middle part of Gansu, improve its impoverishment and backwardness, and change the deterioration of ecological environment, is a large-scale trans basin diversion water project. This project has a profound impact on environment, not only covering an immense area for a long time, but also including a great number of complicated influential indices. In order to conduct a systematic and comprehensive assessment to the environmental impact level of this project, Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is used to determine the important weighted value of environmental impact under each assessment index, and to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of environmental impact in different districts. The results give evidence that effectuation of this project will significantly improve the living standards of those people who has benefited from this project as well as the ecological environment, and will promote a sustainable development of regional environment and economy. In the mean time, the results also show that AHP is better than the general qualitative analysis. As is expected, the assessment results coincide with the actual ones.

articleTitle: The Study to the Integrated between the SuperMap and the Statistical Analysis Technology and It's Applying in the Regional Environment Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper summarized the regional environmental problems in China and analyzed the corresponding resolving methods and their limitation. After the brief introduction of the composition, structure, function and special features of the Regional Environmental Management Digital Integrated Technology, this work took the Beijing City digital map (1:50000) as the working basic map, chose a typical region as the researching region. By using the abundant data in the Country Environmental Statistical Data System and using the methods including the Integrated Technology of GIS coupling with the Principal Component Analysis, Cluster Analysis, Regression Analysis and Trend Surface Analysis, this paper performed a systematic analysis of the regional environmental problems in the choose researching region. The work could provide a digital management tool and a piloting solved method for resolving the regional environmental problems and making effective use of the environmental data.

articleTitle: HW/SW Co-Design for Embedded System Based on DDF
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Embedded systems are targeted for specific applications under constraints on relative timing of their actions. In this paper, we proposed a co-synthesis approach to hardware/software (HW/SW) co-design for embedded system based on Dynamic Data Flow (DDF). Firstly, we introduced the theory of DDF and presented a methodology of designing embedded system on system-level that depends on decomposing DDF graph into sub-graphs. Furthermore, we then extend DDF by analyzing C language program structure in detail. Finally, we designed an embedded monitoring prototyping system based on FPGAs with HW/SW co-design approach. Our experience is verified that the HW/SW co-design for embedded system based on DDF is effective.

articleTitle: Stereo Vision for Spin Tests in the Vertical Wind Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To measure the model's poses in the spin tests, we present a measurement method based on stereo vision and a set of manmade signs on the surface of the spin model in this paper. Through images caught by two monochrome CCD video cameras, the three-dimensional coordinates of manmade signs on the model are rebuilt. By the signs' coordinates in the plane reference frame and their coordinates in the world reference frame, we can judge the model's poses in the world reference frame. The experimental results, the model in a rotary balance, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The data are shown in the paper.

articleTitle: Survey on Construction Contractor Incentive Mechanism Design
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The research status of the construction contractor incentive mechanism design have been reviewed and commented from several aspects such as progress incentive, cost incentive, quality and safety incentive, coordinate multi-objective incentive, as well as the implicit incentive. Some disadvantages in the current study, such as the incentive method mainly focusing on network optimization, incentive contract type mainly focusing on cost plus incentive fee or fixed price incentive contract, little attention to the incentive to more than one contractor which work for the same owner and insufficient implicit incentives and so on, are pointed out. Further, the future research and development trend of construction project field is prospected. The systematic research of the construction contractor incentive mechanism design which can be based on the incentive theory and principal-agent theory is put forward.

articleTitle: Macro Economy - Signal Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper uses the view and theory of signals and systems to analyze the classical linear macroeconomic model put forward by Keynes. Through the analysis of the model from system angle, we can analyze the influence of system parameters and input signal on macroeconomic operation very clearly. Through the analysis of system structure and system response characteristics, we determine the influence of system parameters on economic operation situation. The results show that this new method overcomes a series of disadvantages of traditional methods of directly using matrix principle to analyze the model.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Model of Marginal Industry Technological Innovation Internationalization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The marginal industry is the industry that has lost or will lose the comparative advantage, including marginal industry I and marginal industry II. According to the characters and main problems of the technological industry internationalization, put forwards the strategies, such as strengthening self-innovation, pushing the synchronization between the localization and marketization of the technological innovation, participating the international technology union and so on.

articleTitle: Optimizing Entrepreneurial Environment to Promote the Development of Entrepreneurial SMEs' Informationization in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper attempts to establish the synthetic evaluation index model, utilizes fuzzy analysis to analyze Entrepreneurship environment of Heilongjiang Province, and draws the conclusions that Entrepreneurship environment in Heilongjiang Province needs to improve. Considering the problems in the development of entrepreneurship environment, this paper puts forward some suggestion and countermeasures on how to encourage the development of entrepreneurial activities to promote informationization of Entrepreneurial SMEs in Heilongjiang Province, thereby narrowing the gap with the developed coastal regions.

articleTitle: Research on Applied Diagnosis Technology Based on Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The technology of an intelligent fault diagnosis provides a new way for the reliability and safety of industrial systems, but, it can gradually no longer meet all demand to diagnose faults in complex systems by some existing solitary and static means, because of the equipments and functions complication in a complex industrial system. Considered with the characteristics of a fault diagnosis, a new technology plan based on some reconstruction operations is provided for a complex fault diagnosis task, some methods about how to reconstruct a fault diagnosis process are also discussed, at last the feasibility of discussed technologies are initially verified in some simulations.

articleTitle: Virtual Linear Dispersion Code in OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We present a new transmission scheme which apply the linear dispersion code (LDC) to a single transmit antenna in the OFDM system. Our scheme, named virtual LDC, transfers the LDC substreams through the multiple uncorrelated OFDM subchannels. The virtual LDC scheme can achieve the coding and diversity advantage as well as LDC in MIMO. It is shown that the virtual LDC scheme can improve the BER performance compared with plain OFDM system.

articleTitle: Research on Track Map Database for Low-Cost Train Control System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The low-cost train control system is new trend for modern train operation and management. Based on the functional requirement of track map database, generation of track map in GIS and schematic form are mainly studied in this paper, as well as their mapping description. In the low-cost scheme, the flow of the generation is discussed in detailed and several strategies are employed to realize the mapping of GIS and schematic track. With the generating software developed in this work, the generated track map database is validated in the simulation environment and the correction and effectiveness are guaranteed.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis for Dams of Fuhuashan Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of dams of Fuhuashan reservoir operation, anti-slide stability of whole sections of the main dam and the secondary dam were analyzed by Swedish circle method and simplified Bishop method. The minimal safety factor of stability and the most dangerous slip circle were determined for cross sections not meeting stability requirements. The probable causation was analyzed, and conclusions and suggestions were provided.

articleTitle: Threat Situation Analysis of Local Area Network Based on the Network Graph Theory Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A threat situation analytical method based on the network graph theory model was presented. In this method, the attack cost of adjacent nodes and the calculating formula for its effectiveness value were defined, as well as the method to calculate the maximum threat path and node. It analysis the threat level of the target node and the threat path of a local area network. The results indicated that: the target node of attack cost varies on different routes; it should exist the maximum and minimum threat path.

articleTitle: Research on Multi Autonomic Objects Flexible Workflow Based on Complex Adaptive System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the flexibility and intelligence of flexible workflow, the CAS (Complex Adaptive System) theory is introduced into flexible workflow research. Based on the analogy analysis between CAS and flexible workflow and the multi Autonomic Objects (AO) flexible workflow, a complex adaptive multi-AOs flexible workflow model is proposed, then the stimulation-response model of AO is given, and an example is described to demonstrate the realization mechanism of AO intelligence.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Some Features of Lightning Flashes Observed on Radar and Satellite Images in Northwestern China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Middleware for Data Storage Resources Discovery and Dynamic Management in Grid Computing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The data grid has provided the emerging technology for constructing the ultra large-scale data storage and management in the grid computing. This paper presents a new kind of data grid middleware for data storage resources discovery and dynamic management in gird environment. The data grid middleware has the characteristics of self-adaptive software system structure. The architecture of grid storage resources discovery and dynamic management is presented for discovering data storage resources from the different computer organizational structure, the different grid, and different store medium in the grid. This middleware can realize the necessary functions for the ultra large-scale application in data grid environment. It could be applied to the ultra large-scale data storage management in grid computing in next generation internet.

articleTitle: A Runtime Profile Method for Dynamic Binary Translation Using Hardware-Support Technique
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Profile data is valuable for identifying program hotspots and guiding optimizations. Traditional software profiling techniques incur significant overhead and are not suitable for DBT (Dynamic Binary Translation) systems. Hardware can support profile collection through either counters or timer interrupts that permit collection of statistical samples via software. Most hardware-support profiling systems can only achieve either high profile accuracy or low overhead. In this paper, we propose a novel profile approach on DBT using hardware support technique to achieve rapidly and accurately collecting profile information with minimal runtime overhead. This approach makes use of instrumentation code and a set of profiling hardware which supports operations of updating counters. It is believed that such a software-hardware collaborative approach will serve to provide a strong foundation for optimizing DBT systems.

articleTitle: Cluster Supply Chain Network Operating Mechanism: Co-Competition and Interaction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cluster supply chain as a new type of network organization coupling of industry clusters and supply chain. It is a combination of competition and cooperation. While in cluster supply chain that exist interaction between logistics, capital flow and information flow in various units. Co-competition and interaction is to support the normal operation of cluster supply chain network. In this paper, we made classification of co-competition mechanism at different levels of the core networks and support networks in cluster supply chain network, and analyzed interaction mechanism from logistics, capital flow and information flow, expecting a better understanding of operation mechanism of cluster supply chain and its characteristics.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition with Marginal Fisher Analysis on Local Binary Patterns
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel approach to facial expression recognition with Marginal Fisher Analysis (MFA) on Local Binary Pattern (LBP) is proposed. Firstly, each image is transformed by an LBP operator and then divided into 3 × 5 non-overlapping blocks. The features of facial expression images are formed by concatenating the LBP histogram of each block. Secondly, MFA algorithm based on Graph Embedding (GE) is applied for dimensionality reduction. Finally, Support Vector Machine (SVM) is used to classify the seven expressions (anger, disgust, fear, happiness, neutral, sadness and surprise) on Japanese Female Facial Expression (JAFFE) database. The maximum facial expression recognition rate of the proposed algorithm reaches to 65.71% for person-independent expression recognition, which is better than LBP + LDA algorithms. The experiment results prove that the facial expression recognition with MFA on LBP is an effective and feasible algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on Function Mechanism of Integrated Industry Based on The Complex Systems Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: First, the definition of integrated industry is given from the perspective of complex systems. Second, the factors of integrated industry are identified by the application of the hierarchical structure model of the complex systems theory. Finally, the function mechanism of integrated industry is analyzed.

articleTitle: New Function of Financing Warehouse in Chattel Mortgage Financing under Property Law
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The promulgation of the PRC Property Law provided enterprises with a new financing channel of chattel mortgage. Compared with chattel pledge financing, which previously was the only choice under the Guarantee Law, chattel mortgage financing enjoys many advantages, and at the same time, brings with the difficulty of monitoring. By using a financing warehouse run by a third party logistics firm, combined with a reasonably designed system, the monitoring difficulty can be resolved and thus the chattel mortgage can be more applicable.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Bit and Power Allocation Algorithm Based on OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed a novel bit and power allocation algorithm for OFDMA systems. Compared with previous schemes, the proposed algorithm is considered with two different stages to improve the bit and power allocation algorithm performance instead of traditional one stage. Two different stages proposed in this paper include RLB algorithm and B-Tighten algorithm. The numeric results show this algorithm has lower computational complexity in the overall transmission power by constraining the fixed data rate and bit error rate.

articleTitle: The Research on Human Resources Utilization Mode in the Process of Enterprise Informationization: An Analysis Based on the View of Wikinomics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wikinomics advocates mass collaboration, which means that people in the world use their wisdom and creativity focusing on the solutions to certain problems, so that enterprises can take advantage of collective wisdom to achieve the purpose of cost-cutting, and rapid innovation. With the era of web2.0, the competitiveness of enterprises lies in the capacity, through the construction of enterprise informationalization, to fully make use of external human resources through the network platform, rather than the simple representation of the quantity and quality of human resources. With the introduction of wikinomics, this paper analyzes the changes of human resources utilization mode in the process of enterprise informationization, and introduces the impacts of current enterprise informationalization on human resources utilization mode. Besides, this paper will put forward some relevant measures on how to utilize internal and external human resources comprehensively.

articleTitle: Fair Dynamic Pipelining Memory Access Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Technology trends are leading to increasing number of cores on chip. All these cores inherently share the DRAM bandwidth. The on-chip and off-chip cache or memory resources are limited and in many situations, cannot hold the working set of the threads running on all these cores. This situation makes DRAM bandwidth a critical shared resource. Hence computer designers are faced with an increasing Processor - Memory Performance Gap, which now is the primary obstacle to improved computer system performance. Existing DRAM access management schemes provide support for enforcing bandwidth shares but have problems like starvation, complexity, and unpredictable DRAM access latency. In this paper, we propose a DRAM access management scheme - Fair Dynamic Pipelining (FDP) memory access scheduling with two key features. First, the scheme avoids unexpected long latencies or starvation of memory requests using the dynamic pipeline arrangement policy. Second, it provides an alterable priority strategy to make the response of memory more fairly. The experiment result shown that the FDP scheduling makes the bandwidth shares to achieve desired average latencies for multi cores memory accesses.

articleTitle: Improvement of Interleaved Multiplication Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An improved modular multiplication algorithm based on the interleaved multiplication is presented in this paper. Carry save addition (CSA), redundant representation, a fast lookup table and a counter register are used to improve this algorithm. Carry save addition and redundant representation are used to replace other additions like carry select addition, carry lookahead addition and so on, because carry propagation brought by those additions can be prevented by carry save addition, and redundant representation can make the arithmetic operations fast without carry propagation. The fast lookup table with only 7 pre-calculated values can minimize the number of additions, and can only be addressed once in one iteration, which not only speed up, but also save area compared with other literatures used lookup tables. The iteration number can be reduced by a counter register being added in this improved method to compute the number of 0 from the most significant bit of one operand like X. Analysis and emulation result shows the area and time complexity (AT) of the improved method is equal or even less than 2n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Different Schemes for Treatment with Multi-Islands and Complex Coastlines in Wave Numerical Computation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to describe complex multi-island terrain and coastlines adequately in ocean wave numerical model, basing on the optimization of computing grid by using depth and high resolution coastlines, the method of introducing sub-grid effect into WAVEWATCH-III model has been established. Comparing the results of computation with this scheme and with the scheme for improving grid resolution to distinguish out islands, it shows that: The effect of multi-islands and complex terrain on wave spreading is adequately described by sub-grid effect of islands and the results are much better; The computational precision of significant wave height obtained by introducing the scheme for sub-grid effect of islands into computation with low resolution grid is equivalent with the precision of results obtained by computation with high resolution grid, but the efficiency of former scheme is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Mode Analysis of Several Typical Blood Cells under Optical Phase Models by VirtualLab Technique
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to get more information and improve classification precision of the cell, the paper chooses several typical blood cells as main study objects, and sets up the related optical phase models. Then, according to the optical interference theory and related experimental parameters choosing, the VirtualLab imitation system is applied to design relevant modules to get the phase distributions of these blood cells. The paper shows that different cells have different phase distributions after unwrapping of these phase distributions, which provides preferable theoretic basis and technical support for improving the inspecting precision of the blood cells.

articleTitle: Research status and Progress of Knowledge Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge integration (KI) is not only the basis of knowledge innovation, but also the important condition for different organizations to get sustainable competition advantage. Based on the detailed documentary materials, this paper offers a synergetic view of the literature on KI. In this paper, the meaning of KI is first introduced. Then, the research status of KI in fields of computer science and management are analyzed. Finally, the hot topics, directions and key issues about KI research are pointed out. This will further deepen theoretical study with a better target and reference, and will plays a fundamental role for enriching knowledge management theory and integration theory.

articleTitle: An Efficient Gene-Enzyme Identification Method in the Reconstruction of Metabolic Networks: Hybrid Participle Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Metabolism is the set of chemical reactions that occur in living organisms in order to maintain life, and a genome-scale metabolic network can be reconstructed by identifying, categorizing and interconnecting all the genes, proteins, reactions and metabolites that participate in the metabolic activity of a biological system to form a metabolic network. Enzymes play a very important part in metabolism, and the identification of all genes encoding metabolic enzymes and to assign correct Enzyme Commission classification (EC) numbers to them is pivotal in the reconstruction of metabolic networks. In this paper, we represent an automated and efficient gene-enzyme identification method in the reconstruction of metabolic networks: Hybrid Participle Algorithm (HPA). In order to prove the usefulness of HPA, we reconstructed the metabolic networks of Escherichia_coli_K12 using both PathoLogic and HPA. The results indicate that by using HPA, we can identify more metabolic genes and their corresponding enzymes than by using other methods based on the whole name match method, such as PathoLogic. And the F-measures of our results are higher than the F-measures of the results obtained by using PathoLogic. HPA provides an automated and efficient way to identify the metabolic genes and their corresponding enzymes.

articleTitle: Dynamic Portfolio Insurance Strategy and Its Empirical Research in Chinese Futures Market
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Futures option cannot only hedge volatility of spot price, but also can protect the investor from loss a lot in disadvantageous circumstances. Without appropriate options, alternative strategy can be taken by combining the underlying asset with risk-free asset, that is, by dynamic adjusting positions of the two assets to replicate the desired option. The strategy is named dynamic portfolio insurance. This paper focused on its implementation by dynamic hedging using only the underlying portfolio (or, more commonly, a highly correlated portfolio of futures) and cash. The basic feature of the dynamic hedging strategy is selling out of the underlying portfolio as its price falls, and buying more of the underlying portfolio as its price rises. The former implements a floor on losses and the latter ensures the upside capture. By simulation, we tested the effectiveness of dynamic portfolio insurance strategy in Chinese futures market.

articleTitle: Granular Computing Applied to Heuristic Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Granular Computing (GrC) is a new concept and novel approach to solve the complex problems and provide a method for massive data-searching in the field of artificial intelligence. This paper presents a novel method which combines the quotient space theory to the granular computing for analysis of the hierarchical structure and data searching. This method can simplify the original state-space effectively, so it is very meaningful to the heuristic search algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the Experiment Teaching of C Language
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: "C Language Program Design" is a course with strong practice, whose experiment plays an important role in the process of C language teaching. The paper analyzes the problem in experiment teaching of the course of C Language Programming; declares the method of experiment teaching, the content of experiment, teaching organization, examination and extracurricular contest; discusses experiment teaching on the C language. Practice of teaching has proved that this method promotes C language experiment teaching, enhances the students' ability of analyzing and solving problem.

articleTitle: Using Dynamic Copula Method for CDO Pricing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper extends the copula method in CDO pricing to dynamic copula model. As one can see, financial data often cover a long time period and dependent structure between different time series always tends to change instead of to keep static. So using dynamic copula model to price CDO is much more accurate than traditional static one. In our work, we apply GOF test and binary segmentation procedure to detect the change of copula function. The result shows that in different time period, the best copula fitting for data set is not static, thus the expected loss and fair spread varies from one stage to another one. Our empirical research shows that fair spread of each tranches varying from different stages. This explains why CDO is so popular and profitable in the past year, but its investors suffered so much when financial crisis happened.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo Simulations of Dynamic Behavior in Polydisperse Granular Gases System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Monte Carlo simulations are employed to investigate the dynamic behavior in a polydisperse granular media with fractal size distribution. The dispersion of size distribution can be described by a fractal dimension d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>, and the smooth hard disks are engaged in a two-dimensional horizontal rectangular box, colliding inelastically with each other and driven by Gaussian white noise. We have mainly studied the effect of the dispersion on the steady-state dynamic properties of the system in the same inelasticity case. With the increase of d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>, the distributions of path lengths between collisions deviate more obviously from expected theoretical forms for elastic spheres and have an overpopulation of short distances. The collision rate increases with d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>, but it is independent of time. The tails of the velocity distribution functions rise significantly above a Gaussian as d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> increases, but the non-Gaussian velocity distribution functions do not demonstrate any apparent universal form. Moreover, the spatial velocity correlations are apparently stronger with the increase of d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>. The d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>-dependent nature of the dynamic behavior is induced by the more dissipation due to the more dispersion of the disk size distribution in the inelastic collisions as d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> is increased.

articleTitle: Test and Processing of Gun's Shooting Vibration Signal Based on Wavelet Threshold De-Noising
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The gun brings with acute vibration during its shooting, which greatly impacts gun's firing accuracy and reliability. If vibration response has been tested and analyzed when the gun shooting, gun's dynamic characteristic would be obtained which can afford important references for gun's optimization and technology improving. The paper designs the testing system for gun's shooting vibration, according to the test state and requirement during gun's shooting. With the problem of noise interference inside the signal, wavelet threshold de-noising is adopted to decrease noise when the principle of heuristic threshold and improved threshold function are used. Then the characteristics in time and frequency domain are enhanced.

articleTitle: Generalized Predictive Control Based on Toeplitz Equation and It's Application in Liquid-Level Control System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A rapid generalized predictive control algorithm based on Toeplitz equation which is used to separate the future and past information in the predictive equation is presented in this paper. And the performance of the closed-loop system is improved further for the introduction of a weighted average strategy in the control law. Simulations and experiments verify the feasibility and rapidity of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: PRBS Test Signature Analysis of Switched Current Circuit
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A PRBS tested signature analysis method that is based on the excitation of the switched current circuits with pseudo random sequence and the subsequent analysis of the captured response is proposed in this paper. It has taken into account of the connection between special structural problems and CMOS's parameters in switched current circuits such as the drain-gate capacitance Cdg, gate-source capacitance Cgs and transconductance gm. The fault detection capabilities of the test and data analysis methods demonstrated by applying them to variant switched current filter circuit.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Risk Management of China's Commercial Banks under Financial Crisis: A Financial Engineering Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Organization Transformation Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the information age, the relationship between organization transformation and IT is more and more complicated and close. Based on the composition of organization, this article introduces the four aspects in organization transformation: BPR, organization restructuring, personnel changes and changes in organizational culture, and analyzes the application of IT in each aspect. At the last part, it introduces the implementation plan for organization transformation base on IT in detail.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Automatic Negotiation Model Based on the Third-Party Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: E-commerce negotiation is one of the key issues in E-commerce. This paper presents an E-commerce automatic negotiation model based on the third-party agent, which is made of a group of buyers agent with the mutual cooperation, the sellers agent and the trading hall agent system that manages both of their agent system information. This model uses the mobile agent technology and the participation of the third-party agent, greatly accelerates the speed of online transactions, and improves the efficiency of e-commerce.

articleTitle: Evaluating Indexes System Research on SMEs' Innovative Capabilities in the Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper forms the evaluating indexes system of the innovative capabilities of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in the cluster. By using a sample including the SMEs' innovative capabilities in the cluster of biotechnology industry in Guangzhou, I find that the evaluating indexes system well explains the intuition observed from the data. The indexes system provides an effective way to identify existing problems and to analyze the reasons. Last, the paper puts forward some suggestions for decision makers.

articleTitle: Design of an Acceleration Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A small-size acceleration measurement system based on ARM is designed and developed in this paper. It adopts Micro-machined capacitive integrated chip Model1221 as sensor and SD card as Data memory. Combined with communication port, application software is designed to display, store and deal with the data measured. By measuring the centripetal acceleration of rotating body at a uniform velocity, the static performance of this system is calibrated; by measuring the blast acceleration produced by shaking table, the dynamic performance is tested and compared. The results show that this system has higher intelligent degree, smaller size, lighter weight, lower frequency response (including direct current response), wider frequency response range, and greater static and dynamic performance. At last, this acceleration measurement system is helpful and has extensive application prospects in measurement area.

articleTitle: Analysis and Calculation of the Electromagnetic Field in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Permanent magnet (PM) synchronous motor has the magnet devices with variable shapes and location, so the electromagnetic field in PM synchronous motor is more complex. Finite element method (FEM) provides an accurate means of determining the electromagnetic field distribution, with due account magnetic saturation characteristics. With the ANSYS, the distribution of electromagnetic field in PM synchronous motor was analyzed and calculated. Through a prototype machine, no-load and load electromagnetic field in PM synchronous motor were obtained. When the PM synchronous motor was loaded, direct axis (d-axis) and quadrature axis (q-axis) armature reaction magnetic field were obtained. By back-dealing model of ANSYS, the pictures of magnetic flux density (B) and magnetic vector potential (A) were gained. Then back EMF of PM synchronous motor was figured out with two different means, and the calculation results were compared and analyzed, which are helpful for the design and performance analysis of PM synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Realization and Application of Aero Hazard Weather Forecast Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Algorithm of aero hazard weather was studied by meso-scale numerical prediction model (MM5) and World Area Forecast System (WAFS). After meso-scale numerical prediction model was localized, algorithms of hazard weathers were analyzed. Algorithms of aero route hazard weather about wind shear, bump, icing, visibility, cloud cover and cloud height were established. The forecast results of wind shear grade, bump grade, icing grade, visibility, cloud cover and cloud height were given out. These products were displayed with Meteorological Information Comprehensive Analysis and Processing System (MICAPS) in operation. Based on interpolation algorithm, projection commutation and WAFS, the plane and section charts of wind and temperature prediction product of random fairway were processed and made. The application instance showed that the algorithm and forecast outputs played an important role in actual application and service of the conferences of China's parliament and China's Political Consultative.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Collaborative Management System in the Industry Chain of Steel
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the 21st century, with the further deepening of economic globalization, the competition among steel enterprises has gradually upgraded to that of industry chains. It has been proved that only integrates actively and effectively all related enterprises in the industry chain and operates collaboratively, does steel enterprise achieve an upturn in the overall competitive capacity in the industry chain of steel. From the view of enterprise competence theory (part of integration theory of industry chain), the origin and foundation, formation and mechanism of collaboration are analyzed. On the basis of theory research, system architecture of competence integration-based collaborative platform in the industry chain of steel is built. At the end of the paper, the application instance of the collaborative platform is given.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machine for Suppressing Error Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Support Vector Machine (SVM) is sensitive to noises and outliers. For reducing the effect of noises and outliers, we propose a novel SVM for suppressing error function. The error function is limited to the interval of. The separation hypersurface is simplified and the margin of hypersurface is widened. Experimental results show that our proposed method is able to simultaneously increase the classification efficiency and the generalization ability of the SVM.

articleTitle: ESCPP: An Evaluation and Alerting System for the Compatibility between Practice Guidelines and Practicing Medicine Using Arden Syntax
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The clinical quality is influenced by the disseminating velocity of new medical knowledge and the rate of patients that receive evidence-based clinical service.
