In this study, we introduced an evaluation and alerting system for the compatibility between practice guidelines and medicine practices using Arden Syntax (ESCPP) based on EGADSS. We also introduced an approach to automatically create CDA file from XForms file using metadata. The knowledge is coded in Arden Syntax with MLM. CDA file was used for information exchange. Currently, ESCPP has been used to evaluate the compatibility of summary medical records from hospitals. It could also give alert messages at the point of care using Infobutton.

articleTitle: A Numerical Study on the Anomalies of the South Asian High and the Subtropical Western Pacific High
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A numerical study on the relationship between the interannual longitudinal oscillation of the South Asian High (SAH) and the subtropical western Pacific high (SWPH) and the heat source anomalies during boreal summer has been conducted by using a high-resolution regional climate model IPRC-RegCM. The results show that the anomalous heating (cooling) over the Yellow River and Huaihe River valley may play an important role in the longitudinal oscillation of the SAH and the SWPH in summer. Further study suggests that the heat source (sink) strengthens (weakens) the ascending motion of the air over the Yellow River and Huaihe River valley, which reinforces (reduces) the high-level divergence. Consequently, the intensity of the SAH increases (decreases) and the ridge of the SAH extends further eastward (withdraws westward). In addition, due to the anomalous northerly in upper (middle) troposphere the abnormal sinking (rising) motion of the air occurs above the sea in middle and low latitudes, which is accompanied by adiabatic heating (cooling). As a result, the deep and warm SWPH is strengthened (weakened) and extends further westward (withdraws eastward).

articleTitle: An Improved Joint Detection Approach for TD-SCDMA System over Multipath Channels
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the joint detection method for TD-SCDMA system, and derives an improved approach to eliminate inter-symbol interference (ISI) in condition of multipath channel. Analysis for the received signals exhibits its characteristics of PARAllel profiles with LINear Dependencies (PARALIND) model. The proposed blind PALALIND algorithm utilizes no channel parameter for detection, and performs better with snapshots increasing. Simulation results indicate that its performance is quite close to space-time minimum-mean-square-error (ST-MMSE) and also robust in array error condition.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Mobile Spatial Information Location Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the multidimensional and enormous for spatial data, this paper provided a new based on the mobile oriented spatial information location algorithm. The algorithm used quadtree theory has nothing to do with a specific space to operate object excluded, so that the spatial location of the operation be able to fast access to the operation object, improve the spatial location operational efficiency. Finally, application examples were given out to prove this design model's feasibility, and the contrast between the existing Web location algorithm and based the Quadtree theory location algorithm also validated that the latter was more efficient and faster for spatial location.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Vector-Valued Three-Dimensional Wavelet Packets with Arbitrary Integer-Valued Matrix Dilation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this work the notion of orthogonal vector-valued trivariate wavelet packets, which is a generalization of uni-wavelet packets, is introduced. A new method for constructing them is developed, and their characteristics is discussed by using time-frequency analysis method, matrix theory and finite group theory. Orthogonality formulas are established.

articleTitle: A New Distributed Routing Protocol for Forwarding Networks Using Linear Number of Packets
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new efficient distributed routing protocol for any general purpose destination-based forwarding networks (like Internet) which forward packets solely based on the destination address. Our approach is to minimize the number of messages and the time needed to recompute the relevant forwarding tables due to topology change by introducing a concept of senator nodes (a small subset of the nodes in the network) who are responsible for maintaining the system wide tables; all other nodes communicate with their respective senators. We deploy a self-stabilizing algorithm to create a k-hop dominating set as senator nodes, where k is a constant, 1 ¿ k ¿ D/2, D is the diameter of the network. The cost of route updates is measured in round, a time-slot such that each packet identified by the packet ID can be forwarded at least once. We show that, in response to topology change caused by link or node failures, the recomputation of forwarding tables is guaranteed to converge within 5k + 2 rounds (a constant) with O(n) messages, where n is the number of nodes in the network.

articleTitle: A Study on Optimizing the Program of the Network Organization's Joint Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The key to optimizing the program of the network organization's joint decision-making is to study the synergistic effect created for the network organization's members by the program, and the maximized synergistic effect created for the network organization's members becomes the principle to select the program of the network organization's joint decision-making. The paper constructs the evaluation index system of the program of the network organization's joint decision-making from the impact of both the size of synergistic effect and the ratio of synergistic effect, describes the group decision-making method based on the fuzzy evaluation and uses the method to optimize the program of a specific network organization's joint decision-making.

articleTitle: Proportional Delay Guarantee in Web QoS Based on Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the heterogeneity of Web clients increasing, the differentiated service becomes an important issue for e-commerce Web sites, and the control theory has already been used for this in Web server. However, when workloads vary significantly, the real-time performance of feedback control needs to be improved. After analyzing the heavy-tailed property of embedded files in Web pages, this paper presents a predictive approach based on the queuing feature of Web server and HTTP 1.1 persistent connections. It achieves the relative delay guarantee by calculating the future delay of different priorities and adjusting their quota of service threads. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach performs a better dynamic property.

articleTitle: WinCon-8000 Smart PAC Used in Survey the Tide Height of Coast
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Combine with the item of survey the tide height of coast in Tianjin. Detailedly introduce the structure and peculiarity of WINCON-8000 control unit and how to use the isagraf language to program it. The control unit connects various sensors to measure the wind speed, wind direction and the tide height and also sends the real time data to the control center via the GPRS. The raw data should to be analyzed and progressed at the center and then be issued on the website.

articleTitle: Continuation of High-Quality but Original Ecological Living Style - Innovative Ideas in Inner Cities' Renovation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper on one hand demonstrates innovative ideas in old cities' renovation both from improving infrastructural facilities and preserving original life style. On the other hand, it theoretically probes into current ideas of old cities' renovation in China.

articleTitle: MMN Analysis for Chinese Lexical Tones Based on Enhanced ICA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the physiological coding mechanism of Chinese lexical tones with the single-trial mismatch negativity (MMN) study using independent component analysis (ICA). The enhanced ICA algorithm combined with subspace filtering performs MMN preprocessing, the evoked components are extracted again to improve the performance of removing artifact. Experiment results show that MMN responses are elicited distinctly by the different stimulation blocks at the prefrontal electrodes, and especially better contrast responses are obtained with the falling-rising and falling tone deviants among the flat tone standards. The peak latency and amplitude have large fluctuation in the blocks with the falling tone deviants, P3 is also distinct in them.

articleTitle: Incentive Mechanism of Management Stakeholders in Large-Scale Highway Construction Project Based on Game Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Large-scale highway construction projects present a principal-agent relationship chain at two levels and have four stakeholders under the deputy construction system, and the effect of cooperation among the stakeholders are deeply influenced by the incentive mechanism. Based on the principal-agent theory, the article analyzed gamble models between government and project owners, project owners and supervisors from the perspective of behavior and benefit, and established corresponding incentive mechanisms according to different management stakeholders in large-scale highway construction projects.

articleTitle: BNAK-Divide-and-Merge Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Divide-and-Merge is a methodology for clustering a set of objects that combines a top-down "divide" method with a bottom-up "merge" method. In this paper, we propose a 2-way normalized cut with automatically determining K clustering algorithm (BNAK-Divide-and-Merge) based on the Divide-and-Merge. In order to improve the efficiency and performance of the divide phase, our methodology alternately uses 2-way normalized cut spectral clustering algorithm with a threshold to limit the number of tree nodes produced by the divide phase. Furthermore, we present a measurement of automatically determining the expected number of clusters (i.e., K) at the merge phase so that it not only reduces the number of additional parameters which must be inputted manually, but also allows the algorithm to control the clustering quality. We also give empirical results on four common well-known data sets where the algorithm performs better than or competitively with k-means and Divide-and-Merge.

articleTitle: Research on mSCTP-Based Application Continuity in IMS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Application continuity in IMS requires Mobility Management to ensure Session having Seamless handover and small delay. As a Session Control Protocol of IMS, SIP introduces big delay and real-time handover problems. In this letter, we proposed a combination scheme of SIP and mSCTP to solve the problem of Application continuity in IMS. We presented a novel approach for the problem of Compatibility to existing application based on TCP/UDP.

articleTitle: Study on Hierarchy Collaborative Planning for TFT-LCD Production Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: TFT-LCD (Thin Film Transistor Liquid Crystal Display) panel production as example, a hierarchical planning model is constructed to study the collaborative planning in multi-site multi-stage manufacture. According to the characteristics of TFT-LCD manufacturing process, three levels are proposed here for production chain planning: Firstly, for multi-stage planning, a Mixed Integrated Planning Model is constructed to realized the upstream and downstream collaborative planning; for multi-site planning, a Liner planning model is constructed to realized the parallel factories planning; and for the single factory planning, DBR (Drum-Buffer-Rope) theory based model is constructed. Secondly, the hierarchical collaborative planning model system intergraded with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system also studied.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 3D Visualization Based on Middleware of 2D Components GIS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because of the absolute superiority in space and time complexity, 2D data model is used widely in the GIS industry, and has become the main model of GIS data storage. Now, the real-time 3D visual modeling based on two-dimensional GIS data has become the focus of attention. However, the traditional model of three-dimensional visualization based on two-dimensional GIS data has many problems such as data redundancy, non-uniform and function singleness. In order to solve these problems, this paper presents the concept of middleware of three-dimensional visualization based on the platform of Components GIS. Through the interaction among the middleware interfaces, three-dimensional view is associated with the two-dimensional GIS data, so that many operations can be done by users, such as query, edit and analysis based on the two-dimensional GIS data in the three-dimensional view. The middleware model not only ensures the independence of three-dimensional modules, but also safeguards the integrity of the data. And then the middleware model is applied to the design of three-dimensional functional modules of Chemical Pipe Gallery Management Application System, which is set up on GisPipe70, the City Pipe Information System platform, and gets a good effect of realization. Finally, the superiority of middleware models is analyzed.

articleTitle: The Evaluation on Innovation Performance of the Electronics Industry in the Northeast in China - Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the elements as market factors, technical factors and social factors, this paper constructed the theoretical model which affected innovation performance of the electronics industry in the Northeast in China. With EXCEL software, SPSS15.0,and this paper analyzed empirically innovation performance of the Electronics industry among the Northeast region and the Yangtze River Delta and the Pearl River Delta, and that proposed the innovation policy implications for the Northeast in China.

articleTitle: The Research of Automatic Data Hoarding Technique Based on Hyper Graph
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a low-cost automatic data hoarding technique. Data hoarding is the process of pre-fetching important data into local cache for future operation before disconnection. It can find the data sequence rules of broadcasting history according to data mining method, and formulate hype graph model and it can also cover the data of invalid window through low-cost hoarding computation. The theoretical analysis and experiment results indicate that the technique is low-cost and can solve cache pollution and can significantly improve cache hit rate and shorten average response time.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research and Application of a New Distributed Data Access Model Based on Mobile Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Order Cepstrum Technology for Fault Diagnosis of Gearbox
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An RFID Signal Capturing and Controlling System for BRT Priority System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an RFID signal capturing and controlling system for BRT (Bus Rapid Transit) priority is proposed. Setting an active RFID tag on the BRT vehicle and setting an RFID reader close the road intersections, the reader identify the coming BRT vehicle quickly and exactly, the system perform the BRT signal priority process and control the signal lamp phase by comparing the BRT schedule. We analyse the design of the system and it's realization of hardware and software flow.

articleTitle: Study on Software Project Risk Priority Management and Framework Based on Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper establishes a framework for software project risk management and presents a method for risk priority management as a module in the system on the basis of Risk Management Information System. It provides a possible framework for the construction of a concrete database including a possible list of risks and fields of risk description as well as an empirical research on the identification of important risks through Delphi Method, AHP, and computerized calculations. The study is aimed at providing guiding concepts for the establishment of software project Risk Management Information Systems, thus reducing the cost and increasing the efficiency of risk management for software projects.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Influencing Factors of Leadership Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Studying on leadership effectiveness is extremely important for enhancing organizational performance and leadership capacity of individual leaders. Based on relevant theory and research results, this paper put forward the factors that influence leadership effectiveness in three dimensions, collecting data through questionnaire survey, using SPSS17.0 software for statistical analysis of data. The variable and subject items of distribution of the three dimensions factors were verified. Then a multiple regression model between four influencing factors and leadership effectiveness was constructed, which analyze the differences among different demographic variables. The conclusions drawn from this research would be a reference for the organizations to strengthen the building of leadership effectiveness.

articleTitle: An Open Education Model for Using SVG in Distance E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) is a special XML-based language used to describe and draw two-dimensional scale-independent graphics on web. As an open graphics standard developed by W3C, SVG cannot only render high-quality scalable images with luxuriant contents, but also can be animated and enriched with interactivity. With support of powerful animations and interactivity, SVG is convenient to help teachers have communion with students in e-learning environments. This paper summarizes SVG's capabilities in e-leaning environments, outlines various benefits of SVG and XML in open and distance digital learning. Besides outlining above new features of SVG applying in e-learning solutions, this paper also review some general usage scenarios and examples for SVG-based application in distance education. In addition, to solve the problem in open distance e-learning e.g. developing course wares for CRTVU (China Central Radio and TV University) educational web, a suggested open framework for SVG-based application in distance education and cost-benefit evaluation is also proposed. This paper also elaborates on the comparison between SVG with Macromedia Flash and PDF (Portable Document Format) in various facets such as opening, interactivity, flexibility and extensibility. Furthermore, the paper discusses the technologic trend for SVG-based applications in the educational field.

articleTitle: Research on a Global Optimization Method for QoS of Web Service Composite
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of Web service technology, applications constructed by Composite Web Service becoming possible, so the importance of optimization problems for QoS of Web Service composite are becoming increasingly evident. Genetic algorithm and ant colony algorithm are both belong to the global optimization methods of QoS. For ant colony algorithm easy to drop into the slow pace of convergence while genetic algorithm easy to fall into local optimal solution and the low efficiency problem, this paper combined with the two algorithms' advantages, give full play to the positive feedback characteristics of ant colony algorithm and genetic algorithm's rapid global search capability, improves the global optimization algorithm's ability. After testing and analysis, it shows that the presented algorithm resolve the optimization problem of QoS better.

articleTitle: Analysis of Freight Index Based on Fractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the fractal characters of Baltic Dirty Tanker Index weekly return time series. BDS test and Rescaled Range Analysis are applied for studying non-linear dependence and random of the time series. The Hurst index and acyclic periodic is gained by R/S analysis. Conclusions show that there is non-linear dependence and non-random, also the series show inverse persistence.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Strategic Interaction and Interpartner Legitimacy in Service Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper empirically explores strategic interactions between service integrator and customer, and the role of product service and integrated service on interpartner legitimacy based on capability approach and institutional legitimacy theories. The result shows that strategic interactions between service integrator and customers have significant influence on interpartner legitimacy in service supply chain, especially integrated service mediate between strategic interaction and interpartner legitimacy, while product service has little effect on interpartner legitimacy.

articleTitle: Rapid Non-Template Edge Recognition in Range Image
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traditional edge detection methods often employ self-defining templates to recognize edge points in 2D images. Recently, this technique has extended to develop many 3D edge operators used to understand 3D range images in computer vision community. Existing template-based approaches are mostly variant to rotation or scaling transformation and sensitive to noise in raw data. In this paper, a non-template edge recognition method for 2D scan lines in range images is proposed. Based on point's distribution analysis in a single scan line, some new coefficients are defined to characterize features of large noise and edge points. Subsequently, corresponding discriminant criteria are stipulated for denoising and recognition. The method performs an extremely rapid speed for data processing based on simple calculations on few points, and reaches equilibrium of strong robustness and high adaptability. Because all the coefficients are established on the basis of distances between the points or their ratio, the proposed method is inherently invariant to translation and rotation transformation, and is suitable for any sensor viewpoints. Computational complexity and time expenditure are evaluated during a real data experiment.

articleTitle: Statistics Properties of Geometric Brown Motion under Haar Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies geometric brown motion: x(t) = e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B(t)</sup>. Its relative properties, stationary properties under the Haar wavelet, and density obtain.

articleTitle: Parallel Computing for Finite Element Structural Modal Analysis on Workstation Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of mode synthesis analysis, parallel algorithm of solving large-scale structural eigen problem is presented in this paper. The eigenmode of the structure is solved using subspace iterative parallel method. The substructure subspace iterative method is implemented using the stiffness matrix and mass matrix of the substructures without assembling the stiffness and mass matrix of whole structure. The numerical results show that this parallel algorithm is effective for large- scale structure eigenproblem.

articleTitle: Spectral Method Using Hermite Functions for Semilinear Wave Equations with Strong Damping
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We consider spectral method using Hermite functions for semilinear wave equation with strong damping. A spectral scheme is constructed. We then prove the stability and the convergence of the scheme. Numerical results indicating the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: The Definition and Empirical Analysis on Influencing Factors of Modern Service Industry - Based on Time-Series Data
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Modern service industry is a new concept of China. The research and definition on it have just been at the initial stage. This paper analyzed other scholars' study of it by introducing the process of the development of this concept. On the basis of that, the paper gave a new definition of modern service industry. And according to the definition, the paper discussed the influencing factors of modern service industry, including outside environmental factors and internal factors. Because of the standard industrial classification and statistical criterion of China, the paper made empirical analysis by the time-series data of modern service industry over the past five years to approve the strength and direction of these factors, so as to provide theoretical and actual foundation for the further development of modern service industry.

articleTitle: A Novel Teaching System Reform on the Application-Oriented Talent Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Application-oriented talent cultivation is practice in essence. And the economic globalization has put forward new requirements for the training standards of the internationalized talents. In many years' international cooperative school-running with western university, we take western model for reference to reform the teaching system of the software engineering specialty. We comprehensively revised the cultivating scheme, the teaching method, and the practice teaching. Comparing before the reform, student's knowledge grasp level, knowledge utilization ability, communication ability, management capacity and the professional accomplishment have been greatly enhanced. Practice shows that these reforms are effective to application-oriented talents cultivation.

articleTitle: The Comparative Research on the Operation Models of Tourist Attractions in the Shangri-La Region
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper has summed up three operation models of the different scenic spots in Grand Shangri-La region, which are the model of government operation, the model of company operation and the model of cooperation of between the government and a company. Meanwhile, it has analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of the models, and drawn a conclusion that they had some problems. The author suggested the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress should strengthen legislation on heritages, e.g. the World Heritage Spots, National Nature Preservation Zones, National Geoparks, National Scenic Spots, should build a strict system of the supervision and management, and should forbid private companies to operate. We should respect traditional nationalities religious beliefs and taboos and give them a role in protecting the natural environment. We should encourage the communities to participate in the protection and supervision of Scenic Spots. We should raise up and support environmental NGOs, and enhance the whole nation's awareness of the environment protection.

articleTitle: Research on Numerical Simulation of Uncontrolled Blowout in Gas Field
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The real time measurement for uncontrolled blowout in gas field is not available. To study on the gas diffusion law during the process of gas diffusion, the K-¿ comparison of different model for turbulent. Two-and three-dimensional numerical simulations of jet flow are presented. The result shows that the numerical simulation method is an effective way for analysis of jet flow for uncontrolled blowout in gas field.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Study Based on ESI: Taking Material Science as Example
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper makes a bibliometric study of the articles on material science in ESI with a special emphasis on the distribution of countries, institutions, journals and scientists of high productivity and impact. It also analyzes the journals and scientists with highly cited papers and hot papers on material science. Finally, the co-citation analysis on the highly cited authors is conducted by SPSS so as to provide the hotspots and scientists' clusters on material science in recent 11 years. And some conclusions are got in this study.

articleTitle: Detection of conserved microRNAs in Saccharum Officinarum Using Microarray
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) reported previously from Arabidopsis. thaliana and other seven plant species, by both experimental validation and prediction, were used to identify potential miRNAs in Saccharum officinarum which is an important food and bio-energy crop. A microfluidic microarray was developed for detecting plant miRNAs and used for the first experimental analyzing the mature miRNAs and miRNAs* in S. officinarum. Using probes corresponding to detect 231 miRNAs and 104 miRNAs*, a total of 114 conserved miRNAs and 11 miRNAs* were detected, following a set of strict criteria. The results suggest that miRNAs are highly conserved and divergent among plants. To validate the hybridization results, a RT-PCR assay of mature miRNA expression was performed, yielding the detection of five miRNAs selected. Comparison of expression profiles revealed that 80 miRNA and five miRNAs* expressed differentially between young seedlings and adult plants. We also found that three miRNA families, including miR394, 476 and 481 characteristically expressed in the seedling. The above studies provide an approach for large-scale experimental detection of conserved miRNAs in species with limited genome information available.

articleTitle: Research on Multiplier Theorem of Difference Set Pairs
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We studied on the multiplier theorem of different sets theory, introduced and certificated the multiplier theorem based on the different sets pairs theory, by which to determine the non-existence of some Different Sets Paris.

articleTitle: Research on Migration and Degradation of Nitrogen Based on 15N Trace Technique in Semi-Aerobic Landfill
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Simulated semi-aerobic landfill equipment and anaerobic landfill equipment were constructed. In-situ trace and contrast experiment based on the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>N isotope technique was developed when the landfills were stably working for 12 months. Each equipment was respectively added with 4 g standard <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>Cl tracer, and the leachate samples at the spaces and bottom of the equipments were taken, to detect ¿(NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N), ¿(TN), the abundance of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>N in leachate TN, and the abundance of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>N in leachate NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N. The dynamic variation characteristics, migration rules and degradation principles of leachate nitrogen during the semi-aerobic landfill process were researched. Results showed that, most of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>CL solution rapidly went through the upper layer of landfill to the middle layer, lower layer and underlayer for eluviation, migration and accumulation after the tracer was added; compared with point positions far from the airway, the point positions near the airway in the middle layer of the semi-aerobic treatment reached nitrogen's degradation balance and stability more rapidly, and ¿(NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N) in the lower layer was maintained at a higher level; the migration and conversion of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N in leachate were the main contributory factors to the change of total nitrogen content at the bottom area; compared with anaerobic landfill structure, semi-aerobic treatment could earlierly reach a migration balance and a stable degradation status of nitrogenous pollutant of the system.

articleTitle: Detection of Task-Conflict of Task and Role Based Access Control Model for Workflow
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the task and role based workflow access control model(TRBAC),a method of detecting the conflict between tasks is proposed in this paper. Using Description Logics (DL) to represent the TRBAC model and the reasoning mechanism provided by DL could detect the errors timely while assigning tasks in the workflow process.

articleTitle: Discovery and Management of SOA Application
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the continual development of SOA applications, it is necessary for us to discover and compose the existing Applications dynamically according to user request, and store and manage the SOA applications cluster effectively. Aimed at the questions, this paper gives an approach of discovery using knowledge ontology reasoning based semantic web, and the process of management based on grid.

articleTitle: The Postgraduate Specialty Curriculum Arrangement Analysis of Instructional Technology in America
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the research of the postgraduate specialty curriculum arrangement of instructional technology, United States has taken the leading position in the world, mainly developed postgraduate education, and made the long-term exploration and practice. So this paper detailedly surveys the postgraduate specialty curriculum arrangement of instructional technology in 14 American universities. According to the AECT94 definition of instructional technology, the paper analyzes and compares the collected data for obtaining some successful experiences. Their experiences can be used to promote the development and improvement of instructional technology in China.

articleTitle: Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity Estimation from MODIS Observations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Land surface temperature (LST) is a key variable for studying global or regional land surface processes, energy and water cycle, and thus, has important applications in various areas. LST retrieval, however, is a difficult subject and a challenge issue due to complex interactions between land surface and atmosphere. Based on the water vapor dependent (WVD) and the extended water vapor dependent (EWVD) algorithms, a new approach for separating and determining LST and land surface emissivity (LSE) using only two MODIS thermal infrared (TIR) channels is proposed. In the algorithm, both WVD and EWVD algorithms are used to get first guess estimates of LST and at-surface brightness temperature, which are used to determine LSE, first. Then, the LST is recalculated from the surface radiance combined with the estimated LSE. Compared with the MODIS LST and LSE products, the root mean square error (RMSE) of LST and LSE retrieved by our algorithm is 0.62K, and 0.008, respectively. The advantages of the proposed algorithm is discussed briefly. The preliminary results show that the new algorithm is able to provide an accurate estimation of LST and emissivity from MODIS data. And compared with the current MODIS algorithm, our algorithm is more easy to be implemented.

articleTitle: The Development Strategy of Boshan's Ceramic and Colored Glaze Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Boshan, which is known as "the land of ceramic and colored glaze", is one of the five biggest national ceramics production bases. Along with the accelerated process of economic integration, competitions in this field are more and more fiercer. Analyzing the status and existent problems, consulting the tendency of this industry both home and abroad, this paper puts forward the following strategy to promote Boshan's ceramic and colored glaze industry.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Improvement of Security Routing Protocol in Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Security decides whether Ad hoc network can be fully utilized. Since Ad hoc network isn't dependent on fixed infrastructure, its secure architecture is facing new challenges, and the security of its routing protocol is a very important issue. This paper first introduces the design of the secure routing protocol and its security weaknesses, then proposes an improved secure routing protocol and presents the simulation results for the improved protocol.

articleTitle: Study and Realization of Three Dimensional Visualization of Mine Geological Objects
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The basic framework is proposed to establish three dimensional(3d) visualization of mine geological objects, and carries through effective analysis to the key technologies of 3d mine geologic objects. Kriging method is used in drill hole data interpolation to construct the constrained delaunay triangulation net(TIN). Through linking the corresponding triangular grids of two consecutive layers to be treated into imitated triangular prism cells. These cells can be used to construct 3d geologic objects stratum. In the process of achieving improved delaunay triangle net methods. The design and main algorithms of 3d mine geological modelling are also studied.

articleTitle: Predicting Entrepreneurship from Financial Statements: Three Draft Criteria
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At the end of a three-step approach combining both quantitative and qualitative analysis, the authors of this study suggest to recur to these three criteria in order to at least partially predict the entrepreneurial posture of a company on the basis of its financial statements: turnover's growth and assets renewal of at least 33% over the past three years and a three year EBIT sum at least equal to 0. Further testing of the three criteria is finally suggested.

articleTitle: A New Watermarking and Information Hiding Technique Based on Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presented a new watermarking method for convert communication and copyright protection. For improving the transparency and robustness of watermarking or information hiding, a visual model was employed to calculate the block based just noticeable difference (JND), and the three detail sub-bands of block discrete wavelet transform (DWT) were selected for embedding objects. Firstly, a watermark sequence binarized from a text information file or image file was encoded by redundant encoding and scrambled chaotically. Then, an image block was selected each time from the carrier image, and transformed by DWT. And then according to the JND and the watermark code, the coefficients at same position of three detail sub-bands were adjusted to hide the information. Lastly, the inverse DWT was executed to get the information hidden image. The experimental results show that the hidden information is invisible, and the algorithm is robust to general image processing operations. The conclusion is that the algorithm is effective and practical.

articleTitle: Study on Mine Environmental Quality Evaluation Index System and Method: A case Study in Panxi Hongge Vanadium-Titanium Magnetite
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through investigating different types of Mining, guiding by principles of science, integrity, practicality, lead and level, this study established a scientific and practical evaluation system of the mine environment quality which can provide a theoretical basis for evaluating the quality of mine environment objectively. Using expert experience evaluation method, the subsystems of mine environment quality evaluation and their evaluation index weights were determined, and mine environment quality index calculation methods based on the grid cell were given. At the same time, in order to better express the spatial distribution situation of environmental quality, the surface simulation of mine environment quality (spatial interpolation) using grid-based unit of environmental of mine as a sample point index were given. According with the mine environmental quality index, the environment quality of mine was divided into three grades, which were poor (MEQI <40), general (40 ? MEQI ? 70), good (MEQI> 70). Based on index system and methods of the mine environment evaluation been established, taking Panxi Hongge vanadium-titanium magnetite as an example, using remote sensing and GIS technology, applying IKONOS remote sensing images and related meteorological, geological and socio-economic data, the environmental quality of the mining area were evaluated. The results showed that: The environment quality which was poor of Hongge mine were mainly distributed in the region around Panjiatian - Xiaoheijing iron ore, Maanshan iron ore and Hongge iron ore. The areas of the three grades of mine environmental quality which was good, general and poor were 28%, 58% and 14% respectively. Open pit and waste rock piled up which occupied vast land resources, the damage of vegetation, a large number of geological disasters, large-scale and more hidden danger of geological disasters Caused by mining activities was the main reason for the environmental damage of the mining area.

articleTitle: The Realization Methods of Fuzzy Sensor Linguistic Symbol Description
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the high speed development of science and technology, traditional sensors cannot meet the needs of all real world applications. Fuzzy sensors play a new role with linguistic description. How to change measurement number values into linguistic symbolic depiction and some new concepts are given in this paper. Using semantic relation, insert values and learning from expert three methods, you can realize fuzzy sensor systems.

articleTitle: Application of Adobe Audition in the Teaching of Undergraduate Signal Processing Course Group
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The application of AU (Adobe Audition) in the teaching and learning of USPCG (Undergraduate Signal Processing Course Group) is explored. To improve the teaching effects of USPCG, the courses' characteristics are analyzed, and then an innovative aspect that the Adobe Audition can be used as a teaching software tool in USPCG is proposed. According to the functions and advantages of AU, its roles in optimizing teaching and learning means, enriching teaching contents, and promoting students' all-round development are discussed in detail. The study shows that employing Adobe Audition will arouse the learning interest of the students, improve their understanding of core signal processing concepts, help them draw strong connections between the theory and practice, and make the classroom activity more harmonious.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Product Configuration Processes for Online Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Dynamic Complexities in a Host-Parasitoid System with Aggregated Parasitoid
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The effect of aggregated parasitoid on a host-parasitoid system are investigated qualitatively by computer simulation. Our numerical simulations show that the aggregation of parasitoid can stabilize the population dynamics when the density-dependent effects of host is weak, while it can also destabilize the system when the density-dependent effect of host is strong. A variety of complex population dynamics including chaotic bands with narrow or wide periodic windows, pitchfork and tangent bifurcation, period-doubling bifurcation and period-halving bifurcation, attractor crises, intermittent chaos, supertransients and multiple attractors with fractal basins of attraction are obtained.

articleTitle: Pareto Optimal Prediction for Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper addresses the optimal prediction for moving objects according to the Pareto optimal model. There are many factors need to be taken into account when predicting moving objects, e.g. current position, history trajectory, weather, and so on, and these factors are often independence. Existing techniques for moving objects prediction always use a synthesized factor, which is calculated by a score function contain many factors, as the single metric to select optimal results. Unfortunately, in many applications, these factors often can't be integrated as one score-function, and users often need select the most possible prediction result by themselves. This paper firstly defines a prediction model using the Pareto optimal model, which selects optimal results by multiple independence score-functions, and then presents the Pareto Optimal Prediction algorithm (POP algorithm) for moving objects, which selects Pareto optimal prediction results for moving objects. By this algorithm, users can select the most possible prediction result by themselves.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: From Project Experience to Enterprise Competitiveness: A Knowledge Management Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Application of Wiki to Peer Revision in English Writing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wiki is a collaborative writing tool. Applying Wiki to English writing can support peer revision effectively. Generally speaking, the Wiki-based platform of English writing set up on some official Wiki websites, which can't fulfill the needs of teaching, such as lacking adequate management support for the teaching of English writing. Our project designs and develops a Wiki-based Peer-revision Platform for College English Writing (WPPCEW) on the local JSPWiki platform, which is guided by the Process Writing Method. The main advantage of WPPCEW is to overcome drawbacks of the current Wiki-based platform of English writing. Teaching practice also demonstrates that this peer-revision platform has the problems such as the inconvenience of page-naming rules and the control of permissions.

articleTitle: Research on Moving Object Detecting and Shadow Removal
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper uses new methods to detect moving objects under different illumination environment. Improved on-line Gaussian Mixture Model combines background subtraction method is used to update the background image under gradual illumination changes environment and color gradient combines morphologic method to update the background image under sudden illumination changes environment. After analyzing the brightness and sensitivity characteristics of shadow in different colorspace such as RGB,HSV,YCbCr etc. The paper points out HSV colorspace is suitable to remove visible shadow and YCbCr colorspace is suitable to remove invisible shadow. The experiment shows that the system is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Moderating Effects of Uncertainty on the Relationship between Risk Management and Information Systems Project Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The structural contingency perspective has been widely used in IS research. Researchers suggest that managers should use proper risk management approaches to manage IS development projects according to the degree of uncertainty of the project's environment. This paper develops an integrative model to explore the moderating effects of project uncertainty on the relationship between risk management factors and project performance and carries out an empirical analysis on the research model with a Partial Least Square (PLS) modeling approach.

articleTitle: Interval-Valued Intuitionistic Fuzzy Probabilistic Set and Some of Its Important Properties
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we first present the concept of interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy probabilistic set (IvIFPS), which is determined by two defining functions that indicate the membership interval and nonmembership interval of an element to a set of objects, with respect paid to the randomness of choosing them. Moreover, some important properties, moments and correlation coefficient of interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy probabilistic sets are also be studied, which can be possibly applied to medical diagnosis, pattern recognition and artificial intelligence areas.

articleTitle: Implementation and Research of Social CRM in Mobile BOSS Based on Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of Information Technology such as Web 2.0, the internet is getting more interactive which supplying more information of individuals and social community composed of individuals for market analysis in enterprises. A new Social CRM Tool framework based on complex network analysis technologies aiming to offer better marketing and sale results for Mobile BOSS (Business Operation Support System) was proposed in this paper. And it also adapts some novel technologies such as SOA [1] technology, Mash-Up [3] and so on. The designing and implementation details also can be found in this paper to supply a vivid and real experience of Social CRM Tool basing on the original software model which has been used in some real BOSS in the province level of China to promote efficiency of CRM.

articleTitle: Co-Opetition and Knowledge Sharing in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to recognize the underlying logic of how to balance the cooperation - conflict relations to improve knowledge sharing, this paper constructs a conceptual model to examine the different relationships among cooperation, constructive and destructive conflict, their interactions and the knowledge sharing. We find that co-opetition management is in indeed an important relational capability for superior knowledge sharing, that the interaction of cooperation and constructive conflict works positively while the interaction of cooperation and destructive conflict works negatively towards knowledge sharing.

articleTitle: Load Testing for Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The performance testing criteria was analyzed, including response time, concurrency users, throughout and performance counter. Performance testing is necessary for the system reliability. Load testing can be used for software troubleshooting and optimizing. With the LoadRunner and TestDirector testing tools, a load testing scheme based on an online examination system was designed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Screen Wall Splicing System Based on Computer Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A screen wall is a widely used application in reality and has been implemented in various methods. Traditional implementation methods always adopt dedicated devices according to specific hardware, which leads to poor portability and limited function. Compared with traditional methods, computer technology conduces to powerful image processing function. Additionally, clearer picture transmission could be achieved owing to computer network's high quality of transmission and strong resistance to interference. This thesis discusses the key techniques on computer implementation of a screen wall. It deals with comparison transmission of screen image and synchronization control of multi-displays.

articleTitle: A Scheme of Multipath Gateway Discovery and Selection for MANET Using Multi-Metric
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When the mobile ad hoc network (MANET) is connected to the Internet, it is important for the mobile nodes to detect available Internet gateway (IGW) providing access to the Internet. We propose a new approach of IGW discovery and selection for MANET to connect with Internet. In the scheme, the multi-path is used to find all paths to IGW by source node in MANET, and multi-metric is used to select the optimum path to IGW. The result of evaluation shows that performance of the new approach is better than others'.

articleTitle: Research of Flame Image Recognition Algorithm Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The key problem of fire detection is the recognition and classification for fire flame and interference. Support vector machine (SVM) is a potential data classification tool developed from statistical theory. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional fire detection, An image fire detection algorithm based on support vector machine is presented. The algorithm overcomes the disadvantages of neural network such as over learning, trapping in local minimum easily etc., and overcomes the complexity of doing a lot of experiments and statistical analysis to obtain recognition threshold. The experiment results show that the image fire detection algorithm based on SVM has high accuracy and notable effect on solving the recognition problem of small samples and nonlinear problem.

articleTitle: An Evaluation-Management Information System of High Slope Geo-Risk for Mountainous City Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The occurrence of Geotechnical catastrophe caused by high slope has been a serious constraint on economic development of the mountainous city. A mountainous city high slope risk management information system based on the GIS is established by integrating the mountainous city high slope hazards risk evaluation model with graphic processing and spatial analysis function of the GIS together. The system is made up of a database module, an editing module, an analysis module, a query and display module as well as a webgis module. On the basis of collecting, storing, searching for, and managing relevant information, the system can perform the regional assessment and vulnerability assessment of geotechnical high slope risk.

articleTitle: Research on Infrared Breath Alcohol Test Based on Differential Absorption
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An infrared alcohol testing system based on differential absorption is presented. The technique relies on the fact that the breath alcohol gas has a unique, well-defined absorption characteristic within the infrared region of electromagnetic spectrum. It is used to detect the present and concentration of alcohol gas. The non-dispersive infrared gas detection principle is introduced in detail. Experiments show that the testing system has high precision, good environment adaptability, and its indication error and repeatability reach the China National Standards.

articleTitle: An Energy-Efficient Physical Layer Adaptive Modulation Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks pose numerous design challenges. They require long term, robust sensing for many applications. One important challenge is to design sensor networks that have long system lifetimes. Since the radio has the greatest impact on the energy consumption of the WSNs node, we present a physical layer adaptive channel coding and modulation scheme to lower the number of retransmission of package, then decrease the number of retransmission data because of error. So the energy consumption of the WSNs node can be saved and lifetime of the network is been extended. Experiment results show that the total amount of bits that are sent can be reduced by employing this scheme.

articleTitle: Content Encounter Probability Based Message Forwarding in Opportunistic Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Opportunistic Network is a special kind of mobile Ad Hoc network in which communication nodes are sparsely distributed in the network area and the communicating opportunities between the nodes are created by the moving and encounter of the nodes. Achieving reliable data transmission in Opportunistic Networks is a great challenging task because there is no contemporaneous path between source and destination nodes. In this paper, to achieve more efficient Pub/Sub service, a content-based routing scheme, called Content Encounter Probability based Message Forwarding in Opportunistic Network (CEPMF), is proposed. In CEPMF, predicates are used to propagate the interests of subscribers into the network, and the predicates are tagged with utilities indicating the priority of the node to relay a specific content message. Content messages are transmitted to the nodes with a predicate that matches the content message and has a high utility value. The relay node also merges predicate-utility pairs whose intersection is not empty to improve its buffer efficiency. The evaluation results show that CEPMF outperforms SW and SF scheme by 10% in delivery ratio and by 15% in buffer efficiency.

articleTitle: Research of Ranking Method in Evolution Strategy for Solving Nonlinear System of Equations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As new methods, Evolutionary algorithms (EA) have been adopted to solve these complicated nonlinear systems of equations (NSE) problems. Especially, during solving these NSE problems with evolution strategy (ES), the traditional evaluation method between two different individuals has some drawbacks because of not considering the conflict of the different equation objectives, and then it more likely sticks into local optimum on these problems with two or more conflicting equation objectives. Therefore, this paper proposes a new probability ranking method based on the individual fitness value when the comparing two individuals appear the different equation-difference conflict. The experimental results show that our modified algorithm holds the better performance of global searching and less probability of sticking into local optimum.

articleTitle: Irregular-Location Based Key Pre-Distribution Scheme for Distribution Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using sensors' deployment information in key management schemes is often proposed as a means to achieve local connectivity in large sensor networks. However, some proposed schemes are difficult when there are obstacles and holes in the network topology. We proposed an Irregular-location based Key Pre-distribution (IKP) scheme to solve the problem that boundary regions which have a fewer sensors may become isolated. Then, we addressed how to exchange messages among sensors in irregular sensor networks. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively deals with the exchange messages among sensors in the irregular region.

articleTitle: Study on Image Distortion Caused by Camera Incline in Multi-Format Aerial Digital Camera
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The study on multi-format aerial digital camera mosaic technology has important significance. Which can cause aerial imagery acquisition achieve digital production with high efficiency and speediness. The image distortion caused by camera incline was studied particularly in the process of multi-lens aerial digital camera exterior marriage in this paper. The formulas on the Ground Sampled Distance(GSD) change ratio of any pixel caused by camera incline in two-mosaic, four-mosaic and aerial camera were deduced and calculated. Finally the conclusion how to design the obliquity of single camera in multi-lens aerial digital camera was gotten.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Based on Bidding
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In a multi-agent environment, if multiple agents learn simultaneity, the feedbacks of the environment would be confusing, even be conflicting. This paper presents an approach for developing multi-agent reinforcement learning systems in which all agents learn alternately. In each learning cycle, only the active agent executes the action calculated by the reinforcement learning algorithm and is in the state of learning phase. All the other agents take actions acquired previously and are in the state of non-learning phase. After the active agent finishes the learning phase, another agent is chosen to learn by bidding. The proposed method has been implemented in soccer game and the high efficiency of the proposed scheme was verified by the result of computer simulation.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Endocrine PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel endocrine particle swarm optimization algorithm (EPSO) base on the idea of general PSO algorithm and endocrine is proposed in the paper. In the method, particles are grouped by stimulation hormones (SH) of endocrine system, and the best positions of classes are used to update the positions of particles which controlled by them. The new positions of particles are not only determined by the best position which it achieved so far and the global best position in current generation, but also influenced by the best position of class which is belonged to the global information and local information are combined completely. The simulation experiments with three typical multi-objective functions are used to indicate the effectiveness of the method with compared to MOPSO-DC.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on College Students' Debugging Abilities in Computer Programming
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: College students' debugging abilities plays a major role in their computer programming. Some researchers report that debugging work represents about 25-50% of the cost of a large software project, and an even greater proportion of an individual programmer's task. This paper studied the college students' debugging abilities in computer programming by designing an experiment, providing experimental materials, designing an experimental procedure, collecting experimental data, and analyzing these data. The aim of this study is mainly to make clear college students' debugging knowledge, debugging progress, debugging skills, and debugging strategies by analyzing their debugging protocol data and therefore offer instructors some insights into instructing college students in their debugging programs.

articleTitle: The Impact of Robot Instruction to Education Informatization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the characteristics of developing robot instruction in pre-primary education, primary education, secondary education, university education and its impact on the educational informatization, the application of "Robot Assisted Instruction" in all kinds colleges at all levels has also been discussed. Through the above explanations, we can easily realize that the interactive ability of robot based on the traditional computer is extended, more function is added and its application range is expanded.

articleTitle: Parallel Software Correlator Based on Multi-Core PC Servers and Computer Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Chinese Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) network (CVN) is a synthetic aperture radio telescope with the equivalent diameter up to 3000 Km. This telescope aims to astronomy observations and deep space explorations. The correlator is the kernel data processor, and its operation is both data intensive and computation intensive. This paper presents the structures of two CVN software correlators and their applications. One software correlator based on the multi-core PC server played an irreplaceable role in CE-1, the just finished Chinese lunar exploration mission. After the scan-based modification, this correlator got the first CVN pulsar image. The research of another powerful high speed software correlator based on the cutting-edge computer cluster was carried out to fulfill the CVN astronomical and geodetic applications in the near future. As the first Chinese Gigabit VLBI correlator, the prototype high speed software correlator demonstrated its ability in the first CVN 256Mbps e-VLBI experiment.

articleTitle: A Method of Fast Laser Scanner Simulation in ALV
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the use of robot and ALV simulation system, we propose a new method of Fast Laser Scanner. Simulation based on hardware acceleration. This method is fast and with high accuracy. When utilize the new features of new hardware, could it greatly reduced the overload of rendering, which enables it to be used in real-time simulation systems, cut down the experiment costs. In the end, full experiments are given; data details and comparison are presented.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of PAPR in MC-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper analyzes the peak to average power ratio (PAPR) of Multi-carrier code-division multiple access (MC-CDMA) system and gives a mathematic expression on complementary cumulative distribution function (CCDF) of PAPR based on the correlation functions of the spreading sequences. It is shown that the PAPR varies as the changing of correlation functions of the sequences. PAPR property is studied based on several orthogonal sets of sequences: Walsh, Golay complementary and Bridge sequences.

articleTitle: The Application of Digital Image Processing Technology in the Quantitative Study of the Coarse Aggregate Shape Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The angularity of coarse aggregate is a key characteristic. The high-temperature stability, low temperature anti-cracking performance and moisture susceptibility of asphalt mixture are influenced greatly when coarse aggregates are used in the asphalt pavement. Three indexes were used for quantizing the angularity of coarse aggregate. They are FI (Form Index), Angularity GM (Gradient Method) and Angularity RM (Radius Method). These three indexes can be obtained through computing the coordinates of the edge-points of the coarse aggregates. The coordinates can be obtained through image processing. The whole process is divided into the following steps: image preprocessing, image segmentation, morphological image processing and contour tracing. Automatic processing of data by computer greatly reduces the workload, and provides the convenience for calculation and storage of data. The information collection of the angularity of coarse aggregate is simplified.

articleTitle: Optimizing Network Virtualization in Kernel-Based Virtual Machine
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper introduce the improvement of the Kernel-based Virtual Machine's (KVM) network I/O performance resulting from the re-design and the re-implementation of certain aspects of its network virtualization and better support for network intensive application, especially in multiple virtual machine sharing the host's network packets. We research two techniques. First, we define the new virtual network interface architecture, and then demonstrate that the use of such a virtual network interface architecture leads to much better transmitting and receiving performance, particularly in multiple virtual machine sharing the same packets from the host. Second, we optimize the memory operation in which implementation of the network I/O in transmitting and receiving operation. We use fixed memory map technology instead of copying the data in the context switch. We show that, with these optimizations, transmitting and receiving network I/O performance in KVM is obviously improved.

articleTitle: Event Driving Based Alarm Correlation Approach by Using Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to practical requirement, this paper puts forward an alarm event correlation approach basing on event driving, which considers the temporal relationship between events, and establishes several Petri net models. The experiment results show that, the approach basing on event driving to select time window can implement the alarm event correlation correctively and effectively for complex network. So the accuracy and efficiency of alarm is improved.

articleTitle: Study on Investment Optimization for Power Grid Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The issue of grid companies on how to appropriately allocate the limited funds among different grid construction projects in market environment is discussed. Based on the research on investment optimization for grid construction projects with the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) based design concept, the index system for evaluating grid investment projects was constructed. Based on the AHP, the comprehensive evaluation model for grid construction project investment was also built. Based on the theory of modern investment portfolio, the optimal model of grid projects on investment portfolio is built. The correctness of model is improved by a numerical case.

articleTitle: Colon Straightening Based on a Gravity Field Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we present a colon straightening method based on a gravity field model. The colon is considered as an isotropic elastic solid geometry. Nonlinear finite element method is adopted to simulate the colon deformation process under the gravity in the natural world. Thin-plate spline based kernel transform is used to interpolate among the nodes of the finite elements. Experiments with both simulation models and a CT dataset are designed. The results show the proposed method is more effective compared with other existing straightening methods in the regions of the colon with high curvature or asymmetrical structure.

articleTitle: Study on the Differential Pressure Characteristics of Swirlmeter for Wet Gas Flow
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The differential pressure characteristics of swirlmeter for the wet gas flow is studied experimentally in the paper. After studying of the relationship between the over-reading and Lockhart-Martinelli parameter X, gas Froude Number Frg, the gas to liquid density ratio DR, a differential pressure correlation of swirlmeter for wet gas metering is put forward for the first time. The results of experiment have proved that the correlation fitted the data set to an uncertainty of ±5% at a 96.4% confidence level, with the conditions of pressure from 0.25 MPa to 0.35 MPa, X from 0.02 to 0.8, and Frg from 0.3 to 0.85.

articleTitle: Project Process Sequencing Based on Dependency Structure Matrix (DSM)
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper points out that the selection of the optimization objective function for Dependency Structure Matrix (DSM) sequencing optimization should not only consider the number and distance of the feedbacks, but also should take into consideration activity's rework probabilities, costs and time. Furthermore, this paper proposes the activity's ratio of cost to time and Rework Factor matrix as the optimization parameters, and proposes Total Coordination Cost (TCC) as the optimization objective function. An improved Genetic Algorithms (GAs) is used to help optimize the project. The simulation result indicates that the feedbacks and the total project costs can be significantly reduced using TCC as optimization objective function comparing to traditional optimization methods.

articleTitle: A Study on E-Government Success Framework Based on IS Success Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: E-government now includes a significant service component. However, commonly used measures of IS effectiveness focus on the technology, rather than the services. Thus, there is the danger of misunderstanding E-government effectiveness if it does not include service quality. So in this study, we argued for E-government success with the IS success model in order to identify and understand key factors affecting E-government success.

articleTitle: Analysis of Enterprises to Participate in the Farmland Development and Arrangement Based on Game Theory - A Case-Study on Lupotan, Shaanxi Province, P. R. China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It's of great innovation for enterprises to participate in the farmland development and arrangement under the circumstances of the shortage of farmland resources. This paper analyzes the theoretical basis of enterprises' behavior based on game theory, establishes a cooperative game model and static games of complete information, such as dominant strategy equilibrium between enterprises, iterated dominance equilibrium between enterprises and farmers, according to the relations among the main game subjects, i.e. local government, enterprises and farmers, and analyzes an instance in Lupotan, Shaanxi, based on which strategies for the enterprises are proposed.

articleTitle: QoS Issues in IEEE 802.16 Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The IEEE 802.16 mesh network is a promising next generation wireless backbone network. One fundamental issue in IEEE 802.16 mesh networks is QoS provisioning. Although IEEE 802.16 standard has made certain efforts to address this issue, many technical problems still exist in this field. In this article, we present a detailed investigation of QoS issues in IEEE 802.16 mesh networks in order to provide a better understanding of the research challenges of QoS provisioning under Mesh mode. We also try to provide a rudimentary overview of several key proposals in the relevant literature.
