A number of methods have been proposed for generating trees, But these methods could not accurately simulate the appearance changes in the growth process of trees. The paper presents an interactively parameterized modeling method based on the morphological characters of Chinese fir and the results testify our method can simulate Chinese fir well.

articleTitle: On Some Legal Problems of Third-Party Electronic Commerce Platforms in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of practical dilemma of the third-party electronic commerce system in China, this paper points out strengthening the policies and regulations' supervision is the key to continuously enhance its influence. The paper is divided into three parts. Part I describes the social and economic position of China's third-party platform. Part II establishes legal principles of supervising and managing it. Part III considers related legal problems, such as liability rules for errors in e-commerce, the intermediary system of e-commerce, special rules of e-contract. Recommendations of improving its supervision and management mechanism are provided.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research into Dynamic Student Module and Intelligent Tutoring System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Exploring Credit Card Adoption and Usage Model of College Student: An Analysis Based on TAM Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study investigates adoption/use behavior within the context of college students. A research framework based on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) is developed to identify factors that would influence the adoption and continue use of the credit card. Besides the "perceived usefulness" and "perceived ease of use", this paper introduces the "perceived risk", "promotion", "trust in electronic channel", "computer self-efficacy", "subject norm", "structural assurance" as new factors. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is employed to examine the entire pattern of inter-correlations among the factors, and to test related propositions empirically. A survey including a total of 343 college students is conducted and confirmatory factor analysis used to determine the measurement efficacies. The results reveal that perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, promotion and perceived risk play direct and significant role in influencing the intention of adopt the credit card while computer self-efficacy and subject norm play indirect role. Perceived ease of use has a significant indirect effect on intention to adopt/use through perceived usefulness, while its direct effect is less significant.

articleTitle: Can Information Asymmetry Hypothesis Properly Explain Announcement Effects of Seasoned Equity Issues in China?
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study aims to examine whether information asymmetry hypothesis can properly explain announcement effects of seasoned equity issues in China. We use the market adjusted model to measure announcement effects in event studies and use six variables (SIZE, AGE, VOL, B/M, VAR, and EARN) as proxies for information asymmetry in multiple regression analyses. The results show that cumulative abnormal returns around the announcement day are significantly positive for private placements but insignificant for public offerings. The results also show that the coefficients of all variables as proxies for information asymmetry are insignificant in regression analyses. The evidence indicates that information asymmetry hypothesis cannot properly explain the announcement effects of new equity issues in China.

articleTitle: A Robust ICA-Based Digital Image Watermarking Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel digital image watermarking scheme is proposed in this paper, which embeds a digital watermark into the DCT coefficients of the host image based on human visual system (HVS), and the locations of embedding watermark are saved as key. The proposed algorithm is able to extract the watermark without requiring the original image only through utilizing independent component analysis (ICA) and the preserved key. The experimental results show that the proposed method is robust against many attacks, such as JPEG compression, noise, rotation and cropping etc.

articleTitle: Monitoring Land Use of Construction Based on WebGIS with RIA Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RIA bears not only similar functions and features like traditional desktop applications, but also some irreplaceable advantages in UI performance, interactive capability, and network transmission. Compared with presently prevailing Browser/Server framework characterized by "Thin Client", RIA technology can make full use of and balance the computing ability of client and server, and then enhances interoperability and performance of software system. XML, acting as one kind of extensive open language and common data exchange format, plays a very important role in the field of web applications. This paper firstly gives a brief introduction to RIA and one of its specific applications: OpenLayers, and to a famous web map server: ArcIMS and its specific data exchange protocol: ArcXML. It can be found OpenLayers has much better interoperability, flexibility and higher performance than the intrinsic client of ArcIMS. Then one solution is proposed to construct the information system for monitoring the status of land use. Within proposed solution, OpenLayers, as replacer to the intrinsic client of ArcIMS, is extended to implement some special functions. The business model of the system and how the technology mentioned above is used for the model is introduced in details.

articleTitle: Research of Refractive Correction Forecasting Software Technology Based on WEB Database
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: DTK (Diode Thermal Keratoplasty) technology is a new type of laser refractive technology. This thesis adopts web-based database for the multi-layer architecture mode, ADO.NET technology for the realization of data access, and B/S (Browser /Server) mode for the resolution of network method to accumulate large samples data and improve forecast accuracy of refractive laser correction. The thesis also develops refractive correction prediction software based on Web database to fulfill the publishing, updating of and access to information through web so that a more flexible device management tool can adapt to the information age, and it gives the achievement results, including data management interface, the results of data analysis and so on. Refractive correction prediction software based on Web database has realized data accumulation of laser refractive and improvement of prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: The Wireless Multi-Protocol RFID Reader Based on the Modularity
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently, there are variety of international RFID protocols, and various corresponding RFID electronic tags. So, users have a strong requirement of supporting multi-protocol RFID reader. Because of the diversity of the application environment, users have to identify the moving items and transmit the results to remote servers. This paper focuses on the research and design of the wireless multi-protocol RFID reader based on the modularity, which integrate some wireless communication module, and use the fault-tolerant processing to improve the reliability of recognition.

articleTitle: The Statistical Analysis of Internal Factors that Impact on the Quality of Financial Reporting - Based on a Survey of Different Types of Chinese Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: China is the emerging market economy, ownership of property gradual transformation from all countries into encourage private property. As the economic consequences of accounting information. In the enterprise internal financial reporting participants will be affected the quality of financial reporting in different ways. In this paper, the results of the survey reflects financial reporting participant by different motives and in different ways for the quality of financial reporting in different types, size, scope of business of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Corporate Governance and Innovative Performance: Evidence from US publicly Traded Manufacturing Firms
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study investigates the relationship between corporate governance and corporate innovation performance. For this purpose, we using COMPUSTAT, patents data and corporate governance quality data to test our hypothesis. We uncover a positive relationship between corporate governance quality, GQ index which is a measure for shareholder right, and innovation outcome, as well governed firm have higher innovation productivity. We conclude that corporate governance quality is an important determinant of innovation performance.

articleTitle: Visual Teaching of Numerical Analysis Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Numerical analysis is a useful course which can solve various practical problems in engineering and research with the combination of mathematics and computer. In this paper, a demonstrating system of numerical analysis for visual teaching is designed and implemented based on MATLAB. The structure of the system and the specific algorithms are given, including interpolation method, numerical integration method, curve fitting method, finding roots of nonlinear equation, solving linear system of equations and solving initial value problem of ordinary differential equation. Visual teaching gives students intuitive descriptions through images or other forms, which helps students easily to understand mathematical principle and stimulates students' learning activity. It has been proved in the recent years teaching application of numerical analysis in BUCEA that such an innovated methodology reduced the difficulty of teaching and understanding.

articleTitle: Income Inequality, Demand-Induced Innovation and Technological Progress
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Much of the existing literature on the relationship between technological progress and inequality primarily deals with the effects of technological change on inequality within an economy, relatively fewer studies examine the reverse relationship of the effects of inequality on innovation or even on technological progress. Based on the related literature, we analyze the possible indirect effecting mechanism of inequality on technological progress, and then we test it empirically by using system generalized method of moments (GMM) with Chinese industrial panel data from 1999 to 2007. The result shows that income inequality can indirectly affect technological progress: income inequality is not conductive to the increasing of R&D input, impeding the technological progress; it is neither conductive to the entry of foreign technology, restraining the technological progress of capital industry.

articleTitle: Shareholder-Manager Disagreement and Corporate Investment: Evidence from China Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article theoretically analyses how shareholder-manager disagreement affects corporate investment, and firstly tests this theory using panel data of China listed companies. The results confirm the negative effect of shareholder-manager disagreement on real investment in China stock market, and originally prove that disagreement theory may act as one possible explanation for investment sensitivity to stock price.

articleTitle: The Introduction of Deficiencies and Reforming Measures of Teaching Model for Undergraduate Computing Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The informational process of our country is being improved by immense amounts of computer professionals at all levels. Meanwhile, the deficiencies exist in teaching model for undergraduate computing education, so the current model must be innovated to be more helpful to the training of personnel. It is the goal of our endeavor that computer teaching model meets the demands of the professional development.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Corn Nitrogen Nutrition Using Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The hyperspectral reflectance for corn canopies were acquired in primary growth stages in order to monitor corn growth status and diagnose nitrogen. The results showed that the leaf nitrogen accumulation, vegetation indexes, area of red edge remarkably changed with growth stage. The leaf nitrogen accumulation almost increased from seedling stage to silking stage, and then decreased from trumpet stage to milky maturity stage. And vegetation indexes and area of red edge of corn canopy almost increased from seedling stage to trumpet stage, and then decreased from trumpet stage to milky maturity stage. The correlation analysis indicated that the spectral parameters highly correlated with leaf nitrogen accumulation at seeding stage, silking stage and whole growth stage. The correlation relationship of the whole growth cycle was stronger than that of any single growth stage. From a single stage point of view, the seeding stage was the best growth period to monitoring the leaf nitrogen accumulation. The regression analysis displayed that the all regression models between spectral parameters and leaf nitrogen accumulation were all significant at whole growth stage. The research demonstrated that it is a feasible method for quantificational evaluation of corn leaf nitrogen accumulation by hyperspectral remote sensing.

articleTitle: An improved award-penalty mechanism based on the principal-agent theory in build-operate-transfer projects
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: BOT is the primary financing model which used in China to solve the capital needs for infrastructure construction, however, the current award-penalty mechanism couldn't satisfy the development of BOT model; several problems about the quality and management rise during the authorized period. In view of this kind of situation, the paper introduces a new parameter ¿ based on the principal-agent theory to create a new drive contract s(x) in BOT projects, thereby improving the current award-penalty mechanism, the parameter ¿ depends on how hard the enterprises work, the quality parameter of the infrastructures that detected by the authorities, the managing situation and some exogenous variables that are unpredictable and uncontrollable. The improved mechanism can supply the guidance and foundations to realize the effective and rational supervise on the agents during the infrastructure construction and operation.

articleTitle: Representation of Speaking Mouth Image for Visual Speech Synthesis System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper proposes a kind of joint feature with the geometric parameters and the color moment to represent the speaking-mouth image frames for the image-based visual speech synthesis system. The experiment results show the proposed joint feature can effectively provide the basis for classify the speaking-mouth images to distinguish the different speaking state according to the lip shape and the tooth visibility. In order to derive the geometric feature, a kind of step-by-step point feature localization is proposed here is introduced to get the feature points. Comparing the localization results by this automatic localization algorithm with that by hand, the paper proves the localization result can meet the need of geometric feature representation.

articleTitle: Research on Time-Validity and Incremental Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Association rule mining is an important research field in data mining. Current association-rule methods mainly depend on the support-confidence framework. The strategy is not quite effective in consideration of the time-sensitive factor and correlation problem between antecedent and consequent of rules. To solve this problem, a novel association rules framework has been proposed: time-validity support and time-validity match. First, we define a new match as the substitution of confidence for coping with the correlation problem between antecedence and consequence of rules. Moreover, by embedding the time-entropy factor into the new support-match framework, the time-sensitive can be solved. Finally, an example is given to prove the feasibility and superiority of the new method. On the basis of this, we propose a new incremental algorithm and the idea of performance. Experimental results and comparisons with traditional incremental method demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: A Structured Description Approach for Emergency Preparedness Based on Open XML
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the research of Emergency Preparedness (EP), knowledge representation and storage of the EP is one of the most important tasks. However, most of the existing plans are ill-structured and lacked compatibility, which makes it difficult to manage. In this paper, we proposed a formal description of their features and contents, which conforms to Open XML standards, on the basis of the analysis of EPs and the corresponding responding procedures, to realize the separation of templates, business data and the display styles, thus providing a practical way for the digitization of Emergency Preparedness.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Radar Video Compression and Network Transmission
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the characters of pulse compression radar video echo signal, propose a new radar video compression coding algorithm. Based on the new algorithm, design the network transmission system and validated it. The result shows the new algorithm has better performance, the network transmission system based on it can realize a long time record for radar video, keep the precise structure of target echo, and realize the information sharing.

articleTitle: Research on Price Structure and Price Forms of IT Project
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the characteristics of the meaning, constitution and dynamic behaviors of price for IT project, its price structure and price forms cannot be simply equated with general merchandise. Commonly, the components of IT project price vary a lot with different angles. We mainly in this paper focused from the perspectives of IT project life cycle, expenditure pattern and trading environment. On the basis, the paper made a deep study of the price forms of IT project, involving theoretical price, planned price, free price and cost price, and dwelled on government price, government guiding price and market regulation price in combination with the nature and features of various costs of IT project.

articleTitle: Independent Tasks Scheduling Algorithm Based on Dynamic Fit Degree
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: After analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of the scheduling heuristics in the literature, in order to get better load balance and schedule more tasks to its more suitable machines at the same time, a new scheduling algorithm based on Dynamic Fit Degree (DFD) was put forward. The suitability of the machine with minimum time for finishing the task was described by task's DFD schema. The proposed algorithm used DFD as the priority, and the task with biggest DFD was scheduled first in each step. The simulation results compared with other scheduling algorithms show that the proposed algorithm produces better results.

articleTitle: Design of Resource Sharing Model Based on TPM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional model of resource sharing has the problem of insecurity of resource itself, thus, it is easy to cause malicious disclosure of shared resources. According to this, in this paper, we design a hierarchical sharing model with high security based on TPM, and describe the access mechanism of the model.

articleTitle: Development of Ontology-Based Knowledge Management System for Dynamical Participation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge Management (KM) is being given more emphasis in enterprise to win the challenge, but today the KM in use has two limits: static use and closed maintenance. This paper put forward a Ontology-based and Dynamic Participate KM Framework-OKMDP. We set up the framework with the molding of information content. From three points (creating sharing understanding, open knowledge integrating, linking with attention), two levels (knowledge process and knowledge meta-process), we studied the theory and method of OKMDP development.

articleTitle: A New Scheduling Method for ELMC Based on VxWorks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of software for Electric Load Management Center (ELMC) is presented in this paper. Based on the embedded real-time operating system VxWorks, ELMC performs multiple tasks including periodic and aperiodic ones. While rate monotonic (RM) algorithm is still used to process periodic tasks, we propose a condition triggered algorithm (CTA) to schedule aperiodic tasks by using VxWorks's semaphore mechanism. The schedulability test is also presented in this paper. We improved the test conditions to meet the needs of this system. At last, several tests are held and the results proved that compared with other scheduling procedures, the hybrid scheduling scheme has greatly improved the real-time capability and shortened response time for urgent tasks.

articleTitle: A New Design of Nonblocking Permutation WDM Networks Based on Three-Stage Clos Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As optical communication becomes a promising networking choice to meet the ever-increasing demands on bandwidth, crossbar-like wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) switching network is widely used in parallel and distributed processing community. However, the hardware cost of the existing crossbar-like networks is very high. On the basis of three-stage Clos network, we propose an optimal design of strictly nonblocking permutation WDM switching networks named Permutation with Full Wavelength Conversion (PFWC) model, of which the hardware cost is reduced to O(k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/2</sup>N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/2</sup>) while the performance is kept high. Therefore, our PFWC model is much more cost-effective and thus practical in parallel and distributed systems.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Internet Service Automatic Fault-Heal System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the current situation of Internet service management, we put forward an Internet service automatic fault-heal system. Combined with autonomic computing and services probes components, we put forward organization model and autonomic computing model of the system. Simultaneously, with the use of timed automata and UPPAAL - a model checking tool for timed automatons, we modeled the system and simulated it. Then we made a detailed description and analysis of each component of this model. Finally, combined with the verifier of UPPAAL and the TCTL formula, we verified the deadlock, safety and feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Companding Technique Study for Reducing Peak-to-Average Power Ratio of OFDM Signals
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studied on companding technique for reducing peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signals, and proposed a novel convergent companding function. The function makes the instantaneous power of OFDM signals form uniform distribution, realizing large signal compressing and small signal expanding without changing the average power of original signals. It can attain the PAPR less than 3dB through quantitatively tuning up parameters. Computer simulation shows that, comparing with the existent companding technique, this proposed one has not only lower computational complexity but also less spectrum distortion and lower bit error ratio under the same system condition. It's really a practical and effective.

articleTitle: Study on Service Recovery Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study reviewed results currently available on antecedents of service recovery satisfaction, especially on the effects of perceived justice. Based on expectation-disconfirmation paradigm and justice theory, we proposed and empirically examined the model of service recovery satisfaction. The results showed that outcome justice and procedural justice are the direct antecedents of service recovery satisfaction and there are great possibilities that customers evaluate them through their respective disconfirmation with expectation and performance.

articleTitle: Influence on Enterprise Informationization Construction of the Corporate Culture
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of computer, spread supersonically and electronic media break the obstacle among men and their culture, a kind of unique world culture is taking shape. No matter that the world turns into smaller "global village ", obvious cultural difference exist on different district, different countries, which not only influences on the life of people, but also influences on the operation of enterprises. The implementation information construction progressively of enterprise of our country in recent years, but success rate is not very high, take application of ERP as an example, success rate is still less than 10%, To this reality, this subject thinks " the succeed of enterprise informationization has sizable relations with the corporate culture", and further study the corporate culture characteristic which benefit enterprise information construction.

articleTitle: Safety Mechanism Analysis in Human Capital Investment of Software Outsourcing Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Human capital investment is the start of human resources development. In that course, people pay corresponding cost, transform the original of human resource and input knowledge, so that they can form and increase the human capital constantly. Just like some other investments, software outsourcing industry need to contrast investment decisions as well as cost and profit of invest. This essay will follow this idea, anglicizing the cost and profit of human capital investment in software outsourcing industry. And in base of that, we'll make a further analysis in the problem of software outsourcing industry of human capital investment in our country.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Software Receiver Based on GPS Positioning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under the development of high technology, GPS software receiver has been more and more highly developed, thus becoming the hot issue in the GPS receiver research field. This paper demonstrates GPS software receiver using IF signal from the NewStar210A IF signal sampler as the raw data, then using Matlab as the software for signal acquisition and tracking. The navigation data, pseudo range, carrier phase information is got. Carrier Noise Ratio Method is applied to rough capture, while carrier location method is also used to get the users location. The experiment result mentions that carrier noise ratio method is used to improve the speed of acquisition and carrier location method can get a higher positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamical Mechanism and Gambling of University Knowledge Transfer
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a production factor knowledge is becoming more and more important in today economy society, and knowledge has become the key for industry and the whole economy in the future. Each knowledge form about flowing, transfer and evolution, including knowledge flowing direction, has become hot and difficult problem in the manage science area. Based on studying about knowledge transfer, this paper discusses motive power of university knowledge transfer and industry absorbing knowledge. Meanwhile, through analyzing knowledge transfer by game playing method, this paper also calculates game playing Nash equilibrium result.

articleTitle: Semantics of Knowledge Forgetting in Alternating-Time Temporal Epistemic Logic
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The forgetting has been found an important and wide application in computer science and AI, especially epistemic reasoning fields. In this paper, the notion of knowledge forgetting is proposed in Alternating-Time Temporal Epistemic Logic. The bisimulation of forgetting is established, and the related properties are showed. By the bisimulation, the semantics and properties of knowledge forgetting are proposed. Knowledge forgetting can enrich Alternating-time Temporal Epistemic Logic. Knowledge forgetting of group agents can be presented and computed in Alternating-Time Temporal Epistemic Logic, include knowledge forgetting of "everyone knows", knowledge of common knowledge and knowledge of group knowledge.

articleTitle: Study on Data Quality Control Method Based on Network Survey
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There is invalid data in the network survey data inevitably. Therefore, we need distinguish and remove these data before further analysis. In this paper, we discuss the survey data quality control approaches and propose an effective method via explicit rule extraction and data clustering. The examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the clustering method.

articleTitle: A DM-Based Approach to SEW System Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Enterprise strategic early warning (SEW) is to make prediction and early warning to the whole process of the formulation, implementation and evaluation of enterprise strategy, which fits the urgent need of the long-time survival and healthy development of enterprises. And data mining (DM) could reveal the to the enterprises if their future development would be faced up with crisis in addition to providing the decision level with chance of future development. These two aspects would be of even more profound significance as they are combined. On analyzing the necessity and possibility of applying the data mining to enterprise strategic early-warning, the indictors are established based on the balanced scorecard, under guidance of it's design principle. Furthermore, the model of enterprise strategic early-warning is built.

articleTitle: Strategic Option and Software Design for Financial Expansion for Yanzhou Coal Mining Co., Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For Yanzhou Coal Mining Co.,Ltd., on the basis of an analysis of market advantages on its products, core technologies, brand reputation and sophisticated technologies, we find that it is well suited for adopting three kinds of financial development strategy, including expansion of scale, expansion of technology, and expansion of capital operation. Accordingly, we set up the software for supporting financial expansion to predict annual financing of the future, assisting decision-making for Yanzhou Coal Mining Co.,Ltd..

articleTitle: Research on System Integration Environment Framework of E-Commerce Model in Construction Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By discussion on the project administration system of e-commerce is the concrete realization of the system for internal business mode of construction enterprise electronic commerce model, and analysis of enterprise re-engineering of system integration and EC-oriented are the two cornerstones for e-commerce model research. From the enterprise business model for point view of the entire integrated environment core, exploring integration in project administration system and other functional systems in corporation internal environment of local network, and integration in internal information system and B2B e-commerce systems in corporation external environment of Internet, the article establishes a system integration environment framework for e-business model.

articleTitle: Decoding Compressed Image with Embedded User's Information
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the internet has been a main method of image's transmission and storage, a significant problem is how to prevent illegal diffusion for some images. In this paper, we prefer an effective method of registering the decode program with the user's information by which the installation procedure produces the registering number with processed chaotic sequence or random sequences, thereby guarantee the ownership and the integrity of the image data.

articleTitle: Toward Network Advertisement Database Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the network advertisement has been developing widely, the problems, such as the fraudulent advertisements and compulsive promotions are presented, which has caused the trust of the public for advertisements to lose unceasingly and the advertisement effect to be weaken gradually. The paper proposals a scheme solving of network advertisement database management system. In the proposed NADBMS, B/S structure is adopted. The system design composes of three parts: the design of system structure, the design of system database, and the implementation of system module. The design of system structure includes: member registration module, network advertisement management module, commodity evaluation module, commodity inquiry module, statistics, and analysis survey module, background manage module and so on. The design of system database comprises data construction of the system and the design of the construction of data base. Adopting this way to manage network advertisement, the issues, such as fraudulent advertisements and compulsive promotions, are effectively resolved by commodities evaluation and active searching. This paper discusses developing trends of network advertisement.

articleTitle: A Knowledge-Based Framework for Data Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at integrating heterogeneous data sources into a logic unified data view, data integration has drawn considerable attention. This paper proposes a novel knowledge-based framework for data integration within which schema integration and content integration are two focal modules. A constructive semantic recommendation algorithm is put forward for schema integration, and a rule-based cleansing procedure is summarized for content integration. Experiments validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed algorithms and thus verify the framework is feasible and pragmatic.

articleTitle: Research on the Principal-Agent Model of Enterprise Human Resource Management Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the increasingly furious market competition, human resource has been the core resource for enterprises to gain sustained competitive strength. As a new management method, human resource management outsourcing gradually shows its necessity and essentiality. However, in the business of human resource management outsourcing, it is a combination of outsourcing enterprises and outsourcing vendors with different interest. There is a great uncertainty between their complex relationship and the environment of internal and external. In such Information asymmetry case, it is the focus of the research that how outsourcing enterprises take incentive measures to achieve the win-win target. This article, from the view of moral hazard model based on the Principal-agent theory, is attempted to discuss model solution in different situations. Finally, according to the conclusions, this article points out some reasonable and effective suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on Reverse Nearest Neighbor Queries Using Ranked Voronoi Diagram
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The reverse nearest neighbor query is a new issue in the spatial and security database theory and application. This paper answers the reverse nearest neighbor queries effectively using the properties of the Voronoi diagram and the space-dividing regions. The reverse nearest neighbors of the given query point can be acquired without computing its nearest neighbors every time by the query and dynamic updating algorithm using the ranked Voronoi diagram. Experiments on typical synthetic data sets confirm the efficiency and scalability of proposed algorithms compared with the Brute Force search and TPL approach.

articleTitle: Refinery Production Cost Control and Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cost management is very important portion of refinery production management. Production cost is a synthetic index which can reflect managerial level. How to effective control and manage production cost is a complex problem for refineries. We establish the production cost control and management system which have four functions of cost budget, cost monitor, cost check and cost analysis. The system procures favorable effect in practice.

articleTitle: Research of E-Commerce Software Quality Evaluation Using Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to overcome the subjectivity on weight allocation of the traditional evaluation methods in e-commerce software quality evaluation, based on the object classification capability of rough set theory, the paper presents a completely data-driven e-commerce software quality evaluation method using measurement methods of knowledge dependence and attribute importance in rough set theory. It overcomes the subjectivity and ambiguity of traditional evaluation methods. An example is presented to explain the evaluation process.

articleTitle: An Urban Infrastructure Common Data Model Based on Loose Coupling Topology and Rule Base
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urban infrastructure data constitutes an important part of urban geographic information. Relying on GIS technology and the urban infrastructure data, and giving consideration to the characteristics of the urban infrastructure, we can build a common data model, namely URIOCOM (Urban-Infrastructure-Oriented Common Model) to achieve accurate and efficient modeling and analysis of the urban infrastructure. The author provides an introduction to URIOCOM built according to the metadata standard for urban infrastructure and expounds on how to build a loose coupling geometrical-logical network based on the spatial distribution of logical network models and geometrical network models and their logical correlation. The author also analyzes core technologies such as the principles of establishing the Urban-Infrastructure-Oriented rule base. URIOCOM can effectively and expeditiously express municipal information, and therefore meet the needs for the sharing of urban infrastructure data, interoperation, and streamlined management of infrastructure parts.

articleTitle: Managerial System Change Mechanism in Large Scale Complex Construction Project: A Case Study of World Expo 2010 Shanghai China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Construction project contains numerous negative characteristic for managerial system implementing, but there are also substantial evidences that various system features are indeed important for project management, especially for large scale complex project. In order to achieve the managerial system more efficiently and effectively, system management is absolutely necessary. The primary purpose of this study is to show managerial system change mechanism in large scale complex construction project management for better system management. System change is an economic standpoint for elaborating system emergence, development, change, etc. So the structure of this paper would be as follows: firstly, it explores the features of managerial system for basic comprehension; Secondly, this study elaborates why and how project management system emergence, development, change in large scale construction complex project; and then, focuses on managerial process of project managerial system. The case study of project management system change of World Expo 2010 Shanghai China would be illustrated in the end.

articleTitle: Knowledge Transfer in Chinese Multinational Corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traditional studies of knowledge transfer in the multinational corporations (MNCs) based on the developed countries hold that knowledge transfer is from the parent company to subsidiaries. In fact, in the knowledge transfer of MNCs, the importance of the parent and subsidiary changes relatively with the stages of overseas investment. The paper analyzes the stages according to the process of MNCs' investment and development. Combined with the main factors influencing Chinese MNCs' knowledge acquisition, the paper proposes to enhance all-round absorpative capacities, optimize the network organizational structure and establish overseas strategic alliances or mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

articleTitle: Research on Mode of Eco-Agriculture Industrialization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Eco-agriculture industrialization is one way to solve the problems that exist in Chinese eco-agriculture practice. Effective mode of eco-agriculture industrialization adapted to local condition and resource is one approach to develop Chinese agriculture. On the basis of discussion of characters, modes and business modes of eco-agriculture industrialization, a fresh mode of eco-agriculture industrialization system is constructed in this paper.

articleTitle: Using Ajax to Build an Micropayment System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of information technology, information goods will become an important component of people's daily consumption, response to the characteristics of information goods, how to provide safe and efficient way to implement micropayment system become more and more important. Ajax is a novel technology using in rich-client web application recently, it provide a better way of information transmission between Browser and Server. In this paper, we propose an Ajax based micropayment system with interactive and exquisite user interface, and compare to traditional B/S program, it can save network traffic. The purpose of this research is to construct an simple, convenient and practical micropayment system.

articleTitle: Effects of Land Use Pattern Change on Soil Loss at Catchment Scale: A Case Study in Loess Plateau of China Based on GIS and SEDEM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Exploring the effects of land use pattern changes on soil loss is a frontier field in contemporary research in physical geography. Based on GIS and SEDEM, this paper took a catchment in Loess Platau of China as a case study, discussed the effects of land use pattern on soil loss. The results indicate only 0.08% sparse grassland changed into grassland in Majiagou watershed from 1995 to 2000, and the total river export has changed relatively. Not only the land use types but also the spatial distribution of land use type has important effects on soil erosion. The SEDEM is very sensitive to the tiny change of land use and can predict the effects of land use pattern change on soil loss well. In the further study, SEDEM can be tested for different area.

articleTitle: Improving TCP over Geostationary Satellite Links
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To integrate the space network with the ground network is the uptrend of the future communications, and geostationary satellites are very important nodes in the hybrid networks in which the reliable data transportation is critical. Based on this point, the paper designs the GEO satellite network topology that integrate the LEO network, MEO networks and GEO networks with the terrestrial networks. Because of the high bit error rate, large bandwidth delay product, asymmetric channel, and intermittent connectivity, the regular TCP, proved robust and efficient for terrestrial networks, has problems when direct using in the space/ground hybrid networks. The paper takes SNACK proposed by CCSDS SCPS-TP as the extension for TCP using in the hybrid GEO satellite networks, and compares TCP SNACK with the regular TCP, including Tahoe, Reno, Newreno, SACK and Vegas. The simulation results show that TCP SNACK has a better performance than the regular TCP in the GEO satellite networks communication.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Internalization on Geological Scientific and Technological Work in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Globalization and Internationalization are the main trends of future socioeconomic development in China. They will have a profound impact on every field of China's socioeconomic. In this paper, we treat geological scientific and technological work as the subject of research, analyzing the influences generated by Internationalization for geological scientific and technological work and building the corresponding supply and demand model. From the point of supply-push and demand-pull, we analyze separately raw material market, mining capital market and demands of geological work required by the development and changes of minerals market under the background of Internationalization.

articleTitle: The Influencing Factors of New Product Development Performance: Market Orientation, Organizational Learning and Organizational Innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on a lot of related literatures, the authors suggest a model of three factors that affect new product development performance, which include market orientation, organizational learning and organizational Innovation. The empirical result tests the relationships among them. And they all have positive influence on new product development performance. Organizational innovation also serves as a partial mediating variable between market orientation, organizational learning and new product development performance.

articleTitle: Research on Safe and Reliable Remote Data Transmission Technology Based on SMS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To realize remote data collection and transmission by using SMS, the operating principle and characteristics of SMS are researched for higher reliability and security in this article. Enhanced design is implemented for its safety and reliability based on the SMS protocol. A new remote data transmission technology is proposed, which is based on SMS with low cost, high safety and high reliability, and a data exchange protocol is designed by using the hierarchical structure. In this article, the said protocol is developed and realized by using the JAVA language. The experimental test for additional expense of delay from the above-mentioned technology and the application in remote monitoring has primarily verified the validity, safety and reliability of the technology.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategies of the Design of Educational Digital Game
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The problems of Educational digital game encountered is lack of game nature and playability since the date of its birth, so it was not fascinated by students. For all this defects, brand new concept and some optimization strategies of educational digital game are proposed in this article. For example, to strengthen its design of goal and incentive mechanism, to enhance the viscosity degree, to improve the design of its interpersonal relationship, in order to enhance its fascination to students.

articleTitle: Research on Choice of Decaying Coal Enterprises' Inter-Regional Entry Modes
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on efficient data of questionnaire, we adopt logit model to investigate decaying coal enterprises' inter-regional entry modes. Results indicate that local natural resource endowment, local government support and capital density are determinants of entry modes, while variables as local market competition and inter-regional investment enterprises' comprehensive strength affect choices of entry modes insignificantly, market size is negatively correlated with controlling degree of entry modes. Finally we suggest that market-orientation of mining right, supporting facilities construction of coal resources exploitation and financing mechanism perfection for high value-added projects and inter-regional M & A are crucial to select high-control entry modes.

articleTitle: A Grey Verhulst Forecasting Model for the Diffusion of ISO9000 Standard in Guangxi Province in China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: ISO9000 certification has become a worldwide phenomenon, spreading across all countries and regions of the world. It is an innovation in nature for the organizations to introduce and implement ISO9000 standard, and diffusion path of ISO9000 standard can be described with S type curve. In the paper, we establish a grey Verhulst forecasting model of ISO9000 certification in Guangxi by using the data of Guangxi's ISO9000 certification during 2001-2006. The results of model accuracy checking show that the grey Verhust model is excellence and can serves as a tool to forecast the diffusion trend of ISO9000 certification in Guangxi. By applying the grey Verhulst model, we find that the diffusion of Guangxi's ISO9000 certification will approach saturation point at year 2014 if no other measures are taken.

articleTitle: Design of the System for Wireless Commutation and Data Acquisition Based on DSP and Research on Key Technologies of Î¼ C/OS-II
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Design of system for wireless commutation and data acquisition and transplant method of embedded real-time operating system on DSP are mainly researched. The difficulties of transplant and multi-task acquisition and communication of synchronous signal are resolved. And after transplant, the system is scaled. The transplant and boot loader are both burned on the system board for wireless commutation and data acquisition that based on TMS320VC5416 DSP. The system runs stably and the indicators meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching of "Introduction to Computer": Within the Construction of Computer Field Course Groups
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To meet the new requirements of the reform in the teaching contents and the curriculum system, the paper analyses the meaning and significance of the construction of computer field course groups above all. According to the demand and mission of CC2005, and point out the shortage in existing teaching of "introduction to computer", then puts forward our practical operation in teaching of "introduction to computer" combined with the construction of computer field course groups.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Full-Custom Design of a 16-Bit Multiplier for 0.5um Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Uneven Cluster-Based Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a novel Uneven Cirque energy-balance Clustering Routing for sensor networks (UCCR) was proposed. UCCR import energy forecasting mechanism, according to the residual energy of node to determine when to re-cluster. Cluster head is chosen based on the residual energy and the relative position. Multi-hop data routing was formed in inter-cluster, routing to build not only consider the energy consumption of nodes send data, but also takes care of forward nodes to receive energy consumption, the distance of the data sentting directly is limited to within the threshold at the same time minimizing the number of data transfer. And at the stage of stable transmission each cluster head using dynamic routing to avoid the relay node rapid death due to excessive energy consumption. The simulations show that the new protocol proposed in this paper can effectively reduce network energy consumption, better balance the energy consumption of network nodes, significantly extending the network life cycle.

articleTitle: Research on Green Supply Chain Construction and Operation of Automobile Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: "The green" has become a global topic; countries around the world have made more and more strict environmental protection laws and regulations for the enterprises. The automobile enterprises have been urgently required to reduce the pollution to the environment and to realize the production and operation activities green finally. What's more, the implementation of green supply chain is one of the symbols of harmonious society, and therefore the study of automobile enterprises green supply chain construction and operation has theory and practical significance. This paper draws out the green supply chain construction model of automobile enterprises based on the green supply chain operation reference model (GSCOR model), then explains the specific operations of the green automotive manufacturing supply chain in the fourth part from four core components: green procuring, green manufacturing, green delivering and green recycling.

articleTitle: An Optimized Cluster Algorithm for MANET
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cluster algorithm is one of the hotspots for studying routing protocol in mobile Ad Hoc networks, which is benefit for enlarging the network topology and utilizing the capacity of channel efficiently. This thesis researches the cluster algorithm of maximum node degree and modifies the update mechanism of cluster header. When the changing of node degree is within a range, the state of header is not updated. On the one hand, it is in favor of the stable of cluster and decreasing the number of control messages, on the other hand, it is beneficial to saving the system energy and prolonging the communication time. We simulate the optimized cluster algorithm and the results show that the optimized algorithm is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Real Estate Investment and Regional Economic Growth: Evidence from Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Method and Validation of Risk Analysis for Big or Small Shield Tunneling Projects
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel method of risk analysis for the big or small shield tunneling projects was brought forward and validated. Firstly, the risk factors in big or small shield tunneling projects were systematically analyzed. Secondly, with a real big or small shield tunneling project as the example, the reliability method was brought forward to analyze the risk degree. Finally, the feasibility of this method was validated by comparing the obtained results with the progress of the project. The application of the reliability method is meaningful in reducing the risk degree of big or small shield tunneling projects by taking effective measures in advance.

articleTitle: Pattern of Employment and Job Attitudes - The Role of Employee's Locus of Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study is aimed at work attitudes of part-time employment and full-time employment of retail businesses. The result indicated that internals in part-time employment would be associated with higher job satisfaction and affective organizational commitment than full-time employment. On the contrary, externals in full-time employment would be associated with higher job satisfaction and affective organizational commitment than part-time employment.

articleTitle: A Perceptual Blurring Metric for Compressed Video
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A perceptual blurring metric, based on the variance difference between the original and compressed video sequence, is proposed. The human contrast sensitivity function is used to define different spatial frequency bands in which the variance is measured. The region of interest area is used for masking video content to further improve the accuracy of the metric. The proposed metric is evaluated on subjective blurring scores, and yields a high correlation coefficient of 0.934. Robustness of the metric is tested and revealed correlations higher than 0.78, when all video fragments were used.

articleTitle: Chinese Corporations' Choice of Charitable Acts: A Comparison of TNCs' Practice
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The rapid development of global integration further enables enterprises' market expansion and social penetration, and charitable acts increasingly become an important strategy for enterprises to expand social space. Good enterprises' image has become the core part of competitive advantages and enterprises' charitable act just can improve the enterprises' image. Based on the analysis of TNCs' practices and the description of enterprises charitable act - performance matrix, this paper suggests that China enterprises should choose charitable acts with more compatible enterprises economic performance of which are strategic charitable acts, and China enterprises are facing the choice of charitable acts by I¿/ III¿/ IV.Finally some suggestions on the choice of China enterprises' charitable acts are given.

articleTitle: A Study on Confirmation Model of Surplus Profit Sharecropping in Light of Monitoring Cost and Self-Discipline Level
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In reality, when the manager influences the production of corporations in an inestimable way, the more self-disciplined he is, the more dependent his income is on the enterprise's production and the more unlikely he is directly monitored. However, the traditional confirmation model of surplus profit sharecropping neglects monitoring strength, monitoring cost and the manager's self-discipline. On the basis of constructing and analyzing a theoretical model, the present thesis obtains ß, an incentive ratio, which includes monitoring cost implicitly, and reflects monitoring strength, is relevant to the manager's self-discipline and has some effect on explaining practical limitations of high salary incentive contract for senior executives.

articleTitle: A Novel Dynamic Binary Anti-Collision Algorithm Based on Stack for RFID System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Taking both identifying times and transmission bits into account that were not simultaneously concerned in other binary-search schemes, a new anti-collision algorithm for RFID system based on stack storage was proposed in this paper. The main idea of this algorithm is to modify the process for a reader to identify all the tags and reduce the amount of bits sent by the reader. In order to decrease identifying times, this algorithm utilizes the memory function of stack to avoid starting identifying from the root step each time. In addition, it adopts suitable protocols to further curtail necessary transmission bits. Simulation results indicate that this algorithm cannot only reduce the identifying times but also reduce the amount of transmission bits. Furthermore, it obtains a better performance with regard to times-efficiency and data-efficiency. Consequently, this algorithm can relatively shorten operative duration and spare energy needed.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Modeling and Simulation Based on ABM and SDM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Supply chain is not just a continuous or a discrete system, but a continuous-discrete combined system. Existing supply chain dynamics models cannot show the continuous-discrete combined features. In this paper, Agent-based Model and System Dynamics Model are used in AnyLogic to do modeling and simulation of supply chain, which contains factory, distributer, retailer and consumer. Bullship effect is showed in the simulation results.

articleTitle: Cost Control Analysis of Hydroelectric Engineering Based on AHM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Generally, hydroelectric projects have long construction period, and its investment scale is very big. Simultaneously, its construction technology is difficult. Under these conditions, how to balance construction cost, schedule, and quality is always a problem concerned by constructors. In construction management, the optimum goal is minimum cost with the guarantee for schedule and quality. This paper analyzes the construction process of hydroelectric projects according to its characteristics in detail. On the basis of depth research, the cost control points were determined. After developing hydroelectric projects cost control system, the paper applies Analytic Hierarchical Model (AHM) to research a construction case, making a scheduling for its cost control points to make the direction of cost management clear in the future. The final purpose is to provide an evidence for enterprise to realize the optimum cost control.

articleTitle: Research of NASH Model Parameters Determination by DEM Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method is developed in this paper to determine the parameters of the Nash runoff model. As the developing of geomorphology, Rodriguez-Iturbe et al. have developed the relationship between geomorphologic parameters and Nash runoff model parameters. In this paper digital elevation model (DEM) is introduced to derive the geomorphologic parameters, and then the Nash run off model's parameters are deduced. This method is used in the Yanduhe catchment, a tributary of Changjiang watershed. The result show that the calculated runoff is modeled well of the measured runoff. So there is a conclusion that this method can be used in the ungauged basins in NASH model.

articleTitle: The Simulation Design of the Ozonizer Base on Proteus
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to control vegetable diseases and insect pests in the vegetable base, the ozonizer of SCM controlled is designed in this paper. The paper provides the system architecture of ozonizer and the IGBT inverter power supply. It also introduces the simulation design of control system by proteus, and gives the kind of problems and solutions occurred by ozonizer installation. The production of ozonizer is 7g / h, the control range of timing time that is from 0 to 99 minutes, and the error that is less than 2 seconds. The practice shows that germicidal efficacy is better when controlling around 20 minutes. The ozonizer has the characteristics of convenient operation, high automation, low cost, complete sterilization and no secondary pollution. So it cannot only be used in controlling diseases and pests of greenhouse vegetables, but also used in other fields such as medical service and daily disinfection if slightly changed.

articleTitle: The Presentation for the Properties of Biorthogonal Vector-Valued Wavelet Packets with Six-Scale Dilation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the notion of biorthogonal vector-valued wavelet packets in higher dimensions is introduced. A feasible procedure for designing these vector-valued wavelet packets is presented. Their biorthogonality properties are characterized by using time-frequency analysis method, matrix theory and finite group theory. Three biorthogonality formulas are established.

articleTitle: Research on Investment Portfolio Optimization and Equilibrium Size under the Circumstance of Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The investment portfolio problem of financial asset was discussed under the circumstance of financial networks from the angle of capital markets' interconnection. The size-control and risk-control models of investment were established for individual sectors under the non-balance conditions of financial assets and liabilities. The financial instruments' equilibrium problem consisting of multiple sectors was analyzed, and the models describing the equilibrium size and the equilibrium price of system were established under the circumstance of financial networks. Furthermore, the optimal solutions for models of individual sectors and multiple sectors were obtained and the correlations among risks, profits and portfolio sizes are also obtained, given different investment utility functions.

articleTitle: The Research and Development of Restrained Iteration Deconvolution Algorithm in Three-Dimensional Microscope Image Restoration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The theory of microscope for imaging thick transparent samples and iterative restrained deconvolution algorithm are introduced in this paper. Under the microscope imaging principle of transparency, clarity of the known three-dimensional images is degenerated, and the defocusing information of the degraded images is removed with restrained iteration deconvolution algorithm. The experimental results show that defocusing the image information of the interference has been effectively removed, for clarity and signal to noise ratio has been significantly improved, and the imaging algorithm can recover the lost part of the process of frequency components to achieve super-resolution recovery. When iterations is in a large number, the recovery is better than the neighborhood and liner methods.

articleTitle: Research & Realization on Key Skills Development: Based on Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The skills are key to the future success of graduates whatever they intend to do in later life. How to develop the key skills are discussed in this paper. We have reformed teaching methods through the subject called digital signal processing by bilingual teaching. More ways of assessments have been adopted to inspire the students' interest in learning. With the proceeding of the subject, it is the process for the students learn how to learn and how to cooperate with others.

articleTitle: Development of E-Business and Networking in Rural Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article presents implications of the research and conclusions regarding the understanding of the e-business practices amongst rural small and medium-sized enterprises. It showed the need for better support of rural small and medium-sized businesses in their transition towards modern enterprises competitive in the new era of information economy. The first section of the article summarizes the potential of information and communication technologies, namely web-pages on the internet, for the building of socio-economic networks and for the creation and development of trust. The second section discusses the applicability of the model, recommendation for the successful development of the potential of ICTs for rural SMEs, and suggestions for further studies.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Relevance between Synergistic Innovation and Innovation Resources and Ability of Auto Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the necessity of innovation resources and ability to auto enterprises' synergistic innovation, expounds their dialectical relationship and establishes corresponding structural equation model on the basis of some assumptions, and then obtains the following conclusions: (1) innovation resources are positively correlated to the synergistic innovation level which is caused by such features as capital transformation, value creation, level enhancement and catalytic reaction of the former; (2) innovation ability is positively correlated to the synergistic innovation level which is caused by such features as university, adaptable adjustment, shaping and lifting, diffusion transfer; (3) compared with innovation ability, innovation resources are more able to influence the innovation level, as innovation resources are obviously more transferrable and productive when both are product elements of synergistic innovation.

articleTitle: A M-RSVP Resource Scheduling Mechanism in PPVOD System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With streaming media services are widely used on Internet, the users of video on demand (VOD) increased rapidly, so there are more demands on quality of service (QoS) of streaming media data transmission. To guarantee the quality of real-time transmission for streaming media data, M-RSVP has been designed on the application layer of OSI model by RSVP principle, which is a resource scheduling mechanism suitable to self-developed PPVOD system on P2P network. M-RSVP has defined the resources and messages, the working principle of M-RSVP resource scheduling has been designed in PPVOD system, and implemented it in PPVOD system. Through experiments and analysis, and compared with the former system, the performance of PPVOD system was improved, so current PPVOD system was optimized.

articleTitle: Research on Reporting and Collecting Information System of Discarded Resources Based on TAPI
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Though the number of our country's discarded resources has been increasing year by year, the information channel and reclaiming system of these discarded resources have not built up perfectly. So it has resulted in a great deal of waste and has polluted the environment around us. This paper looks back the approaches of collecting discarded resources abroad and analyzes the present situation of our country's collecting and recycling discarded resources. Then, it presents an information-collecting scheme of discarded resources through PSTN and TAPI.

articleTitle: Media Analysis of Hand-Held Learning Devices
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication technology, Internet technology and multimedia technology, information explosion of the community request for lifelong learning, people began to look for the new learning pattern that is different from the traditional model. Taking mobile technology into education has gradually become hot in recent years, mobile learning has become a new hot spot of technology research. In 1994, Carnegie Mellon University carry out the Wireless Andrew project successfully will be the introduction of handheld devices be applied in the education, the study of hand-held equipment for the field of mobile learning research become a new field. Hand-held learning devices as a media of mobile learning, which has became the hot products in the Electronic market, From the perspective of the media, we analysis and discuss the Media characteristics the Media characteristics, the impacts of traditional media and the development in the future about the Hand-held learning devices.

articleTitle: Characterization of Stabilizing Switching Sequences in Switched Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we present a strategy to design stabilizing switching sequence for switched system in which no subsystem is stable. By developing the conic switching law, a more general method is obtained to design the switching law. The conditions under which the switching law can make the system asymptotically stable are given. The presented method and results are illustrated by examples.

articleTitle: A Study of the Performance of Hybrid DS/FH Spread Spectrum Systems under UAV Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) fading channel is simulated on the basis of an analysis of the channel characteristics. A hybrid DS/FH spread spectrum communication system model is constructed, the system performance under the channel which presence both AWGN and partial-band interference is studied. Bit error rate performance is determined in the presence of both AWGN and various types of interference, and performance is compared to that of noncoherent FSK systems, and an improvement is achievable with hybrid spread spectrum system.

articleTitle: A Low-Energy Set-Associative I-Cache Design with Last Accessed Way Based Replacement and Predicting Access Policy
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Predicting access is known as an approach to reduce the set-associative I-cache's energy consumption. This paper proposes a LAW (Last Accessed Way) based low-energy I-cache, taking both the replacement and predicting access policy into account. By replacing and accessing instructions speculatively following the last accessed way, the PHR (predict-hit-rate) is significantly improved. Simulator results show that compared with the conventional LRU (Least Recently Used) replacement based set-associative I-cache, such a 16 KB, 4-way and 32B-line-size I-cache can reduce about 47%~57% energy consumption, with only 2.63% performance overhead. In contrast with the way-prediction cache, the proposed I-cache could improve nearly 5.32% performance overhead and 5.95% energy consumption at little cost of hardware.

articleTitle: A Modeling Approach of Mobile Ad Hoc Networks Survivability Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Survivability has become a focal point of research. Simulation is a common method for experimental verification to identify the advantages and deficiencies of survivability models and architectures. This paper proposes a modeling approach of mobile ad hoc network survivability model which support the automatic transformation to a simulation instance. A new survivability model MARC based on the idea of ARC model is conducted. Within this model, the concepts of network services and events are analyzed and formally descript in details. Base on these works, we design MARCDL and outline the important EBNF in this paper. Use of this language is illustrated by a case study.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Patterns and Variation of Precipitation in the Yangtze River Basin Using TRMM/PR Data
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An empirical orthogonal function (EOF) analysis of monthly TRMM/PR (precipitation radar) data set during 1998-2008 was used to examine dominant patterns of precipitation variability in the Yangtze River Basin attempting to explain variation revealed by standard deviation (Std) and coefficient of variation (CoV). The Std and CoV results have represented precipitation variation in different emphasis. The EOF analysis based on the TRMM/PR anomaly data shows that patterns of large scale precipitation variation can be well identified.
