This paper introduces an approach to establishing construction supply chain, with the general contractor as the focal company. A functional modeling tool IDEF0 is used to describe the processes of a construction project. Because it is not practical to discuss the establishment of partnership between the Client and the Contractor due to certain regulations, the supply chain established in the paper just covers the construction stage of engineering projects. When necessary the chain could be expanded easily based on the same principles. However, the chain is far from complete and further researches are needed, mainly including detailed decomposition, standardization of activities and computerization.

articleTitle: An Application of Immune Genetic Algorithm for Load Balancing in VOD Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a method to solve the question of load balancing in cluster. This method is based on immune mechanism is proposed to solve load balancing in cluster. The algorithm can implement diversity of solution effectively, by immune memory library and acceleration and restraint of antibodies thickness. The testing results, compared with weighted round robin algorithm and weighted least connections algorithm, indicate that this algorithm reduces processor average time to complete the task, and increase the number of throughput and connectivity, and improve the handling capacity of the VOD server at no additional server or improving server configuration.

articleTitle: Program of After-Class Learning in Teaching Discrete Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As one of the major classes in the computer science and technology, the most important part of studying Discrete Mathematics is self-study after class. This article provides a method of great validity for students to review after class, to finish assignments and programs, as well as a bilingual assignment for improving the students' English. Students can study with great interest and high efficiency, as well as receiving twice the result with half the effort with the help of correcting the assignments and the new form of the exercise class.

articleTitle: Incremental Web User Clustering Based on Ants' Chemical Recognition System Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces an efficient incremental clustering method based on Ants' Chemical Recognition System Algorithm (ACRSA). We apply it to Web user clustering and compare the accuracy rate of personalized recommendation with ACRSA. This paper also introduces a new cluster-dissolution mechanism into ACRSA to make the result more natural. The experimental results show that this method can achieve incremental clustering adaptively and efficiently, and give more accurate recommendations than ACRSA.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design and Research of the Geological Disaster Decision-Making Sustain Geography Information System in Tianshan Mountain
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Impact of Task on Visual Attention
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Visual attention of human visual system has significant impact on the performance of video and image processing, encoding and decoding, quality assessment, machine vision, and so on. Visual attention is classified into two types: task-driven and data-driven. The difference between these two types of visual attention is essential to develop computational model. And so far the influential factors for the visual attention with and without task haven't been well studied. In this paper, we developed a 3D correlation analysis to evaluate the difference between these two types of visual attention by using video quality assessment as a task. The result shows a strong impact of task and video content on the ROIs.

articleTitle: Analysis on Influencing Factors about the Quality of Professional Master Degree Thesis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Professional Master Degree Program is one of the important types in our country's Graduate Education. With the rise of and development of Professional Master Degree Program, its quality has begun to attract great concerns in the society. The thesis, as a major standard to measure and evaluate the quality and level of Professional Master's Degree Program, carries much weight. By a series of professional standards to analyze the quality of thesis, we can get to realize multi-dimensional factors that impact the quality of professional master's thesis, including factors on academic research climate, supervisors and post-graduates themselves. Taking all these factors into full consideration is aiming to improve the quality of professional master's thesis, thus promoting overall quality of Professional Master Degree Program.

articleTitle: A New Forward-Secure Threshold Signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the most of the existing threshold scheme, a group member can't accomplish signature independently. To this limitation, we propose a new type threshold signature scheme based on Strong-RSA assumption. The prominent trait is that it realizes signing independently and forward security at the same time. The analysis indicated that the scheme has auditability; security problems such as external attack, conspiracy attack also can be solved. Compared with the existing threshold scheme, our scheme is convenient in key distribution, dynamical in adding and deleting group members.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of System Evaluation Methods
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the classifications, foundations of the theory, principles, advantages, disadvantages, and the main application scope of common system evaluation methods including fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, grey forecasting method, technology-economy analytical method, principal component analysis, discrimination analysis, analytic hierarchy process and intelligent evaluation. Then these system evaluation methods are analyzed comparatively from several different viewpoints. Finally some problems needing attention in choosing system evaluation methods are proposed and the conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Trust Assessment Model Based on Domain Group Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In response to the issue of high complexity of trust computation and high communication load in the distributed trust model, the paper presents domain-group collaborative trust evaluation model primarily based on localized trust. It realizes the better trust evaluation result via smaller domain group.

articleTitle: A Mobility Management Based on Proxy MIPv6 and MPLS in Aeronautical Telecommunications Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Recently, Mobile IPv6 (MIPv6) has been chosen as the core of mobility management mechanism for Aeronautical environment. Considering the fact that Aircraft is travelling at high speeds and connected by a wide range of wireless networking technologies, it is a challenging task for providing seamless mobility. Proxy Mobile IPv6 (PMIPv6) is a network-based localized mobility management (NETLMM) protocol, Unlike previous host-based mobility management protocols such as Mobile IPv6 (MIPv6), fast handover for Mobile IPv6 (FMIPv6), PMIPv6 is a protocol which network supports IP mobility without participation of the MN, and it also has some salient features. We proposed in this paper, pre-Binding Update scheme for supporting seamless handover in PMIPv6.this scheme reduces handover latency by the proactive signaling. Meanwhile MPLS is now become more and more popular, and MPLS support is an important function for edge and core routers. Therefore, we introduce a MPLS-PMIPv6 tunnel technology to tunnel packets between the LMA and the MAG. it helps to add Quality of Service (QoS) to the ATN. Finally, Integrating MPLS and Proxy IP Mobility can leverage Proxy IP Mobility deployment in the Aeronautical industry.

articleTitle: Model Analysis of Talents' Abilities and Qualities for Information-Based Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In such an age of information, the talents competent for information-based entrepreneurship not only constitute the core competitiveness of newly-established enterprises, but also are of crucial importance to the success in entrepreneurship. In a bid to form a scientific and quantitative system for the selection, cultivation, use and keeping of talents for information-based entrepreneurship, this paper summarizes the abilities and qualities essential for such talents, makes a comprehensive analysis over the talents' roles in work, and eventually proposes a model concerning the talents' abilities and qualities for information-based entrepreneurship on the basis of the previous researches.

articleTitle: Face Recognition with Locally Linear Embedding on Local Binary Patterns
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, A new approach to face recognition is constructed by combining the local binary pattern (LBP) operator and locally linear embedding (LLE). LBP is an effective low-cost image descriptor to extract facial texture feature which represents the local structure of face images. LLE is an excellent non-linear data dimensionality reduction method. Its main optimization only involves a sparse eigenvalue problem and do not involves local minima. The new approach benefits from the advantages of both LBP and LLE. The proposed algorithm is experimented on ORL database. Extensive experiments are carried out to compare with other common methods such as LDA and LLE. The experiment results show that the combination of LBP+LLE provides better performance than that of those traditional algorithms and prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Satellite Cloud Image Segmentation Based on the Improved Normalized Cuts Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose a novel approach for satellite cloud image segmentation based on the improved Normalized Cuts Model. We extracted three important features from the multi-channel grayscale information and the texture features of satellite image, by the statistical analyses of the surface observation. Having set up the weight matrix by those features, we use the spectral graph theoretic framework of normalized cuts to find partitions of the satellite image, and estimate the cloud type of every partition. Experimental results on a satellite cloud image are shown.

articleTitle: Environmental Regulation and Regional Technical Innovation: Empirical Study Based on China Provincial Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Porter Hypothesis points that proper environmental regulation can promote technical innovation. In order to verify the applicability of Porter Hypothesis in China, this paper uses China provincial panel data from 1999 to 2007 to make empirical study on the relation between environmental regulation and technical innovation. The results reveal that the relation is significantly positive. When the degree of environmental regulation increases 1%, the number of invention patent and utility model patent increases 0.17% and 0.07% respectively. Based on the empirical results, this paper gives some suggestions from the angle of policy making of environmental regulation and technical innovation, increase of innovation input and acceleration of regional economic development.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Based on Good Character Breed for Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Genetic algorithm based on good character breed is presented, which imitates breeding good character seeds in biology. Genetic algorithm runs several times to build a seed set. Searching space of traveling salesman problem is rationally divided into segments based on the fine seed, for it is similar as optimum in structure. Evolution strategy combines with cut algorithm for the better resolution of large-scale TSP. The technique of open routing optimization and the technique of overlapping segments are used to solve the problem of end points of segments connection and optimization. The processes using the algorithm for eil101 and ch150 in TSPLIB give examples how to solve TSP. The results show that the genetic algorithm based on good character breed for TSP is efficient.

articleTitle: Pricing of Multi-Asset Options Using Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Generally, we price options by calculating the expected value of future cash flows, discounted with the appropriate risk-free interest rate. However, the closed-form solutions for many multi-asset options don't exist. In this paper we consider the pricing of the multi-asset options by Monte Carlo method. As a test case, we take the quanto option for example, which is a typical multi-asset option. At the same time, we use the antithetic variates technique, a variance reduction technique, to increase simulation efficiency.

articleTitle: The Method of Adaptive Noise Cancellation Based on Frequency Domain Subband Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the subband adaptive filtering has the better performance in convergence and computing efficiency, it has been widely used in many signal processing fields, but the aliasing in-band from decimated in subband impair the system performance greatly. In the paper, based on the theory of signal orthogonal decomposition, used self-contained sinusoid basis, a novel subband signal adaptive noise cancellation method DFTSD-LMS is presented, where the analysis filters implemented by DFT have discrete ideal performance. Because there has no aliasing in-band after decimation, so the performance of cancellation is increased. The simulation results indicated that the system had higher convergence speed and SNR gain comparing with full band adaptive noise cancellation system, especially when the reference signal is colored noise.

articleTitle: Genetic Local Search for Facility Location-Allocation Problem in Closed-Loop Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The complexity of closed-loop supply chain makes the operation of logistics system more dependent on logistics network, so the facility location-allocation problem in closed-loop supply chains has been the most important problem in the supply chain management with reverse logistics. The Facility location-allocation problem in designing closed-loop supply chains is analyzed in this paper at first, and then the mathematical model is formulated. In the model the logistics network is shared by forward logistics and reverse logistics, and the demanded quantities is considered as stochastic variable. The objective of the model is to optimize the total cost of the closed-loop supply chain. Because the formulated model is NP-hard, genetic local search algorithm is designed to solve the problem. The local search is used in the algorithm to improve the search effectiveness. Simulations based on numerical examples show that the proposed mathematical model and the algorithm are effective.

articleTitle: The Integration of Multi-Source Heterogeneous Data Based on Middleware
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the widespread application of GIS, an increasing number of industries involved in GIS result in the appearance of multi-source heterogeneous data source. Due to the deficiencies of common methods of multi-source heterogeneous data integration, we put forward the integration of multi-source heterogeneous data based on middleware. GIS middleware integrates multiple data source driver and provides a unified interface to client GIS software, client GIS software can seamlessly integrate multi-source heterogeneous data without care about the specific format of spatial data, so we can fast and sequentially achieve to load multi-source data. This article introduces the working principle and concrete realization of model about the middleware, the technology of middleware has been successfully applied in the MapGIS platform and achieved the integration of multi-source heterogeneous data.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain and Logistics Risk Management Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The problem of supply chain and logistics risk management by combing supply chain thinking and logistics operation thinking are studied. Firstly, it expounds the sort of supply chain and logistics risk; Secondly, it analyzes supply chain risk prevention measures; At last, supply chain risk management model and supply chain logistics operation model are established.

articleTitle: Infant Management System Based on RFID and Internet Technologies
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology has been widely accepted in hospitals to track and locate newborn babies. This paper proposes a Web-based management system based on RFID tagging system in neonatal department. The centralized database system improved infant care and safety, reduced systems and human-based errors and enabled fast sharing of medical information with the clinical staff and families. Besides the system architecture and functions are described, the technologies employed in the development are briefly introduced too.

articleTitle: An Access Control Mechanism for Geospatial Information Services
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The specifications of geospatial information services released by OGC provide a comprehensive framework for integration and sharing of distributed and heterogeneous geospatial information. Due to various security threats in distributed environment and prevalent copyright violations in practice, there is a strong demand to secure access to geospatial information provided in the form of services. The requirements for geospatial information services are fine-grained and spatially aware access control. In this paper, we propose a mechanism of using GeoXACML and SAML to realize access control for geospatial information services. The GeoXACML is responsible for declaration of geospatial authorization rules. The SAML is in charge of security assertions, secure transmission, and authentication in multiple security domains. Finally, we present the reference framework of the access control system and explain the specific procedure to control access to geospatial information services.

articleTitle: Practical Lock-Free Implementation of LL/SC Using Only Pointer-Size CAS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The significant benefit of lock (or wait)-freedom for real-time systems is that by avoiding locks the potentials for deadlock and priority inversion are avoided. The lock-free algorithms often require the use of special atomic processor instructions such as CAS (compare and swap) or LL/SC(load linked/store conditional). However, many machine architectures support either CAS or LL/SC with restricted semantics. In this paper, we present a Practical lock-free implementation of the ideal semantics of LL/SC using only pointer-size CAS. To ensure our implementation is not flawed, we used the higher-order interactive theorem prover PVS for mechanical support.

articleTitle: Translating UML Statechart Diagrams to X-Nets
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: UML statechart diagrams mainly used to describe the behaviors of objects. Until now, UML statechart diagrams has no standard formal semantics, so it is very difficult to analysis and verification UML statechart diagrams. To formally describe the semantics of UML statechart diagrams, in this paper a new type arc called delete arc was proposed. Together with the input port and inhibitor arc which have been applied in petri net, an extended Petri net model, X-Net, which can precisely describe the semantics of UML statechart diagrams was defined. At the same time, The transition rules of X-Net also were defined. Extended Hierarchical Automata (EHA) that is an abstract syntax formalizing UML statechart diagrams can facilitate the conversion from UML statechart diagrams to X-Net and a conversion procedure translating EHA to X-Net was presented.

articleTitle: Study on Express Delivery Service Provider Configuration by Applying a Synthetic Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the demanding requirement on speed and convenience, express delivery service has already become the major transmittal form for commercial documents, files, invoices, samples and etc. In China's express delivery market, China EMS, private company and international giants are the three main service providers. Due to different characters on service level, cost, infrastructure and other aspects, they dominate different segmented market. In the process of express delivery service configuration, a synthetic approach composed of Analytic Network Process (ANP) and Linear Programming (LP) is utilized. Based on the analysis of Chinese express delivery market, a set of evaluation index for express service provider is established. Applying analytic network process method, an evaluation model is built according to the established evaluation index. Furthermore, a selection and evaluation process is simulated for a freight forwarding company. Linear Programming then has been utilized to determine the exact business volume distribution among potential service providers. The result indicates ANP method is an effective way to solve management problem with interdependent relations and feedbacks. Meanwhile, Linear Programming helps determine the way to achieve the best business configuration proportion based on company's service requirement.

articleTitle: A Pre-Whiten Method for Active Sonar in Reverberation Background
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Matched filter, the optimal receiver in white noise, is not always optimum in reverberation background. A pre-whiten filter to restrain the reverberation is proposed. On the premise of Gaussian color noise model of reverberation with local stationarity, a method using all-pole partition pre-whiten filters is proposed based on autoregressive(AR) model, which is adaptive. Priori knowledge of the noise and reverberation are not required. An algorithm called reverse partition pre-whiten is also brought forward versus the order partition pre-whiten algorithm. Simulation results are presented to show that the method is effective in enhancing the echo-to-reverberation ratio, and the performance of reverse partition pre-whiten algorithm is better than the order partition pre-whiten algorithm.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of Inner Mongolia Grassland Fire Spread Simulation System Based on GIS and CA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The grassland makes a significant contribution to the economy of Inner Mongolia. However, the grassland fire, which causes a great damage to the animal husbandry and threatens the properties securities of people in the pastoral area, is becoming an important interference factor to the steady development of grassland animal husbandry. The article, which combines the CHENEY grassland fire physical spread model, CA theory, local vegetation and climate together, introduced a grassland spread CA model fits for the grassland of Inner Mongolia. Choosing the MapX and VB as the secondary development softwares, the article realizes simulating the grassland fire spread trend dynamically on the basis of GIS system.

articleTitle: Automatic Landmark Detection and Norid Registration of Intra-Subject Lung CT Images
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of lung registration, a new hybrid non-rigid approach is proposed to deform the intra-subject lung images with the assistance of the anatomical landmark information. Firstly, the two volumes, respectively for expiration and inspiration breath-hold lung, are segmented to extract the airways which have tree-like topology. Secondly, the two extracted airways are skeletonized by an efficient voxel-coding based method. Thirdly, the points with distinct topological features in the two breath-hold skeletons are picked as the landmarks and the correspondence anatomical relationship between the landmarks are described by Huffman-coding. Finally, a coarse-to-fine registration scheme, combined with landmark-based algorithm (thin-plate spline, TPS) and intensity-based (modified Demons) algorithm is proposed to warp and deform the intra-subject volumetric CT images. The experimental results show that the proposed approach is more accurate and inverse-consistent owing to the intrinsic one-to-one mapping of correspondent points and improved registration strategy.

articleTitle: An Improved Individual Evaluation and Elitism Selection for Distribution Performance of SPEA2
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By analyzing classical SPEA2 algorithm, we find that the individual fitness assignment of SPEA2 made against the preservation of evolutionary population's diversity. NSGAII and SPEA2 adopted respectively crowding distance algorithm and neighbor distance algorithm to prune the elitism population. But they are lack for giving attention to the diversity of evolutionary population and elitism population simultaneously. In order to improve the distribution performance of the multi-objective optimization, an improved method of calculating fitness value based on SPEA2 is proposed. And we design more reasonable strategy of elitism population selection. Our approach is tested on a set of benchmark test functions. The results show that pareto-optimal solution sets with more uniform distribution can be obtained.

articleTitle: Establishing Fingerprint Pollution Source Identification System of the Accidental Water Pollution Emergency Based on MapInfo
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We design and develop the Fingerprint pollution source identification system of accidental water pollution emergency. It's built on MapInfo platform, and developed by MapBasic language. By comparing the water quality test result of the accidental water pollution emergency with the "fingerprint" characteristics database, the system identifies specific sources of pollutants and provides appropriate prevention and response measures to make sure that the accidental water pollution emergency management can be taken more perfect, targeted, reasonable and scientific.

articleTitle: Space-Time Matrix Method for Joint Frequency and 2-D DOA Estimation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: High-resolution parameter estimation techniques have recently been applied to jointly estimate multiple signal parameters. In this paper, we consider the joint frequency and 2-D DOA estimation problem. We define a novel space-time matrix which includes the information of incident frequencies and 2-D DOAs. The joint frequency and 2-D DOA estimation method used the defined space-time matrix is named as space-time matrix method. Making using of the proposed method, the frequencies and incident 2-D DOAs can be estimated by the eigenvalues and corresponding eigenvectors of the defined space-time matrix, respectively. So, the presented method can automatically determined the paring of the estimated frequencies and 2-D DOA by the relationship between eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Compared with the previous work, the space-time matrix method can provide better performance with substantially reduced computational complexity. The performances of some relevant algorithms are compared via simulations, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Mass Customization Strategies in Non-physical Products Service Industries
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mass Customization (MC) has achieved remarkable success and widespread application in the manufacturing, whereas in service industry it just beginning. Great deals of studies for MC are also based on the manufacturing, in services industry there are still a lot of research gaps. In this paper, Firstly, The successful experiences of MC applications in the manufacturing are summarized; include modularization, postponement and electronic commerce platform three big essential factors. Which the postponement is very difficult to implement in services industry is the key issues in MC application. Then a "non-physical products services industry (NPPSI)" concept was put forward and defined. Inventory can be regarded as infinite in NPPSI, which can be used to solve the problem of postponement in mass customization. At last conclusions are given.

articleTitle: The Research and Design of Information Sharing of GIS Based on RESTful Web Service
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The model of Web Service and Geographic Information Services Specification of the OGC is introduced in this paper firstly; then the difference of the RPC and ROA is analyzed, the properties of the REST and the detail of the Restlet architecture are expounded. The detail of the advantages of GIS information sharing which used the REST design principles is indicated. Finally, the design process which used the REST design principles is described.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Target Queue Length FREM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fuzzy Control has been a research highlight in network congestion control field. But many existed fuzzy algorithm's parameters and fuzzy rules are static, so it have defect in respond speed, stability and environment sensitivity. As to these problems mentioned above, based on the existed FREM (Fuzzy Random Exponential Marking) algorithm, this thesis explores adaptive FREM algorithm - AFREM (adaptive fuzzy REM) algorithm, the main idea is adjust the dropping probability of FREM algorithm according to the network load. We show theory analysis and simulation test. The test shows that AFREM adapts control the packets dropping according to flow. The new algorithm shows superior performance than FREM in controlling the queue length of the router and can achieve perfect control properties in the event of network dynamic change.

articleTitle: Introduction of the Incident Wave in 2D-MRTD Scattering Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method of applying total-field/scattered-field (TF/SF) technique is proposed to introduce an incident plane wave in two-dimensional multiresolution time-domain (2D-MRTD) scattering scheme based on Daubechies' compactly supported wavelet. To verify the feasibility of this method, the scattering data of the near fields and radar cross section (RCS) of a two-dimensional conducting cylinder are presented. It is shown that the incident wave has been imported successfully to the total computational region and the results of the RCS obtained by the MRTD method agree well with the analytical Mie-series solution.

articleTitle: Cooperative Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Radio in Rayleigh Channels
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: How to improve the detection performance of cognitive radio has concerned more and more, but most studies are based on the AWGN channel. For cognitive radio will be used by people as soon as possible, the research of detection performance under the fading channel is essential. The detection performance of cognitive radio based on Rayleigh fading channel which is the most representative is studied in this paper. And the probability of detection and false alarm on the method of double threshold sensing in the Rayleigh channel also are derived. The simulation results show that the performance on the double threshold method can improve more significantly than the conventional cooperative sensing method.

articleTitle: A Survey of Flat Graphical Model in Image Understanding
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Flat Graph Model has become a very active direction in Image Understanding (IU) field, which constructs the probabilistic model of analysis object, processes parameter learning and probability inference, and obtains the final recognition result by analyzing maximum a posteriori. Image Under-standing could be regarded as labeling each pixel or patch independently. Flat graph model, latent generative model, and its applications in the task of IU are investigated in this paper. First of all, latent "topics" are discovered by using bag-of-words model in detail, and the generative model from the statistical text literature here is applied to a bag of visual words representation for each image. Subsequently, probabilistic learning and inference are processed on the topic distribution vector for each image. At last, the application and prospect of flat graph model are briefly explored.

articleTitle: A Multi-Hop Cluster Based Routing Protocol for MANET
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cluster based routing protocols have the benefit of reducing routing overload and increasing performance in the transmission delay and throughput. In this paper, on the basis of CBRP we propose a new protocol called KHCBRP (K-Hop Cluster Based Routing Protocol) which enlarges the range of electing clusterhead to K hops and introduces the concept of metric of constraint degree to restrain the clusterhead election. KHCBRP also improves the routing discovery by integrating the inter-cluster on-demand routing and the intra-cluster table-driven routing, which can solve blindly "Broadcast" problem in CBRP and reduce redundant information and routing overload in the network. The simulation result shows that KHCBRP provides better performance in the MANET network of large scale and high mobility.

articleTitle: Data Encryption by Two Keys
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This Paper presents a new data encryption conception and algorithm. In this paper, one general data encryption key is used, and one more method encryption key is used too. By two keys method (TKE), the new algorithm obtain many useful properties, it operates quickly and easy perform by hardware, it has high encryption intensity and just like the DES when one bit in the data charged the encryption code will have many bits charged, it can make digital seal and digital signature, the length of data block can be changed, the encryption way can be changed easily and it not only can be used for big organization such as government, bank ...., but also for individual. As pages limited, the paper gives part research result and then other content will be described in other papers.

articleTitle: Customer Value Analysis Based on BP Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Customer is one of the most important resources of an enterprise. Customer value analysis is the basis of customer relationship management and customer classification is an important item of customer value analysis. Aiming at the characteristics of customer in the mobile telecommunication industry, the thesis designed the BP neural network model, and presented the doable evaluating programs using matlab6.5 neural network toolbox according to the customer value evaluation system. In this way, the objectively evaluation on customer value of the mobile telecommunication industry, according to the evaluation and calculation results, can present some suggestions to improve its customer value.

articleTitle: Design of Role-Based Security Access Control Model in the Workflow
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper design a new security model based on the existing workflow security model. First the problems of existing models leads to the overall model framework and operation mechanism, as well as the implementation of model programs. Then it analyzed safety performance improvement using the new model and the existing models.

articleTitle: An Efficient Shared-Bandwidth Reservation Strategy for MPLS Fast Reroute
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: MPLS fast reroute achieves rapid restoration by computing, setting up backup LSP for potential failure point in advance and re-directing the traffic close to failure point when failure happens. In order to economize the network resource, and improve the resource utilization, in this paper we provide a shared-bandwidth reservation strategy during setting up the local backup path. This solution extends RSVP-TE signal to include object protected, and realizes path shared according to the object for different failure point. In addition, this solution allows resource sharing among backup paths of different service LSPs, with a guarantee of bandwidth protection for any single node/link failure. The result of the solution shows that the usage of backup resource is less and the resource utilization is higher.

articleTitle: A Study on Inquiry-Based Teaching Model for Deaf Students
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In ordinary schools, it is very hot to study the inquiry-based teaching model in class and after class. However, in the special education it is almost in a blank. As many studies have suggested that the deaf students in many respects are the same as the normal students. And so many successful examples on the inquiry-based teaching for normal students also can be good experiences for it to be used for deaf students. So in this article the author will first introduce the main characteristics and the basic model of the inquiry-based teaching for normal students. And then introduce the learning characteristics of the deaf students. At last, the author will combine the characteristics of deaf students to make an inquiry-based teaching model which for deaf students specially.

articleTitle: An Information-Theoretical Approach to Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this note, we present a new method that allows us to determine threshold values for separating presence and absence of proteins in a stack of fluorescence images describing a spatial distribution of proteins across a biological object (like a slice of nervous tissue, a sample of blood cells etc.). This method is based on the so-called Multi-Information Function which is closely related to the Mutual-Information Function and the Kullback-Leibler distance. We apply this method to stacks of fluorescence images and find that the resulting threshold values are almost identical with threshold values found using completely independent methods based on technological and biological aspects of the images in question.

articleTitle: Research on the 3D Modeling Method of Urban Underground Pipeline Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the digital city proposed, 3D visualization of underground pipe network, as an important part of the integrated management system of urban GIS, has now become the focus of attention of many scholars. In order to resolve the problems on the current 3D modeling method of urban underground pipeline network, we present a novel algorithm based on a 3D component library in this paper. The algorithm, introduces the concept of 3D component library, makes the 3D models of standard pipe fittings as element components and splits the complex 3D model of the underground pipeline network into several element components. The element components are classified by type and stored in the 3D component library. When construct the underground pipe network 3D models, firstly, gets the element components by the type ID of 2D entities, then through the approach that the combination of different element components, we can obtain the accurate 3D models. Comparing with the traditional 3D modeling method of urban underground pipeline network, this new algorithm is more lifelike and accurate. The system based on the method can improve the efficiency of its development and the reusability of its resource. This new algorithm also provides a common solution for a complex 3D model, which can construct the 3D model of complex urban facilities, such as overpass.

articleTitle: Research on Application of ZigBee Technology in Flammable and Explosive Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network based on ZigBee technology is a wireless network which is composed of many nodes of ZigBee RF chip, sensor and MCU, especially suitable for application of the remote monitoring system in flammable and explosive environment. This paper presents the characteristics and advantages of ZigBee technology, also discusses the system for hardware and software design. This system effectively fulfills the remote monitoring in flammable and explosive environment and posses high practical values.

articleTitle: On Reliability and Validity of the Computer Basic Knowledge Questionnaire in College Freshmen
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to teach college freshmen more conveniently, we have formulated a questionnaire to investigate the computer basic knowledge they had got in secondary schools. This paper measures and analyzes the reliability and validity of that questionnaire by the technology of education measurement. The result indicates that the questionnaire has a good internal consistency; and its distinction validity, content validity and construct validity are satisfactory. Therefore, the questionnaire is suitable for the survey about the computer basic knowledge of college freshmen in China.

articleTitle: Image Knowledge Management and Rapid Precise Image-Mining Technology Investigation in Internal Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Internal cloud computing system can be built via constructing intra-enterprise server clusters, distributed database system, and parallel computing systems. We can define original semantic tags for digital images stored in the system or uploaded by users and store these tags in a distributed way. Then the corresponding search algorithms can be designed to help system to find the needed information promptly and accurately. And it can provide a fast image browsing interface based on the order of the degree of matching and worth to let users to choose and download the images they need. Particularly, we can build the industry-oriented, more specialized picture information base that enterprises can take advantage of. In the meantime, it can provide general-purpose users and specialized users with digital-image-related service suite. The innovation parts of this research include building intra-enterprise cloud computing system, the definition of index tags of the images based on the weight factors of various semantics and images to serve the purpose of accurately search images, and distributed storage of every copy of retrieved data in multiple databases installed on different servers to facilitate fast image-mining.

articleTitle: Study on the Ontology for Entomology Identification Expert System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The reliability and acceptability of an expert system depends mainly on the quality of knowledge. An ontology defines the terms used to describe and represent an area of knowledge. In order to organize the insect knowledge more orderly and computer-usable, an ontology for insect was developed. The insect ontology is the basis for the identification of an insect from its characteristics, and for beginners to learn the basic knowledge of insect. Prote¿ge¿ 3.2 is used for ontology development of concepts and relationships.

articleTitle: Application Research of Fuzzy-Accurate Model on the Level Evaluation of Informatization in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of learning from the researches of scholars in the past, this text constructs the new index set and appraises models to evaluate the level of information in higher education; The paper choose 3 university and carry on empirical analysis according to the mathematical model, finally it draw a conclusion that the model have strong practicality.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Optimized Memory Access Scheduling Based on Rules
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Memory Wall is a bottleneck of enhancing the performance of computer system. How to reduce Memory Access Latency is a problem that we have to deal with. In order to enhance the bandwidth and reduce the latency, MAS optimization utilizes the characters of DRAM to reschedule the memory access. In this paper, we make deep research on MAS (memory access scheduling) algorithm of DDR2 Memory Access Controller, the problem of MAS is NP-complete problem. Considering particular analysis the characters of DDR2, time relations of access operation and the cost of hardware, we propose a MAS algorithm based on rule. By studying effective data bar which is generated by Genetic Algorithm, we mine four rules. So we just use these four rules to schedule in Memory Access Controller. The results of experiment show that compared with FR-FCFS (first-ready first-come first-serve) scheduling strategy, the rule based algorithm improves the performance of scheduling and is near 1.5 times faster.

articleTitle: Efficient Animation Rendering Based on Spatio-Temporal Coherence
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present a new animation rendering method based on spatio-temporal coherence; it can improve the efficiency of ray generation and reduce temporal noise in animation. Beginning with an initial set of light samples produced by Monte Carlo path tracing, then use path mutation strategies to redistribution the energy of the samples over the current frame, during the path mutation, use similar method reuse the mutated path to the neighboring frames. We use dynamic update KD-tree method in animation rendering architecture to accelerated building KD-Tree. Our results show that the rendering efficiency, particularly in scene of indirect lighting, can be notably improved by our technique.

articleTitle: An Improved IGI Available Bandwidth Probing Technique
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The conventional IGI (Initial gap increasing) method can significantly impact the cross traffic. In this paper, we propose an improved IGI method for the problem. With the reasons why the IGI method can significantly impact cross traffic, the method of finding turning point is modified. Firstly, the larger initial gap is chosen, and the gap is decreased step by step to reach the turning point. The turning point is judged based on the principle that the output gap is larger than input gap. Using ns simulations, the performance about the measurement accuracy and the impact of probe traffic on the cross traffic is respectively compared between the improved and traditional IGI method, which proved that the improved method can maintain the advantages and reduce its impact on the cross traffic.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Management of Cross-Border M&A in China Petroleum Corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: China petroleum corporations have achieved great success in cross-M&A activities, including scale, power and pace, such as the acquisition of PetroKazakhstan by China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) in 2005. However, they have also suffered setbacks and difficulties, and failed in the end, especially China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC) had to retreat from bidding for Unocal (the ninth big American petroleum company) by USD 1,400,000,000 more than the competitor due to political risk. Thus, a conclusion can be drawn through empirical study of these failure cases, that is, the main risks in cross-M&A events for China oil companies are political risk, economic risk and petroleum geological risk. Then, in order to assess and warn the risks in advance, a complete risk indicator system has been set up around the three risk factors separately. The political risk indicators consist of international relation, internal political situation and policies of the host countries; the economic risk indicators comprise price, exchange rate, financing and tax; while the geological risk indicators involve source condition, reservoir condition and others. At last, according to the concrete risks, a lot of countermeasure, aiming at risk scatter, risk transfer and risk reduction, are put forward. Risk scatter measures are 2 approaches; one is diversification investment in different oil resource region in the world. Another is diversification structure by integrating upstream and downstream including exploration, development, storage, transportation, oil refining and marketing. Some methods may transfer risk, for example, seeking for enterprises from host country and various countries as investment partner; investing foreign Private Offered Fund; arranging insurance, registering a new company abroad, and peeling sensitive asset off the merged target and so on. To reduce risk, there are also some suggestions: bank lender from more than one country and organization including host bank, win-win treaty between host country and China, employment localization, etc, which should be taken into account in cross-border M&A.

articleTitle: Identification Technology for Three-Dimensional Fluorescence Spectrum of Mineral Oil Based on Lifting Wavelet - Multi-Resolution Orthogonal Multi-Wavelet Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The fluorescence characteristic spectrums of samples obtained from the parameterization for three-dimensional fluorescence spectrum of mineral oil are diverse, and therefore, the species identification of mineral oil is difficult to be realized through simple formulas when the species identification of mineral oil is conducted by means of three-dimensional fluorescence spectrum technology. In this paper, lifting wavelet is adopted to conduct noise reduction on fluorescence spectrum signal of mineral oil extracted by spectrometer firstly, and then a hierarchical multi-resolution multi-wavelet neural network with the feature of localized learning is adopted to realize the classified recognition for fluorescence spectrum of mineral oil. The experiment shows that, the network not only maintains all the advantages of wavelet neural network, but also possesses better approximation properties than uni-wavelet neural network, which realizes the identification of mineral oil by lower frequency of training and of which the identification accuracy is up to 95%.

articleTitle: Reverse NN Search Based on MR-Tree for Polygon Dataset
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many methods for answering RNN query have been proposed, which is a problem formulated only recently. But these approaches for processing such queries have at least one of the following deficiencies: (i) the query object and data object all are points and (ii) it is very limited to further improve search efficiency, which is indexed by conventional exterior approximate index method, such as R-tree, Grid-index and so on. Therefore, we develop algorithms of RNN query processing polygon data objects indexed by MR-tree to improve the search efficiency, which is indexed by multi-approximate index method. Firstly, the MR-tree index structure and method are introduced, and the RNN query for polygon data set is defined. Secondly, the algorithm of RNN based on MR-tree is presented. Thirdly, a series of tests of the RNN algorithm based on MR-tree indicate that the algorithm is applied and outperforms that based on the conventional index. So the proposed approach can be used to answer the RNN query for polygon data set and also is useful for current spatial database system.

articleTitle: Management Information System for Dam Safety Monitoring Based on B/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aimed at the deficiency of research and development in management information system for dam safety monitoring (DSMMIS) at home and abroad, considering the developing demand of dam safety monitoring and management, DSMMIS based on B/S (Browser/Server) have been researched. Based on B/S, the system is designed and realized by adopting ASP.NET(C#) technique and SQL server 2005 database, mainly including drafting of the development goal, selection of the development environment, design of the overall structure and system function, and realization of program, etc. The system, with friendly interface, convenient utility and high reliability, has been used successfully in many dam safety monitoring projects such as BiKou, showing good operation condition, being capable of managing all kinds of dam safety monitoring information promptly, accurately and conveniently, monitoring the safe operation of the dam timely.

articleTitle: Study on Incentives on the Construction Contractor Considering the Reputation Effect
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By applying principle-agent and reputation theory, combining with the multi-task principle-agent model and agent market reputation model, construction contractor incentive model of construction project considering the reputation effect was established, and the validity of the market reputation incentive to the contractor was analyzed. We obtained: Firstly, reputation incentive can partly substitute explicit incentives; the "market reputation" of the contractor can make the contractors' opportunism behavior less and lower the client's incentive cost even without the "Game reputation" which is formed by the repetitious game between the client/project management company and the contractor. Secondly, the explicit incentives and the implicit incentives are complementary each other; when the reputation incentive is stronger, the explicit incentives can be weaker. Thirdly, the validity and maneuverability of reputation incentive depends on the establishment of construction market credit system and the just evaluation of the contractor's working ability and effort.

articleTitle: Research on the Quality Control Method of Urban Engineering Geological Database
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By studying on the existing theories and methods of database quality control, the characteristics of urban engineering geological database are analyzed, and the topological consistency of spatial data and the logical consistency of attribute data are excavated. By means of introducing the knowledge and experience of experts, the knowledge association rules based quality control method of urban engineering geological database are established. And then, the quality control of urban engineering geological database based on the knowledge association rules is proposed. Taking engineering geological database of Nanjing for example, many kinds of method are used to carry out quality control to spatial data and attribute data of urban engineering geological database. And the validity and effectiveness of this database quality control method are verified.

articleTitle: The Reliability Measure of Tree Topology Based on Surviving Edges
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A wireless sensor network is a self-organizing network which is composed of a large number of intelligent sensor nodes. The network topology is also changing with the residual energy of sensors. And the tree topology is an important and special one in sensor network. For reliability measure, it is important to find more reliable tree topology in the same class. In this paper, a new reliability measure of tree topology is proposed as the probability that the edge-induced subgraph is connected. Different from traditional all-terminal reliability, this new reliability measure focuses on residual edge connectedness and is able to distinguish the reliabilities of different trees which are in the same class. Furthermore, star S is also proved to be uniformly best tree under our proposed reliability measure in its class.

articleTitle: A Recognition Method for Wool and Cashmere Fiber Based on the Feature of the Spectral Line
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper provides a recognition method for wool and cashmere fiber based on the feature of the spectral line. In this study, the morphology of the wool and cashmere fibers are determined by optical microscope. Then from the images, a great number of fiber surface information are obtained. And through a local projection method and segmented into unit, the spectral line of the wool/cashmere fiber are extracted. The features of each spectral line, such as unit width, unit peak value and coefficient of dispersion, are extracted according to the characteristics of the surface morphology. Hence, the difference helped to identify wool from cashmere based on the analysis of the features of such spectral lines.

articleTitle: Rules and Scripts Based Dynamic Spatial Data Catalogue Technique Study and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Catalogue technology has been widely used in spatial information organization, management and retrieval; it also plays vital effect in geography information system in organizing distributed and various spatial data resources. However, recent ways to describe catalogue tree, such as xml or database tables, lead fixed structure which is difficult to change, reuse and extend when facing masses of real-time spatial data. The directory service (OpenGIS Catalogue Services) standard developed by OGC (OpenGIS Consortium) only defines the directory service interoperable interface specifications but lacks of organizations and technology to implement. Thus, it is indispensable to develop a new method to manage masses of spatial data in spatial data warehouse or spatial data center systems in a facile, flexible and real-time way. Through analyzing common methods of representing and building catalogue system, this paper presents the novel concept of dynamic spatial data catalogue (DSDC) based upon these traditional model. Firstly, DSDC builds up a highly abstracted catalogue model for general directory description. Then, combining with the requirements of GIS application system, it developed a dynamic spatial data catalogue technique and mechanism using rules and scripts to produce the dynamic effect of catalogue representation. It detailedly introduced the key approach of the implementation using XML as the define language of rule, and using python as the script language. In this way, the catalog system will meet the requirements of faster development, easier extension, heterogeneous spatial data resource integration and real time reaction in a flexible way. DSDC technology is also an approach to build or integrate with any GIS systems rapidly. This paper discusses some applications of DSDC in various appropriate occasions, illustrates the integration of DSDC with MapGIS data center platform, and gives the application of DSDC in specific GIS application development and building process. The DSDC technology has been implemented and used in managing national 1:50000 basic geographic database resource and weather spatial data of Wuhan dynamically. Experiments prove that dynamic spatial data catalogue using rules and scripts has obvious advantages and will have huge potential in GIS applications.

articleTitle: A Study into the QOS Evaluation of a Telecom CRM System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the formation of a customer-driven market, the telecommunications industry is facing increasingly intense competition. In this paper, we look at Quality of Service (QOS) for a Telecom Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, with the aim to set up a rating scale for it. In addition we used a sort experts set method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to establish an integrated evaluation model. Finally, we developed a system for evaluating the QOS of a Telecom CRM system using Dreamweaver.

articleTitle: Seismic Disaster Analyse and Evaluation System Based on OGC Standard
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, the city quakeproof and disaster reduction, urgent rescue as well as the disaster fast appraisal are important method to reduce the earthquake disaster. Therefore, establishing a real-time, all-around seismic disaster analyse and evaluation system is extremely essential. This article puts forward a seismic disaster analyse and Evaluation System which followed the OGC standard of the related service standard with GLS, GDAS, WFS-T, GML and WMS. It can promote the data sharing level to the feature class. Indicated after the experiment, the system has realized effectively the assessment in seismic disaster analyse and evaluation, and decision support to reduce disaster, emergency succor.

articleTitle: Automatic Citation Metadata Extraction Using Hidden Markov Models
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Automatic citation metadata extraction is an important aspect of digital library development. The previous methods which using hidden Markov models to extract citation metadata mostly need label many training data manually. To save the high cost of labeling training data manually, this paper describes a method for citation metadata extraction using hidden Markov models. This method use unlabeled data (plain texts which we want to extract metadata) as training data. The results of experiment show that our method has good performance in precision and recall.

articleTitle: Spatial Heterogeneity Analysis of Soil Moisture Based on Geostatistics
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper is around the monitoring of soil moisture and the scale effect of the relevant research issues in arid / semi-arid areas. First of all, the surface temperature and vegetation index are inversed quantitatively using remote sensing data, and according to the distribution of vegetation index - surface temperature feature space, the soil moisture index is extracted. Then the regional soil moisture spatial heterogeneity characteristics are analyzed by means of geostatistics. Moreover, the best spatial resolution is determined for the study of soil moisture in this area. The study adopted a more effective understanding of regional scale soil moisture conditions, with a certain degree of scientific significance and practical significance.

articleTitle: Optimized Fast Scalar Multiplication Algorithm Based on DBNS
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Scalar multiplication is important in elliptic curve cryptography, the time that consumes is significant for it's applications. In this paper, the point arithmetic improved on elliptic curve over binary field such as 3P, 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>P, then proposed an optimized DBNS chain with loose constraint of exponents to short the chain's length. Combined the new DBNS chain and more efficient point arithmetic, introduced the optimized scalar multiplication algorithm. Experiments show that the new algorithm speed up scalar multiplication.

articleTitle: An Educational Flash Game for Pre-School Children
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An educational Flash game for preschool children is presented and analyzed, focusing on its design approach, flow chart, content, practical mode, and practical effects.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Reconstruction Using Laser Scanning Data Acquired from Ancient Architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to reconstruct ancient architecture accurately and quickly, a hybrid algorithm combining improved marching cubes with deformable model is adopted in the study based on an optimized spatial grid data structure. After preprocessing such as filter, registration, merging and so on, laser scanning data for reconstructing ancient architecture has become discrete points. So an optimized spatial grid data structure is exploited firstly to build topological relationships between points. Then the improved marching cubes are used to build an initial surface model implied by laser scanning data. Finally, an accurate model is got through the coupling effect between the surface model and laser scanning data according to the theory of improved deformable model. Laser scanning data captured from Forbidden City of China is taken as examples to test the method proposed in the literature. Results show the efficiency and robustness of the method addressed in the paper to mode ancient architecture.

articleTitle: Blocking Wavelet-Histogram Image Retrieval by Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There exist numerous image retrieval systems perform a fast similarity search in the image databases, but the quality of the outcomes provided by color histogram-based image search is usually rather limited. In this paper, an innovative approach based on blocking wavelet-histogram image similarity retrieval method and particle swam optimization (PSO), which is proposed as a solution to the problem of intelligent retrieval of images in large image databases. The problem is recast to a discrete optimization one, where a suitable speed and position of particle is defined through a customized PSO. Farther on, in virtue of the new computation model, a fitness function which combines blocking wavelet transformation information and the Euclidean distance of color histogram is constructed. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is feasible and effective to the similarity search in images database.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of E-Commerce Recommendation System Based on Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Water Quality near the Dam Area of Three Gorges Reservoir Based on Bayes
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Water quality stochastic assessment based on Bayes is proposed in this paper. It is applied to assess monthly water-quality monitoring data at the typical sections in Three Gorges Reservoir from the year 2004 to 2006. The typical sections locate at Huanglingmiao, Badong, Guandukou, Xiangxi and so on. The conclusions obtained are listed as follows: (1) Water quality in the reservoir is favorable, and is between Class I and II of Environmental Quality Standard for Water Quality(GB3838-2002). (2)Water quality at any monitoring section has seasonal changes in one year but annual variation. In general, water quality in rainfall year is worse than that in dry year. (3) Nutrients are the key factor that affects the water quality, which will potentially bring on water pollution near the dam of the reservoir. So, it is important to pay more attention to take effective measures for pollution control.

articleTitle: Studies on Color Space Selection and Methods of Segmentation Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The selection of color space is one of the determinants of the image segmentation quality, the segmentation results will be more accurate if the appropriate color space is adopted. In this paper, five kinds of color space RGB, HSI, YIQ, YCbCr, Lab are compared by three types of evaluation methods. The third method of image segmentation quality evaluation is proposed in this paper. The results shows that RGB space for image segmentation is the best choice, and the evaluation results by the method of this paper is consistent with the final experimental results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Frequency-Hopping TDMA System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the design and implementation of a frequency hopping TDMA system is presented. The system is built around software defined radio concepts. The system architecture is described in detail, which is composed of three modules. High performance digital devices of DSP and FPGA realize the IF digitalization. Software implementation for frequency hopping synchronization is discussed and a method for direct sequence and frequency-hopping united acquisition is also introduced. Finally, TDMA network strategy is described. Applications in radio stations demonstrate that the frequency-hopping TDMA system is an advanced multiuser, voice and data communication system with good anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Transmit-Receive Antenna Selection for Distributed Multi-User MIMO Downlink Channels
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on accurate distributed multiple input multiple output (D-MIMO) downlink multiuser correlation channel model, a low complexity algorithm are proposed for joint transmit-receive antenna selection. By defining new metrics of uncorrelation and centrality, the sum rate performance of the proposed algorithms is comparable to the decremental algorithm with significant computational complexity reduction. The simulation results have proved our conclusion.

articleTitle: Research of Interaction between TCP and MAC Protocol in Multihop Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper first shows that TCP's congestion control mechanism based on packet-loss does not adapt well in multihop ad hoc networks. Then by modeling the MAC protocol, the interaction between the MAC protocol and TCP is pointed: the function of the MAC layer is to try its best to look for a group mutually exclusive job scheduling for the loaded traffic, whereas the function of transport layer is to adjust its traffic to ensure the existence of a feasible scheduling so that the MAC layer can find. By constructing the optimal MAC protocol according to the contention graph, we gain the maximum transmission rate of TCP senders which can assure the TCP fairness.

articleTitle: Minimum Interference Model in Wireless Sensor Network for Foul Environment in Workshop and Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the low-rate radios used and the effects of wireless interferences in workshop and warehouse's foul environment, traditional workshop and warehouse informatization system has many defaults, such as, manual business process management, information flowing delay after material flowing, high mistakes ratio, stacking and crane job schedule in a state of chaos, very much production waste, and hard to manage the storage. In this paper, First, we propose a technique to evaluate the quality of wireless signal in workshop and warehouse. Second, we propose a minimum interference model in wireless sensor network by discovering zone-disjoint paths for wireless signal, assigning a particular channel based on a channel assignment algorithm. With our prototype provide high-quality wireless signal in workshop and warehouse, workers can use wireless PDA follow the intelligently instruction to do multi-process material-flow-job scheduling, calculation and allocation of storage space, storage monitor, and production execution monitor.

articleTitle: A New Information Security Model Based on Network Service Protection
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional security model, aimed at ensuring privacy and integrity of information, has limitations on special networks such as the electric power information network, which emphasizes the stable operation and cooperation of the electricity service. Then a new idea on protection of network service security is proposed in this paper. Firstly, divide the network service into two parts as processes and data with security identifiers given respectively. The non-alterability of implementation logic in network service holds to ensure the continuous and stable operation of the service. Then the licensed access to data is implemented by comparison of the security identifiers of processes and data. In the end, a new information security model based on the network service protection is established, followed with the security features and possible implementation.

articleTitle: Honeycomb Architecture for Energy Minimum-Cost in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The focus of Wireless sensor networks is how to use limited energy to be able to make the network more effectively. Therefore, energy-saving research has becoming a major focus of recent research, and the network topology control is a part of energy-saving research, We propose that the sensor field be overlaid with a honeycomb virtual mesh based on a tessellation. Based on this cellular structure, we transmitted the data in the form of Packet forwarding. And we can save energy to prolong the life time of the Wireless Sensor Networks.

articleTitle: A Concept for QoS Integration in Trusted and Autonomic Service Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In a dynamic e-Business environment, constructing Virtual Society (VS) by creating Service cooperation has become the mainstream approach for reforming the development of application software systems. And e-contract is one of the important ways to support autonomic service cooperation. However, because of the inherent non-controllability of agents across different management domains, this approach has been confronted with the challenge of so-called "trust" crisis. This crisis has worried the research of autonomic computing and multi-agent systems for a long time. At the same time, with the growing popularity of autonomic service oriented cooperation, a general QoS support for services will play an important role for the success of this emerging technology. Unfortunately, current autonomic service cooperation does not offer comprehensive QoS support. In this paper, based on the previous work, we present a extended model for Trusted and Autonomic Service Cooperation integrated with QoS definition and management process, called TASC, which does not only eliminate the dilemma that the requirements of "Autonomy" and "Trust" conflict with each other, but also enable the QoS integration in Web services. It measures and monitors the QoS parameters, checks the agreed-upon service levels, and reports violations to the authorized parties involved in the autonomic service cooperation management process.

articleTitle: Investigating the Impact of Financial Crisis on Online Retail
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many experts believe the global financial crisis in 2008 is the worst of its kind since the Great Depression in 1929. The crisis was started from housing market in the US and spread into financial markets. It had a ripple effect around the world and many other industrialized economies were troubled by its consequences and almost every industry has influenced by its outcomes. Online retail (or B2C e-Commerce) as a part of retail industry was not immune from the financial crisis. This paper investigates how the financial crisis has affected online retail industry. This paper uses the US statistics but it can be generalized to rest of developed countries. By discussing the statistics provided by department of commerce of the US, it is found that financial crisis has caused the online retail sales to decline. After that the reasons of decline in online retail sales are presented and a discussion about why the impact of financial crisis affects traditional retail harder than online retail is developed.
