Finally several solutions are recommended to prevent any further decline in the industry sales.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Instructional E-Portfolio System with Web2.0 and Google Services
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of the previous case study of e-portfolio based on web2.0 and Google services, this paper, according to analyzing the opportunity provided by the web2.0 and Google services into instructional application in the perspective of e-portfolio assessment, constructs a practical instructional e-portfolio system, using web2.0 tools and Google services, and presents the concrete constructing progress, and then the paper illustrates the application progress in teaching and learning the curricula of Visual Basic Program Design in order to show how to utilize the instructional e-portfolio system based on web2.0 tools and Google services in concrete curriculum.

articleTitle: Codebook Based Beamforming in MIMO Broadcast Channels with Finite Rate Feedback
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In multiple-antenna broadcast channels, if the transmitter has no perfect channel state information (CSI), feedbacks are usually needed from the receivers. When the number of receivers is small, fixed feedback will lead to a sum rate ceiling as the SNR increases. In this paper, we analyze the methods to increase the throughput in codebook based feedback in MIMO broadcast channels. Three codebooks are used for comparison and the results show that, using finer codebook and regularized zero-forcing can increase the system's throughput. However, the sum rate ceiling still exists as long as fixed feedback is used. Feedback bits increase along with SNR seems to be the only way to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Supplier Management Practice in China: Case Studies on Manufacturing Organizations
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: One important aspect of supply chain management is supplier management. As many manufacturers are concentrating on their core competences, they need to gain a competitive edge from their supply side through effective supplier management. Based on the results of case studies at six Chinese manufacturers that recently implemented supplier management, this paper finds that although the six examined firms are cautious about supplier selection, they lay little emphasis on supplier performance evaluation and the supply base turns out to be larger as the business grows. However, there is no strong move towards reducing the supplier base at the six study companies, which is partly due to lack of support from supplier performance measuring.

articleTitle: A Reliable Wireless Communication Protocol for Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless sensor networks can be used in industrial applications to overcome some limits of wired fieldbuses. This paper proposed a reliable wireless communication protocol (RWCP) for industrial applications. Protocol design focused on network reliability and power consumption. Reliability was improved by creating redundant links dynamically. Deterministic communication was provided through super frame scheduling. Overhearing was avoided by periodically sleeping. RWCP was implemented and simulated according to the design. The simulation result showed that RWCP can improve the reliability of network communication, and has lower power consumption than other protocols.

articleTitle: Feature Selection with Maximum Information Metric in Text Categorization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Text categorization usually suffers from a huge-scale number of features. Most of those are irrelevant and noise which could mislead the classifier. In order to improve the efficiency and effectiveness for text categorization, feature selection is often performed. In this paper, a novel feature selection approach for dealing with text categorization, called Maximum Information Metric (MIM), is proposed to get good quality terms of documents. This method exploits the weight of term and document frequency to construct the correlation between a term and each class. It aims to maximize the differences of term over each class based on information theory. We design a better evaluation function to yield a kind of ranking of the features. Experimental results on the standard Reuters-21578 and 20-Newsgroups corpus show that the new feature selection approach outperforms the classic methods including Information Gain (IG), Chi-square statistic (CHI) in a context of text categorization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design Wireless Data Transmission System for Small Hydropower Stations Based on nRF24L01
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model of Going-Concern - From the Viewpoint of Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The export-oriented firms face a lot of international environmental pressure due to the regulations of international environmental protection enacted by developed countries. Therefore, this paper based on the viewpoint of sustainable development attempts to establish the prediction model of going-concern of Taiwan including environmental indicators, financial indicators and corporate governance indicator. Making use of logistic regression model carried out empirical research. The results of this study are as follows: first, liability ratio, return on assets, cash flow ratio and percentage of ownership held by the directors and supervisor have information content for the prediction of going-concern; second, the results of this study provided partial support for the environmental indicators, the behavior of penalty and indemnity due to environmental pollution and the transparency of environmental information provide information content in the prediction model of going-concern.

articleTitle: Locality Preserving Embedding
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Most manifold learning based methods preserve the original neighbor relationships to pursue the discriminating power. Thus, structure information of data distribution might be neglected and destroyed in low-dimensional space in a sense. In this paper, a novel supervised method, called Locality Preserving Embedding (LPE), is proposed to feature extraction and dimensionality reduction. LPE gives a low-dimensional embedding and preserves principal structure information of the local sub-manifolds. The most significant difference from existing methods is that LPE takes the distribution directions of local neighbor data into account and preserves them in low-dimensional subspace instead of only preserving the each local sub-manifold's original neighbor relationships. Therefore, LPE optimally preserves both the local sub-manifold's original neighbor relations and the distribution direction of local neighbors to separate different sub-manifolds as far as possible. The proposed LPE is applied to face recognition on the ORL and Yale face database. The experimental results show that LPE consistently outperforms the-state-of-art linear methods such as Marginal Fisher Analysis (MFA) and Constrained Maximum Variance Mapping (CMVM).

articleTitle: Negotiation-Based Trust Establishment for Shibboleth
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In frameworks of Shibboleth, if the identity provider (IdP) receives a request from the service provider (SP), before sending back the response, it must verify the SP's identity by its metadata file. The same as in SP. However, these metadata files are stored in local and if the metadata file is modified hostilely, the trust establishment will be damaged. We focus on Shibboleth and propose a solution of trust establishment between an IdP and a SP for Shibboleth. While in the conventional framework of Shibboleth trust establishment is done by local metadata file, in our solution trust establishment is done by negotiation, an SP or IdP requests the discovery service (DS) whether the provider is trusty, then the DS returns either "true" or "false" to the SP or IdP.

articleTitle: The Research and Realization of TA (NIM) System of National Atomic Time Standard of China
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: TA (NIM) system which is the latest atomic time system was constructed in NIM (National Institute of Metrology) in 2008 to improve the standard of atomic time and the frequency stability and accuracy of China. In this system, the H-maser is reference clock which is steered directly by cesium fountain clock, and local atomic time TA (NIM) is generated by algorithm. The technical scheme of TA (NIM) system was studied in detail, which includes instrument and equipment, working principle of system and algorithm design. And also the software in the system has been completed under the present condition of the timekeeping laboratory. After the operation of the TA (NIM) system and software for half an year, the intercomparison of TA (NIM),TAI and UTC (NIST) showed that the TA (NIM) system is the optimal under the present condition of laboratory. There are two advantages in the TA (NIM) system. Firstly, time stability of one day is lower than 1ns compared to UTC (NIST) and few countries can reach the standard. Secondly, frequency accuracy of long-term keeps the same as that of cesium fountain clock, and achieves 10-15 order, approaches to international standards.

articleTitle: Study on Construction of the Model of Collaborative Visual Learning Environment Based on Interactive Whiteboard
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of information technology, quality education are putting forward new requirements on teaching of the curriculums. Traditional teaching methods and learning environment show some obvious deficiencies in teaching certain courses because of the restrictions on the nature of their content. The emergence of interactive whiteboard is a revolutionary breakthrough in traditional mode in response to the information technology trends. This paper mainly focuses on the exploration of the way to improve the existing teaching of curriculums through constructing a model of collaborative visual learning environment based on interactive whiteboard.

articleTitle: Study on Credit Evaluation of Power Consumer Based on the Clustering Analysis and AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Effective credit management is critical to the power company in the market operation. As for the power company, predicting the credit level of power consumers in advance is the important premise of implementing differential service. On basis of establishing the index system of credit evaluation, this paper classifies a large number of power consumers quickly and objectively according to their preprocessed index data samples. Then the weight of each index is calculated flexibly with the method of AHP (analytic hierarchy process). At last, the credit score of each consumer group which can represent the credit level of all power consumers belonging to the group is computed according to the index data of the group center, thus the credit level of each consumer can be determined. Meanwhile, this paper also provides a calculation example analysis, the result of which shows that the method used in this paper is fast, accurate and effective.

articleTitle: Research of the Structure and Working Mechanisms of Wide-Area Backup Protection Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The multiple agents in wide-area backup protection system cooperate in parallel to detect and cut the fault quickly with narrow scope, using wide-area information. Based on wide-area backup protection algorithm, the structure and working mechanisms of wide-area protection agents are proposed. The agent's multi-layer structure with multi-component is constructed; as well as the working flow is analyzed. The cooperating associated scope which includes cooperative members is set up. Based on messages of data or request type, the equal coordination model is brought forward for wide-area protection agent. The cooperating strategies and joint rules which aim at the fault-tolerance are adopted to overcome the exiting and partial failure of one agent and refusal operation of relay, improving protection performance of whole system.

articleTitle: Research on Multiple Attribute Decision Making under Uncertainty Based on Grey Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multiple attribute decision-making theory under uncertainty is an important part of decision making theory, in this paper, a grey multiple attribute decision-making approach is proposed to study multi-criteria decision-making problems under uncertainty in which criteria values are interval gray numbers. Using grey related analysis as a means to reflect uncertainty in multiple attribute models through interval numbers. According to related theory, a non-risk standard expected value decision-making matrix can be obtained. Though determining the ideal grey relation reference sequence and non-ideal grey relation reference sequence, we can calculate the distance-proximity and angle-proximity of each alternative, and then the best alternative can be obtained by optimal membership degree which is based on distance-proximity and angle-proximity. At last the numerical illustrations prove the new model to be effective and scientific.

articleTitle: The Performance Merit of Dynamic Threshold Energy Detection Algorithm in Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In cognitive radio systems, secondary users should determine correctly whether the primary user is absent or not in a certain spectrum within a short detection period. Traditional spectrum sensing schemes based on fixed threshold are sensitive to noise uncertainty, a fractional fluctuate of average noise power in a short time will lead to the accuracy of spectrum detection decreasing seriously. In this paper we propose a novel dynamic threshold energy detection algorithm in cognitive radio systems. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the proposed strategy can combat the noise uncertainty effectively, and good detection accuracy can be attained, if a suitable detection threshold is chosen. That is, the proposed scheme can enhance the robustness of combating the noise uncertainty and veracities of the spectrum sensing.

articleTitle: The Research on Email Forensic Based Network
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to requirement of judicial forensic and diversity of network crime, a framework based on XML and plug-in techniques is proposed. The framework uses plug-in technique which ensures the framework has good extensibility; meanwhile, the framework adopts encrypt and authentication technology which ensures collected evidence can be accepted by court. Subsequently, based on this framework, an algorithm on email forensic is proposed, and by means of fuzzy matching the algorithm can analysis email information from network packets on SMTP protocol and HTTP protocol.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High-Performance Modular Exponentiation Arithmetic Unit
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the design and implementation of a high-performance modular exponentiation arithmetic unit based on Montgomery algorithm and FIPS method. We present an effective method of improving FIPS pipeline efficiency and optimizing the memory occupation. First, create multiple data paths to the multipliers input ports to use the units in multiplex; second, insert the zero value into the pipeline data sequence without generating additional memory space to store the temporary products; third, organize the inter-RAMs' data sharing and iteration by FSM to keep smallest memory usage. It finally performs a high-speed and space-efficient modular exponentiation arithmetic unit. The design has been verified on Xilinx Virtex-5 FPGA platform with maximum frequency of 142MHz, only occupying eight 32×32 (1Kb) Dual-Prot Block RAMs totally. 1024-bit modular exponentiation can reach the speed of 123.15Kbps.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Variation between US FDI in China and Sino-American Trade
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper carries on an empirical research dynamically on US foreign direct investment in China and Sino-American trade, adopting Johansen cointegration test, the VEC Model, Granger Causality Test and implus response technology, based on analytical quarterly data in the period from 1995 to 2009. The studying result demonstrates that there is a stable relationship among the US foreign direct investment in China, China's GDP and Sino-American trade. The implus of US foreign direct investment in China and Sino-American trade makes China's GDP a long-term volatility.

articleTitle: Estimation Methods for GPS Kinematical Positioning and Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The characteristics of three GPS kinematical data processing models, Least Square, Kalman filtering, and Semiparametric model are discussed and their advantages and disadvantages are compared. With observational data and pertinent data processing software, the applicable condition, context and effect of the three models are experimented. Results show that when the mobile platform is in uniform motion, the accuracy of the three models are almost equal; when the mobile platform is in stochastic acceleration, the accuracy of Semiparametric model is superior to that of LS, and that of Kalman filtering is the worst.

articleTitle: Computational Reconstruction Three-Dimensional Object Using Integral Imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: 3-D scene reconstruction and visualization has become a subject of research for many years because of its wide range of applications. Among various approaches, integral imaging is a promising way to realize 3-D natural scene reconstruction. Current researches in this area focus on the free view synthesis from the elemental images. In this paper, instead of generation of free views of 3-D natural scene, a method of computational reconstruction of 3-D object by calculating the position of each voxel is proposed. The reconstructed 3-D object is demonstrated to have high accuracy in shape as well as detailed texture information. In addition, it can also be converted into a standard virtual reality model under the principle of computer graphics.

articleTitle: A Research and Improvement Based on Rijndael Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: S-box is the only non-linear operation of the AES algorithm, it directly determines the performance and security of the algorithm. For that S-box's iterative output cycle is not more than 88, but has nine algebraic expressions as well as the efficiency of AES algorithm cannot meet the need of network storage, we proposed improved programs, and construct a new S-box. After the improvement, iterative output cycle is 256, and algebraic expression reached 254 items. The implementation efficiency of the algorithm has improved nearly 40%.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study on Customer Collaborative Product Innovation System of Knowledge-Driven
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: RF Power Amplifier Linearization Method Based on Quadrature Nonlinear Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the predistortion power amplifier linearization system, output of the power amplifier must be feedback to acquire the nonlinear distortion information. After quadrature demodulation, usually both the in-phase and quadrature part of the feedback complex signal should be sampled. This paper proposed a novel predistortion linearization method based on the quadrature nonlinear model, which needs only the in-phase or quadrature part of the feedback complex signal, so the hardware costs can be reduced. Simulation results show the effectiveness of this method for suppressing the spectrum regrowth caused by the nonlinearity of the power amplifier.

articleTitle: The Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Mechanism Based on Bayesian Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a Collaborative filtering recommendation method based on Bayesian theory. It firstly divides the items that has been rated into two group, then uses Bayesian theory to study the users' preference. And analyze the degrees of the users' preference for the items' inherent characteristics. Then judge which group the item that has not been rated belongs to. At last It computes the similarities of ratings in the cluster which it belong to. Because it searches less, it can improve the response time. The problem of scalability and Real-time was resolved. Finally, we experimentally evaluate our result and compare them to the traditional item-based algorithms. Our experiments showed that this algorithm could effectively improve the real-time performance of recommendation systems.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Dual-Mode Traffic Lights System Design
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Red-Green light system is an important traffic control system, widely used in urban traffic management. Traffic light control systems need to achieve automatic control function at the junction changes. Traffic lights control system designed by single-chip computer work at a single mode, it is not easy to be upgraded or change device size. The reliability is low, slow and difficult to adapt the traffic flow at different times of the daily changes. Dual-Mode Traffic Light Control System based on the different times of intelligent control of traffic lights-off time for the various road junctions improves the efficiency of the junction scheduling. FPGA Design Based on dual-mode traffic light control system has a simple circuit, high reliability and computing speed, scalability, as well as reconfiguration of good characteristics.

articleTitle: Round Trip Time Estimation Based on Adaptive Filtering
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To improve the performance of TCP transmission, round-trip time (RTT) estimation is often adopted as an effective approach. There exist many positive or passive methods for RTT estimation, but rarely of them take account of RTT's self-similarity which should not be ignored. In this paper, a new RTT estimation algorithm employing adaptive filtering is proposed. The algorithm is based on RTT's self-similarity. It uses the preceding values of RTT for its prediction. It is illustrated by simulation on NS-2 that our algorithm can predict well, especially in scenarios where the link state changes suddenly. Comparing with other RTT methods, this method is more simple and easier to be transplanted to online systems.

articleTitle: An Improved Strategy for Object-Oriented Multi-Scale Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to enhance the accuracy of classification of high-resolution remote sensing data, it is necessary to utilize the rich scale-dependent information and geographical information contained in high-resolution image. In this paper, an improved object oriented multi-scale image segmentation method based on the mean shift and the fractal net evolution approach (FNEA) is introduced. In this method, the useful information contained in high-resolution image is utilized, and the efficiency of segmentation is also considered. Besides, the experiment in this paper shows that it is effective for extracting feature ground object whose feature is obvious in the original image. While, after this improved segmentation, the number of image object is less compare with the traditional FNEA, which would be helpful for the following classification.

articleTitle: Production Tracking and Mass Balance in a Refinery Based on Manufacturing Operations Management and Data Reconciliation
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a production tracking and mass balance method in a refinery based on the framework of manufacturing operation management which is defined in prominent international standard IEC/ISO 62264. Based on the product network constraints determined from production dispatching and product quantities from production data collection, a data reconciliation approach based on Support Vector regression is applied to obtain the mass balance. A practice application example shows our approach is efficient and reasonable.

articleTitle: Software Sensor Based on Aspect Recombination for Avionics System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The major approaches to monitor the software environment is software sensor. This paper proposed a kind of software sensor, which is based on environment-aware. Considering the efficiency of the sensor monitoring, we made the identification of concern point and separation of aspects in avionics system, and carried out the aspects recombinant by software sensors implantation. Finally, sensors are embedded in the software system with the weaving aspect. An application on fault diagnosis of INS/GNSS software system illustrates that the new method is significance for location and occasion of the sensors implantation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Method of analog circuit fault diagnosis based on ANN (artificial neural network) and ES (expert system) is proposed according to the recent development of modern electronic testing technology and artificial intelligence. The structure and organizing of fault diagnosis system on analog circuit and its feasibility is mainly illustrated, and the platform of software based on Labview and Matlab is developed. Through the software, the system can manage its two main function module which are auto measurement module and fault diagnosis module working on an environment orderly. If a test program is loaded into the software platform, the corresponding circuit will be measured automatically. It is shown that the software platform has friendly interface, complete function and content with the need of intelligent fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Triple I Method with the FMP Consistency of Multiple, Multidimensional Fuzzy Inference
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a triple I method with the FMP consistency of multiple, multidimensional fuzzy inference is proposed by utilizing similarity measure to endow each rule with the weight.

articleTitle: Investment Decision-Making of Construction Projects Based on Modified Risk-Adjusted Discount Rate
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A fundamental tool used to optimize investment decision-making of projects with different construction periods and risks is risk-adjusted discount rate. However, there are some shortcomings of this method, such as difficulty in adjust the discount rates and exaggeration of long-term risks. The objective of this paper is to modify it and to find a better way to assist investment decision-making of construction projects. Firstly, factors contributing to risks of construction projects will be listed and scored by experts, according to which the total degree of risks that will be determined by Analytic Hierarchy Process. Secondly, risk-adjusted discount rate(r)=risk-free rate of return(i) +unit risk premium(b)×total degree of risks(Q). In addition, the critical point of decision-making will be brought in and there is an real-life example to illustrate this decision-making process.

articleTitle: Function Design of GIS Technology in "Emergency-Aid System"
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Supervising system of safety in production takes on the supervision duty in the safety production field all over China. It is a question how to free the supervisors from heavy and fruitless daily work by relying on modern information technology and help them to make real contribution in these aspects, such as preventing accidents, reducing accidents, dealing with accidents scientifically and directing renewing and rebuilding work. This thesis put forward design on how to construct the safe production supervising and emergency-aid system including GIS platform.

articleTitle: A WEBGIS Vector Graphic Model Based on VML
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the conception of "The Digital Earth" been put forward and the developing of Internet, as an Internet-based geographic information service to provide users with, WebGIS is also developing rapidly. Moreover, the network transmission is the key issue of data showed in the WebGIS. To solve this problem, this paper provides a WebGIS vector graphic model based on VML. According to its own characteristics of vector graphics and VML, data transmission is very small, vector graphics of the client display quickly and efficiently. As we all know, with the accuracy of people's activities on the weather has become increasingly demanding, meteorological data has grown exponentially. How to provide the high-quality meteorological data of easy identification for the public and decision-making departments is becoming increasingly important. The structure of WebGIS vector graphic model has been applied to the XiaMen Bureau of Meteorology. It is to make the public more easily understand the weather, but also to meet day-to-day operations of the Bureau of Meteorology. The light WebGIS framework and its novel idea also can be applied to other domains.

articleTitle: Research on a New Case-Based Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new case-based teaching mode is put forward in this paper. The new case-based teaching mode is a teaching process that under teacher's guidance, students play the main body to collect information, choose case, analysis and show the case to the teacher and other students. Practice has proved that, compared with the traditional case teaching, this new case-based teaching mode can enhance the teaching efficiency and students' information collection ability as well as research capacity.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Emulation Based on Representative Network Behavior and Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Emulation modeling of computer networks is an effective technique for evaluating the performance of network, transport, and application-level protocols. Traffic generation is one of the key challenges in modeling and simulating the Internet. In this paper we present a Emulation system for controlled live traffic generation over given network. This work presents a platform, named Real Network Traffic Generation System Based on Typical Network Behavior and Protocols, which allows to simulate network real traffic. Network traffic generation is controllable and responsive. It can be used to evaluate or examine several network servers and establish live network traffic environment for network security experiment.

articleTitle: Effects of Information Resources on Awareness of Government Increasing Residents' Health
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The importance of informational databases is highly considered as major health concerns for vast majority of people widespread. This article illustrates different databases and their significance for food consumers. Some of the databases studied were US Department of Agriculture (USDA), Healthfinder, Nutrition and Cancer Prevention, Nutrition Insights and Food safety. For example the USDA database contains information about Food Guide Pyramid, U.S. Dietary Guidelines, Food and Dietary Intake Statistics, Food Assistance Programs, Food Safety and Recall information, Food Composition Database. Other mentioned databases include huge amount of data easily available for food consumers, food retailers, food manufacturer and government etc.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Behavior and Dynamical System Simulation of Crashworthy Arresting System in Waterborne Safety
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In waterborne safety management of sluice on Suzhou River estuary in Shanghai, the Crashworthy systems are used for ensuring the safety of sluice gate and the arresting net is the core system. It is the first time that the arresting net is used in engineering of waterborne safety. Dynamical system simulation and mechanical analysis of crashworthy arresting system are studied for waterborne safety of sluice on Suzhou River estuary in Shanghai. The axial stress distribution cures of main cables and nylons are drawn, and the boat's acceleration and reaction force are gained. According to the results of numerical simulation, mechanical properties in operating process are investigated, and the working principle of arresting system is introduced. A finite element model to simulate the arresting system is presented, and the results are contrasted by mechanics analysis. Through analyzing the results of simulation, the arresting system can effectively keep the going wrong boats off. The proposed method is shown to provide a reference to design of arresting system.

articleTitle: A Study on Urban Early Warning System against Exceptionally Severe Disasters
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently, due to the frequent occurrence of exceptionally severe disasters in cities, original urban early warning system has been unfit to latest requirements of the times. So a new urban early warning system needs to be constructed on the basis of both the digital technologies and the legal, institutional, fund, personnel and material guarantees of this system. The system construction should start with the establishment of monitoring and early warning mechanism, crisis management mechanism, mechanism of fluent information and its publicity and digital early warning mechanism so as to strengthen the entire construction work.

articleTitle: Optimum Design for Suction Chambers of Pipeline Pumps Based on Uniform Design and CFD
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the maximal velocity distribution uniformity, the minimal velocity-weighed average bias angle of the outlet section and the minimal hydraulic loss of the suction chamber, three optimum object functions of suction chambers of pipeline pumps are established. According to uniform design, ten optimum schemes are determined with the height H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and the length L as the optimum parameters, and internal flows of the pipeline pump in different schemes are simulated with steady flow hypothesis and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) commercial code FLUENT 6.2. At the same time, values of optimum object functions in different schemes are calculated. The regression analysis is applied to deal with optimum results, and three regression models of optimum object functions are established. By calculation, the best parameters are achieved when H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> equals to 75.00 mm and L equals to 215.00 mm. The research results can be used to instruct the chamber hydraulic design of pipeline pump and the optimization method also can be used to improve the performance of the other type pump suction chambers.

articleTitle: Research on the System Model of Government Knowledge Management Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Government Knowledge Management is helpful in raising the work efficiency of the government, enhancing the scientific nature of policy-making, and improving the satisfaction degree of the public. To overcome the deficiency of intelligence and personalization service of the existing Government Knowledge Management System (GKMS), the five-layer system architecture model based on multi-agent for GKMS is put forwarded in this paper. Each layer and its functions are described in detail. The overall layers cooperate with each other to provide the service of the heterogeneous knowledge integration, the knowledge push and the knowledge application and so on. And some key techniques of the system model realization are discussed.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm for Auto Scheduling and Adjusting
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For many existed course arrangement systems for college have some shortcomings, the paper introduce a intelligent and humanization algorithm for auto scheduling and adjusting. The principles of the algorithm include two dispersions, three non-conflicts, four priorities and five time patterns. By applying the VB (Visual Basic 6.0) programming language, SQL database, and programming ADO, the system is designed successfully. It has lots of advantages, such as fast arrangement, full use of instructional resources, reduced the relevant academic staff's unnecessary work and obtained wide application.

articleTitle: Distributed Watershed Concentration Flow Model Based on DEM
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Allowing for catchment hydrological effect due to spatial variability of precipitation and underlying topography, the catchment is divided into a number of basic units of concentration flow within only one channel link by the method of natural divide. The basic unit of concentration flow is regarded as a V-shaped structure, and a distributed watershed concentration flow model is built on a series of V-shaped units of catchment. In the model, geomophologic instantaneous nit hydrograph based on area-time curve methodology is used to simulate overlanflow concentration, and Musking mothodology is used to simulate river flood routing. The model is applied in Xingfeng river basin and the result is reasonable.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Reputation Management Framework for Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Although some reputation schemes have been proposed for ad hoc networks, they are still not the most suitable for WMNs due to the special infrastructure and communication mode in WMNs. In this paper, a hierarchical reputation management framework for WMNs is presented. We show how to collect and query reputation values in an accurate, secure and efficient manner. The correlation validation algorithm is presented to detect both clients' and routers' misbehavior and ensure reliable information aggregation. The simulation results show that our model performs well in terms of computational overload, detection accuracy, and scalability.

articleTitle: Indexed Option Based Valuation of Private Benefits of Control
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The benefits of control, also called voting right are treated as protective put options against the hired CEO's capability for the first time. The indexed option pricing model is used to estimate this value. However, the results show that the value of voting right is decreasing with the incumbent CEO's capability. Although the growth rate of the average capability of the professional manager market is exogenous, the value of the voting right is raising as the growth rate increases. This result can be used to as a reference of the determination of the premium price in corporate control market.

articleTitle: Constructing 3-Band Symmetric Cardinal Orthogonal Scaling Function
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The 3-band symmetric cardinal orthogonal scaling function with compact support is of interest in several applications. In this paper, we provide some characterizations of the 3-band symmetric cardinal orthogonal scaling function. We generalize some results of the symmetric cardinal orthogonal scaling function from the 2-band case to the 3-band case. Also, we find some new results.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Coarse Acquisition Code Generation Algorithm in GPS System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the coarse acquisition code (C/A code), which is for civil navigation, of the ranging codes for Global Positioning System (GPS) is studied, simulated and analyzed by the Use of Matlab. With the simulation results we can confirm the correctness of the method and feasibility, which is at simulation platform to further study on the real environment of GPS signal, so That it can capture the complexity of tracking the satellite signal environment, and improve the performance of satellite receiver.

articleTitle: The Impact of Chinese GUANXI Culture on the Stability of Cooperative Relations of Entrepreneurial Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the structure of cooperative relations of entrepreneurial supply chain (ESC) and the three -level influential factors of its stability. The factors of GUANXI culture have effect on the stability of cooperative relations of ESC. Then some assumptions are given based on the impact of GUANXI culture to these factors and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is used to test the assumptions. Finally, it comes to the conclusion that different elements of GUANXI cultural have different impact on the stability of cooperative relations of ESC.

articleTitle: Solution on Network Teaching System Based on Open Source Framework
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve the ease of use and performance requirements of the network teaching system, a solution based on open source framework of Spring, Hibernate and JavaServer Faces (JSF) is proposed. The generics DAO schema is introduced into the data persistence layer and the rich UI components of development framework ICEfaces based on open-source Ajax are embedded in the presentation layer to meet the need of system. The practice shows that the improved method presented by this paper enables the architecture to provide high reusability, expansibility and maintainability, and improves system performance and human-computer interaction experience.

articleTitle: IF Filter Design and Implementation of FPGA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the field of digital signal processing, using FPGA digital front-end technology in order to complete the process of IF filtering is a way of software radio implementation. According to the author's ideas based on the hardware implementation of digital IF in a gsm system, this paper introduced a FPGA design and optimization in the direction of application in the system level.

articleTitle: Blind Source Separation Using Generalized Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel algorithm for blind separation of instantaneous linear mixtures of source signals is proposed. The proposed algorithm is based on the generalized singular value decomposition of a matrix pencil. We use a set of linear combinations of time-delayed correlation matrices to estimate the mixing matrix. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has better performance in accuracy comparing with TLS-ESPRIT algorithm.

articleTitle: Pondering and Practice of How to Build the Education Highland for the Civil Engineering Specialty in the Application-Oriented Universities
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The construction of university education highland is an important part of "085" engineering which is a connotation construction of university education in Shanghai. According to the actual situations of the civil engineering specialty in our school, this thesis researches initially the construction of the highland for university education from the aspects such as the development status quo of this specialty, the construction philosophy, the main issues to be solved, the main measures and general goals. It deems that the goal of educating innovative talents in the application-oriented universities can be enhanced and achieved by taking educating the innovative talents as its core and taking improving the teaching quality as its key point, as well as by enhancing the construction of its course system, optimizing its subject structure and constructing/completing its teaching appraisal system.

articleTitle: HHT Analysis of Height Influence on Blasting Vibration Parameters under Rocky Slope
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through Hilbert-Huang transform analysis of signals from different height of the rocky slope, law and amplification cause of peak particle velocity and frequency spectrum of blasting seismic wave in three directions were studied. On basis of energy damage mechanism, damage analysis of rocky slope under blast load from view of momentary input energy shows that total input energy and the maximum momentary input energy are dominant in horizontal radial direction of 56m height, followed by horizontal direction of 32m height and vertical components in low height range of the slope.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of UML in Virtual Laboratory System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the virtual laboratory system as a research object carries out the needs analysis and the problem domain analysis about the system with the use of UML, establish the static and dynamic behavior model, object class diagram and physical component diagram, make an overview about the UML modeling mechanism of the system, achieve a complete modeling process of the virtual laboratory system.

articleTitle: A Novel Shape Descriptor: Gaussian Curvature Moment Invariants
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The moment descriptor is combined with Gaussian curvature for three-dimensional shape representation and a novel three-dimensional shape descriptor combined local with global representations is proposed in this paper. Normalization process to the new moment invariants is presented and their independence to the translation, rotation and scaling transforms is proved. Experiments indicate a better classification result to objects with slight different shape characteristic compared with some traditional approaches without increasing the running complexity.

articleTitle: A Review of Error Resilience Technique for Video Coding Using Concealment
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional error resilience technique has been widely used in video coding. Many literatures have shown that with the technique's help, the video coding bitstream can been protected and the reconstructed image will get high improvement. In this paper, we review the error resilience for video coding and give the improvement of this new technology. These techniques are based on coding simultaneously for synchronization and error protection or detection. We apply the techniques to improve the performance of the multiplexing protocol and also to improve the robustness of the coded video. The techniques proposed for the video also have the advantage of simple transcoding with bit streams complying in H.263.

articleTitle: Research on a Reference Electronic Business Model for Construction Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The era of electronic commerce makes the development of electronic business be the focus of informazation of construction industry. The identification of the concept of electronic business focusing on reality practice is utilized in construction enterprises for reinforcing management theories and application foundation of electronic business models. According to multi-aspect requirement analyses of electronic business, organization management patterns, the range of enterprise business process, this paper proposes a reference model whose logical structure and core business process support the transformation from a general business performance to the integration of web-based external and electronic-oriented internal business modes in construction enterprises.

articleTitle: Design of a High Security GSM/UMTS Inter-System
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: GSM and UMTS mobile radio network will coexist for a few years. Security of interoperation between GSM and UMTS becomes more important. This paper proposes a high security GSM/UMTS inter-system which supports all possible network roaming and provides high security service for both GSM and UMTS subscriber. The paper discusses the architecture of proposed system and authentication procedure in different network environment. The high security GSM/UMTS is efficient in GSM and UMTS coexistence environment in future through a comparison with previous GSM/UMTS inter-system.

articleTitle: Top Executives Pays, Sorting, Training and Efficiency between the United States and Japan
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are notable differences in executive pays, sorting and training, and the same social efficiency between the United States and Japan. In America, (1) executives compensations are much higher than Japanese counterparts, (2) top executives are chosen from the internal or external candidates, while top executives are mainly promoted internally in Japan, as showed in labor mobility, (3) there is a lower level of firm-sponsored training than that in Japan. Although there are notable differences in top executives' management, the same economy achievements are acquired in both the United States and Japan. By model analysis, I have found manager general ability contribution and specific ability and managerial labor market affects top executive pays, sorting, training, firm profits and social efficiency. Just so, American manager compensations are much more than Japanese counterparts; compared to American companies, Japanese firms would more like choose a manger from inside and provide training to the manger. Because of many kinds of factors counteracting each other, there is no obvious difference in social efficiency between the United States and Japan.

articleTitle: Robust Digital Watermarking Adopting Barcode in Image
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new barcode watermarking algorithm in Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) domain is proposed. The algorithm utilizes the visual masking and texture characteristics of Human Visual System (HVS) to achieve the invisible and robust requirements for watermarking. In addition, a barcode which consist vertical bars and numbers is taken as the watermark embedded into the host image. Numbers in the barcode were separated from the barcode by using DWT and enhanced before embedded. Thus the watermark scheme possesses more robustness and security. The experiment results show that the algorithm is robust to common digital image processing methods and the image's quality is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Discussions on Cultivation Patterns of Practical Skilled Talents
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Railway informationization has the characteristics of "large coverage scope, crossover and associated information, and standard and orderly system", railway information has higher requirements on practical skilled talents, and the higher vocational colleges must completely integrate talent cultivation modes from teaching idea, curricula system, teaching mode and teaching methods. The thesis proposes the cultivation mode of "large platform, small module, fuzzy group, and re-orientation", with the purpose of cultivating the students to form the knowledge structure of "one major, multiple skills and broad knowledge domains", make efforts to reach "one major, and capable of 2 or 3 other majors, and jack of all trades", so as to adapt to the fast railway development.

articleTitle: Spread of Cross-Border Pollution and Response Time for an Accidental Instantaneous Explosion and Continuous Leakage of Liquefied Chlorine
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cross-border air pollution from an instantaneous explosion and continuous leakage of liquefied chlorine was investigated using the SLAB model. The maximum allowable concentration of chlorine for short-term exposure and the maximum allowable concentration of harmful substances (for one-time exposure) in residential areas were selected as standards. Typical weather conditions used were D stability with a wind speed of 3 m/s and F stability with a wind speed of 1.5 m/s. The results show that the relationship between the quantity of explosive or leakage rate for liquefied chlorine and the spread of pollution satisfy power functions and that the relationship between the spread of pollution and the arrival time of pollution is linear. This study provides a basis for early warning of and emergency response to cross-border pollution from the release of liquefied chlorine.

articleTitle: A Native XML Storage Scheme Seamlessly Integrated with Relational Databases
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the promotion and application of XML standards, an increasing number of organizations and institutions are using XML in their information management and data exchange. The classic problem of data management has emerged, namely, how to effectively store, retrieve, index, query and update the XML documents. This paper presents a native XML storage scheme seamlessly integrated with relational database, whose central idea is to take advantage of effective XML node numbering scheme to support XML data model over relational table. Firstly, this relational table of XML nodes is a non-destructive mapping of XML data model; Secondly, the storage scheme maximize the reuse of the underlying storage mechanism existing in relational database, which guarantees the transaction processing, log and recovery management, concurrent control of XML data. Using a variety of data sets, we conduct experiments on this scheme and previous XML storage schemes to compare the storage space, storage time and publication time between them. Experimental results show that our storage scheme is a high-performance XML storage scheme.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Image Reconstruction Based on the Minimal Surface Regularization
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The super-resolution image reconstruction is an ill-posed problem, which need regularizing during the reconstruction. A new regularization algorithm is presented, which regards the super-resolution image as a surface in the three-dimensional Euclidean space, and the regularization constraint is that the reconstruct image has the minimal surface area. An energy functional based on the super-resolution image reconstruction model and the regularized minimal surface is drawn, and a partial differential equation presented via the calculus of variations. The equation is solved by an explicit iteration method. The experiment shows this algorithm could reconstruct the super-resolution image efficiently.

articleTitle: Double Channels of Frequency Division Signal Source Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the principle of the direct digital frequency synthesis (DDS) technology. Then the design scheme of sine signal source with the double channels of frequency division is presented based on EP2C5 produced by ALTERA. The conclusions drawn from the experimental results show that the output of the double channels sine signal source have characteristics of small waveform distortion, frequency accuracy. In addition, the frequency and the coefficient of frequency division are adjustable in real time.

articleTitle: Researches on the Cyclostationarity of MIMO OFDM Signals
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, cyclostationarity of the V-BLAST MIMO OFDM signal is examined based on the model of MIMO OFDM systems in the wireless communication channel and the theory of cyclostationarity. Mathematical deduction and simulation results are both shown that the received MIMO OFDM signals is cyclostationary in the wireless communication channel. Meanwhile, if the received signal is sampled at the data rate, a cyclostationary sequence can be obtained. And if the received signal is oversampled, then a cyclostationary sequence with its cyclic period magnified along with the oversampled rate.

articleTitle: A Multi-Granularity Annotation Management and Multi-Scale Provenance Compression Technique for Data Streams
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we propose a new technique for multi-granularity provenance annotation management and multi-scale provenance compression applied to data streams. First of all, we propose a new mgp-SQL syntax system based on some studies. The construction and propagation of data provenance annotations in three different granularities have been described in this paper. Provenance of multiple granularities can be propagated in the process of querying. Then, we introduce a compression method using DWT (Discreet Wavelet Transform) for data provenance carried by data streams. We have proposed a novel multi-scale conception for efficient storage which allows users to adjust compression ratio in the process of continuous querying. Thus, provenance annotations of a proper scale will be constructed and stored. Finally, we combine both techniques and present the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on the Effects of the Equity-Based Incentives for Risk Neutral Managers
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We assumed the managers are risk neutral, and use sensitivity to pay-performance to represent the effect on equity-based incentive. Then, we use the principal-agency model to compare the effect on restricted stock incentive with the effect on stock option incentive. We got the conclusion as following, the effect on restricted stock incentive is more than that on stock option incentive when grant price of restricted stock equals to exercise price of stock option, but the effect on stock option incentive is more than that on restricted stock incentive when grant price of restricted stock equals to zero. This conclusion will give some theoretic guidance for Chinese listed companies to choose the manner of equity-based incentive when they have finished their equity division reform.

articleTitle: Study on the Ecological Carrying Capacity in Mining Areas: A Case Study in Panxi Mining Concentrated Area
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The large-scale and super-strength development of mineral resources in mining concentrated area in long term has made great contributions to Chinese economic construction and development, but it has caused serious damage to the ecological environment even ecological imbalance at the same time. In this study, according to the characteristics of mining concentrated area, the scientific and practical ecological carrying capacity evaluation index system of mining concentrated area had been established. Taking Panxi mining concentrated area as an example, using remote sensing and GIS technology, applying remote sensing image and Statistical data, the ecological environment evaluation data of mining areas was extracted effectively. For the non-linear relationship between the evaluation indexes and the degree of ecological carrying capacity in study area, this study innovative took the evaluation of ecological carrying capacity of the study area by using artificial neural network whose training used SCE-UA algorithm that well overcome the slow learning and difficult convergence of traditional neural network algorithm. The results of ecological carrying capacity evaluation of the study area were objective, reasonable and the credibility was high. The results showed that the area distribution of five ecological carrying capacity grade types was basically normal, and the overall ecological environment situation of Panxi mining concentrated area was in the middle level, the degree of ecological carrying capacity in the north was higher than the south, and mining activities were dominant factors to cause eco-environmental damage and ecological carrying capacity. In this study, a comprehensive theory and technology system of regional ecological carrying capacity evaluation which included the establishment of ecological carrying capacity evaluation index system, processing of evaluation data and establishing of evaluation model. New ideas and methods had provided for ecological carrying capacity of mining concentrated area.

articleTitle: Computational Symbolic Approach to Constitutive Equation of Liquid Crystalline Polymer - Anisotropic Viscoelastic Fluid
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The computer software, such as Maple is used to construct constitutive equation of liquid crystalline polymer - anisotropic viscoelastic fluid. The analytical expressions of material functions are obtained by computer software Maple. A new continue theory is developed for the anisotropic fluid. Tube flow of the drilling liquid is studied by Maple.

articleTitle: The Research of Generating Secure Elliptic Curve over GF(p)
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Generating a secure elliptic curve is complicated and there are only a few algorithms for some special elliptic curves at present. In this paper an algorithm of generating an elliptic curve over prime field GF (p) with a prime number order is discussed. Another algorithm of generating an elliptic curve with an order which equals to the product of two prime numbers is proposed.

articleTitle: The Reasons of Diversification Discount
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed the reasons of diversification discount. The investigation has been performed using panel data procedure for a sample of 320 Chinese companies listed on Shanghai Stock Exchange over the span from 2001 to 2006. We find that diversification discount have two main reasons. One is the high agency cost, the other is the cost inefficiency. So, for Chinese listed companies, we suggest that the implementation of the diversification strategy should be cautious.

articleTitle: Research on Railway Tunnel Duration Risk Assessment Based on the Improved PERT Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the railway tunnel construction network planning with the characteristics of Precedence Network (PN) and Parallel Path (PP), taking into account the classical PERT (Program Evaluation and Review Technology)model can only be used for general network planning risk assessment analysis. Introducing three conceptions into this article, named Virtual Time Procedure X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">jk</sub>, Correlation Path, Leading Path Respectively. Then, PN can be transformed into the general PERT of virtual time procedure X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">jk</sub>. On this basis, and further puts forward a modified general PERT method that use of the Influence of Leading Path on Correlation path to solve the problem of the PP. Based on the method, the improved PERT model used to railway tunnel duration risk assessment were put forward, and the proposed model was applied to one tunnel (43.8 kilometers long two-lane ) in Fujian Province, two kinds of analysis cases were drafted, and make the result more acceptable to the Accurate MC method. The results show that The improved PERT model are of clear physical meaning, and which can solve the complex network of PN and PP; if there are no plans to consider the PP and PN, the calculated value of the expectations of small period, large variance; By accurate MC methods and the use of this paper to propose the analysis of PERT model, the result is closer to, and thus the improved PERT model has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Explanation of Business Group Building: An Empirical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we investigate how business group is built from an emerging market perspective. We find that property rights, market development and financial institution are important determinants of business group. Business group is popular when investor protection is weak; the less developed the market, the more possible to build up business group; and the development of financial institution reduces the incentive of group formation.

articleTitle: Measuring Market Risk of China Wheat Futures Based on AAVS-CAViaR Model
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering the asymmetry of return distributions and asymmetric impact of positive and negative returns on the quantiles, the paper puts forth a new conditional autoregressive value-at-risk by regression quantiles model with asymmetric absolute values and slops (AAVS-CAViaR) quantile specification for heavy-tail data applications. An empirical study on the evolution patterns of market risk of wheat futures in Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange is performed. The dynamic quantile test, the regression quantile criteria and back testing results support our new model works well. It is found that the asymmetric impacts of price news on the quantiles of returns exist in Chinese wheat futures market. A rule to select proper VaR predicting model is suggested, and we also find AAVS model performs better than indirect GARCH model for our selected sample.

articleTitle: Nonstandard Employing Knowledge Worker's Organizational Citizenship Behavior: A Comparative Research Based on Different Employment Types
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Recent years, nonstandard employment has been coming an important method for organization to increase its flexible ability. Especial the nonstandard employing knowledge workers have been the vital part of organization's core competition. However nonstandard employing knowledge workers have different features and working context comparing with standard employing knowledge workers, which will affect their Organizational Citizenship Behavior (OCB) that is important attitude and behavior available to organizational performance. This research investigates the difference between standard and nonstandard employment knowledge worker's OCB and among different nonstandard employment types by empirical study. The results show the standard employment knowledge workers' OCB are higher than nonstandard employee's generally, and among the nonstandard employment types, the OCB are different.

articleTitle: The Application of Wavelet Transform for Lamb Wave Tomography
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An application for Lamb Waves Tomography (LWT) was presented using time-frequency analysis. By the interaction of Lamb wave and defects, there would be several modes, which were likely to result in the overlap of echoes in time domain. Based on wavelet transform, in this paper, arrival time of the Lamb waves was extracted accurately in time-frequency domain, and this method facilitated to get wave arrival time of wave energy easier and more accurate than others before. Wavelet transform was a better way to incorporate time-frequency analysis into tomography algorithms in order to improve image quality.

articleTitle: Research Development on the Systematic Application of Software Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the status quo of software quality management and related theories we compare and analyze the two primary quality management systems - ISO9001 and CMMI (Capability Maturity Model Integration). Then, Give discussions on the importance and possibility of synergizing the two. The conclusion is utilizing the two systems by interpreting CMMI by the form of ISO, and arranging them properly, so as to decrease the cost of repeated approval.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Architecture for Information Fusion Platform in Coal Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: How to integrate and analyse vast production and management information plays a very important role for coal enterprise. A multi-level coal enterprise integrated information fusion platform is put forward based on multi-agent system technology, a distributed information fusion model is proposed, Multi-agent framework and coordination mechanism of different agents in the architecture are discussed. The platform can integrate the isolated application system of coal enterprise and fuse the various information under heterogeneous environment efficiently.

articleTitle: Modeling Analysis of Frequency Lottery-Buyer's Behavior
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Frequency lottery- buyer's consumer behaviors are personalized, initiative and irrational. By surveying, collecting the frequency consumer behavioral information, and constructing structural equation modeling. In conclusion, individual socio-economic status affects gambling behavior through motives and self-limited rationality, while micro-environment has a direct impact on gambling behavior.

articleTitle: Effects of Ammoniating Pressures on Structure of Stem Tissues of Rice Straw
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fast ammoniating system is a new ammoniated instrument. In the system, rice straw can be ammoniated under different pressures of gaseous ammonia. This study was conducted to investigate the effects of different pressures on the structure of rice straw stem tissues after being ammoniated in the system. In this experiment, rice straw was ammoniated in the fast ammoniating system, and the pressures were set as follows: 0MPa [control], 0.1MPa, 0.2MPa and 0.3MPa, for 1 hour, respectively. The histological changes of tissues of rice straw stem were observed by an scanning electron microscopy [SEM]. The results showed the histological structure of rice straw stem had different changes after ammoniation: straw stems were physically compressed and distorted. Sclerenchymal tissue was little distorted, but the thin ground parenchymal tissue was compressed and distorted significantly. The extent of changes increased as the pressures increased. There was little change in the epidermis structure with the treatments. In conclusion, the rice straw stem tissues had different distortion after ammoniation under different pressures in fast ammoniating system, and the extent of histological distortion increased as the pressure increased.

articleTitle: Robust Stabilization of a Class of Unmatched Uncertainties Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a smooth and simple robust tracking controller for a class of nonlinear systems with unmatched uncertainties. The designed controller can be the concrete expression including no Lyapunov functions and no norm computing in each step of control and can suppress forwardly the influence of uncertainties. The practical stability of output tracking error and the states of the corresponding closed-loop system are demonstrated by Lyapunov stability theorem. Finally, an illustrative example is given to demonstrate the utilization of the approach developed.

articleTitle: Dynamics of a Three-Population Food Chain Model with Impulsive Effect
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we consider a three-population food chain model which concerning about impulsive releasing predators (natural enemies) at fixed moment. By using the Floquet theory and the comparison theorem of impulsive differential equation, conditions for global asymptotic stability of pest-eradication periodic solution and permanence of the system are obtained. Finally, the explanation of its biological significance is given.

articleTitle: Realization and Optimization of Image Compression Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A high-speed image data compression system Based on high-speed TMS320VC5416DSP is presented; Hardware constitutes and working principle of the digital image processing is introduced. The basic principal of image encoding algorithm of JPEG is summarized and the realization of JPEG on DSP is expounded, especially the realization and optimization of DCT transform is discussed.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Relationship between Price and Trading Volume in Shanghai Securities Market
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Being the study on inner link of basis variables of securities exchange process, price and trading volume relationship research has practical significance to discovering market trading characteristic and operation regulation as well as provides theory guide to market trading mechanism improvement. Based on MDH, the authors carry out time division study on Shanghai securities market price and trading volume relationship using Granger cause inspection method and draw the conclusion that the market lies in two-way price and trading volume Granger cause relationship, and the market quality gains remarkable development due to trading mechanism reform. It also points out trading volume, especially information trading volume, has increasing explanation ability to price variation. In the end, the authors provide concrete suggestion on further trading mechanism reform.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Electricity Price Chain Based on Interpretative Structural Modeling
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Firstly, influencing factors of chain of electricity price were analyzed, and hierarchical structure chart for the relationship between influencing factors based on Interpretative Structural Modeling (ISM) was constructed. Then through delaminating influencing factors that graph, the levels and relationships among influencing factors of electricity price were shown intuitively, which provide basis for electric price management.

articleTitle: The Efficient Analysis of the CRM Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: People's living quality is rising gradually in the 21 century; the consciousness of serving for people is enhanced continuously. Customer's personal needing expectation toward products and services become higher and higher. In modernized enterprise, as the autoimmunization of production process and the management modernization of information network, information management plays a more and more important role in enterprises. The office autoimmunization degree, enterprises' management level, employee's computer application ability and enterprises' informational level in our country all have a substantial progress at the aspects of information technique and the management theoretic.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction for Cone-Beam Micro-CT by Fuzzy-Logic Based Non-Linear Filters
publicationTitle: 2009 First International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In Micro-CT, the smaller voxel requires much higher dose to achieve an adequate signal-to-noise ratio compared to clinical CT. Thus, it necessitates a method that reduces statistical noise in order to improve dose efficiency. We have developed a fuzzy-logic based non-linear Gaussian (NLG) filtering for smoothing projection data before reconstructed.
